source_text: blessed the kind-because they will find kindness.
target_text: dhèu dhu pad'elo rasa kasia mi dhèu leo, rèngu oto, lula èèna na, ama lamatua kasia rèngu kahèi.

source_text: blessed the clean in heart-because they will see god.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, rèngu oto, lula èèna na, rèngu unu ra ladhe rèdhi ama lamatua.

source_text: blessed the peacemakers-because they will be called sons of god.
target_text: dhèu dhu tema padame dhèu, rèngu oto, lula èèna na ama lamatua ka dhu peka na, ‘rèngu se'e ka, ana ja'a. '

source_text: blessed those persecuted for righteousness' sake-because theirs is the kingdom of the heavens.
target_text: dhèu dhu pasae j'aj'èra, lula ra madhutu ama lamatua, rèngu oto, lula lamatua mesa na ka, dhèu aae rèngu dhu hua iia.

source_text: blessed are you whenever they may reproach you, and may persecute, and may say any evil thing against you falsely for my sake-
target_text: ladhe dhèu leo paj'èra miu, lula miu madhutu ja'a, miu oto kahèi. ladhe dhèu padhai kaked'u miu, aa lole pa'ele iie kolongara miu, miu oto kahèi.

source_text: rejoice and be glad, because your reward is great in the heavens, for thus they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu hud'i pakasee iisi aa pakarej'e d'ara, lula ama lamatua dhu sadia nare le pala dhu ae hia miu ètu sorga. te ngaa sanèd'e! mesa boe miu di dhu dui j'aj'èra sèmi èèna, te lod'o uru sèra dhèu dhu paj'èra le kahèi dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: you are the salt of the earth, but if the salt may lose savor, in what will it be salted? it is good for nothing from now on, except to be cast outside, and to be trodden down by men.
target_text: ladhe èdhi d'èi sèna ka nganga'a j'aj'i be'a, na, èdhi tao ku masi. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, rèngu parluu miu. te ngaa ladhe masi sèro heka, gaguna na, ngaa? dhoka core eele di ètu j'ara, ho dhèu j'èli ne.

source_text: you are the light of the world, a city set on a mountain is not able to be hid;
target_text: miu hud'i mamuri ku sèmi labhu kahèi, sèna ka dhèu ae bisa ladhe rèdhi miu dènge be'a. miu hud'i heo lo'a-lo'a ku, nuka sèmi kota ètu kolo ledhe, dhu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi ne.

source_text: nor do they light a lamp and put it under the measure, but on the lampstand, and it shines to all those in the house;
target_text: ladhe dhèu paheo labhu iiki, ra saguru boe ne dènge èru rai, te ngaa ra padhèdi labhu ne ètu era dedha, ho pasaraa aa'i d'ara èmu.

source_text: so let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works, and may glorify your father who is in the heavens.
target_text: miu hud'i mamuri ku sèmi èèna. mamuri miu hud'i saraa ku, sèna ka dhèu leo ladhe rèdhi mamuri miu dhu be'a. ropa dhèu ladhe rèdhi mamuri miu sèmi èèna, ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua, peka na, ‘ira ii! ama miu ètu sorga, kapai titu kèna, nga! '

source_text: do not suppose that i came to throw down the law or the prophets-i did not come to throw down, but to fulfill;
target_text: mage miu pangee na, mamai ja'a asa rai-haha ne, sèna ka tao eele atora ama lamatua dhu pangèd'u mi musa. aa baku pangee na, ja'a pusi-pahae boe dènge ngaa dhu uru èèna, dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua peka tèke le. te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka pamèci j'ara aa'i-aa'i, nuka sèmi mia dhu ra peka tèke.

source_text: for truly i say to you, until the heaven and the earth may pass away, one iota or one tittle may not pass away from the law, until all may come to pass.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, nanene paie-iie! liru dènge rai-haha bisa mèka laho aa'i, ladhe aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i mèka madhutu atora ama lamatua. masi ka ca katèd'a èèna ka, bisa boe ele nèti atora se.

source_text: therefore whoever may loose one of these commands-the least-and may teach men so, he will be called least in the kingdom of the heavens, but whoever may do and may teach them, he will be called great in the kingdom of the heavens.
target_text: nèti dhèu unu ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i, ladhe abhu dhu sisu atora ama lamatua, lula na pangee, na, ‘atora ne, ana iiki-iiki di, de gaguna na aad'o! ' hèia na aj'a sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu leo, pe ama lamatua ètu sorga, tao ne j'aj'i mi ca dhèu ana iiki. te ngaa bagi mi dhèu dhu tao madhutu aa'i atora ama lamatua, hèia na aj'a-nori dhèu leo sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua pakab'ua ne.

source_text: for i say to you that if your righteousness may not abound above that of the scribes and pharisees, you may not enter into the kingdom of the heavens.
target_text: parcaya la ja'a! miu hud'i mamuri mola, risi nèti mese agama dènge dhèu partei agama parisi sèra. ladhe aad'o, na, miu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: you heard that it was said to the ancients: you will not murder, and whoever may murder will be in danger of the judgment;
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa dhu hia mi bèi-baki èdhi, peka na, ‘baku pamadhe dhèu, te dhèu cee dhu pamadhe dhèu nèngu lèke huku. '

source_text: but i say to you that everyone who is angry at his brother without cause will be in danger of the judgment, and whoever may say to his brother, stupid, will be in danger of the sanhedrin, and whoever may say, moron, will be in danger of the gehenna of fire.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku panasa, te dhèu cee dhu nasa dènge a'ari na, èèna na nèngu lèke huku. dhèu dhu jèke a'ari na, ka peka na, ‘èu bod'o kabao! ' pe nèngu la'e dhaa asa dhèu heka-dhèu heka agama. aa dhèu cee dhu jèke a'ari na, ‘goa, ee! ' nèngu lèke huku ètu ai naraka.

source_text: if, therefore, you may bring your gift to the altar, and there may remember that your brother has anything against you,
target_text: de ladhe èu dhu mèti mèdha persembahan hia ama lamatua, te ngaa èu sanèd'e, na, abhu a'ari dhu nasa era dènge èu,

source_text: leave there your gift before the altar, and go-first be reconciled to your brother, and then having come, bring your gift.
target_text: tèke eele uuru ku mèdha persembahan sèra. hèia lamu padame ku dènge a'ari mu, èle, na heka mai hia persembahan se asa ama lamatua kèna.

source_text: be agreeing with your opponent quickly, while you are in the way with him, that the opponent may not deliver you to the judge, and the judge may deliver you to the officer, and you may be cast into prison;
target_text: ladhe ca dhèu neo tao lii langu dènge èu, be'a risi lamu lai-lai ho padame dènge ne. ladhe aad'o, dhèu ne nèti èu asa hakim. hèia hakim saraka èu sa polisi, ka ra pamaso èu asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: truly i say to you, you may not come forth from there until you may pay the last penny.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e tare'a-re'a mi èu ne! èèna na èu pea taruu ètu d'ara bèdho, toke b'ae aa'i mèu-mèu kèlu-g'ètu èu sèra.

source_text: you heard that it was said to the ancients: you will not commit adultery;
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, dhu peka na, ‘baku bersina. '

source_text: but i say to you that everyone who is looking on a woman to desire her, already committed adultery with her in his heart.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a neo peka na, sèmi ne'e: dhèu dhu ladhe nèdhi dhèu bhèni èci, hèia d'ara na neo j'unu pa'èci dènge ne, na, dhèu mone ne bersina le dènge bhèni ne ètu d'ara na.

source_text: but if your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast from you, for it is good to you that one of your members may perish, and not your whole body be cast into gehenna.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake musi madha g'ana èu, na, ed'o eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge musi madha cabèka di, aa baku ra pèci mu asa d'ara ai naraka dènge musi madha dua-dua.

source_text: and if your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and cast from you, for it is good to you that one of your members may perish, and not your whole body be cast into gehenna.
target_text: aa ladhe èu tao sala dènge kacui-aai g'ana èu, poro eele kacui-aai ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge kacui-aai cabèka di, aa baku ra pèci mu asa d'ara ai naraka dènge kacui-aai dhu kateme iisi.

source_text: and it was said that, whoever may put away his wife, let him give to her a writing of divorce;
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, na, ‘dhèu dhu pa'ia dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, nèngu hud'i hia ku sasuri pa'ia mi bhèni èèna. '

source_text: but i say to you that whoever may put away his wife, except for the matter of whoredom, makes her to commit adultery; and whoever may marry her who has been put away commits adultery.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu ia eele dhèu èmu na, te ngaa bhèni ne tao nèdhi boe j'ara makae, hèia bhèni ne leo hari èmu, na, dhèu èmu uuru èèna ka dhu tao nèngu j'aj'i bersina. aa ladhe abhu dhèu mone dhu leo nare bhèni dhu dhèu èmu na ia eele, na, rèngu dua ra bersina kahèi.

source_text: again, you heard that it was said to the ancients: you will not swear falsely, but you will pay to the lord your oaths;
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa dhu na hia mi bèi-baki èdhi, peka na, ‘ladhe èu pajaji pake lii soo-subha, dhu ale kolongara ama lamatua, na, èu dhu pa'èki le dènge soo-subha èèna. '

source_text: but i say to you not to swear at all; neither by heaven, because it is the throne of god,
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: ladhe èu neo pajaji, na, mage mu j'oka subha. baku subha dènge ngara sorga, lula sorga èèna era pea ama lamatua.

source_text: nor by the earth, because it is his footstool, nor by jerusalem, because it is the city of the great king,
target_text: mage subha pake ngara rai-haha, lula rai-haha ne, era bane haga ama lamatua. aa mage subha pake ngara yerusalem, lula yerusalem èèna, kota nèti dhèu aae kapai.

source_text: nor may you swear by your head, because you are not able to make one hair white or black;
target_text: baku subha pake ngara kab'a kètu miu. te miu dènge boe koasa ho paredha rèu kètu miu, sèna ka ca loa sa j'aj'i mèdhi do j'aj'i pudhi.

source_text: but let your word be, yes, yes, no, no, and that which is more than these is of the evil one.
target_text: de ladhe miu neo pajaji, dhu peka oo, na, peka la ‘oo' di. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, na, peka la, ‘aad'o' di. ladhe miu peka risi nèti èèna, sèra sa j'aj'aj'i nèti nidhu.

source_text: you heard that it was said: eye for eye, and tooth for tooth;
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, dhu peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu cee dhu pa'ele iie musi madha miu, na, pa'ele iie kahèi musi madha na. aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pakabhui eele ngutu èu, na, pakabhui eele ngutu na kahèi. '

source_text: but i say to you not to resist the evil, but whoever will slap you on your right cheek, turn to him also the other;
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku b'ala bhabhelu dènge bhabhelu. ladhe dhèu tèb'e ripi èu cabèka, na hud'i laa, na tèb'e hari ripi dhu leo.

source_text: and whoever is willing to take you to law, and to take your coat-also permit to him the cloak.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo tenge lii langu dènge èu, ho neo nare kodho èu, na, hia ne kodho pana èu kahèi.

source_text: and whoever will impress you one mile, go with him two;
target_text: ladhe sordad'u ca dhèu laka-seti èu ho pasae mèdha na kako d'ai ca kilometer, na, èu pasae mèti kaj'èu na toke dua kilometer.

source_text: to him who is asking of you be giving, and him who is willing to borrow from you, you may not turn away.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo manèngi nare mèdha èu èci, na, hia la. aa ladhe dhèu neo pija mèdha èu, na, hia la.

source_text: you heard that it was said: you will love your neighbor, and will hate your enemy;
target_text: miu tadèngi le, dhu peka na, ‘sue la a'ari èu, aa nasa la dènge dhèu dhu nasa dènge èu. '

source_text: but i say to you, love your enemies, bless those cursing you, do good to those hating you, and pray for those accusing you falsely, and persecuting you,
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: èu hud'i sue ku dhèu dhu nasa dènge èu, aa manèngi ho lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu paj'èra èu.

source_text: that you may be sons of your father in the heavens, because he causes his sun to rise on evil and good, and he sends rain on righteous and unrighteous.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sèmi èèna, èu pad'elo, na, èu ana ama ètu sorga. lula nèngu ka tao madha lod'o hia dhèu dhu be'a, dènge dhèu dhu bhelu. na papuru èj'i hia dhèu dhu tao madhutu paredha na, aa mi dhèu dhu lab'a paredha na kahèi.

source_text: for if you may love those loving you, what reward do you have? do the tax collectors not also do the same?
target_text: de ladhe èu sue dhoka dhèu dhu sue èu, èu ngee na ama lamatua hud'i b'ala hia èu mèngi-nale, do? aad'o! te dhèu bhelu kahèi ne'a sue angalai na, dhu sue nèngu.

source_text: and if you may greet your brothers only, what do you do abundant? do the nations not also do so?
target_text: de ladhe èu me'a dhoka hia lii maho'o mi angalai èu, na, kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua, re'a ad'u-ue j'ara sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: you will therefore be perfect, as your father who is in the heavens is perfect.
target_text: de sanèd'e, ee! ama mu ètu sorga sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i. de èu hud'i tao madhutu ku sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: take heed not to do your kindness before men, to be seen by them, and if not-you have no reward from your father who is in the heavens;
target_text: yesus aj'a taruu, peka na, sanèd'e! mage mi madhutu atora agama di, sèna ka dhèu pad'iri miu. te ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, ama miu ètu sorga b'ala boe rui-j'aj'èra miu.

source_text: whenever, therefore, you may do kindness, you may not sound a trumpet before you as the hypocrites do, in the synagogues, and in the streets, that they may have glory from men; truly i say to you, they have their reward!
target_text: ladhe miu neo soru-bara dhèu kasia, mage lami palolo asa mia-mia. te ladhe miu se tao sèmi èèna, miu ca ropa dènge dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu sèmi sèra, d'èi lasi karihu asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a ho dhèu koa si, peka na, ‘ira ii! dhèu ne maj'èni madhutu atora agama, nga! ' ja'a peka mola-mola kèna! dhèu dhu tema sèmi rare lii koa-kad'iri nèti dhèu, rèngu se abhu le pala ra.

source_text: but you, doing kindness, do not let your left hand know what your right hand does,
target_text: de ladhe miu neo soru-bara dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, mage mi palolo kahèi!

source_text: that your kindness may be in secret, and your father who is seeing in secret will reward you himself.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne re'a boe. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga dhu ne'a ngaa dhu miu tao pahuni. pe nèngu ka dhu b'ala hia miu berkat ae-ae.

source_text: and when you may pray, you will not be as the hypocrites, because they cherish to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the broad places, that they may be seen of men; truly i say to you that they have their reward.
target_text: lod'o miu sabaj'a, miu baku tao nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu se d'èi lasi asa j'ara dhu dhèu ae-ae, aa titu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ho dhèu koa-kad'iri si, peka na, ‘dhèu se, dhèu mola-mèci! ' te ngaa nanene pabe'a-be'a! dènge rèngu abhu koa sèmi èèna, rèngu sèmi rare le pala ra.

source_text: but you, when you may pray, go into your chamber, and having shut your door, pray to your father who is in secret, and your father who is seeing in secret will reward you.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku sèmi èèna. ladhe miu manèngi-mangaj'i, lami asa d'ara kama ho bèdho babèdho na. èle èèna, heka mi sabaj'a mau-mau hia ama mi ètu sorga. masi ka dhèu leo rèdhi boe, te ngaa ama miu ladhe nèdhi. bèli-camèd'a na b'ala hia miu berkat ae-ae.

source_text: and-praying-you may not use vain repetitions like the nations, for they think that in their speaking much they will be heard,
target_text: ladhe miu sabaj'a, baku padhai lii dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. te dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua sabaj'a sèmi èèna ka. rèngu pangee, na, ama lamatua d'èi nanene lii manèngi ra dhu madhera lola-lola èèna.

source_text: therefore do not be like them, for your father knows those things that you have need of before your asking him;
target_text: mage mi madhutu j'ara rèngu sèra! te masi ka miu dhae manèngi mèka ngaa-ngaa nèti ama mi ètu sorga, te ngaa nèngu dhu ne'a mema le, ngaa dhu miu parluu.

source_text: therefore pray thus: our father who is in the heavens, hallowed be your name.
target_text: de ladhe sabaj'a, na, madhutu la conto sèmi ne'e: ‘ama ètu sorga! kolongara ama dhu mola-mèci. hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama dhu kapai èèna.

source_text: your kingdom come, your will come to pass, as in heaven also on the earth.
target_text: hud'i laa ama j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i! hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i, tao madhutu paredha ama ètu rai-haha ne, nuka sèmi ana pajuu ama, tao madhutu paredha ama ètu sorga.

source_text: give us today our appointed bread.
target_text: ama, hia la ji'i nganga'a-nganginu dhu d'ai bèli-bèli.

source_text: and forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.
target_text: ji'i manèngi, ho ama saku eele aa'i sasala-sasigo ji'i, nuka sèmi ji'i kahèi pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu dhu ra tao mi ji'i.

source_text: and may you not lead us into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one, because yours is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory-for all ages. amen.
target_text: ama, j'aga la ji'i, sèna ka ji'i baku tao bhabhelu. aa pakaj'èu la ji'i nèti koasa nidhu, te ama ka dhèu aae dhu koasa kapai risi eele. aa ama ka dhu mèd'u paredha, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. sabaj'a ji'i d'ai sange ne'e ka, ama. amin. '

source_text: for if you may forgive men their trespasses he also will forgive you-your father who is in the heavens;
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e, ee! ladhe miu pabhèlu eele sasala dhu dhèu tao mi miu, èèna na ama mi ètu sorga saku eele sasala-sasigo miu kahèi.

source_text: but if you may not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your father forgive your trespasses.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu mo'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala dhu dhèu tao mi miu, bèli-camèd'a ama mi bhèlu boe sasala miu kahèi.

source_text: and when you may fast, do not be as the hypocrites, of sour countenances, for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear to men fasting; truly i say to you that they have their reward.
target_text: ladhe miu manèngi-mangaj'i aa puasa, mage mi tao rèhu susa, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. te ra ad'u-ue j'ara èèna, ho dhèu pad'iri si, peka na, ‘dhèu se'e se, dhèu mola-mèci! ' te ngaa sanèd'e, ee! dènge sèmi rare koa-kad'iri sèmi èèna, na, rèngu abhu le pala ra.

source_text: but you, fasting, anoint your head, and wash your face,
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu puasa, lèu pamèu-mèu rèhu mi, aa sageri paie kètu miu!

source_text: that you may not appear to men fasting, but to your father who is in secret, and your father, who is seeing in secret, will reward you.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu rèdhi miu, re'a boe na, miu dhu puasa. te ngaa ama miu ne'a. pe na pala hia miu mèngi-nale ae-ae.

source_text: do not treasure up to yourselves treasures on the earth, where moth and rust disfigure, and where thieves break through and steal,
target_text: miu baku sab'a taruu, ho dhodhoka pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu rai-haha ne di. te hub'u dènge rutu pa'ele iie aa'i si. aa dhèu mana'u mai pa'ele iie era tatèka mèdha-panyau, aa mana'u rèti si.

source_text: but treasure up to yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust disfigure, and where thieves do not break through nor steal,
target_text: te ngaa be'a risi miu maj'èni sab'a, sèna ka pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu sorga. te ètu era nèi, abhu boe hub'u dènge rutu dhu pa'ele iie si, aa abhu boe dhèu mana'u, ho mai mana'u rèti.

source_text: for where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
target_text: te ladhe miu tèka mèdha-panyau miu ètu era mia, na, tatu d'ara miu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: the lamp of the body is the eye, if, therefore, your eye may be perfect, all your body will be enlightened,
target_text: musi madha dhèu, nuka sèmi labhu dhu pasaraa d'ara ra. ladhe musi madha na mèu, nèngu madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu hua iia, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu kako ètu d'ara saraa.

source_text: but if your eye may be evil, all your body will be dark; if, therefore, the light that is in you is darkness-the darkness, how great!
target_text: te ngaa ladhe musi madha na ahu, nèngu bisa boe kako madhutu madha j'ara mola, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu gogo ai lae-lae ètu d'ara maroga. de ladhe saraa ètu d'ara miu j'aj'i maroga, na miu mamuri d'ara maroga kahèi.

source_text: none is able to serve two lords, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will hold to the one, and despise the other; you are not able to serve god and wealth.
target_text: dhèu bisa boe sab'a hia dua lamatua, lula èèna na nèngu d'èi risi ca dhèu di. bisa kahèi nèngu madhutu lamatua èci, aa pusi-pahae boe dhu leo. nèti èèna ka, èu bisa boe peka na, ‘ama lamatua èèna, lamatua ja'a, ' ladhe èu tao doi-dhari j'aj'i mi lamatua èu.

source_text: because of this i say to you, do not be anxious for your life, what you may eat, and what you may drink, nor for your body, what you may put on. is not life more than nourishment, and the body than clothing?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku bhute pangee, na, ja'a mamuri tasa mera mia, ku'a-kinu ngaa, pake ngaa? miu pangee na, mamuri ne dhoka ta'a-tinu, di? aa ngi'u ne, dhoka pake mèdha-papake, di? aad'o sèmi èèna.

source_text: look to the birds of the sky, for they do not sow, nor reap, nor gather into storehouses, and your heavenly father nourishes them; are you not much better than they?
target_text: ladhe ku manu-bhui dhu lela ètu talora liru. rèngu bhute rèdhi boe sèla hini, dènge puu-g'ètu, ho tèka nganga'a ètu d'ara soka. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga piara manu-bhui sèra taruu. tatu nèngu kab'oi miu risi eele nèti rèngu. de ngee pabe'a-be'a. te ama lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: and who of you, being anxious, is able to add to his age one cubit?
target_text: ladhe dhèu titu ètu madha tèru, ho na bhute dènge lalau ngi'u na, nèngu bisa pamadhera hari ngi'u na, do? bisa boe!

source_text: and why are you anxious about clothing? consider well the lilies of the field; how do they grow? they do not labor, nor do they spin;
target_text: ladhe bisa boe, na, nga tao ka miu bhute dènge pangee hari mèdha-papake? lami ladhe ku hela bunga dhu muri tab'a ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a. rèngu manyèru boe hèngu, aa manènu boe sig'i sa hèi.

source_text: and i say to you that not even solomon in all his glory was clothed as one of these.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e ku la! mèdha-papake dhèu aae soleman dhu kab'ua risi, saraga na bisa boe segi saraga hela bunga ne.

source_text: and if the herb of the field, that today is, and tomorrow is cast into the furnace, god so clothes-not much more you, o you of little faith?
target_text: te ama lamatua taru kira mi bunga dhu muri dhoka doe ne'e, aa bèli madhe, ho dhèu core asa d'ara ai. ladhe na tao sèmi èèna, tatu nèngu papake miu risi eele nèti hela bunga sèra. de tasamia ka miu parcaya pa'èra boe mi nèngu?

source_text: therefore you may not be anxious, saying, what may we eat? or, what may we drink? or, with what may we be clothed?
target_text: de baku mi pangee na, ‘ji'i neo nga'a ngaa? ' do, ‘neo nginu ngaa? ' do, ‘neo pake ngaa? '

source_text: for the nations seek for all these, for your heavenly father knows that you have need of all these;
target_text: dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua, rèngu sab'a loe boe ho neo abhu aa'i-aa'i se. te ngaa miu baku tao sèmi èèna, te ama miu ètu sorga dhu ne'a aa'i le, ngaa-ngaa dhu miu parluu.

source_text: but seek first the kingdom of god and his righteousness, and all these will be added to you.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i pakako uuru ku sasab'a na, aa hud'i madhutu ku paredha na, heka na hia miu aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu.

source_text: therefore do not be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for its own things; sufficient for the day is the evil of it.
target_text: de baku bhute pangee, na, bèli miu parluu ngaa. te bèli èèna dènge bhabhute unu na. sasusa lod'o doe ne'e, èle ètu doe ne'e kahèi.

source_text: do not judge, that you may not be judged,
target_text: miu baku galaa dhèu, sèna ka ama lamatua baku pasala miu kahèi.

source_text: for in what judgment you judge, you will be judged, and in what measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
target_text: ladhe miu nile dhèu sèmi mia, pe ama lamatua nile miu sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe miu ige sasala dhèu sèmi mia, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua ige sasala miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and why do you behold the speck that is in your brother's eye, and do not consider the beam that is in your own eye?
target_text: masi ka sasala dhèu ciki oo'e èèna ka, èu bhèlu boe. te ngaa sasala èu dhu kapai, èu pame'a boe ciki sa. èci èèna ka dènge èu ladhe mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu d'ara madha angalai èu, te ngaa abhu agarii aae ca laa dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu, dhu èu me'a more boe.

source_text: or, how will you say to your brother, permit that i may cast out the speck from your eye, and behold, the beam is in your own eye?
target_text: nga tao ka èu bani peka na, ‘angalai! mai ho ja'a tiu eele ahu nèti d'ara madha èu'. aa te ngaa èu mesa mu bisa boe mèdhi ngaa-ngaa, lula agarii aae dhu hutu nare musi madha mu.

source_text: hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to cast out the speck out of your brother's eye.
target_text: heeh! èu ne, mema dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo! tao eele uuru ku agarii nèti musi madha èu, heka ladhe mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu d'ara madha angalai mu, sèna ka èu bisa tiu eele ahu ne kèna.

source_text: you may not give that which is holy to the dogs, nor cast your pearls before the pigs, that they may not trample them among their feet, and having turned-may tear you apart.
target_text: baku aj'a j'ara lamatua dhu mola-mèci mi dhèu dhu d'èi pahahe dhèu. lula dhèu sèra nuka sèmi busa pakadhi, dhu ra kabèli mai kadhi hari miu. rèngu sèra goa sama sèmi hahi kahèi. ladhe dhèu hia ne mutiara dhu kab'ua, na pusi boe! te ne'a dhoka j'èli palaho di.

source_text: ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you;
target_text: ladhe miu sabaj'a, baku loe manèngi mi lamatua; te èèna na, na hia. ladhe patangi-tenge; pe na pad'elo j'ara. ladhe kad'eu taruu babèdho; pe na bhoke.

source_text: for everyone who is asking receives, and he who is seeking finds, and to him who is knocking it will be opened.
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu loe boe manèngi mi lamatua, èèna na ra sèmi rare. dhu patangi-tenge, pe ra abhu. dhu kad'eu taruu, pe na bhoke èmu.

source_text: or what man is of you, of whom, if his son may ask for a loaf-a stone will he present to him?
target_text: miu pangee sèku! ladhe ana manèngi roti, tatu ama na hia boe ne hadhu, si?

source_text: and if he may ask for a fish-a serpent will he present to him?
target_text: do, ladhe ana manèngi i'a, ama na hia boe mege, sina ma?

source_text: if, therefore, you being evil, have known to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your father who is in the heavens give good things to those asking him?
target_text: ama mi ètu sorga, mema d'ara na hua iia titu kèna! de ladhe dhèu rai-haha dhu bhelu-katub'a sèmi miu, me'a hia mèdha dhu be'a mi ana miu, ngaa hari ama mi! tatu na bagi hia miu ngaa dhu miu manèngi.

source_text: all things, therefore, whatever you may will that men may be doing to you, so also do to them, for this is the law and the prophets.
target_text: de, ngaa dhu èu neo dhèu leo tao mi èu, na, èu hud'i tao sèmi èèna kahèi hia nèngu. lula ne'e ne ka, j'aj'i mi kapua nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu musa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu peka-padhai karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: go in through the narrow gate, because wide is the gate and broad the way that is leading to the destruction, and many are those going in through it;
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo maso sorga, nèngu hud'i maso ku re hèb'a kota dhu kob'o. te ngaa mage-mage, oo! abhu kahèi j'ara leo dhu mud'a, aa hèb'a dhu taleo, dhu dhèu ae-ae lasi re èèna. te j'ara sèmi èèna ka dhu lere dhèu asa naraka, ka ra cèri eele nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: how narrow is the gate and compressed the way that is leading to life, and few are those finding it!
target_text: dhèu dhu neo maso sorga, hud'i madhutu ku j'ara dhu susa, aa maso re hèb'a dhu kob'o. te, masi ka dhèu ciki di dhu kako re j'ara èèna, te ngaa j'ara dhu kob'o èèna ka, dhu nèti dhèu asa lamatua.

source_text: but take heed of the false prophets who come to you in sheep's clothing, and inwardly are ravenous wolves.
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge dhèu dhu tema kapod'e-kabèli, dhu d'èi padedha iisi, peka na, rèngu se dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua. te rèngu tao ngi'u ra be'a nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho. te ngaa rèngu se dhèu bhelu-katub'a, èci èèna ka dènge busa hui dhu mai kadhi kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: from their fruits you will know them; do men gather grapes from thorns? or figs from thistles?
target_text: tasamia ho miu bisa tadhe dhèu dhu kapod'e sèmi sèra? ladhe la nèti tatao rèngu. èèna sèmi dhèu ladhe rèdhi hua, hèia tadhe dènge ana aaj'u ne. hua dhu be'a, mai boe nèti aj'u dhu karehe.

source_text: so every good tree yields good fruits, but the bad tree yields evil fruits.
target_text: te aj'u dhu be'a ladhe d'ai hua, hua na be'a kahèi. te ngaa aj'u dhu karehe ladhe na hua, hua na karehe kahèi.

source_text: a good tree is not able to yield evil fruits, nor a bad tree to yield good fruits.
target_text: abhu ètu mia, aj'u dhu be'a, hua na karehe, aa aj'u dhu karehe, hua na be'a?

source_text: every tree not yielding good fruit is cut down and is cast into fire:
target_text: aj'u dhu hua na karehe, tatu ra patue eele, ho core asa d'ara ai.

source_text: therefore from their fruits you will know them.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge rèngu dhu rèti lii padhai kapod'e-kabèli sèra. miu tadhe si nèti tatao ra.

source_text: not everyone who is saying to me, lord, lord, will come into the kingdom of the heavens, but he who is doing the will of my father who is in the heavens.
target_text: èèna na abhu dhèu dhu paroa ja'a, na, ‘lamatua! ' te ngaa rèngu dhoka ale ètu hèb'a di. bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua ètu sorga tule eele si. te dhodhoka dhèu dhu d'èi tao madhutu dad'èi nèngu di, dhu na sèmi nare rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: many will say to me in that day, lord, lord, have we not prophesied in your name? and in your name cast out demons? and in your name done many mighty things?
target_text: pe ropa d'ai èle rai-haha ne, dhèu ae mangaku, peka na, ja'a ne lamatua rèngu. aa dènge lii solo-mako, ra peka na, ‘lamatua! ji'i se la'a pakako a'aj'a lamatua ètu mia-mia, babège nidhu dènge kolongara lamatua, aa tao tadha-tadha malaa pake koasa nèti lamatua. '

source_text: and then i will acknowledge to them, that-i never knew you, depart from me you who are working lawlessness.
target_text: masi ka rèngu solo-mako ja'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa èèna na ja'a peka dènge rèngu, na, ‘miu se, cee? ja'a tadhe boe miu, te miu mamuri boe madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. de mi pakaj'èu ka nèti ne'e! '

source_text: therefore, everyone who hears these words of mine, and does them, i will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock;
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nanene ja'a, hèia ra tao madhutu lii padhai ja'a, rèngu se nuka sèmi dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu, dhu patitu èmu ra ètu dedha hadhu kapua.

source_text: and the rain descended, and the streams came, and the winds blew, and they beat on that house, and it did not fall, for it had been founded on the rock.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka èj'i aae mai toke èi lala, aa ngèlu aae lèke èmu ne. te ngaa èmu ne guri boe, lula patitu ètu dedha hadhu kapua.

source_text: and everyone who is hearing these words of mine, and is not doing them, will be likened to a foolish man who built his house on the sand;
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nanene ja'a, te ngaa tao boe madhutu lii padhai ja'a, nèngu ne èci èèna ka dènge dhèu goa dhu patitu èmu na ètu dedha salae.

source_text: and the rain descended, and the streams came, and the winds blew, and they beat on that house, and it fell, and its fall was great.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka èj'i aae mai toke èi lala. ngèlu aae lèke èmu ne kahèi. hèia èmu ne guri eele, toke laho teb'o-teb'o.

source_text: and it came to pass, when jesus finished these words, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra malaa-maloha, lula nanene a'aj'a na,

source_text: for he was teaching them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
target_text: te nèngu ne'a mèu isi nèti a'aj'a ne. na aj'a-nori sèmi boe mese agama sèra.

source_text: and when he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him,
target_text: lod'o yesus puru nèti ledhe, hèia dhèu ae-ae lasi madhutu ne.

source_text: and behold, a leper having come, was prostrating to him, saying, lord, if you are willing, you are able to cleanse me;
target_text: kabèdhi laa, ca dhèu dhu pèd'a kusta mai paraga dènge ne. hèia na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus, ho manèngi, aku nèngu na, lamatua! sue ku ja'a la! ladhe mo'o, na, puri ku papèd'a ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu madenge ia ka dènge ja'a, aa ja'a bisa hari sabaj'a ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and having stretched forth the hand, jesus touched him, saying, i will, be cleansed, and immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yesus j'ole kacui-aai na ka na g'ag'e dhèu ne, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a ko'o! èu èle kèna! kabèdhi la, èi papèd'a dhèu ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: and jesus says to him, see, you may tell no one, but go, show yourself to the priest, and bring the gift that moses commanded for a testimony to them.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ne, sanèd'e paie! èu èle le nèti papèd'a-tarègu, te ngaa baku èu lolo dènge dhèu èci sa. aa èu hud'i madhutu ku atora musa. de lamu asa ama agama ho na parisa ngi'u èu, sèna ka ne'a na èi papèd'a mu ele le, tare'a, do dhae. èle na, èu hia persembahan tadha makasi, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, èu ne èle tare'a-re'a le nèti papèd'a.

source_text: and jesus having entered into capernaum, there came to him a centurion calling on him,
target_text: èle èèna, hèia yesus maso asa d'ara rae kapernaum. ètu era ne'e, komedhaa sordad'u roma ca dhèu, mai manèngi ho yesus soru-bara ne, aku nèngu na,

source_text: and saying, lord, my young man has been laid in the house a paralytic, fearfully afflicted,
target_text: ama! ana sab'a ja'a ca dhèu, pèd'a aae, ka na j'èra titu kèna ètu èmu. na bisa boe puru nèti era j'unu na.

source_text: and jesus says to him, i, having come, will heal him.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, oo! pe ja'a dhiu puri-pa'èle ne.

source_text: and the centurion answering said, lord, i am not worthy that you may enter under my roof, but only say a word, and my servant will be healed;
target_text: te ngaa komedhaa ne b'ala, aku nèngu na, ama! ama roca ia ka mai asa èmu ja'a, lula ja'a nia boe sèmi ama asa d'ara èmu ja'a. sad'i ama ku peka dhoka lii ca hèb'a di nèti ne'e, tatu ana sab'a ja'a ne èle dènge nèti papèd'a.

source_text: for i also am a man under authority, having under myself soldiers, and i say to this one, go, and he goes, and to another, be coming, and he comes, and to my servant, do this, and he does it.
target_text: ja'a ke'a j'ara ne, lula ja'a dènge dhèu paredha dedha kahèi, dhu dènge koasa ho paredha ja'a. aa ja'a dènge koasa kahèi, sèna ka paredha sordad'u ja'a sèra. ladhe ja'a pua, peka na, ‘lamu sa nèi! ' tatu na la'e dènge. aa ladhe ja'a peka, ‘mai asa ne'e! ' tatu na mai. aa ladhe ja'a paleha dhèu sab'a ja'a, peka na, ‘sab'a ne'e! ' tatu na tao madhutu. de sad'i ama ku lii di, tatu ana sab'a ja'a èèna, èle dènge nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and jesus having heard, wondered, and said to those following, truly i say to you, not even in israel have i found such great faith;
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi nare, hèia na malaa. ka na padhai lii dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a dhae paraga kèdhi mèka dènge ca dhèu sa nèti dhèu yahudi dhu lèka èra sama sèmi dhèu roma ne!

source_text: and i say to you that many from east and west will come and recline with abraham, and isaac, and jacob, in the kingdom of the heavens,
target_text: nanene paie-iie! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu leo rai kara ae-ae, nuka sèmi dhèu roma ne, mai nèti haa, nèti dhimu, ho madhèdi ra'a-rinu mei èci dènge abraham, isak dènge yakob ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: but the sons of the kingdom will be cast forth into the outer darkness-there will be the weeping and the gnashing of the teeth.
target_text: masi ka lamatua dhu hag'e nare le dhèu yahudi, sena ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, te ngaa ae ka dhu pusi-pahae boe ne. èèna na, lamatua tule eele si asa era dhu maroga kiu-kiu. ètu era ne'e, ra tangi roma iisi d'ara pèd'a, aa ra j'èra titu kèna.

source_text: and jesus said to the centurion, go, and as you believed let it be to you; and his young man was healed in that hour.
target_text: padhai lii nare, hèia yesus peka dènge komedhaa ne, lèpa ka. te ana sab'a èu èèna èle le, madhutu sèmi parcaya èu ne. ka lod'o dhu na padhai èèna, ana ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: and jesus having come into the house of peter, saw his mother-in-law laid, and fevered,
target_text: ca tèka, yesus la'e asa èmu petrus. na ladhe nèdhi ina dhèu èmu petrus dhu j'unu ètu dedha koi, dhu pèd'a maringi-sagoro.

source_text: and he touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she arose, and was ministering to them.
target_text: ka yesus kèpe kacui-aai na, hèia ina ne èle nèti papèd'a na. hèia na kèd'i, ka la'e lalau nganga'a hia yesus si.

source_text: and evening having come, they brought to him many demoniacs, and he cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were ill,
target_text: ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia dhèu sèra mai rèti dhèu rèngu dhu nidhu tao. hèia na paredha nidhu se, peka na, eee, nidhu! rai pakaj'èu nèti ne'e! hèia nidhu se kalua dènge ka. na puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu aa'i-aa'i nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: that it might be fulfilled that was spoken through isaiah the prophet, saying, he took our sicknesses himself, and bore the diseases.
target_text: na tao j'ara se, ho pamèci dènge lii dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, dhu suri tèke le, peka na, na puri-pa'èle papèd'a-tarègu èdhi. aa pasae nare j'aj'èra èdhi.

source_text: and jesus having seen great multitudes around him, commanded to depart to the other side;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus nèdhi dhèu ae-ae mai kalibhu rare ne. hèia na peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, mai pakèd'i lati asa cabèka dano.

source_text: and a certain scribe having come, said to him, teacher, i will follow you wherever you may go;
target_text: hèia mese agama ca dhèu mai, padhai lii dènge ne, peka na, ama mese! sad'i ama asa mia èèna ka, ja'a bera-bera dènge ama!

source_text: and jesus says to him, the foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky places of rest, but the son of man has nowhere he may lay the head.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, be'a kahèi do! te ngaa sanèd'e. dhèu rai-haha aa badha-manu aa'i-aa'i, dhu dènge era pea-palu'u. busa hui lèpa asa ro'a na. manu-bhui la'e asa rèd'a na. te ngaa ja'a dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne dènge boe era pea-palu'u. nanèlu ho bane kètu dènge boe kahèi.

source_text: and another of his disciples said to him, lord, permit me first to depart and to bury my father;
target_text: èle ka, dhèu èci hari mai peka dènge yesus, na, ama! ja'a neo madhutu ama, te ngaa hud'i ja'a ladhe-leru ku ina-ama ja'a. ladhe ama ku madhe, ho padhane kore, heka ja'a madhutu kèna.

source_text: and jesus said to him, follow me, and permit the dead to bury their own dead.
target_text: te ngaa yesus padhai lii, peka na, sèmi ne'e! hud'i laa dhèu leo dhu parcaya boe lamatua padhane dhèu madhe. te ladhe èu neo madhutu ja'a, na, madhutu la dènge d'ara kateme!

source_text: and when he entered into the boat his disciples followed him,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus ca'e asa dedha koha, palere dènge ana-ana madhutu na.

source_text: and behold, a great storm arose in the sea, so that the boat was being covered by the waves, but he was sleeping,
target_text: ropa rèngu ètu talora dano era, yesus bhèj'i. kaca'a laa, ngèlu aae mai. naha aae tèb'e koha ne, toke èi maso asa d'ara.

source_text: and his disciples having come to him, awoke him, saying, lord, save us! we are perishing!
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ana madhutu se lasi parèi yesus, aku rèngu na, ama! ama! kèd'i ku la! bara ku ji'i, te èdhi molo madhe aa'i ti kèna!

source_text: and he says to them, why are you fearful, o you of little faith? then having risen, he rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm;
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, wee! nga tao ka miu se madha'u sèmi ne'e ne? miu parcaya boe ja'a, do? ka na kèd'i. èle ka na kai ngèlu dènge naha ètu d'ara dano ne, peka na, mau ka! hèia naha dènge ngèlu mau dènge ka.

source_text: and the men wondered, saying, what kind-is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
target_text: ka ana madhutu yesus se malaa-maloha. ra papeka na, ira ii! cee ka dhèu ne'e ne? tasamia ka na bisa paredha ngèlu dènge naha, ka madhutu dad'èi na?

source_text: and he having come to the other side, to the region of the gergesenes, there met him two demoniacs, coming forth out of the tombs, very fierce, so that no one was able to pass over by that way,
target_text: nèbhu boe ka rèngu d'ai cabèka dano, ètu rai gad'ara. ètu era nèi, abhu dhèu dua dhu nidhu tao. rèngu pea ètu era ro'a dhèu madhe. dua ra se'e bhelu titu kèna, toke abhu boe ca dhèu sa hèi dhu bani kako re era èèna. ropa rèdhi yesus mai, hèia

source_text: and behold, they cried out, saying, what regards us and you, jesus, son of god? did you come here to afflict us before the time?
target_text: ra pa'oo, peka na, we, ana ama lamatua! nga tao ka èu mai gagu ji'i se? masi ka d'ai mèka lod'o ho hia hahuku mi ji'i, te ngaa èu mai le ho neo paj'èra ji'i!

source_text: and there was a herd of many pigs feeding far off from them,
target_text: kaj'èu boe ètu era èèna, abhu hahi canau dhu nyuu rai, tenge nganga'a.

source_text: and the demons were calling on him, saying, if you cast us forth, permit us to go away into the herd of the pigs;
target_text: hèia nidhu se manèngi yesus, aku rèngu na, ladhe babèga eele ji'i, na, pua la ji'i maso asa d'ara hahi sèi!

source_text: and he says to them, go. and having come forth, they went into the herd of the pigs, and behold, the whole herd of the pigs rushed down the steep, into the sea, and died in the waters,
target_text: hèia yesus paredha nidhu se, peka na, lami ka! hèia nidhu kalua tèke eele dhèu dua se, lasi maso asa d'ara hahi deo sa. ka hahi se rai paceb'a re sebhe ledhe ka manahu asa d'ara dano, hèia ra cèna, ka madhe aa'i si.

source_text: and those feeding fled, and having gone into the city, they declared all, and the matter of the demoniacs.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi sèmi èèna, dhèu madhenga hahi, rai lasi asa d'ara rae, hèia ra lolo ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne.

source_text: and behold, all the city came forth to meet jesus, and having seen him, they called on him that he might depart from their borders.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, dhèu ae lasi asa era èèna. d'ai nèi, ra rèdhi yesus. hèia ra pakaseti yesus, ho pakèd'i nèti rae rèngu ne.

source_text: and having gone into the boat, he passed over, and came to his own city,
target_text: èle èèna, yesus si ca'e hari koha, lèpa asa ca bèka dano. ka rèngu puru ètu kota na.

source_text: and behold, they were bringing to him a paralytic, laid on a bed, and jesus having seen their faith, said to the paralytic, take courage, child, your sins have been forgiven.
target_text: ètu era ne'e dhèu j'èru rèti angalai ra dhu karuku asa yesus. ropa ladhe nèdhi, yesus ne'a le, na, rèngu parcaya ne, peka na, nèngu bisa puri-pa'èle angalai ra. hèia na peka dènge dhèu karuku ne, aku nèngu na, ana! pa'èra d'ara èu! te ja'a saku eele le sasala èu.

source_text: and behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, this one speaks evil.
target_text: te ngaa ètu era èèna, abhu pèri-pèri mese agama yahudi dhu tadèngi lii padhai yesus èèna. ka ra nasa, hèia ra papeka, na, dhèu ne'e ne bani titu kèna peka sèmi èèna! dhodhoka ama lamatua di dhu bisa abho sasala-sasigo dhèu. te ngaa lii padhai dhèu ne tao iisi na sama sèmi ama lamatua sa. nèngu ne pahaha ama lamatua!

source_text: and jesus, having known their thoughts, said, why think evil in your hearts?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a d'ara rèngu. nèti èèna ka na lii, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu se pangee, na, ja'a ne pahaha ama lamatua?

source_text: for which is easier? to say, your sins are forgiven; or to say, rise and walk?
target_text: mia ka dhu mud'a risi? ladhe ja'a peka dènge dhèu karuku ne, ‘ja'a saku eele le sasala èu, ' do, ja'a peka na, ‘kèd'i, ho lèpa ka. '

source_text: but that you may know that the son of man has power on the earth to forgive sins-then he says to the paralytic-having risen, take up your bed, and go to your house.
target_text: ladhe na kèd'i dènge ka, miu heka mèdhi, na, ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. te ja'a dènge hak ho abho sasala dhèu. hèia yesus paredha dhèu karuku ne, peka na, kèd'i ka! ded'e mèti ka karad'a èu, ho lèpa ka!

source_text: and he, having risen, went to his house,
target_text: ka dhèu karuku ne kèd'i, hèia na lèpa dènge ka.

source_text: and the multitudes having seen, wondered, and glorified god, who gave such power to men.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi, hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra malaa-maloha. hèia ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua, peka na, ama lamatua, kapai risi eele! na hia koasa kapai sèmi ne'e, hia mi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: and jesus passing on from there saw a man sitting at the tax office named matthew, and says to him, follow me, and he, having risen, followed him.
target_text: èle ka yesus la'e nèti era èèna, hèia ladhe nèdhi ca dhèu roro doi bea dhu sab'a ètu kantor bea. ngara dhèu ne, mateos. hèia yesus gale ne, peka na, mai madhutu ja'a! ropa tadèngi nare, hèia mateos kèd'i dènge ka, la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: and it came to pass, he reclining in the house, that behold, many tax collectors and sinners having come, were dining with jesus and his disciples,
target_text: ka mateos nèru yesus si lasi ra'a-rinu asa èmu na. na nèru kahèi mone aanga-angalai na dhèu roro bea sèra, aa tamu dhu leo kahèi, ho ra'a-rinu dènge rèngu.

source_text: and the pharisees having seen, said to his disciples, why does your teacher eat with the tax collectors and sinners?
target_text: te ngaa abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei parisi, mai ka'ugu ètu madha ana-ana madhutu yesus, peka na, nga tao ka mese miu madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu guna boe se, nuka sèmi dhèu roro bea dènge angalai ra dhu bhelu-katub'a sèra?

source_text: and jesus having heard, said to them, they who are whole have no need of a physician, but they who are ill;
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, dhèu pèd'a parluu dote-matarii, te ngaa dhèu dhu pèd'a boe parluu boe.

source_text: but having gone, learn what this is: kindness i will, and not sacrifice; for i did not come to call righteous men, but sinners.
target_text: be'a risi lami parisa paie-iie lii holo-nori ama lamatua. te uru èèna, na pua hosea, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai na, dhu suri peka na, ‘dad'èi ja'a nuka, dhèu-dhèu ja'a hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, aa pad'elo rasa kasia. ladhe ra tao boe madhutu sèmi èèna, na, badha korban rèngu dhu rèti hia ja'a, dènge boe kab'ua. ' ne'e ne ka dhu ama lamatua peka tèke le. nèti èèna ka, ja'a mai boe ho uri dhèu dhu pangee na, rèngu dhèu mola, te ngaa ja'a mai sèna ka ladhe-leru dhèu dhu laku-laku boe.

source_text: then the disciples of john come to him, saying, why do we and the pharisees fast much, and your disciples do not fast?
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yohanis tuka sarani sèra, mai sa yesus. dhèu se karèi, aku rèngu na, ji'i dhu madhutu yohanis tema puasa. aa dhèu parisi puasa kahèi. te ngaa tasamia ka ana madhutu ama sèra loe boe ra'a-rinu? rèngu re'a boe puasa, do?

source_text: and jesus said to them, can the sons of the bride-chamber mourn, so long as the bridegroom is with them? but days will come when the bridegroom may be taken from them, and then they will fast.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa dènge lii pakasame, na, sèmi ne'e: ladhe pesta kab'i, tamu sèra puasa boe, te ngaa ra'a toke bècu. ladhe pengantin mone dènge rèngu era, aa'i-aa'i ra ra'a-rinu palere-lere. te ngaa ladhe dhèu leo rai rèti ka pengantin mone ne, hèia mone aanga-angalai na, d'ara ra susa, de heka ra puasa kèna.

source_text: and no one puts a patch of undressed cloth on an old garment, for its filling up takes from the garment, and a worse split is made.
target_text: dhèu bisa boe rare bèla hiu ca èta, ho kalape mi kodho dhui dhu mae. te ropa base kodho ne, bèla hiu dhu kalape la'a deo na karuku, na kodho deo na asa mae aae.

source_text: nor do they put new wine into old skins, and if not-the skins burst, and the wine runs out, and the skins are destroyed, but they put new wine into new skins, and both are preserved together.
target_text: j'ara sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge dhua dhu heka rèti mai nèti kapua, bisa boe bhori asa d'ara sabha dhui. te aad'o na sabha ne madhore, hèia dhua bhori eele asa rai la'e. de dhua dhu hiu hud'i bhori ku asa d'ara sabha hiu, sèna ka dua ra be'a taruu! dènge sèmi ne'e, yesus nori si, peka na, a'aj'a na dhu hiu, baku pakihu dènge a'aj'a dhu dhui.

source_text: while he is speaking these things to them, behold, a ruler having come, was prostrating to him, saying that my daughter just now died, but having come, lay your hand on her, and she will live.
target_text: ètu d'ara yesus padhai lii era dènge ana madhutu yohanis sèra, hèia kapala nèti èmu manèngi-mangaj'i mai paraga dènge ne. ka na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. hèia na manèngi, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! sue ku ja'a la! te ana bhèni ja'a heka madhe kèna. de lati ho ama bane ai mi ana ne, sèna ka na mamuri hari.

source_text: and jesus having risen, followed him, also his disciples,
target_text: ropa na tadèngi, hèia yesus dènge ana madhutu na, madhutu dènge ka dhèu deo na.

source_text: and behold, a woman having a flow of blood for twelve years, having come to him behind, touched the fringe of his garments, for she said within herself, if only i may touch his garment, i will be saved.
target_text: ètu talora j'ara, ca dhèu ina kako la'e madhutu si. bhèni ne lèke papèd'a bhèni, dhu loe boe ciki sa d'ai canguru dua tèu kèna. na pangee, na, sad'i ja'a gai lèke kodho yesus di, tatu èi papèd'a ja'a ne èle. nèti èèna ka, na ara padètu la'e, hèia na gai lèke suu kodho yesus.

source_text: and jesus having turned, and having seen her, said, take courage, daughter, your faith has saved you, and the woman was saved from that hour.
target_text: yesus dhu ne'a, hèia na kabib'a, ladhe sa ina ne. ka na lii, peka na, ina, ee! pa'èra la d'ara èu. te, lula èu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a, nèti èèna ka èu èle nèti papèd'a. hèia bhèni ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: and jesus having come into the house of the ruler, and having seen the pipers and the multitude making tumult,
target_text: èle ka, yesus si lasi taruu asa èmu nèti kapala èmu manèngi-mangaj'i èèna. d'ai era nèi, maso la'e asa d'ara, hèia na ladhe nèdhi dhèu dhu tema karihu musiik mamadhe, dènge dhèu ae dhu tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: he says to them, withdraw, for the girl did not die, but sleeps, and they were deriding him;
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ae eele ka tangi, aa lami ka èmu miu! te ana ne madhe boe, dhoka na bhèj'i di. te ngaa dhèu se mari dènge pakapengo hèb'a mi yesus.

source_text: but when the multitude was put forth, having gone in, he took hold of her hand, and the girl arose,
target_text: èle ka, dhèu se aa'i-aa'i lasi asa li'u. ka yesus maso asa d'ara kama ana bhèni ne. na kèpe ai ana ne, hèia ana ne mamuri dènge ka.

source_text: and the fame of this went forth to all the land.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi j'ara ne, ka dhèu mulai palolo lème ètu kabarai ra, lula-nèti ngaa dhu yesus tao ne.

source_text: and jesus passing on from there, two blind men followed him, calling and saying, deal kindly with us, son of david!
target_text: èle, hèia yesus kako taruu. ètu talora j'ara, abhu dhèu bèdhu dhèu dua dhu madhutu ne. dua ra rodhe, peka na, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud! sue ku ji'i la!

source_text: and he having come into the house, the blind men came to him, and jesus says to them, do you believe that i am able to do this? they say to him, yes, lord.
target_text: ropa yesus maso asa d'ara èmu cue, dhèu bèdhu se lasi paraga dènge ne. ka yesus karèi dua ra, peka na, miu se lèka tare'a-re'a, na, ja'a ne dènge koasa ho puri-pa'èle miu, sèna ka bisa ladhe mèdhi, do? hèia dua ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama karèi ia ka, te ji'i dhu lèka mema-mema le.

source_text: then he touched their eyes, saying, according to your faith let it be to you,
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii dhaa dua ra, hèia yesus g'ag'e musi madha ra, ka na peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, j'aj'i ka madhutu parcaya miu.

source_text: and their eyes were opened, and jesus strictly charged them, saying, see, let no one know;
target_text: yesus padhai lii èle, hèia dua ra ladhe rèdhi dènge ka. te ngaa yesus pasanèd'e si, peka na, baku miu peka dènge ca dhèu sa, ngaa dhu j'aj'i le!

source_text: but they, having gone forth, spread his fame in all that land.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se taha rare boe d'ara ra. ka ra kako palème kabarai èèna, lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, tatao yesus mi rèngu dua ra.

source_text: and as they are coming forth, behold, they brought to him a man mute, a demoniac,
target_text: ropa dhèu bèdhu se lasi, dhèu rèti dhèu leo hari èci asa yesus. dhèu ne bisa boe padhai lii, lula nidhu tao ne.

source_text: and the demon having been cast out, the mute spoke, and the multitude wondered, saying that it was never so seen in israel,
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi, hèia yesus paredha nidhu kalua nèti dhèu lii aad'o ne. nidhu èèna kalua, ka dhèu ne padhai lii dènge ka. hèia dhèu ae ètu era èèna malaa, ka ra peka na, ira ii! èdhi dhèu yahudi paraga tèdhi mèka madha j'ara sèmi ne'e ne!

source_text: but the pharisees said, by the ruler of the demons he casts out the demons.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu parisi ka'uu, peka na, dhèu aae nidhu ka dhu hia ne koasa, sèna ka na bisa babège eela nidhu.

source_text: and jesus was going up and down all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and proclaiming the good news of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako palème kota-kota dènge rae-rae, sèna ka aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a sèra. na aj'a dhèu nèti lii holo-nori ama lamatua, aa j'ara tasamia rèngu bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. na puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: and having seen the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them, that they were faint and cast aside, as sheep not having a shepherd;
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ae se, hèia na taha nare boe d'ara, lula dhèu se re'a heka tao sèmi ngaa sa. te rèngu nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dènge boe dhèu madhenga.

source_text: then he says to his disciples, the harvest indeed is abundant, but the workmen few;
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae se, nuka sèmi nganga'a ae-ae ètu d'ara oka-tedhe. masi ka nganga'a ae titu kèna, te ngaa dhèu sab'a d'ai boe ho puu-g'ètu, sèna ka tèke asa d'ara gud'a.

source_text: therefore implore the lord of the harvest that he may put forth workmen to his harvest.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i manèngi ku mi lamatua oka, sèna ka na tabha hari dhèu sab'a, ho lasi puu-g'ètu isi oka se.

source_text: and having called his twelve disciples to himself, he gave to them power over unclean spirits, so as to be casting them out, and to be healing every disease and every sickness.
target_text: èle ka, yesus paroa ana madhutu na, sèna ka mai pakaboko. hèia na hia si koasa ho babège eele nidhu aa puri-pa'èle dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: and of the twelve apostles the names are these: first, simon, who is called peter, and his brother andrew; james of zebedee, and his brother john;
target_text: ana madhutu na dhu na pua sèra, dhèu canguru dua, nuka: partama, ngara na simon dhu dhèu tema paroa ne, ‘petrus', dènge ari na, anderias, yakobis, dènge ari na, yohanis dua ra ana sabadeus,

source_text: philip, and bartholomew; thomas, and matthew the tax collector; james of alpheus, and lebbeus who was surnamed thaddeus;
target_text: pelipus, bertolomeos, tomas, mateos dhèu roro doi bea, yakobis dhu leo nuka ana alpius, tadius,

source_text: simon the zealot, and judas iscariot, who also delivered him up.
target_text: simon nèti partei politik selot, dènge yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahie yesus.

source_text: these twelve jesus sent forth, having given command to them, saying, do not go away to the way of the nations, and do not go into a city of the samaritans, and be going rather to the lost sheep of the house of israel.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus pua ana madhutu na canguru dua dhèu sèra, aa paredha si, peka na, ja'a pua miu lami asa dhèu èdhi dhèu yahudi sèra, lula ae nèti rèngu dhu madhutu boe j'ara mamuri ama lamatua dènge mola. rèngu cakaraa kahib'i-kalèbho dhu sala j'ara. nèti èèna ka, baku lami asa dhèu yahudi boe, nuka sèmi dhèu samaria.

source_text: and going on, proclaim, saying that the kingdom of the heavens has come near;
target_text: lami peka dènge dhèu isra'el èdhi sèra, na, ‘ne'e ne, d'ai lod'o kèna, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. '

source_text: be healing those ailing, raising the dead, cleansing lepers, casting out demons-freely you received, freely give.
target_text: aa lami puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a, pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, pa'èle dhèu kusta, aa babège eele nidhu. ama lamatua hia le miu ae-ae, te ngaa na manèngi hari boe ca ana maa sa. de lami ka ho pala pa'ae-ae mi dhèu leo, te ngaa mage mi manèngi hari ngaa-ngaa kahèi.

source_text: do not provide gold, nor silver, nor brass in your girdles,
target_text: pakèd'i dènge ai hua. baku mèti doi,

source_text: nor leather pouch for the way, nor two coats, nor sandals, nor staff-for the workman is worthy of his nourishment.
target_text: gee j'ara, mèdha silu, salapa, do tatea. te dhèu hud'i hia ku dhèu sab'a, ngaa dhu pantas ho ra bisa mamuri.

source_text: and into whatever city or village you may enter, inquire who in it is worthy, and abide there, until you may go forth.
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara kota do rae èci, na, miu hud'i tenge ku dhèu dhu neo sèmi rare miu. hèia miu pea ètu èmu èèna, toke miu pakèd'i tèke eele era èèna.

source_text: and coming into the house greet it,
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara èmu dhèu, peka la dènge rèngu, ‘saloom! lamatua hia miu mèngi-nale. '

source_text: and if indeed the house is worthy, let your peace come on it; and if it is not worthy, let your peace return to you.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ètu d'ara èmu ne, sèmi rare miu dènge be'a, na, miu manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia si berkat. te ngaa ladhe ra ro'o boe sèmi rare miu, na, lamatua hia boe rèngu berkat.

source_text: and whoever may not receive you nor hear your words, coming forth from that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet,
target_text: ladhe dhèu ro'o boe nanene lii padhai miu, mi kalua nèti èmu èèna, do kota èèna, hèia miu caro eele ahu nèti haga miu, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ladhe ro'o boe nanene, pe rèngu d'ui rare pala ra.

source_text: truly i say to you, it will be more tolerable for the land of sodom and gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, lod'o ama lamatua huku dhèu ètu rai-haha ne'e, tatu na pabia mi dhèu sodom dènge gomora dhu uru èèna bhelu titu kèna. te ngaa sanèd'e! èèna na, nèngu huku bia risi hari mi dhèu dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare miu!

source_text: behold, i send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves, therefore be wise as the serpents, and pure as the doves.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! te ja'a pua miu ne, èci èèna ka ja'a patabuli kahib'i-kalèbho asa talora aae busa hui. nèti èèna ka, ngangee miu hud'i sèmi mege dhu d'èlu-mèu. aa d'ara mi hud'i mola ku nuka sèmi koro j'aha dhu ne'a boe tenge lii langu.

source_text: and take heed of men, for they will give you up to sanhedrins, and in their synagogues they will scourge you,
target_text: te ngaa baku pamud'e! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu paj'èra miu, sama sèmi busa hui kadhi pamadhe kahib'i-kalèbho. èèna na, rèngu nuni rèti miu asa era parisa lii langu agama. aa dhèu hake paparu miu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a.

source_text: and before governors and kings you will be brought for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
target_text: pe rèngu ère rèti miu asa madha gubernur dènge dhèu aae, lula miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa miu hud'i pake lod'o sèra, ho peka-padhai dènge ra lii lolo be'a nèti ja'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua tadèngi kahèi kolongara ja'a ne.

source_text: and whenever they may deliver you up, do not be anxious how or what you may speak, for it will be given you in that hour what you will speak;
target_text: te ngaa ladhe rèngu nuni rèti miu sèmi èèna, mage miu madha'u, peka na, ‘èèna na, ja'a peka tasamia? ' do, ‘ja'a neo dhaa peka sèmi ngaa? ' baku j'aj'i mi ngangee, te ladhe d'ai lod'o na, ama mi ètu sorga ka dhu peka dènge miu, nèti j'ara mia ka dhu miu hud'i peka-padhai.

source_text: for you are not the speakers, but the spirit of your father that is speaking in you.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ngaa dhu miu padhai, mai boe nèti d'ara miu unu mi, te roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna ka dhu aj'a-nori ètu d'ara miu, sèna ka miu padhai sèmi ngaa sa.

source_text: and brother will deliver up brother to death, and father child, and children will rise up against parents, and will put them to death,
target_text: sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a ètu d'ara èmu cue, ladhe abhu ca dhèu parcaya ja'a, èèna na a'ari nèngu mesa na, ka dhu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. aa ladhe ana ka dhu parcaya, èèna na ama na ka dhu pamadhe ne. ladhe ina-ama ka dhu parcaya, bèli-camèd'a ana-ana ra ka dhu pamadhe si.

source_text: and you will be hated by all because of my name, but he who has endured to the end, he will be saved.
target_text: sanèd'e! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i tèka d'ara dènge miu, lula miu parcaya ja'a ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu taha taruu, èèna na ama lamatua hia ne mamuri.

source_text: and whenever they may persecute you in this city, flee to the other, for truly i say to you, you may not have finished going through the cities of israel until the son of man may come.
target_text: ladhe dhèu paj'èra miu ètu d'ara kota cue, rai lami asa kota leo! lèke kèna! ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ropa miu palème aa'i mèka kota-kota ètu isra'el, te ngaa ja'a dhu lèpa hari mai le èèna.

source_text: a disciple is not above the teacher, nor a servant above his lord;
target_text: biasa dhèu pakab'ua ca dhèu mese risi nèti ana sakola na sèra. aa dhèu pakab'ua ca dhèu lamatua risi nèti ènu na sèra.

source_text: sufficient to the disciple that he may be as his teacher, and the servant as his lord; if the master of the house they called beelzebul, how much more those of his household?
target_text: ladhe ana sakola mèu sama sèmi mese na, nèngu pangee na d'ai le. aa ladhe ènu d'èlu-mèu sama sèmi lamatua na, nèngu ngee na d'ai le. de sanèd'e paie! ladhe dhèu paroa lamatua èmu, peka na, ‘èu ne, baalsebul, dhèu aae nidhu! ' tatu isi èmu na abhu kolongara dhu karehe risi hari.

source_text: you may not, therefore, fear them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, and hid that will not be known;
target_text: de miu baku madha'u dènge dhèu dhu lab'a miu. te, ngaa dhu dhèu tao pahuni, bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi.

source_text: that which i tell you in the darkness, speak in the light, and that which you hear at the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
target_text: ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a-nori le miu mesa mi, miu hud'i lami lole ku mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. aa ngaa dhu ja'a paholo le dènge miu, miu se hud'i lami peka ku palème era.

source_text: and do not be afraid of those killing the body, and are not able to kill the soul, but rather fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in gehenna.
target_text: baku madha'u dènge dhèu rai-haha, te rèngu bisa dhoka pamadhe ngi'u aae dhèu di, te ngaa bisa boe pa'ele iie samanga. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i madha'u ku dènge ama lamatua, te dhoka nèngu di dhu dènge koasa ho pamaso ngi'u aae dhèu dènge samanga kateme, asa d'ara dhasi ai dhu heo na loe boe ciki sa.

source_text: are not two sparrows sold for an assarion? and one of them will not fall on the ground without your father;
target_text: de pa'èra d'ara miu. dhèu pahie ana mangungu ètu d'ara pasa dènge kab'ua ciki oo'e di. te ngaa ci'u sa bisa boe madhe, ladhe ama mi ètu sorga no'o mèka.

source_text: and of you-even the hairs of the head are all numbered;
target_text: ama miu ètu sorga dhu loe boe ladhe-leru miu, toke j'ara-j'ara dhu ana iiki-iiki. d'ai rèu kètu ètu kab'a kètu miu, na ige nare aa'i hèi.

source_text: therefore, do not be afraid, you are better than many sparrows.
target_text: de baku madha'u! lula ama lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti ana mangungu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: everyone, therefore, who will confess in me before men, i also will confess in him before my father who is in the heavens;
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, dhèu dhu bani mangaku ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae ètu rai-haha ne, pe ja'a kahèi mangaku nèngu ètu katanga madha ama ku ètu sorga, peka na, ‘nèngu ne dhèu ja'a. '

source_text: and whoever will deny me before men, i also will deny him before my father who is in the heavens.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu pasili ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae, peka na nèngu tadhe boe ja'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a peka dènge ama ku ètu sorga kahèi, na, ‘ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne'e. '

source_text: you may not suppose that i came to put peace on the earth; i did not come to put peace, but a sword;
target_text: mage mi pangee na, ja'a ne mai kèti dame asa rai-haha ne. te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha ne èci lab'a èci.

source_text: for i came to set a man at variance against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law,
target_text: ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua peka tèke èèna, ‘èèna na, ana mone lab'a ama na, ana bhèni lab'a ina na, aa bhèni dhèu èmu ana na, lab'a ina nèti dhèu èmu na,

source_text: and the enemies of a man are those of his household.
target_text: te isi èmu mae-manyèla, lula èci lab'a èci. '

source_text: he who is cherishing father or mother above me, is not worthy of me, and he who is cherishing son or daughter above me, is not worthy of me,
target_text: de dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a tare'a-re'a, nèngu hud'i sue ku ja'a, risi nèti aa'i-aa'i, risi nèti ina-ama na, aa risi nèti ana niki na. ladhe aad'o, na, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: and whoever does not receive his cross and follow after me, is not worthy of me.
target_text: te dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, te ngaa d'èi boe pasae j'aj'èra, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: he who found his life will lose it, and he who lost his life for my sake will find it.
target_text: dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula na madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu dhoka neo mamuri hia ngi'u nèngu unu na, èèna na, mamuri na ele iia d'ara!

source_text: he who is receiving you receives me, and he who is receiving me receives him who sent me;
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare miu dènge be'a, nèngu sèmi nare ja'a kahèi. aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare ja'a, nèngu kahèi sèmi nare ama lamatua dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: he who is receiving a prophet in the name of a prophet, will receive a prophet's reward, and he who is receiving a righteous man in the name of a righteous man, will receive a righteous man's reward,
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, lula na padhue-padhai lii holo-nori ama lamatua, pe lamatua b'ala nèngu sama sèmi na b'ala mi ca dhèu nèti lii padhai nèngu. aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare ca dhèu d'ara mola, lula dhèu èèna madhutu tare'a-re'a dad'èi ama lamatua, pe lamatua b'ala nèngu sama sèmi na b'ala mi ca dhèu d'ara mola.

source_text: and whoever may give to drink to one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, truly i say to you, he may not lose his reward.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare ca dhèu dhu haha d'ai seli, lula nèngu madhutu ja'a, tatu ama lamatua b'ala ne. masi ka dhèu hia èi hua ca galaa di, tatu ama lamatua bhèlu boe ne.

source_text: and it came to pass, when jesus finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and to preach in their cities.
target_text: ropa yesus hia nare lii moa mi canguru dua ana madhutu na, hèia na la'e kako palème rae-rae ètu rai èèna, sèna ka aj'a dhèu ètu sèra. aa na peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua.

source_text: and john having heard in the prison the works of the christ, having sent two of his disciples,
target_text: lod'o èèna, yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho. ropa na tadèngi j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu yesus tao, hèia na pua ana madhutu na ho lasi karèi yesus, peka na,

source_text: said to him, are you he who is coming, or do we look for another?
target_text: ama lamatua dhu pajaji tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, na, nèngu neo pua kristus mai, sèna ka pala mamuri mi èdhi dhèu yahudi. ama ne, kristus, do? do, èdhi hud'i mate hari ku dhèu leo? ka lasi karèi yesus.

source_text: and jesus answering said to them, having gone, declare to john the things that you hear and see,
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se tadèngi le, aa mèdhi unu mi dènge madha. de lèpa ho lami peka dènge yohanis, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i, nuka sèmi ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, yesaya, suri tèke le, peka na:

source_text: blind receive sight, and lame walk, lepers are cleansed, and deaf hear, dead are raised, and poor have good news proclaimed,
target_text: dhèu bèdhu, ladhe rèdhi. dhèu karuku, kèd'i kako. dhèu pèd'a kusta, ka'uri ra milu hari. dhèu katele-katipa, bisa tadèngi. dhèu madhe, mamuri hari. dhèu unu aad'o, nanene lii lolo be'a.

source_text: and blessed is he who may not be stumbled in me.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e: lami peka dènge yohanis, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu a'oto, ladhe na parcaya ja'a taruu. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a pa'èra-èra!

source_text: and as they are going, jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning john, what did you go out to the wilderness to view? a reed shaken by the wind?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis se lèpa, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae se, lula-nèti yohanis ne, aku nèngu na, lod'o miu neo paraga dènge yohanis ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a, miu pangee, na, neo paraga dènge dhèu dhu sèmi ngaa sa? tatu boe, miu paraga dènge dhèu dhu roe aala-aala, nuka sèmi kalai èèu dhu bhabheu madhutu ngèlu di!

source_text: but what did you go out to see? a man clothed in soft garments? behold, those wearing the soft things are in the kings' houses.
target_text: aa tatu boe miu mèdhi dhèu dhu pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae, te dhèu sèmi èèna era pea na dhodhoka ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae di!

source_text: but what did you go out to see? a prophet? yes, i say to you, and more than a prophet,
target_text: de lami ladhe dhèu sèmi ngaa sa ètu nèi? mi pangee na, miu lami tenge dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua! tare'a! te nèngu ne, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu kapai risi.

source_text: for this is he of whom it has been written: behold, i send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, dhu suri tèke le lula-nèti yohanis ne, peka na, ‘nanene! ja'a pua dhèu ja'a, sèna ka bhoke j'ara hia èu. '

source_text: truly i say to you, there has not risen, among those born of women, one greater than john the immerser, but he who is least in the kingdom of the heavens is greater than he.
target_text: nanene paie! ètu rai-haha ne, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis ne. te ngaa nèti dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i dhu mangaku ama lamatua sama sèmi dhèu aae, dhèu dhu haha d'ai seli èèna ka, nèngu dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis.

source_text: and from the days of john the immerser until now, the kingdom of the heavens suffers violence, and violent men seize it by force,
target_text: karèi nèti yohanis pakako sasab'a na, d'ai sange ne'e ne, abhu dhèu ae-ae dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. te ngaa abhu dhèu leo dhu pangee sala, peka na rèngu hud'i pamusu ku, sèna ka laka-seti dhèu ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: for all the prophets and the law prophesied until john,
target_text: toke d'ai lod'o mamai yohanis tuka sarani, èdhi dhèu yahudi dhu tema madhutu atora musa, dènge atora dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua leo sèra.

source_text: and if you are willing to receive it, he is elijah who was about to come;
target_text: de parcaya la ja'a! yohanis ne, nuka elia, dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, peka mema le lula-nèti mamai na.

source_text: he who is having ears to hear-let him hear.
target_text: de dhu neo me'a mèu, hud'i nanene ku paie-iie!

source_text: and to what will i liken this generation? it is like little children in marketplaces, sitting and calling to others,
target_text: ja'a neo hia lii pakasame, sèna ka miu me'a, rupa sèmi mia ka dhèu taa limuri ne. te rèngu se cakaraa dènge ana-ana dhu madhèdi ètu d'ara pasa. rèngu dhu pa'oo-parodha dènge angalai ra, peka na,

source_text: and saying, we piped to you, and you did not dance, we lamented to you, and you did not strike the breast.
target_text: ‘ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi tiu sakino dènge karej'e-karae, te ngaa miu roge-ledho boe. hèia ji'i sod'a lii beke dhèu madhe, te ngaa miu tangi boe. '

source_text: for john came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, he has a demon;
target_text: miu se sama sèmi ana iiki dhu re'a boe roca. lod'o yohanis mai, nèngu d'èi puasa, aa ninu boe èi anggor. te ngaa dhèu peka na, ‘nèngu, nidhu tao! '

source_text: the son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, behold, a man, a glutton, and a wine-drinker, a friend of tax collectors and sinners; and wisdom was justified of her children.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, mai le. ja'a puasa boe, aa kinu èi anggor. te ngaa dhèu peka na, ‘nèngu èèna, dhèu gagoo-gagehu! dhèu tema mahu bia! la'e pa'angalai dènge dhèu roro bea! pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe. nèngu dhu ne'a boe makae! ' te ngaa mi patadhe lii padhai ja'a ne! mamèu ama lamatua èèna, cèu ètu d'ara mamuri dhèu unu na.

source_text: then he began to reproach the cities in which were done most of his mighty works, because they did not convert.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua yesus pasanèd'e dhèu-dhèu dhu pea ètu pèri-pèri rae. na tao le tadha-tadha malaa ae risi ètu nèi, te ngaa ro'o boe ae eele nèti sasala ra, ho madhutu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua dhu mola.

source_text: woe to you, chorazin! woe to you, bethsaida! because, if in tyre and sidon had been done the mighty works that were done in you, long ago in sackcloth and ashes they had converted;
target_text: yesus jèke si, peka na, heh! miu dhèu korasin, aa miu dhèu betsaida! mate unu miu! bèli-camèd'a pasae mere mamadhe-mamopo! ja'a tao le rupa-rupa tadha malaa ètu katanga madha miu, te ngaa miu mo'o boe parcaya ama lamatua. masi ka miu dhèu yahudi dhu peka na, miu tadhe lamatua, te ngaa ladhe sèmi tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao se'e ètu kota tirus dènge kota sidon, tatu nèbhu nare sange ne'e, dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra èle le ho'a, aa tèke eele le sasala-sasigo ra ho madhutu ama lamatua. aa tatu ra pake le bèla mèdhi, dènge tao ahu mi kètu ho j'aj'i mi tadha, na, rèngu manyasa nèti sasala ra. masi ka dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon sèra dhèu yahudi boe, dhu mangaku na, tadhe lamatua.

source_text: but i say to you, to tyre and sidon it will be more tolerable in the day of judgment than for you.
target_text: ja'a monya boe! bèli-camèd'a mèdhi unu mi! d'ai lod'o dhu ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, hahuku dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon samaa risi nèti hahuku miu.

source_text: and you, capernaum, which were exalted to heaven, will be brought down to hades, because if the mighty works that were done in you had been done in sodom, it had remained to this day;
target_text: miu dhèu kapernaum! mage-mage, ee! mage mi pangee, na, ama lamatua paca'e miu lami asa sorga. aad'o! èèna na lamatua pèci mi asa d'ara naraka! ladhe sèmi tadha-tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao ètu rae miu dhu j'aj'i uuru le ètu kota sodom, tatu ama lamatua parluu boe labhu pakèpu kota èèna. te ladhe dhèu sodom rèdhi tadha malaa se, tatu ra rai eele le nèti bhabhelu-katub'a ra.

source_text: but i say to you, to the land of sodom it will be more tolerable in the day of judgment than to you.
target_text: tare'a! pe mèdhi unu mi! ladhe d'ai ka lod'o ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i, hahuku dhèu sodom samaa risi nèti hahuku miu se!

source_text: at that time jesus answering said, i confess to you, father, lord of the heavens and of the earth, that you hid these things from wise and understanding ones, and revealed them to babies.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus sabaj'a, peka na, ama! ama dhu j'aj'i lamatua ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae, lula ama pahuni pamèno-mèno j'ara-j'ara dhu ama hia huku mi dhèu-dhèu dhu pangee na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu, aa dhu padedha iisi ra. te ngaa ama bhoke patalele j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi dhèu haha dènge dhu pahaha iisi ra.

source_text: yes, father, because so it was good pleasure before you.
target_text: tare'a, ama! te sèmi èèna ka, dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama!

source_text: all things were delivered to me by my father, and none know the son, except the father, nor does any know the father, except the son, and he to whom the son may resolve to reveal him.
target_text: ropa sabaj'a nare, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, na, nanene paie-iie! ama ku ètu sorga pangèd'u le koasa aa'i-aa'i mi ja'a ne. dhu tadhe mèu ja'a, dhoka ama ku di. aa dhu tadhe mèu ama, dhoka ana na, nuka ja'a ne. aa ja'a hag'e kore dhèu leo, sèna ka peka dènge ra, ho rèngu tadhe mèu ne kahèi.

source_text: come to me, all you laboring and burdened ones, and i will give you rest;
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu roe lula sab'a bia, mai madhutu ja'a! aa miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu pasae bia, mai la asa ja'a!

source_text: take up my yoke on you, and learn from me, because i am meek and humble in heart, and you will find rest to your souls,
target_text: ladhe miu sèmi mere a'aj'a ja'a, ho kako palere-lere dènge ja'a, na, èdhi ca ropa dènge sapi dua ngi'u dhu nuni kataka pare rai èci. te ja'a ne, d'ara hua iia, aa lii mako. ladhe miu madhutu ja'a, miu j'aj'i èra hari.

source_text: for my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
target_text: lula a'aj'a ja'a, carui boe. aa paredha ja'a, bia boe kahèi.

source_text: at that time jesus went on the sabbaths through the grainfields, and his disciples were hungry, and they began to pluck ears, and to eat,
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu kako re karasa oka dhèu. ana madhutu na manganga, hèia ra g'ètu are-gandum ka ra'a noo-noo.
