source_text: and the whole city was gathered together near the door,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ca kabarai mai pakaboko pènu tao cèci ètu madha èmu èèna.

source_text: and he healed many who were ill of manifold diseases, and he cast forth many demons, and was not permitting the demons to speak, because they knew him.
target_text: èi papèd'a ra rupa-rupa, te ngaa yesus puri-pa'èle aa'i mèu-mèu si. hèia na lalèta eele nidhu ae nèti dhèu sèra. yesus hia boe tebho nidhu se'e padhai lii, lula ra tadhe ne.

source_text: and very early, it being yet night, having risen, he went forth, and went away to a desolate place, and was praying there;
target_text: bèli èèna mad'ae aae era, ako maroga, yesus kèd'i ka la'e asa era èci dhu nee-nee, ka na manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua.

source_text: and simon and those with him went in quest of him,
target_text: ropa simon si kèd'i, rèdhi heka yesus, ka lasi tenge ne.

source_text: and having found him, they say to him, all seek you;
target_text: ra paraga dènge yesus, ka ra peka, ama, dhèu canau mai tenge ama ku.

source_text: and he says to them, we may go into the next towns, that there also i may preach, for-for this i came forth.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, èèna be'a kahèi. te ngaa be'a risi lati uru asa rae-rae leo, ho ja'a aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua. te èèna sasab'a-la'a ja'a na.

source_text: and he was preaching in their synagogues, in all galilee, and is casting out the demons,
target_text: èle èèna ka, rèngu kako palème era ètu propensi galilea, ho lole lii lolo be'a ama lamatua. ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, na babège-lalèta eele nidhu nèti dhèu sèra.

source_text: and there comes to him a leper, calling on him, and kneeling to him, and saying to him, if you may will, you are able to cleanse me.
target_text: dhèu èci dhu lèke papèd'a kusta mai paraga dènge yesus, ka na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. na manèngi, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! sue ku ja'a laa. tao pa'èle ku papèd'a ja'a ne. ja'a ke'a, na, ama bisa pa'èle papèd'a ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu madenge heka dènge ja'a.

source_text: and jesus having been moved with compassion, having stretched forth the hand, touched him and says to him, i will, be cleansed;
target_text: nèti lii roma iisi na, ka d'ara yesus roe, ka na j'ole kacui-aai ho kèpe ne. hèia na peka, tare'a! ja'a bisa! èu èle kèna!

source_text: and he having spoken, immediately the leprosy went away from him, and he was cleansed.
target_text: kaca'a laa, papèd'a èèna ele dènge. ka dhèu èèna pèd'a heka.

source_text: and having sternly charged him, immediately he put him forth,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus pua dhèu èèna lèpa dènge pasanèd'e ne, peka na,

source_text: and says to him, see that you may say nothing to anyone, but go away, show yourself to the priest, and bring near for your cleansing the things moses directed, for a testimony to them.
target_text: mu nanene! èu èle le, te ngaa baku lole dènge cee-cee! èu hud'i madhutu ku lii paredha musa uru èèna. de lamu uru ku asa ama agama, ho na parisa ngi'u mu. sèna ka ne'a èi papèd'a èu na ele le, do dhae. èle èèna ka, heka èu hia mèdha èci sèmi tadha makasi, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a èu èle le tare'a-re'a.

source_text: and he, having gone forth, began to proclaim much, and to spread the thing abroad, so that he was no longer able to openly enter into the city, but he was outside in desolate places, and they were coming to him from every quarter.
target_text: masi ka yesus kai baku peka dènge cee-cee, te ngaa ropa la'e d'ai li'u, ka na lolo lème dènge dhèu. èle èèna ka, dhèu ae neo paraga dènge yesus. te ngaa, lula lii dhèu èèna, ka yesus bisa boe pad'elo iisi na asa d'ara kota. nèti èèna ka, yesus pea dhoka ètu era mau èci ètu li'u kota. te ngaa dhèu mai paraga dènge ne nèti mia-mia.

source_text: and again he entered into capernaum, after some days, and it was heard that he is in the house,
target_text: èle pèri-pèri lod'o, hèia yesus lèpa hari asa kapernaum. ka ra papeka d'ai mia-mia, peka na, yesus d'ai le èmu.

source_text: and immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even at the door, and he was speaking to them the word.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu mai nèti mia-mia. lula dhèu ae seli, ka ètu d'ara èmu pènu risi, toke d'ai hèb'a èmu. èle èèna ka, yesus lole dènge ra dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: and they come to him, bringing a paralytic, carried by four,
target_text: ètu talora na padhai lii era, dhèu èpa jèru dhèu karuku èci neo asa madha yesus.

source_text: and not being able to come near to him because of the multitude, they uncovered the roof where he was, and having broken it up, they let down the pallet on which the paralytic was lying,
target_text: te ngaa, lula dhèu ae d'ai seli, ka rèngu abhu boe sasanga ho rèti dhèu èèna asa madha yesus. hèia ca'e lasi asa kolo èmu, bhoke eele rèu èmu re dedha kètu yesus. ropa ra bhoke rare rèu èmu, hèia ra papuru dhèu karuku èena dènge dhèpi na.

source_text: and jesus having seen their faith, says to the paralytic, child, your sins have been forgiven you.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi si, nèngu ne'a le dhèu se'e parcaya tare'a-re'a nèngu. ka na padhai lii dènge dhèu karuku ne, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a saku eele le sasala èu!

source_text: and there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
target_text: ètu èèna kahèi, abhu pèri-pèri mese agama yahudi. ropa ra tadèngi rare lii padhai lii yesus, ka d'ara ngangee rèngu be'a boe.

source_text: why does this one thus speak evil words? who is able to forgive sins except one-god?
target_text: hèia ra papeka, boo! dhèu ne'e bani titu kèna, padhai lii sèmi nèi! dhodhoka ama lamatua di, dhu dènge hak ho saku eele sasala dhèu. te ngaa dhèu ne'e tao ngi'u na èci èèna ka dènge ama lamatua. nèngu pakarehe kolongara ama lamatua!

source_text: and immediately jesus, having known in his spirit that they thus reason in themselves, said to them, why do you reason these things in your hearts?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le ngangee rèngu. hèia na peka, heh! miu baku pangee sèmi èèna.

source_text: which is easier? to say to the paralytic, your sins are forgiven; or to say, rise, and take up your pallet, and walk? and that you may know that the son of man has authority on the earth to forgive sins-he says to the paralytic-
target_text: mia dhu be'a risi? ladhe ja'a peka mi dhèu karuku ne, ‘sasala èu saku eele le, ' miu me'a boe, na, j'aj'i do aad'o. te ngaa ladhe ja'a peka, ‘kèd'i ka! nedhe dhèpi èu, ho lèpa ka. ' ladhe na kèd'i ho miu ladhe mèdhi kahèi, heka miu me'a kèna, ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. aa ja'a dènge koasa kahèi, ho saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu! èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii dènge dhèu karuku èèna, peka na,

source_text: i say to you, rise, and take up your pallet, and go away to your house;
target_text: èu nanene, ee! èu èle le ne! kèd'i ka, nedhe dhèpi èu ho lamu ka.

source_text: and he rose immediately, and having taken up the pallet, he went forth before all, so that all were astonished, and glorify god, saying, never thus did we see.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, cag'ag'a laa dhèu ne kèd'i titu. na nedhe dhèpi na, hèia la'e ka asa li'u. dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra malaa-maloha, ka ra peka, ira ii! èdhi heka tèdhi ka! ama lamatua tare'a-re'a kapai d'ai seli!

source_text: and he went forth again by the sea, and all the multitude was coming to him, and he was teaching them,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus la'e hari asa sebhe dano galilea. ka dhèu ae titu kèna mai paraga dènge ne, hèia na lole dad'èi ama lamatua mi rèngu.

source_text: and passing by, he saw levi of alpheus sitting at the tax office, and says to him, follow me, and he, having risen, followed him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu èci ngara na lewi, ana nèti alpius. sasab'a na roro doi bea. lod'o yesus kako re èèna ka ladhe nèdhi lewi. ka na peka dènge ne, wee! mai madhutu ja'a! ropa tadèngi lii yesus ne, lewi kèd'i dènge ka la'e madhutu ne.

source_text: and it came to pass, in his reclining in his house, that many tax collectors and sinners were dining with jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si ra'a ètu d'ara èmu lewi, pa'èci dènge angalai lewi dhèu roro doi bea sèra. abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu leo madhèdi ra'a dènge rèngu. madhutu ngangee dhèu yahudi, dhèu se'e dhèu karehe. nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu madhèdi ra'a se abhu dhèu ae kahèi dhu d'èi nanene lii padhai lii yesus.

source_text: and the scribes and the pharisees, having seen him eating with the tax collectors and sinners, said to his disciples, why-that with the tax collectors and sinners he eats and drinks?
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu pèri-pèri mese agama nèti partei parisi dhu rèdhi yesus madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge tuka roro doi bea, dènge dhèu karehe sèra. ka ra karèi ana madhutu yesus, peka na, nga tao ka mese miu madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge dhèu roro doi bea dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe sèra?

source_text: and jesus, having heard, says to them, they who are strong have no need of a physician, but they who are ill; i did not come to call righteous men, but sinners.
target_text: yesus tadèngi lii karèi rèngu èèna, ka na dhaa, peka na, dhèu pèd'a mema parluu dote, te ngaa dhèu dhu pèd'a boe, parluu boe dote. mamai ja'a ne sèna ka lalau dhèu dhu laku-laku boe. te ja'a mai boe ho uri dhèu dhu rasa ngi'u na mola.

source_text: and the disciples of john and those of the pharisees were fasting, and they come and say to him, why do the disciples of john and those of the pharisees fast, and your disciples do not fast?
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu nèti partei agama parisi puasa. rèngu rèdhi ana madhutu yohanis tuka sarani, puasa kahèi. te ngaa rèdhi boe ana madhutu yesus puasa sèmi rèngu. hèia dhèu rèngu mai paraga dènge yesus, ka ra karèi, aku rèngu na, ama. ji'i puasa sama sèmi ana madhutu yohanis kahèi. te, nga tao ka, ana madhutu ama puasa boe?

source_text: and jesus said to them, are the sons of the bride-chamber able, while the bridegroom is with them, to fast? as long a time as they have the bridegroom with them they are not able to fast;
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, mema miu me'a le, ladhe abhu pesta kab'i, dhèu dhu abhu nèru sèra puasa boe, ka ra'a toke bècu. ladhe mone dhu kab'i èèna era, dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra'a-rinu.

source_text: but days will come when the bridegroom may be taken from them, and then they will fast-in those days.
target_text: te ladhe d'ai lod'o ho ra kèpe rèti dhèu mone dhu kab'i èèna, ka mone aanga-angalai na sèra d'ara susa, heka ra puasa kèna.

source_text: and no one sews a patch of undressed cloth on an old garment, and if not-the new, filling it up, takes from the old and the split becomes worse;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, bèla hiu baku kalape mi kodho dhui. te ladhe base, na, bèla hiu èèna karuku, hèia kodho èèna asa ka mae aae.

source_text: and no one puts new wine into old skins, and if not-the new wine bursts the skins, and the wine is poured out, and the skins will be destroyed; but new wine is to be put into new skins.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, miu baku edhe dhua pèd'u ètu d'ara sabha dhui. te aad'o na, sabha èèna mae, aa dhua pèd'u na bhori eele asa rai. nèti èèna ka yesus peka dènge si, baku pakihu-kee lii holo-nori nèngu dhu hiu, dènge lii holo-nori dhèu parisi dhu dhui.

source_text: and it came to pass-he is going along on the sabbaths through the grainfields-and his disciples began to make a way, plucking the ears,
target_text: ca tèka, lèke lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, yesus si kako re j'ara ètu d'ara oka. ka ana madhutu na g'ètu rèti are gandum.

source_text: and the pharisees said to him, behold, why do they do on the sabbaths that which is not lawful?
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi ladhe rèdhi, ka ra karèi yesus, tasamia ka, ana madhutu èu madhutu boe j'ara-j'ara agama èdhi? rèngu se g'ètu are gandum lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a. miu baku tao sèmi èèna!

source_text: and he said to them, did you never read what david did when he had need and was hungry, he and those with him? how he went into the house of god, in the days of abiathar the chief priest, and ate the bread of the presentation, which it is not lawful to eat, except to the priests, and he also gave to those who were with him?
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, samia, ee? miu sanèd'e heka lii lolo daud. tèu èèna, abyatar j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. lod'o èèna, daud dènge dhèu madhutu na aa'i-aa'i ra manganga bia. ka ra maso asa d'ara paleo ama lamatua, hèia ra'a roti dhu ama agama hia le mi lamatua. madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu dhu bisa ra'a roti èèna, dhoka ama-ama agama di; dhèu leo bisa boe. daud dènge ana madhutu na sèra, ra'e rare roti èèna, te ngaa dhèu èci sa peka boe, na, daud si sala.

source_text: and he said to them, the sabbath was made for man, not man for the sabbath,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lole hari dènge rèngu, miu baku bhèlu! lamatua hia lod'o a'oro sasab'a hia èdhi dhèu rai-haha. lamatua paj'aj'i boe èdhi dhèu rai-haha, ho madhutu dhoka atora lod'o a'oro sasab'a di.

source_text: so that the son of man is also lord of the sabbath.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a ne ka dhu peka ho dhèu sab'a, do aad'o, lèke dènge lod'o a'oro sasab'a.

source_text: and he entered again into the synagogue, and there was there a man having the hand withered,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lèpa hari la'e asa èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. d'ai nèi, ka yesus paraga dènge dhèu èci dhu ai na roe cabèka.

source_text: and they were watching him, whether on the sabbaths he will heal him, that they might accuse him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu patangi-tenge sasala yesus. ra ma'u yesus, neo re'a na puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a, do aad'o.

source_text: and he says to the man having the hand withered, rise up in the midst.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa dhèu dhu ai roe cabèka èèna, aku nèngu na, mai ku! titu ku mi madha ja'a ne.

source_text: and he says to them, is it lawful on the sabbaths to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? but they were silent.
target_text: ka na karèi dhèu ae ètu sèra sa, aku nèngu na, madhutu atora agama èdhi, èdhi bisa tao ngaa lod'o a'oro sasab'a? tao madha j'ara dhu be'a, do karehe? tao pabe'a dhèu, do pamadhe dhèu? te ngaa dhèu sèra èci sa bani boe bhoke hèb'a.

source_text: and having looked around on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their heart, he says to the man, stretch forth your hand; and he stretched forth, and his hand was restored whole as the other;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus d'ara pèd'a, lula rèngu madhutu dhoka ad'a di, tao boe madha-dhilu mi dhèu ai roe cabèka ne. yesus nasa, ka na ladhe lème dhèu sèra. hèia na peka mi dhèu ai roe cabèka, aku nèngu na, j'ole kacui-aai èu mai sa ne'e! ka dhèu èèna soro kacui-aai asa yesus la'e. kabèdhi laa, èle dènge papèd'a na.

source_text: and the pharisees having gone forth, immediately, with the herodians, were taking counsel against him how they might destroy him.
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi ladhe rèdhi yesus pa'èle kacui-aai dhèu èèna lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a, aa'i-aa'i ra kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ka lasi padhue dènge dhèu partei politik herodes, ho tenge j'ara neo pamadhe yesus.

source_text: and jesus withdrew with his disciples to the sea, and a great multitude from galilee followed him, and from judea, and from jerusalem, and from idumea and beyond the jordan; and they around tyre and sidon-a great multitude-having heard how he was doing great things, came to him.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa sebhe dano galilea. te ngaa, lula dhèu ae sèra re'a le ngaa dhu nèngu tao, ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i mai nèti rae-rae ho madhutu ne. rèngu mai nèti propensi galilea, propensi yudea, aa propensi idumea. abhu kahèi dhu mai nèti kota yerusalem, kota sidon dènge kota tirus. abhu kahèi cahag'e dhu mai nèti cabèka dhimu loko yarden. aa'i-aa'i sèra neo mai paraga dènge ne.

source_text: and he said to his disciples that a little boat may wait on him, because of the multitude, that they may not press on him,
target_text: taga dhèu dhu mai sèra ae seli, ka yesus pua ana madhutu na lasi tenge koha cue hia nèngu. na neo padhai lii dènge dhèu ae sèra nèti dedha koha, sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa ladhe rèdhi rèhu na, aa tadèngi lii padhai lii na hèi.

source_text: for he healed many, so that they threw themselves on him, in order to touch him-as many as had plagues;
target_text: ca hari ni, na puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a ae titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae mai paseti èci dènge èci, neo g'ag'e yesus.

source_text: and the unclean spirits, when they were seeing him, were falling down before him, and were crying, saying, you are the son of god;
target_text: ropa dhèu dhu nidhu tao sa ladhe rèdhi yesus, ka ra bèbha d'ai rai ètu madha yesus. hèia ra taraa, aku rèngu na, èu ne mema tare'a ana ama lamatua!

source_text: and many times he was charging them that they might not make him apparent.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kai rèngu, aku nèngu na, miu baku ale dènge dhèu èci sa hèi, ja'a ne cee!

source_text: and he goes up to the mountain, and calls near whom he willed, and they went away to him;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako la'e asa kolo ledhe èci. na paroa pèri-pèri dhèu dhu nèngu d'èi. ka dhèu se mai madhutu ne.

source_text: and he appointed twelve, that they may be with him, and that he may send them forth to preach,
target_text: èle èèna ka, na hag'e nare dhèu canguru dua. ka na peka, ja'a pili miu ho madhutu taruu ja'a, j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a. ja'a neo pua miu, lami lole lii lolo be'a ama lamatua mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and to have power to heal the sicknesses, and to cast out the demons.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi ja'a neo hia miu koasa, sèna ka miu bisa babège-lalèta nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: and he put on simon the name peter; and james of zebedee, and john the brother of james, and he put on them names-boanerges, that is, sons of thunder; and andrew, and philip, and bartholomew, and matthew, and thomas, and james of alpheus, and thaddeus, and simon the zealot, and judas iscariot, who also delivered him up; and they come into a house.
target_text: ngara dhèu canguru dua sa, nuka: simon dhu yesus pangare na, petrus, yakobis, yohanis, yakobis dènge ari na, yohanis ne, dua ra ana sabadeus. yesus pangare rèngu dua ra, ngara na ‘boanerges', dhu sasoa na ‘sama sèmi d'oro'. anderias, pelipus, bertolomeos, mateos, tomas, yakobis ana alpius, tadius, simon dhu madhutu partei politik selot, dènge yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahie eele yesus.

source_text: and a multitude comes together again, so that they are not even able to eat bread;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra puru hari nèti kolo ledhe deo na. ka lasi asa d'ara èmu èci. dhèu ae titu kèna mai oke rare ne, ka na bisa boe na'a-ninu.

source_text: and those alongside him having heard, went forth to lay hold on him, for they said that he was beside himself,
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ra papeka, aku rèngu na, miu ladhe ku yesus! ne'a heka lalau iisi na. ropa a'ari na tadèngi lii palolo dhèu, ka ra mai neo rare ne.

source_text: and the scribes who are from jerusalem having come down, said, he has beelzebul, and, by the ruler of the demons he casts out the demons.
target_text: lod'o èèna, mese-mese agama nèti yerusalem mai peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku rèngu na, heh! pasa dhilu miu! baku madhutu yesus. te dhèu aae nidhu, dhu ra paroa ngara na baalsebul, maso asa d'ara yesus, ka hia ne koasa, ho bata-magèla nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: and having called them near, he said to them in allegories, how is satan able to cast out satan?
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi nare lii padhue rèngu èèna, heia na paroa nare rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka na peka, lèke boe dènge ngangee dhèu! tasamia ka dhèu aae nidhu bisa babège ngi'u mesa na! ?

source_text: and if a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot be made to stand;
target_text: ladhe ètu d'ara paredha dhèu aae èci, ana kabarai sèra èci patao-palaha dènge èci, paredha dhèu aae èèna taha nèbhu boe.

source_text: and if a house is divided against itself, that house cannot be made to stand;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi ètu d'ara èmu, ladhe isi èmu èci patao dènge èci, isi èmu èèna mae-manyèla!

source_text: and if satan rose against himself, and has been divided, he cannot be made to stand, but has an end.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge nidhu. ladhe èci pamusu dènge èci, rèngu mae-manyèla kahèi. sèmi èèna na, heka rèngu laho kao-kao.

source_text: no one is able to spoil the vessels of the strong man, having entered into his house, if first he may not bind the strong man, and then he will spoil his house.
target_text: ladhe dhèu parapo neo mai parapo èmu dhèu èra èci, na hud'i èki-karadhe uuru ku lamatua èmu na, heka bau nèti mèdha-panyau kèna.

source_text: truly i say to you that all sins will be forgiven to the sons of men, and slanders with which they might have slandered,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka mema dènge miu: ama lamatua sadia saku eele sasala dhèu. ladhe dhèu padhai lii karehe mi dedha dhèu leo, ama lamatua bisa saku eele sasala na era.

source_text: but whoever may slander in regard to the holy spirit has no forgiveness-throughout the age, but is in danger of continuous judgment;
target_text: te ngaa lii padhai lii karehe mi dedha roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, ama lamatua saku eele boe sasala nèngu, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e!

source_text: because they said, he has an unclean spirit.
target_text: yesus peka sèmi èèna, lula dhèu sèra peka na, dhèu èèna, nidhu tao.

source_text: then his brothers and mother come, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ina dènge ari yesus sèra mai tenge ne. d'ai èmu dhu yesus madhèdi ètu d'ara na, rèngu lasi boe asa d'ara, te ngaa ra titu ètu li'u, ka ra hia dhèu lasi paroa yesus.

source_text: and a multitude was sitting around him, and they said to him, behold, your mother and your brothers seek you outside.
target_text: lasi, na, yesus madhèdi padhai lii dènge dhèu ae. ka dhèu sèra peka dènge ne, ama, ee! ina mu dènge a'ari mu nuka ètu li'u si. ra neo paraga dènge ama.

source_text: and he answered them, saying, who is my mother, or my brothers?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, cee ka dhu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ina dènge a'ari ja'a?

source_text: and having looked around in a circle to those sitting around him, he says, behold, my mother and my brothers!
target_text: hèia na ladhe palème asa dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu sèra, ka na peka, miu se'e se ka dhu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ina dènge a'ari ja'a.

source_text: for whoever may do the will of god, he is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
target_text: te cee ka dhu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, rèngu sèra ka dhu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ina dènge a'ari ja'a.

source_text: and again he began to teach by the sea, and there was gathered to him a great multitude, so that he, having gone into the boat, sat in the sea, and all the multitude was near the sea, on the land,
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus la'e hari asa dano galilea. d'ai nèi dhèu ae mai oke rare ne. ka yesus ca'e la'e madhèdi asa dedha koha cue dhu panahu. na aj'a dhèu sèra dènge lii pakasame. dhèu dhu titu ètu dedha salae sèra aa'i-aa'i nanene yesus aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: and he taught them many things in allegories, and he said to them in his teaching:
target_text: na aj'a si lii holo-nori rupa-rupa pake lii pakasame. aku nèngu sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: listen, behold, the sower went forth to sow;
target_text: nanene paie-iie! dhèu èci la'e ceb'e hini ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: and it came to pass, in the sowing, some fell by the way, and the birds of the sky came and devoured it;
target_text: ropa na ceb'e hini sèra, cahag'e lèke ètu sebhe j'ara. kabèdhi laa, manu-bhui mai ka ra'a aa'i.

source_text: and other fell on the rocky ground, where it did not have much earth, and immediately it sprang forth, because of having no depth of earth,
target_text: cahag'e hari lèke ètu era rai dhu pènu dènge hadhu. hini sèra muri, te ngaa rai isi dhoka ciki oo'e di.

source_text: and the sun having risen, it was scorched, and because of having no root it withered;
target_text: ropa lod'o rea mai, ana nganga'a sèra kamale eele hèia madhe aa'i si, lula amo d'ai boe d'ara rai.

source_text: and other fell toward the thorns, and the thorns came up and choked it, and it gave no fruit;
target_text: hini cahag'e lèke ètu dedha rai dhu pènu dènge j'u'u padhudhu. ropa j'u'u sèra muri, hèlu rare ana nganga'a sèra, ka j'aj'i boe hua-hela.

source_text: and other fell to the good ground, and was giving fruit, coming up and increasing, and it was bearing, one thirty-fold, and one sixty, and one a hundred.
target_text: te ngaa hini cahag'e lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi. hini sèra muri dènge sega. hua ae titu kèna. cahag'e dhu abhu d'ai tèlu nguru hari, cahag'e èna nguru hari, aa cahag'e d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: and he said to them, he who is having ears to hear-let him hear.
target_text: de ladhe cee dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene paie!

source_text: and when he was alone, those around him, with the twelve, asked him of the allegory,
target_text: ca tèka, yesus mesa na. hèia ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua dènge pèri-pèri dhèu dhu tadèngi le lii holo-nori na, mai paraga dènge ne. ka ra karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame èèna.

source_text: and he said to them, to you it has been given to know the secret of the kingdom of god, but to those who are outside, in allegories are all the things done,
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, lula miu tare'a-re'a neo me'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua, ja'a neo peka dènge miu. te ngaa mi dhèu leo, ja'a pake lii pakasame.

source_text: that seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest they may turn, and the sins may be forgiven them.
target_text: tatao dhèu leo sèra sama sèmi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke, peka na, ‘rèngu rèdhi le, te ngaa ro'o boe re'a. rèngu tadèngi le, te ngaa ro'o boe tèke ètu d'ara. ladhe sèmi èèna, hud'i rèngu sène. ra parcaya ia ka lamatua, sèna ka lamatua saku eele ia ka sasala ra. '

source_text: and he says to them, have you not known this allegory? and how will you know all the allegories?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge dhèu sèra sasoa lii pakasame hini èèna, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu me'a boe sasoa nèti lii upama deo na, carui risi hari miu me'a sasoa lii pakasame dhu leo.

source_text: he who is sowing sows the word;
target_text: de sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu dhu ceb'e hini èèna, nuka dhèu dhu lole lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: and these are they by the way where the word is sown: and whenever they may hear, satan immediately comes, and he takes away the word that has been sown in their hearts.
target_text: hini dhu lèke ètu sebhe j'ara ka manu-bhui mai ra'a aa'i, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua. te ngaa nèbhu boe, dhèu aae nidhu mai parame rare lii holo-nori nèti d'ara dhèu èèna.

source_text: and these are they, in like manner, who are sown on the rocky ground: who, whenever they may hear the word, immediately receive it with joy,
target_text: aa hini dhu lèke ètu dedha hadhu, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu nanene, ka na sèmi nare lii holo-nori èèna dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: and have no root in themselves, but are temporary; afterward tribulation or persecution having come because of the word, immediately they are stumbled.
target_text: te ngaa lii holo-nori ne, taha nèbhu boe ètu d'ara dhèu èèna. ropa nèngu paraga j'aj'èra lula na sèmi nare lii ne'e, na tèke eele.

source_text: and these are they who are sown toward the thorns: these are they who are hearing the word,
target_text: aa hini dhu lèke ètu talora j'u'u dhu padudhu, èci èèna ka dènge lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu dhèu nanene.

source_text: and the anxieties of this age, and the deceitfulness of the riches, and the desires concerning the other things, entering in, choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èèna bhute dhoka dènge rupa-rupa madha j'ara rai-haha dhu pakarej'e ngi'u na. nèti èèna ka, j'ara se'e seti eele lii holo-nori ama lamatua nèti d'ara nèngu, ka j'aj'i heka ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and these are they who on the good ground have been sown: who hear the word, and receive, and bear fruit, one thirty-fold, and one sixty, and one a hundred.
target_text: te ngaa hini dhu lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu pasa dhilu ho nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge karej'e-karae. tatao nèngu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme. dhèu ne'e tao j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, sama sèmi hini dhu nèti hua-hela. abhu kahèi d'ai tèlu nguru hari, cahag'e d'ai èna nguru hari, aa abhu kahèi dhu d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: and he said to them, does the lamp come that it may be put under the measure, or under the bed-not that it may be put on the lampstand?
target_text: nèti dedha koha, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na. na peka hari lii upama èci, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee! miu mèdhi le, do dhae? dhèu suru rare labhu, ka saguru eele hari dènge soe! ka ra tèke asa ro'a koi la'e! aad'o, sina ma? te ladhe sèmi èèna, tèdhi boe saraa nèngu. dhèu hud'i tao labhu ètu era dhu dedha, sèna ka dhèu rèdhi saraa nèngu.

source_text: for there is not anything hid that may not be revealed, nor was anything kept hid but that it may come to light.
target_text: ngaa dhu dhèu pahuni deo ne'e, bèli-camèd'a dhèu rèdhi aa'i. te ngaa dhu dhèu re'a boe lod'o deo ne'e, bèli-camèd'a dhèu re'a aa'i.

source_text: if any has ears to hear-let him hear.
target_text: de ladhe cee dhu dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene paie!

source_text: and he said to them, take heed what you hear; in what measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and to you who hear it will be added;
target_text: nanene paie-iie! ladhe miu tenge sasala dhèu, na, dhèu leo tenge sasala miu kahèi. sèmi èèna kahèi, ama lamatua tenge sasala miu. te ngaa na tao bia risi hari nèti èèna.

source_text: for whoever may have, there will be given to him, and whoever has not, also that which he has will be taken from him.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci neo tenge tare'a-re'a dad'èi lamatua, nèngu asa d'èlu-mèu. te ngaa ladhe dhèu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, nèngu j'aj'i asa goa.

source_text: and he said, thus is the kingdom of god: as if a man may cast the seed on the earth,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, paredha ama lamatua asa tabha kapai, sama sèmi hini dhu dhèu ceb'e ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: and may sleep, and may rise night and day, and the seed springs up and grows, he has not known how;
target_text: nèngu ceb'e nare, ka la'e bhèj'i. tao heka ai hèb'a mi hini sèra. te ngaa hini sèra muri, ka asa kapai.

source_text: for of itself the earth bears fruit, first a blade, afterward an ear, afterward full grain in the ear;
target_text: hini se muri unu ra. mulai ti rèu, hela, toke d'ai huri.

source_text: and whenever the fruit may yield itself, immediately he sends forth the sickle, because the harvest has come.
target_text: ropa kasere nare nganga'a dhu ètu d'ara oka mami, dhèu unu oka heka la'e puu-g'ètu kèna. sèmi èèna kahèi, paredha ama lamatua. lamatua ka dhu ad'u-ue aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: and he said, to what may we liken the kingdom of god, or in what allegory may we compare it?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii hari, ja'a peka hari lii upama èci sèmi ne'e ka: miu ladhe sèku, dhèu dhu j'aj'i unu lamatua sèra. uru èèna ciki di, nèbhu-nèbhu j'aj'i ae.

source_text: as a grain of mustard, which, whenever it may be sown on the earth, is less than any of the seeds that are on the earth;
target_text: èèna sama sèmi lamusi aj'u dhu ana iiki-iiki.

source_text: and whenever it may be sown, it comes up, and becomes greater than any of the herbs, and makes great branches, so that under its shade the birds of the sky are able to rest.
target_text: ladhe èdhi sèla lamusi èèna, na muri mai, j'aj'i aj'u dhu kapai aae. manu-bhui nèti mia-mia mai tèka tenge mamaho, dènge tao rèd'a ètu kolo aj'u èèna.

source_text: and with many such allegories he was speaking to them the word, as they were able to hear,
target_text: j'ara-j'ara a'aj'a yesus madhutu rare'a dhèu.

source_text: and without an allegory he was not speaking to them, and by themselves, to his disciples he was expounding all.
target_text: ladhe na aj'a dhèu leo, na pake lii pakasame. te ngaa ladhe na aj'a ana madhutu na, nèngu peka aa'i-aa'i sasoa lii pakasame sèra.

source_text: and he says to them on that day, evening having come, we may pass over to the other side;
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia na, yesus aj'a dhèu nèti dedha koha era. hèia na pua ana madhutu na sèra, peka na, mai èdhi pakèd'i lati asa cabèka dano.

source_text: and having let away the multitude, they take him up as he was in the boat, and other little boats were also with him.
target_text: ka ra ca'e koha èci dènge yesus. ra pakèd'i tèke eele dhèu ae sèra ètu èèna. te ngaa dhèu cahag'e ca'e koha leo madhutu yesus si.

source_text: and there comes a great storm of wind, and the waves were beating on the boat, so that it is now being filled, and he himself was on the stern, sleeping on the pillow, and they wake him up, and say to him, teacher, are you not caring that we perish?
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus pasaluu kètu na mi nanèlu, ka bhèj'i luu ètu hui koha. nèbhu boe ka, ngèlu aae mai. naha kapai, ka èi tao sabhori oe pènu koha yesus si. nèti èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus sèra madha'u bia. hèia ra parèi ne, ama! kèd'i ku laa! èdhi oe molo kèna! te ngaa ama pusi-pahae boe!

source_text: and having awoken, he rebuked the wind and said to the sea, peace, be stilled; and the wind stilled, and there was a great calm;
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii parèi ra, ka na kèd'i, hèia na kai ngèlu, peka na, mau ka! ka na paredha naha, aku nèngu na, mera ka! hèia ngèlu mau, aa naha mera dènge ka.

source_text: and he said to them, why are you so fearful? how have you no faith?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus jèke ana madhutu na, peka na, nga tao ka miu madha'u sèmi èèna? miu parcaya ja'a, do aad'o?

source_text: and they feared a great fear and said to one another, who, then, is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u dènge malaa, ka èci peka dènge èci, te dhèu ngaa ne? ka bisa ngèlu dènge naha, madhutu lii paredha nèngu?

source_text: and they came to the other side of the sea, to the region of the gadarenes,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra d'ai cabèka dano galilea. era èèna, ngara na garasa.

source_text: and he having come forth out of the boat, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit, who had his dwelling in the tombs, and not even with chains was anyone able to bind him, because that many times he had been bound with shackles and chains, and the chains had been pulled in pieces by him, and the shackles broken in pieces, and none was able to tame him, and always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying and cutting himself with stones. and having seen jesus from afar, he ran and prostrated to him,
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu mone èci dhu nidhu tao, ka na huj'u. dhèu huj'u ne pea ètu era padhane dhèu madhe. mèu-mèda na kako ca'e-puru ledhe ètu èèna, dènge pake boe mèdha-papake. na pa'oo-parodha ma'ète boe, aa na nare hadhu ho tuku iisi na toke d'ai nu'a. na èra titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu èci sa bisa boe èki ne. masi ka ra èki dènge rate bèsi èèna ka, bisa boe kahèi. pèri-pèri hari, dhèu uj'u haga-ai na kahèi, pake rate dènge kanau bèsi, te ngaa na pama'ète aa'i si. dhèu ne èra bia, nèti èèna ka, èci sa taha boe ne. ropa yesus dènge ana madhutu na puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu huj'u èèna ladhe nèdhi rèngu nèti kaj'èu. hèia na kalua nèti era padhane dhèu madhe, ka na mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus.

source_text: and having called with a loud voice, he said, what regards me and you, jesus, son of god the most high? i adjure you by god, may you not afflict me! for he said to him, come forth, unclean spirit, out of the man!
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi rèhu dhèu ne'e, hèia yesus peka, na, hee, nidhu bhelu! kalua pakaj'èu nèti dhèu ne'e. èle èèna ka, dhèu èèna pajèka, aku nèngu na, weh! èu neo tao ngaa mi ja'a? ja'a ke'a èu ne yesus, ana nèti ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele. ja'a manèngi èu baku paj'èra ja'a!

source_text: and he was questioning him, what is your name? and he answered, saying, legion is my name, because we are many;
target_text: hèia yesus karèi ne, ngara èu cee? na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ngara ja'a legion, lula ji'i ae titu kèna, sama sèmi ca kaboko sordad'u!

source_text: and he was calling on him much, that he may not send them out of the region.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nidhu sèra peka re dhèu huj'u èèna, ho manèngi yesus, sèna ka baku pua rèngu kalua nèti d'ara rae ne.

source_text: and there was there, near the mountains, a great herd of pigs feeding,
target_text: kaj'èu boe nèti èèna, abhu hahi ca oka dhu dhèu madhenge. ele boe hahi sèra dua riho ngi'u. dhu tenge nganga'a ètu sebhe ledhe.

source_text: and all the demons called on him, saying, send us to the pigs, that into them we may enter;
target_text: ka nidhu sèra manèngi yesus, aku rèngu na, hia ji'i maso asa d'ara hahi sèra.

source_text: and immediately jesus gave them leave, and having come forth, the unclean spirits entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep place to the sea-and they were about two thousand-and they were choked in the sea.
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia yesus d'èi kahèi. ka nidhu sèra kalua nèti d'ara dhèu èèna, ka lasi asa d'ara hahi sèra. hèia hahi sèra rai paj'ala, ka lasi asa sebhe tèbhi, ka ra manahu asa d'ara dano, hèia madhe aa'i si.

source_text: and those feeding the pigs fled, and told in the city, and in the fields, and they came forth to see what it is that has been done;
target_text: ropa dhèu j'aga hahi sèra ladhe rèdhi madha j'ara dhu j'aj'i èèna, ra madha'u titu kèna. ka rai lasi peka palème dènge dhèu ètu d'ara rae-rae dhu dètu ètu era èèna. nèbhu boe dhèu canau-kateme mai neo re'a.

source_text: and they come to jesus, and see the demoniac, sitting, and clothed, and right-minded-him having had the legion-and they were afraid;
target_text: dhèu sèra mai paraga dènge yesus, ka ra ladhe la'a, na, dhèu dhu nidhu tao èèna, madhèdi ètu èèna kahèi. dhèu èèna pake le mèdha-papake. kahadhu na mase'a le. rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu sèra madha'u. lula rèngu re'a le, ladhe dhèu cee dhu bisa babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu huj'u èèna, nèngu tare'a-re'a dhèu èra risi.

source_text: and those having seen it, declared to them how it had come to pass to the demoniac, and about the pigs;
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra lasi peka palème ètu mia-mia, aku rèngu na, ji'i ngèdhi le dènge madha, dhèu huj'u ne èle le. sèmi èèna kahèi hahi dhu madhe ètu d'ara dano.

source_text: and they began to call on him to go away from their borders.
target_text: ka dhèu kabarai èèna mai manèngi ho yesus tèke eele ka rai rèngu.

source_text: and he having gone into the boat, the demoniac was calling on him that he may be with him,
target_text: ropa yesus neo ca'e hari asa dedha koha, ka dhèu dhu èle nèti huj'u dhu nidhu tao èèna manèngi yesus, sèna ka nèngu madhutu ne kahèi.

source_text: and jesus did not permit him, but says to him, go away to your house, to your own friends, and tell them how the lord did great things to you, and dealt kindly with you;
target_text: te ngaa yesus kai. ka na peka dènge dhèu èèna, aku nèngu na, be'a risi èu lèpa ka asa èmu, ho peka dènge a'ari èu, ngaa dhu ama lamatua tao le mi dedha èu. peka dènge si, mema ama lamatua sue èu titu kèna.

source_text: and he went away, and began to proclaim in the decapolis how jesus did great things to him, and all were wondering.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia dhèu èèna pakèd'i la'e palème rae-rae nèti canguru kota, dhu ngara na ‘dekapolis'. na lole ngaa dhu yesus tao le mi dedha nèngu. dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi lii lolo na, malaa aa'i mèu-mèu, aku rèngu na, mema lèke tare'a!

source_text: and jesus having passed over in the boat again to the other side, there was gathered a great multitude to him, and he was near the sea,
target_text: èle ka, yesus si pakèd'i hari dènge koha asa cabèka dano. ropa ra puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae mai lingu rare yesus.

source_text: and behold, there comes one of the chiefs of the synagogue, by name jairus, and having seen him, he falls at his feet,
target_text: dhèu èci mai, ngara na yairus. nèngu ne, kètu èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi ètu kota èèna. ropa nèngu nèdhi yesus, ka mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus.

source_text: and he was calling on him much, saying, my little daughter is at the last extremity-that having come, you may lay on her your hands, so that she may be saved, and she will live;
target_text: ka na pamako, peka na, ama, ee! ana bhèni ja'a, heka canguru dua tèu, pèd'a oe madhe. mai lati ku asa èmu ja'a, sèna ka puri-pa'èle ne nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and he went away with him. and there was following him a great multitude, and they were thronging him,
target_text: hèia yesus la'e dènge ka, madhutu yairus asa èmu na. te ngaa ètu d'ara kakako rèngu, dhèu ae titu kèna, ka ra seti ne nèti haa, nèti dhimu.

source_text: and a certain woman, being with a flow of blood for twelve years,
target_text: ètu talora dhèu ae sèra, abhu dhèu bhèni èci dhu pèd'a dhèu bhèni. papèd'a ne loe boe canguru dua tèu kèna.

source_text: and having suffered many things under many physicians, and having spent all that she had, and having profited nothing, but rather having come to the worse,
target_text: mèdha-panyau dènge doi-dhari dhèu bhèni ne'e, èle aa'i mèu-mèu ho b'ae dote. te ngaa papèd'a na èle boe, asa na hoe.

source_text: having heard about jesus, having come in the multitude behind, she touched his garment, for she said, if i may even touch his garments, i will be saved; and immediately the fountain of her blood was dried up, and she knew in the body that she has been healed of the plague.
target_text: bhèni ne tadèngi ae le dhèu palolo ngaa dhu yesus tao. nèti èèna ka, na mai pasuki asa talora dhèu ae sèra, ho na padètu dènge yesus. na pangee, na, sad'i ja'a gai lèke sebhe kodho na di, tatu papèd'a ja'a èle. ropa na gai lèke sebhe kodho yesus, kabèdhi laa raa bhèni ne tèja eele dènge. hèia na rasa, na be'a le.

source_text: and immediately jesus having known in himself that power had gone forth out of him, having turned in the multitude, said, who touched my garments?
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, yesus rasa a'èra kalua nèti d'ara ngi'u na. ka na kabib'a asa kabodho, ho ladhe asa dhèu ae sèra, ka na karèi, peka na, nèti miu se, cee ka dhu gai lèke kodho ja'a?

source_text: and his disciples said to him, you see the multitude thronging you, and you say, who touched me!
target_text: ka ana madhutu na dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama, ladhe ku laa. dhèu ae paseti sèmi ne'e. nga tao ka ama karèi, peka na, ‘cee ka dhu gai kodho ja'a? '

source_text: and he was looking around to see her who did this,
target_text: te ngaa yesus ladhe pala-lème, neo ne'a cee ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho na.

source_text: and the woman, having been afraid, and trembling, knowing what was done on her, came, and fell down before him, and told him all the truth,
target_text: ropa yesus karèi sèmi èèna, hèia bhèni èèna madha'u bia. èle èèna ka, na mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus, ka na mangaku, ama! ja'a ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho ama ku deo na.

source_text: and he said to her, daughter, your faith has saved you; go away in peace, and be whole from your plague.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mi bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, lula èu parcaya ja'a dènge d'ara kateme, nèti èèna ka, èu èle le. lamu ka èmu, dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: as he is yet speaking, there come from the chief of the synagogue's house, certain, saying, your daughter died, why do you still harass the teacher?
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, hèia dhèu èci mai nèti èmu yairus, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ana mu madhe le. de baku paj'èra ia ka ama mese. nèngu la'e ia ka sa nèi.

source_text: and jesus immediately, having heard the word that is spoken, says to the chief of the synagogue, do not be afraid, only believe.
target_text: te ngaa yesus pusi boe dènge lii padhai lii dhèu ne'e. ka na peka dènge yairus, èu baku madha'u, ee! parcaya mi ama lamatua di.

source_text: and he did not permit anyone to follow with him, except peter, and james, and john the brother of james;
target_text: hèia yesus la'e dènge ka, tèke eele ana madhutu na cahag'e. nèti dhoka petrus, yakobis dènge yohanis.

source_text: and he comes into the house of the chief of the synagogue, and sees a tumult, much weeping and wailing;
target_text: ropa d'ai èmu yairus, rèngu rèdhi dhèu jau oob'a-jau oob'a, aa tadèngi cahag'e tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: and having gone in he says to them, why do you make a tumult, and weep? the child did not die, but sleeps;
target_text: yesus maso asa d'ara, ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu maruru dènge tangi sèmi ne'e? ana ne'e madhe boe! nèngu dhoka bhèj'i di.

source_text: and they were laughing at him. and he, having put all forth, takes the father of the child, and the mother, and those with him, and goes in where the child is lying,
target_text: dhèu ètu sèra tadèngi yesus peka sèmi èèna, ka ra mari pakapengo hèb'a dènge ne. hèia na pua dhèu sèra kalua aa'i nèti d'ara kama ana dhu madhe èèna. ka na paroa ina-ama ana bhèni ne, dènge ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra, maso asa d'ara.

source_text: and having taken the hand of the child, he says to her, talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, girl i say to you, arise.
target_text: hèia yesus kèpe kacui-aai ana dhu madhe ne, ka na padhai lii pake lii rèngu, lii aram, aku nèngu na, talita kum! sasoa na, ana bhèni! kèd'i ka!

source_text: and immediately the girl arose, and was walking, for she was twelve years old; and they were amazed with a great amazement, and he charged them much, that no one may know this thing, and he said that there be given to her to eat.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, ana dhu madhe èèna mamuri hari. hèia na kèd'i titu, ka na kako. hèia yesus peka dènge ina na, aku nèngu na, hia ana ne'e na'a-ninu! dhèu ae ètu sèra dhu rèdhi j'ara dhu j'aj'i ne, ra malaa titu kèna. hèia yesus kai si, peka na, mage mi peka dènge dhèu èci sa, ja'a ka dhu pamamuri hari ana ne.

source_text: and he went forth from there, and came to his own country, and his disciples follow him,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, lèpa hari asa rae na, nasaret.

source_text: and sabbath having come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing were astonished, saying, from where did this one hear these things? and what is the wisdom that was given to him, that also such mighty works are done through his hands?
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. hèia yesus la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ho na aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua ètu èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae lasi manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa ra tadèngi yesus aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua, hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra malaa, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne mèu samia ne! na dènge koasa kahèi! tasamia ka na sèmi èèna, ee?

source_text: is this not the carpenter, the son of mary, and brother of james, and joses, and judas, and simon? and are his sisters not here with us? and they were being stumbled at him.
target_text: nèngu ne'e dhoka tuka aj'u di. èdhi tadhe ina na, maria. sèmi èèna kahèi ari na, yakobis, yoses, yudas dènge simon, dènge ari na dhèu bhèni sèra. rèngu dènge èdhi pea ca rae. dhèu se'e ngee ètu d'ara rèngu na, rèngu mèu risi nèti yesus. nèti èèna ka, ra d'èi heka nanene ne.

source_text: and jesus said to them, a prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his relatives, and in his own house;
target_text: ka yesus peka, mema tare'a! dhèu pakab'ua risi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti rae leo. te ngaa ra pakab'ua boe dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu nèti rae nèngu.

source_text: and he was not able to do any mighty work there, except having put hands on a few sick, he healed them;
target_text: d'ara dhèu sèra adhu sèmi hadhu, ka ra parcaya boe lii padhai lii yesus. nèti èèna ka, na malaa, hèia na pake boe koasa na. ka na puri-pa'èle dhoka dhèu pèri di, ètu èèna.

source_text: and he wondered because of their unbelief. and he was going around the villages, in a circle, teaching,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako palème asa rae-rae dhu padètu ètu sèra, ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: and he calls near the twelve, and he began to send them forth two by two, and he was giving them power over the unclean spirits,
target_text: na paroa nare ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra, ka na pua rèngu lasi dua-dua ho lole lii lolo be'a nèti ama lamatua. na hia si koasa kahèi, ho babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: and he commanded them that they may take nothing for the way, except a staff only-no leather pouch, no bread, no brass in the girdle, but having been shod with sandals, and you may not put on two coats.
target_text: na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu baku mèti mèdha ae ètu d'ara kakako miu. baku mèti nganga'a, doi, dènge tas. mèti dhoka tatea, salapa ètu haga, dènge kodho ètu ua di.

source_text: and he said to them, whenever you may enter into a house, remain there until you may depart from there,
target_text: ladhe cee dhu sèmi rare miu ètu èmu ra, miu pea dhoka ètu èèna di, toke d'ai pakèd'i hari.

source_text: and as many as may not receive you nor hear you, going out from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony to them; truly i say to you, it will be more tolerable for sodom or gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu lami asa era èci, hèia dhèu ètu sèra sèmi rare boe miu, aa ra d'èi boe nanene lii padhai lii miu, tèke eele era èèna. aa peka mi dhèu sèra, na, ‘miu mo'o boe nanene, si! de bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere pala mi! '

source_text: and having gone forth they were preaching that men might convert,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lasi lole lii lolo be'a. ra peka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i ele ho'a nèti sasala-sasigo ra, ka lèpa ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: and they were casting out many demons, and they were anointing many sick with oil, and they were healing them.
target_text: ka ra babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu. ra pasuti èi lèngi mi kètu dhèu pèd'a, aa sabaj'a ho pa'èle si nèti papèd'a. ka ra èle dènge.

source_text: and king herod heard for his name became public, and he said, john the immerser was raised out of the dead, and because of this the mighty powers are working in him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu mia-mia tadhe aa'i le yesus. dhèu aae herodes tadèngi le lii lolo lula-nèti koasa yesus kahèi. dhèu palolo ètu mia-mia, aku rèngu na, yohanis tuka sarani èèna, mamuri hari le ètu d'ara ngi'u yesus! nèti èèna ka, na bisa tao tadha malaa sèra.

source_text: others said, it is elijah, and others said, it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu cahag'e hari peka, aku rèngu na, aad'o! ne'e ne, elia dhu mamuri hari d'ara ngi'u yesus. aa dhèu cahag'e hari, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo hari nèti uru sèra.

source_text: and herod having heard, said, he whom i beheaded-john-this is he; he was raised out of the dead.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes tadèngi nare lii lolo dhèu se'e lula-nèti yesus, ka na dhaa, peka na, èèna yohanis tuka sarani, dhu ca hari ni ja'a hia dhèu pare pamadhe le, te ngaa na mamuri hari!

source_text: for herod himself, having sent forth, laid hold on john, and bound him in the prison, because of herodias, the wife of his brother philip, because he married her, for john said to herod, it is not lawful for you to have the wife of your brother;
target_text: dhèu aae herodes pua sèmi èèna, lula nèngu lii langu dènge yohanis. lii lolo na sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu aae herodes leo nare dhèu èmu ari na, pelipus, ngara na herodias. aa te ngaa pelipus dènge herodias dhae pa'ia mèka. nèti èèna ka, yohanis kai pahari-pahari, peka na, ama dhèu aae baku leo dènge dhèu èmu ari mu. te èèna sisu ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa herodes leo nare bhèni ne'e kahèi. hèia na pua dhèu lasi kèpe rare yohanis, ho pamaso ne asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and herodias was having a quarrel with him, and was willing to kill him, and was not able,
target_text: lula yohanis kai pèri hari le, hèia bhèni ne tèka d'ara dènge ne, ka na neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa lake nare mèka, te herodes dhu pamaso le yohanis asa d'ara bèdho la'e.

source_text: for herod was fearing john, knowing him to be a righteous and holy man, and was keeping watch over him, and having heard him, was doing many things, and hearing him gladly.
target_text: ka na pua sordad'u sèra madhenge paie ne ètu d'ara bèdho. herodes madha'u dènge yohanis. na ne'a tare'a, yohanis ne dhèu dhu ama lamatua pua mai. aa yohanis ne dhèu d'ara mola. herodes d'èi nanene lii padhai lii yohanis kahèi. te ngaa stèka-stèka, d'ara na pèd'a nanene lii padhai lii yohanis.

source_text: and a seasonable day having come when herod on his birthday was making a banquet to his great men, and to the chiefs of thousands, and to the first men of galilee,
target_text: ka ca tèka, herodias abhu lod'o dhu be'a, sèna ka na b'ala d'ara pèd'a na. lod'o èèna, lèke dènge hari jadi herodes. ka ra nèru dhèu aae-dhèu kapai mai ra'a-sisi hari jad'i. dhèu dhu mai sèra, ama-ama dhu paredha, ama-ama sordad'u, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a ètu galilea.

source_text: and the daughter of that herodias having come in, and having danced, and having pleased herod and those dining with him, the king said to the girl, ask of me whatever you will, and i will give to you,
target_text: ètu d'ara talora tatao èèna, ana bhèni herodias la'e roge. na roge be'a risi eele, ka d'ara herodes dènge dhèu dhu nèru sèra karej'e bia. nèti èèna ka, herodes paroa ne mai asa madha, ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, èu neo manèngi ngaa? èu peka ho ja'a hia.

source_text: and he swore to her, whatever you may ask me, i will give to you-to the half of my kingdom.
target_text: èu manèngi era paredha ja'a ne bagi dua, hia èu cabèka èèna ka, ja'a ko'o kahèi. ja'a subha dènge ngara ama lamatua!

source_text: and she, having gone forth, said to her mother, what will i ask for myself? and she said, the head of john the immerser;
target_text: ka ana bhèni èèna la'e karèi ina na, aku nèngu na, ina, ee! madhutu ngangee ina ku, na, ja'a manèngi ngaa dhu be'a risi nèti ama ku? ka ina na dhaa, aku nèngu na, lamu asa madha ama mu ho peka dènge ne, ja'a manèngi dhoka kètu yohanis di.

source_text: and having come in immediately with haste to the king, she asked, saying, i will that you may immediately give me the head of john the immerser on a plate.
target_text: ka ana bhèni ne la'e asa madha herodes, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a manèngi kètu yohanis, tao ètu d'ara dula èci hia ja'a. deo ne'e ne, kahèi!

source_text: and the king, made very sorrowful because of the oaths and of those reclining with him, would not put her away,
target_text: ropa herodes tadèngi nare lii manèngi ana bhèni na, ka d'ara na cag'ag'a. te ngaa nèngu bisa heka ère hari lii subha nèngu deo na, lula dhèu ètu sèra tadèngi aa'i le.

source_text: and immediately the king having sent a guardsman, commanded his head to be brought,
target_text: èle èèna ka, herodes paredha komedhaa sordad'u lasi poro rare kètu yohanis nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and he having gone, beheaded him in the prison, and brought his head on a plate, and gave it to the girl, and the girl gave it to her mother;
target_text: ropa ra poro rare, ra tao asa d'ara dula èci, ka rèti la'a asa ana bhèni èèna. na sèmi nare, hèia nèti asa ina na la'e.

source_text: and having heard, his disciples came and took up his corpse, and laid it in the tomb.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis sèra tadèngi ra poro rèti le kètu yohanis, rèngu mai nedhe rèti ngi'u nèngu lasi padhane. d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii lolo mamadhe yohanis.

source_text: and the apostles are gathered together to jesus, and they told him all, and how many things they did, and how many things they taught,
target_text: ca lod'o hari, ana madhutu yesus dhu na pua lasi asa rae-rae ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua sèra, lèpa hari mai, ka ra pakaboko hari dènge ne. ra lolo dènge yesus ngaa dhu rèngu tao dènge aj'a mi dhèu.

source_text: and he said to them, come yourselves apart to a desolate place, and rest a little, for those coming and those going were many, and not even to eat had they opportunity,
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai patangi-tenge yesus. lula dhèu ae seli eele, ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na abhu boe tebho ra'a-rinu hèi. nèti èèna ka, yesus ale dènge ana madhutu sèra, peka na, be'a risi èdhi pakèd'i nèti era ne'e lati tenge era èci dhu mau, sèna ka èdhi ae tara ciki.

source_text: and they went away to a desolate place, in the boat, by themselves.
target_text: ka ra ca'e koha cue lasi asa era dhu mau, kaj'èu nèti d'ara rae.

source_text: and the multitudes saw them going away, and many recognized him, and they ran there by land from all the cities, and went before them, and came together to him,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae ètu sèra sa, ladhe rèdhi koha rèngu kako re sebhe dano. hèia ra kalua nèti rae ka kako pamèri madhutu re dedha rai. nèti èèna ka, rèngu d'ai uuru yesus si.

source_text: and having come forth, jesus saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion on them, that they were as sheep not having a shepherd, and he began to teach many things.
target_text: ropa yesus puru nèti dedha koha, ladhe laa, na, dhèu ae dhu mate ne. dhèu se'e re'a heka tao iisi ra tasamia. nèti èèna ka, d'ara yesus sue si, te rèngu sama sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dènge boe ana madhenga. èle èèna ka, na aj'a si j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: and now the hour being advanced, his disciples having come near to him, say, the place is desolate, and the hour is now advanced, let them away, that having gone away into the surrounding fields and villages, they may buy loaves for themselves, for they do not have what they may eat.
target_text: na aj'a nèti loo nètu, toke d'ai nihia la'e. hèia ana madhutu na sèra mai padhue dènge ne, aku rèngu na, ama! hua iia ama ku pua si lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rae dhu dètu ètu era se'e. te oe mèda kèna, aa ètu era ne'e nganga'a aad'o.

source_text: and he answering said to them, you give them to eat, and they say to him, having gone away, may we buy two hundred denarii worth of loaves, and give to them to eat?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, baku tao sèmi èèna! hud'i laa, pe miu panga'a si. hèia ra karèi hari ne, ira, ee! ladhe èdhi panga'a dhèu ae sèmi ne'e, èdhi kalua doi ae bia, nga. sama sèmi gaji tuka ca tèu kateme, nga! aa èdhi tare doi sèra, nèti mia hua kèna!

source_text: and he says to them, how many loaves do you have? go and see; and having known, they say, five, and two fishes.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu lami karèi sèku dhèu sèra, teko cee dhu nèti nganga'a mèra. hèia ra lasi karèi, ka mai peka dènge ne, abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u di.

source_text: and he commanded them to make all recline in companies on the green grass,
target_text: hèia yesus pua dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ho madhèdi cakaboko-cakaboko ètu dedha j'u'u.

source_text: and they sat down in squares, by hundreds, and by fifties.
target_text: dhèu se'e madhèdi sèmi dhu yesus pua. abhu kaboko dhu dhèu cangasu-cangasu, aa abhu kaboko dhu dhèu lèmi nguru-lèmi nguru.

source_text: and having taken the five loaves and the two fishes, having looked up to the sky, he blessed, and broke the loaves, and was giving them to his disciples, that they may set them before them, and the two fishes he divided to all,
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra, ka na ladhe asa dedha. na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. èle èèna ka, nare roti lèmi bua, ka na ku'u pamae ca'èta-'èta. hèia na hia mi ana madhutu na, ho lasi papala hia dhèu dhu madhèdi sèra. na pala-bagi i'a dua ngi'u sèra kahèi.

source_text: and they all ate, and were filled,
target_text: ka dhèu sèra ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: and they took up of broken pieces twelve hand-baskets full, and of the fishes,
target_text: ra'a èle, hèia ana madhutu na sèra lasi pakaboko nganga'a dhu risi eele sèra, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: and those eating of the loaves were about five thousand men.
target_text: dhèu dhu ra'a sèra, dhèu mone di, lèmi riho dhèu, ige mèka bhèni dènge ana iiki.

source_text: and immediately he constrained his disciples to go into the boat, and to go before him to the other side, to bethsaida, until he may let the multitude away,
target_text: èle ka, yesus pua ana madhutu sèra pakèd'i uuru dènge koha asa rae betsaida ètu cabèka dano. te nèngu dhae la'e mèka, ho na pua dhèu ae sèra lèpa.

source_text: and having taken leave of them, he went away to the mountain to pray.
target_text: ropa dhèu sèra lèpa, na la'e asa ledhe èci ètu èèna, ho na manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and evening having come, the boat was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land; and he saw them harassed in the rowing, for the wind was against them, and about the fourth watch of the night he comes to them walking on the sea, and wished to pass by them. and they having seen him walking on the sea, thought it to be an apparition, and cried out, for they all saw him, and were troubled, and immediately he spoke with them, and says to them, take courage! i am; do not be afraid.
target_text: lod'o mèda le, ka yesus puru mai. na ladhe nèdhi ana madhutu na sèra dènge koha lasi d'ai talora dano le. lula ngèlu madha mèdhu ae, ka ra tuku koha d'ai madhe. d'ara oe mèu sa, yesus heka la'e madhutu si kèna. te ngaa na kako re dedha èi. ropa na kako oe seli koha ra, ana madhutu sèra ladhe rèdhi ne, ka ra madha'u titu kèna. hèia èci karèi èci, aku rèngu na, irii! ngaa nèi? nidhu, do? hèia yesus lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, we! miu baku madha'u! te ja'a ne!

source_text: and he went up to them into the boat, and the wind stilled, and greatly out of measure they were amazed in themselves, and were wondering,
target_text: ropa yesus ca'e la'e asa dedha koha, kabèdhi laa, ngèlu mau dènge. ana madhutu na sèra malaa bia.

source_text: for they did not understand concerning the loaves, for their heart has been hard.
target_text: rèngu heka rèdhi kèna, yesus pake koasa na, lod'o panga'a lèmi riho dhèu èèna. te ngaa rèngu re'a iia boe koasa yesus, lula d'ara rèngu adhu sèmi hadhu.

source_text: and having passed over, they came on the land of gennesaret, and drew to the shore,
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai cabèka dano, ra panahu koha ètu dae genesaret.

source_text: and they having come forth out of the boat, immediately having recognized him,
target_text: ropa ra puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi si. ka ra rodhe lème, aku rèngu na, ee! yesus mai le!

source_text: they ran around through all that surrounding region, and they began to carry around on the pallets those being ill, where they were hearing that he is, and wherever he was going, to villages, or cities, or fields, in the marketplaces they were laying the ailing, and were calling on him, that they may touch if it were but the fringe of his garment, and as many as were touching him were saved.
target_text: dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra lasi peka palème rae, nèti èèna ka, dhèu mai nèti mia-mia, jèru rèti a'ari rèngu dhu pèd'a asa yesus. sad'i ra tadèngi yesus ètu era èci, na, rame-rame nedhe rèti dhèu pèd'a mai. ra paj'unu si ètu d'ara tana lapa ètu èèna. te ra pangee, na, sad'i dhèu pèd'a sèra goi lèke sebhe kodho yesus di, èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra. ka dhèu goi lèke kodho na, hèia èle nèti papèd'a ra.

source_text: and gathered together to him are the pharisees, and certain of the scribes, having come from jerusalem,
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu partei agama parisi canau dènge mese-mese agama mai nèti kota yerusalem neo paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: and having seen certain of his disciples with defiled hands-that is, unwashed-eating bread, they found fault; for the pharisees, and all the jews, if they do not wash the hands to the wrist, do not eat, holding the tradition of the elders, and coming from the marketplace, if they do not immerse themselves, they do not eat; and many other things there are that they received to hold, immersions of cups, and pots, and bronze vessels, and couches. then the pharisees and the scribes question him, why do your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat the bread with unwashed hands?
target_text: dhèu parisi kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi. nuka sèmi, dhèu neo ra'a-rinu hud'i j'amo uuru ku kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe lèpa nèti d'ara pasa, hud'i diu uuru ku èi. toke mèdha dapu rèngu sèmi èru-pangala, pega, curu, galaa, cere, hud'i rase uuru ku madhutu atora ad'a, heka bisa pake ra'a-rinu kèna. ladhe dhèu yahudi cahag'e madhutu boe ad'a rèngu sèmi èèna, dhèu parisi nasa. nèti èèna ka, ra nasa ropa rèdhi ana madhutu yesus sèra ra'a-rinu j'amo boe kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a rèngu. ka rèngu mai pasala yesus, peka na, nga tao ka ana madhutu èu se ra'a-rinu j'amo uuru boe kacui-aai? sèra sa, pasala dènge ad'a nèti bèi-baki èdhi!

source_text: and he answering said to them, well did isaiah prophesy concerning you, hypocrites, as it has been written: this people honors me with the lips, and their heart is far from me; and in vain they worship me, teaching teachings, commands of men;
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se mema padhai lii leo, tao leo! nèti uru nèka mai yesaya suri tèke le, lii padhai lii ama lamatua sèmi ne'e, ‘abhu dhèu dhu koa-kio kolongara ja'a, dhoka dènge hèb'a di, te ngaa nèti boe d'ara. tatao rèngu sèmi èèna na, lèke boe. rèngu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi ja'a, te ngaa rèngu madhutu dhoka atora dhèu rai-haha di. ' miu èci èèna kahèi.

source_text: for having put away the command of god, you hold the tradition of men, immersions of pots and cups; and many other such like things you do. and he said to them, well do you put away the command of god that you may keep your tradition;
target_text: miu tèke eele le paredha ama lamatua, ho madhutu atora dhèu rai-haha. tatao miu ne, d'èlu-mèu bia!

source_text: for moses said, honor your father and your mother; and, he who is speaking evil of father or mother-let him die the death;
target_text: karèi nèti uuru èèna, musa peka le lii paredha ama lamatua sèmi ne'e ka, ‘pakab'ua ina-ama miu. ' aa tabha hari, peka na, ‘ladhe ana èci padhèda ama na, do ina na, hud'i ra huku pamadhe ne. '

source_text: and you say, if a man may say to father or to mother, korban that is, a gift, is whatever you may be profited out of mine, and you no longer permit him to do anything for his father or for his mother,
target_text: ama lamatua aj'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu aj'a leo. miu peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu èci pamoa le neo hia ngaa èci mi ama lamatua, masi ka ina dènge ama na j'èra oe madhe èèna ka, te ngaa pake boe mèdha èèna ho soru-bara si, lula nèngu moa le neo hia mi lamatua. '

source_text: setting aside the word of god for your tradition that you delivered; and many such like things you do.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a peka le, miu pake heka dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa miu gati eele dènge atora miu dhu hiu. atora ae le dhu miu gati eele sèmi èèna.

source_text: and having called near all the multitude, he said to them, listen to me, you all, and understand;
target_text: hèia yesus paroa hari dhèu leo ètu sèra, ka na peka na, pasa dhilu ho nanene paie, sèna ka miu me'a.

source_text: there is nothing from outside the man entering into him that is able to defile him, but the things coming out from him, those are the things defiling the man.
target_text: ngaa dhu maso asa d'ara d'èlu, pakaj'alu boe. te ngaa dhu kalua mai nèti d'ara, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu.

source_text: if any has ears to hear-let him hear.
target_text: cee dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene.

source_text: and when he entered into a house from the multitude, his disciples were questioning him about the allegory,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele dhèu sèra, ka lasi asa d'ara èmu èci. ka ana madhutu sèra karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: and he says to them, so also you are without understanding! do you not perceive that nothing from outside entering into the man is able to defile him? because it does not enter into his heart, but into the belly, and into the drain it goes out, purifying all the meats.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, miu me'a boe kahèi? sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: ngaa dhu dhèu ra'a, èèna be'a. te ngaa dhu kalua mai, karehe. èèna be'a boe. ngaa dhu èdhi ta'a, maso asa d'ara d'èlu, ho èèna na kalua hari asa li'u la'e. lii yesus èèna neo peka mi èdhi, nganga'a aa'i-aa'i, èci sa dhu luri boe.

source_text: and he said, that which is coming out from the man, that defiles the man;
target_text: ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara, èèna ka dhu pa'ele iie dhèu, nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua d'èi boe pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: for from within, out of the heart of men, the evil reasonings come forth, adulteries, whoredoms, murders,
target_text: te j'ara bhelu-katub'a ae ka dhu kalua nèti d'ara dhèu! nuka sèmi: ngangee karehe, tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu boe nèngu, mana'u, pamadhe dhèu,

source_text: thefts, covetous desires, wickedness, deceit, arrogance, an evil eye, slander, pride, foolishness;
target_text: gagoo-gagehu, bersina, bhelu-katub'a, leko-monya, dhèu dhu taha nare boe d'ara, d'èi boe dhèu risi nèngu, padhai lii pamanahu dhèu, padedha iisi, tatao dhu lèke boe, dènge kètu hadhu.

source_text: all these evils come forth from within, and they defile the man.
target_text: j'ara karehe aa'i-aa'i sèra mai nèti d'ara dhèu. sèra ka dhu pa'ele iie dhèu. ama lamatua d'èi boe dènge dhèu sèmi èèna.

source_text: and from there having risen, he went away to the borders of tyre and sidon, and having entered into the house, he wished none to know, and he was not able to be hid,
target_text: èle ka, yesus tèke eele era èèna, ka la'e asa kota èci, ngara na tirus. d'ai nèi, lasi asa d'ara èmu èci, lula yesus d'èi boe dhèu re'a nèngu ètu èèna. te ngaa nèngu bisa boe pahuni ngi'u.

source_text: for a woman having heard about him, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having come, fell at his feet- and the woman was a greek, a syro-phoenician by nation-and was asking him that he may cast forth the demon out of her daughter.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu bhèni dintiu èci dhu nèti rai finisia ètu propensi siria. ropa na tadèngi yesus ètu èèna, na mai manèngi yesus babège eele nidhu nèti ana bhèni na.

source_text: and jesus said to her, first permit the children to be filled, for it is not good to take the children's bread, and to cast it to the little dogs.
target_text: te ngaa yesus core lii èci, peka na, ana-ana hud'i ra'a uuru ku, ho sisa na, ra core hia busa kèna. dènge lii pacele èèna, yesus hud'i soru-bara uuru ku dhèu yahudi nèngu, heka dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: and she answered and says to him, yes, lord; for the little dogs under the table also eat of the children's crumbs.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni èèna b'ala, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a ama. te ngaa busa mate le ètu ro'a mei. nèngu abhu kahèi nganga'a dhu bèbhe nèti d'ara pega ana iiki sèra. madhutu bhèni èèna, lod'o ana ra'a, na, busa na'a kahèi. masi ka yesus soru-bara dhèu unu na, te ngaa nèngu hud'i soru-bara dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: and he said to her, because of this word, go; the demon has gone forth out of your daughter;
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii dhaa bhèni ne, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, tare'a! lii padhai lii èu èèna, mola-mola na kèna! lèpa ka! te nidhu rai le nèti ana èu.

source_text: and having come away to her house, she found the demon gone forth, and the daughter laid on the bed.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne la'e ka. na d'ai èmu, ana na dhu bhèj'i luu. nidhu kalua le.

source_text: and again, having gone forth from the coasts of tyre and sidon, he came to the sea of galilee, through the midst of the coasts of decapolis,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si pakèd'i nèti kota tirus, kako lasi madhutu nebhe dhasi re kota sidon. nèti era èèna, rèngu lasi taruu d'ai dano galilea. hèia ra lasi asa rai èci dhu dènge canguru kota, dhu ra biasa pangare na, ‘dekapolis'.

source_text: and they bring to him a deaf, stuttering man, and they call on him that he may put the hand on him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu èci dhu lii aad'o aa katele-katipa. angalai na lere rèti ne asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus tao ai mi kètu na, sèna ka na èle.

source_text: and having taken him away from the multitude by himself, he put his fingers to his ears, and having spit, he touched his tongue,
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele dhèu ae sèra, ka la'e mesa na dènge dhèu èèna. yesus pamaso kacui-aai na asa ro'a dhilu dhèu eèna dua-dua. èle èèna ka, na tao ilu ètu kacui-aai na, ka na g'ag'e he'o dhèu ne'e.

source_text: and having looked to the sky, he sighed, and says to him, ephphatha, that is, be opened;
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe asa dedha, na ère a'ae madhera, ka na paredha, aku nèngu na, efata. sasoa na, bhoke ka!

source_text: and immediately his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he was speaking plain.
target_text: na peka dhoka sèmi èèna di, kabèdhi laa, dhilu dhèu èèna tadèngi dènge. sèmi èèna kahèi, he'o dhu sakaa èèna, mako ka na padhai lii dènge.

source_text: he charged them that they may tell no one, but the more he was charging them, the more abundantly they were proclaiming it,
target_text: èle èèna ka, dua ra lasi asa era dhèu ae sèra. ka yesus kai si, aku nèngu na, nanene, ee! baku lolo dènge dhèu, peka na, ja'a ka dhu pa'èle dhèu ne'e ne. masi ka na kai si, te ngaa dhèu se'e lasi lolo palème d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and they were being astonished beyond measure, saying, he has done all things well; he makes both the deaf to hear, and the mute to speak.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi lii lolo èèna, malaa bia. ra papeka isi-aanga ra, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne'e, dhèu di, nga! nèngu tao pabe'a aa'i mèu-mèu. dhèu katele bisa tadèngi, aa dhèu lii aad'o bisa padhai lii.

source_text: in those days the multitude being very great, and not having what they may eat, jesus having called near his disciples, says to them, i have compassion on the multitude, because now three days they continue with me, and they have not what they may eat; and if i will let them away fasting to their home, they will faint in the way, for certain of them are come from far.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, dhèu ae mai kamue rare yesus neo nanene lii holo-nori na. dhèu sèra tèlu lod'o kèna ètu era èèna dènge yesus. nèti èèna ka, gee ra èle aa'i le. hèia yesus paroa ana madhutu na, ka na peka, ja'a rasa kasia dènge dhèu ae se'e. cahag'e mai nèti rae kaj'èu, ètu era ne'e d'ai tèlu lod'o kèna, ka nganga'a rèngu aad'o heka ciki sa. baku hia ra lèpa dènge kabake manganga. mage dhoka ra mad'ea ho bèbha ètu j'ara.

source_text: and his disciples answered him, from where will anyone be able to feed these here in a wilderness with bread?
target_text: ka ana madhutu yesus sèra dhaa, peka na, ama. era ne kaj'èu nèti rae. èdhi panga'a tare boe dhèu ae sèmi ne'e!

source_text: and he was questioning them, how many loaves do you have? and they said, seven.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, peka na, roti miu pèri bua era? ka ra dhaa peka na, ama. roti ji'i ate dhoka pidhu bua di.

source_text: and he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and having taken the seven loaves, having given thanks, he broke, and was giving to his disciples that they may set before them; and they set before the multitude.
target_text: ropa nanene nare, hèia na pua dhèu ae sèra madhèdi ètu rai. ka nare roti pidhu bua sèra, hèia na sabaj'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. sabaj'a nare, hèia na pamae roti pidhu bua sèra. ka na hia ana madhutu na papala mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: and they had a few small fishes, and having blessed, he said to set them also before them;
target_text: rèngu dènge i'a pèri ngi'u kahèi. ka yesus sabaj'a hari manèngi makasi. èle èèna ka, na hia ana madhutu na papala hari mi dhèu ae sèra.

source_text: and they ate and were filled, and they took up that which was over of broken pieces-seven baskets; and those eating were about four thousand. and he let them away,
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ele boe d'ai èpa riho sa. ra ra'a toke bècu. ra'a rare, hèia ana madhutu yesus pakaboko nganga'a sisa, ka ra ige pidhu soe hahake. èle èèna ka, yesus pua dhèu se lèpa.

source_text: and immediately having entered into the boat with his disciples, he came to the parts of dalmanutha,
target_text: ropa dhèu se lèpa, yesus dènge ana madhutu na ca'e koha pakèd'i asa rae èci, ngara na dalmanuta.

source_text: and the pharisees came forth, and began to dispute with him, seeking from him a sign from heaven, tempting him;
target_text: lod'o yesus si d'ai dalmanuta, dhèu partei parisi pèri-pèri mai paraga dènge yesus. ra tenge j'ara neo pamanahu ne. ra manèngi, peka na, ama. pad'elo tadha malaa, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, peka na, èu tare'a-re'a abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and having sighed deeply in his spirit, he says, why does this generation seek after a sign? truly i say to you, no sign will be given to this generation.
target_text: hèia yesus ère a'ae madhera, ka na dhaa si, peka na, ladhe ja'a madhutu lii padhai lii miu ne, ja'a manyasa! nga tao ka miu manèngi tadha malaa? baku sèmi èèna. ja'a bisa tao tadha malaa. te ngaa ja'a parluu boe pad'elo mi miu.

source_text: and having left them, having entered again into the boat, he went away to the other side;
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele dhèu parisi sèra, la'e hari asa dedha koha. ka na pakèd'i dènge ana madhutu na sèra asa cabèka dano.

source_text: and they forgot to take loaves, and except one loaf they had nothing with them in the boat,
target_text: ropa yesus si d'ai talora dano, hèia ana madhutu na sèra heka sanèd'e kèna, na, rèngu rèti boe nganga'a leo, dhoka roti cue di.

source_text: and he was charging them, saying, take heed, beware of the leaven of the pharisees, and of the leaven of herod,
target_text: tadèngi ra ale roti, hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu mage-mage ku! baku lèke pangaru karehe nèti dhèu aae herodes dènge dhèu parisi. pangaru rèngu, sama sèmi ragi dhu dhèu pakihu tao roti.

source_text: and they were reasoning with one another, saying, because we have no loaves.
target_text: ra tadèngi na padhai lii sèmi èèna, ka ana madhutu sèra malaa. ka ra papeka isi-aanga si, peka na, mone heka nèi, peka ngaa ne? tao-tao èdhi tèti boe roti, ka na lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: and jesus having known, says to them, why do you reason, because you have no loaves? do you not yet perceive, nor understand, yet have you hardened your heart?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a lii padhai rèngu. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu padhue dhoka roti di! miu me'a mere boe ngaa dhu ja'a peka na, do? mema kahadhu miu kateme.

source_text: having eyes, do you not see? and having ears, do you not hear? and do you not remember?
