target_text: miu mèdhi dènge madha le, te ngaa mo'o boe me'a! èci èèna ka dènge miu mèdhi mèka. miu tadèngi dènge ro'a dhilu le, te ngaa mo'o boe nanene. èci èèna ka dènge miu tadèngi mèka. miu bhèlu le, do?

source_text: when i broke the five loaves to the five thousand, how many hand-baskets full of broken pieces did you take up? they say to him, twelve.
target_text: roti lèmi bua dhu ja'a pamae kore ka hia dhèu lèmi riho sèra ra'a, si? ca hari ni, miu pakaboko mere roti dhu risi sèra pèri soe? ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, canguru dua soe, ama.

source_text: and when the seven to the four thousand, how many hand-baskets full of broken pieces did you take up? and they said, seven.
target_text: ka na karèi hari, aku nèngu na, miu sanèd'e era lod'o ja'a pamae kore roti pèri bua sèra, ka hia dhèu èpa riho ra'a sa, do aad'o? miu pakaboko mere sisa pèri soe hahake? ka ra dhaa, na, pidhu, ama.

source_text: and he said to them, how do you not understand?
target_text: hèia na peka, na, mema tare'a! miu mèdhi dènge madha le. te ngaa, nga tao ka miu me'a mèka koasa ja'a kapua nèti mia?

source_text: and he comes to bethsaida, and they bring to him one blind, and call on him that he may touch him,
target_text: ropa yesus si d'ai rae betsaida, dhèu rèti dhèu bèdhu èci mai asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus pa'èle musi madha dhèu bèdhu ne.

source_text: and having taken the hand of the blind man, he led him forth outside the village, and having spit on his eyes, having put his hands on him, he was questioning him if he beholds anything:
target_text: ka yesus kadhèi nare kacui-aai dhèu ne, ka dua ra lasi asa li'u rae. èle èèna ka, yesus sabhuu ilu mi musi madha dhèu ne, hèia na g'ag'e. ka na karèi, peka na, samia? èu mèdhi le, do dhae?

source_text: and he, having looked up, said, i behold men, as i see trees, walking.
target_text: ka dhèu èèna padoa kètu, ka na ladhe sa g'ana-kariu, hèia na dhaa, peka na, oo! ja'a kèdhi dhèu kako rango-rango era, nuka sèmi ana aaj'u dhu kako.

source_text: afterward again he put his hands on his eyes, and made him look up, and he was restored, and discerned all things clearly,
target_text: hèia yesus caro hari kacui-aai na ca tèka mi musi madha dhèu ne'e. ka na ladhe patae hari, ho neo ne'a, na, musi madha na be'a le, do dhae. ne'e ne, heka nèdhi dènge mèu kèna.

source_text: and he sent him away to his house, saying, neither may you go into the village, nor tell it to any in the village.
target_text: ka yesus pua na lèpa, te ngaa pasanèd'e ne, aku nèngu na, èu lamu ka, te ngaa madhutu j'ara leo. re ia ka betsaida.

source_text: and jesus went forth, and his disciples, into the villages of caesarea philippi, and in the way he was questioning his disciples, saying to them, who do men say i am?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si kako palème rae-rae ètu kaisarea pilipi. ètu talora j'ara, yesus karèi ana madhutu na, peka na, madhutu lii lolo dhèu, na, ja'a ne, cee?

source_text: and they answered, john the immerser, and others elijah, but others one of the prophets.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, dhèu cahag'e peka, na, èu ne, yohanis tuka sarani dhu madhe le, te ngaa mamuri hari. abhu cahag'e peka na, èu ne, elia, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru sèra. aa abhu cahag'e hari peka na, ama ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo.

source_text: and he says to them, and you-who do you say i am? and peter answering says to him, you are the christ.
target_text: ka yesus karèi hari rèngu, madhutu a'abhu miu, ja'a ne, cee? petrus dhaa, peka na, ama ne, kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka.

source_text: and he strictly charged them that they may tell no one about it,
target_text: hèia yesus pasanèd'e si, aku nèngu na, baku lolo mi cee-cee kahèi, ee!

source_text: and began to teach them that it is necessary for the son of man to suffer many things, and to be rejected by the elders, and chief priests, and scribes, and to be killed, and to rise again after three days;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus mulai peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae titu kèna, lula dhèu heka-dhèu heka yahudi, kètu agama yahudi, dènge mese agama sèra, aa'i-aa'i ra sèmi rare boe ja'a. ho èèna na, ra pamadhe ja'a, te ngaa d'ai camèd'a, na, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: and openly he was speaking the word. and peter having taken him aside, began to rebuke him,
target_text: yesus peka boe dènge pahuni, hèia petrus ère ne asa karasa na, ka na kai, aku nèngu na, ama, baku padhai lii sèmi èèna! ja'a ko'o boe dhèu tao ama ku sèmi èèna.

source_text: and he, having turned, and having looked on his disciples, rebuked peter, saying, get behind me, satan, because you do not mind the things of god, but the things of men.
target_text: lii padhai lii petrus èèna, madhutu boe dad'èi ama lamatua. hèia yesus kabib'a, ka ladhe asa ana madhutu dhu leo sèra. ka na nasa dènge petrus, aku nèngu na, weh! èèna lii dhèu aae nidhu! èu pakaj'èu nèti ne'e! èu madhutu dhoka dad'èi dhèu rai-haha di. madhutu boe dad'èi ama lamatua!

source_text: and having called near the multitude, with his disciples, he said to them, whoever wills to come after me-let him disown himself, and take up his cross, and follow me;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus paroa dhèu ae sèra ho mai pakaboko dènge ana madhutu na. ka na aj'a si, peka na, dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, hud'i taha taruu bèli-bèli. nèngu hud'i tèke eele dad'èi na, ho madhutu dad'èi lamatua di. masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, te ngaa nèngu hud'i taha taruu kahèi, nuka sèmi dhèu pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha nèngu unu na ho la'e asa era ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: for whoever may will to save his life will lose it; and whoever may lose his life for my sake and for the good news' sake, he will save it;
target_text: te dhèu dhu mamuri dhoka lalau ngi'u aae na di, bèli-camèd'a mamuri nèngu ele iie d'ara! te ngaa dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula madhutu ja'a, aa lula na peka-padhai j'ara mamuri ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri dhu ma'ète boe dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for what will it profit a man, if he may gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?
target_text: mi nanene, ee! ladhe èu abhu aa'i isi rai-haha ne, te ngaa ama lamatua core eele èu, a'oto na ngaa?

source_text: or what will a man give as an exchange for his life?
target_text: masi ka èu bau mèti aa'i kakaja rai-haha ne, te ngaa bisa boe pasilu dènge samanga èu.

source_text: for whoever may be ashamed of me, and of my words, in this adulterous and sinful generation, the son of man will also be ashamed of him when he may come in the glory of his father with the holy messengers.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu ètu rai-haha limuri ne, bhelu-katub'a rupa-rupa. rèngu pusi-pahae boe madhutu ama lamatua. de cee dhu makae madhutu ja'a, do makae madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a makae kahèi mangaku nèngu ètu madha ama lamatua. te ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, bèli-camèd'a mai hari nèti sorga, palere dènge ana pajuu ama lamatua sèra. ji'i puru mai dènge dadedha ama ku, heka dhèu re'a mèu kèna, ja'a ne cee.

source_text: and he said to them, truly i say to you that there are certain of those standing here, who may not taste of death until they see the kingdom of god having come in power.
target_text: miu baku bhèlu lii padhai lii ja'a ne. abhu nèti miu cahag'e dhu madhe mèka, pe mèdhi ama lamatua nèd'u paredha dènge koasa kapai.

source_text: and after six days jesus takes peter, and james, and john, and brings them up to a high mountain by themselves, alone, and he was transfigured before them,
target_text: èle èna lod'o, hèia yesus gale nèti petrus, yakobis, yohanis, lasi asa ledhe èci dhu dhèu pea boe. ropa d'ai ledhe èèna, rèngu ladhe, na, yesus leko-leo.

source_text: and his garments became glittering, exceedingly white, as snow, so as a launderer on the earth is not able to whiten them.
target_text: aa mèdha-papake na pudhi kale'e. abhu mèka mèdha dhu pudhi sèmi èèna ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and there appeared to them elijah with moses, and they were talking with jesus.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, rèngu rèdhi yesus padhai lii dènge elia dènge musa.

source_text: and peter answering says to jesus, rabbi, it is good to us to be here; and we may make three shelters, for you one, and for moses one, and for elijah one: for he was not knowing what he might say, for they were greatly afraid.
target_text: ka petrus si madha'u bia. hèia petrus malaa, ka na padhai lii ore leli. hèia na peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! èdhi ètu era ne'e, be'a titu kèna! hua iia risi, ji'i tao paleo tèlu bua, cue hia ama, cue hia musa, aa cue hari hia elia.

source_text: and there came a cloud overshadowing them, and there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, this is my son, the beloved, hear him;
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, ra'i-liru puru mai sarimu nare si. hèia ra tadèngi lii èci nèti ra'i-liru èèna, peka na, mi nanene! yesus ne, ana pasue ja'a. miu nanene paie ne!

source_text: and suddenly, having looked around, they saw no one anymore, but jesus only with themselves.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii èèna, petrus si laladhe palème, te ngaa rèdhi heka dhèu leo ètu èèna. ate dhoka yesus mesa na.

source_text: and as they are coming down from the mountain, he charged them that they may declare to no one the things that they saw, except when the son of man may rise out of the dead;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra puru nèti ledhe èèna. ka yesus kai si, peka na, ngaa dhu miu mèdhi deo na, baku lolo dènge dhèu èci sa. ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe uuru ku. ho lod'o d'ai ja'a mamuri hari, na, miu heka lolo dènge dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: and the thing they kept to themselves, questioning together what the rising out of the dead is.
target_text: rèngu tèke pa'èra lii moa èèna ètu d'ara ra. ra ale boe dènge dhèu èci sa. te ngaa tèlu ra pakarèi isi-aanga, na padhai lii ngaa ne, peka na, ‘nèngu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe'? tasamia, ee?

source_text: and they were questioning him, saying that the scribes say that elijah must come first.
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, peka na, mese agama sèra peka na, ‘elia hud'i mai uru ku, heka kristus mai kèna. ' te ngaa madhutu ama, tare'a, do aad'o?

source_text: and he answering said to them, elijah indeed, having come first, restores all things; and how has it been written concerning the son of man, that he may suffer many things, and be set at nothing?
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, mema tare'a. elia hud'i mai uuru ku, ho bhoke j'ara hia kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka. te ngaa tasamia? miu me'a mèka ngaa dhu suri rare le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, lula-nèti dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a? dhu suri rare le, peka na, ladhe lod'o na mai, dhèu paj'èra ne, toke ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: but i say to you that also elijah has come, and they did to him what they willed, as it has been written of him.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu pasa paie dhilu miu! elia mai le. te ngaa dhèu paj'èra ne madhutu dad'èi rèngu. èèna lèke dènge ngaa dhu baki-baki èdhi sèra suri tèke le karèi nèti uuru ka.

source_text: and having come to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning with them,
target_text: ropa yesus dènge ana madhutu na, dhèu tèlu sèra, paraga hari dènge ana madhutu leo sèra, ka ladhe rèdhi dhèu ae pakaboko ètu èèna. dhèu ae sèra mai ho ra neo nanene ana madhutu yesus dhu leo sèra pab'ala lii dènge mese agama ètu èèna.

source_text: and immediately, all the multitude having seen him, were amazed, and running near, were greeting him.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae sèra ladhe rèdhi yesus, ka ra cag'ag'a, te rèngu neo laa, na, yesus ètu ledhe era. hèia ra rai mai soru ne.

source_text: and he questioned the scribes, what do you dispute with them?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, peka na, miu pab'ala lii ngaa na?

source_text: and one out of the multitude answering said, teacher, i brought my son to you, having a mute spirit;
target_text: dhèu èci nèti talora dhèu ae sèra ara sa madha, ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, mu nanene ku laa! ja'a mai kèti ana mone ja'a dhu pèd'a, ho ama ku puri-pa'èle ne. nèngu lii aad'o, bisa boe padhai lii, lula nidhu tao ne.

source_text: and wherever it seizes him, it tears him, and he foams, and gnashes his teeth, and pines away; and i spoke to your disciples that they may cast it out, and they were not able.
target_text: ladhe nidhu maso asa d'ara ngi'u na, na hake ngi'u ana ne mi rai. ho hèb'a na horo karaka, na na'e ngutu na kico-kico sèna. ho ngi'u na patèku sèmi aj'u. ja'a manèngi le ana madhutu ama ku babège eele nidhu èèna. te ngaa ra bisa boe.

source_text: and he answering him, said, o generation unbelieving, until when will i be with you? until when will i suffer you? bring him to me;
target_text: ropa na nanene nare, hèia yesus jèke si, peka na, heh! miu seli-kolane! ja'a aj'a miu pahari-pahari, te ngaa miu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa. miu parcaya èra boe mi ja'a! ja'a mate miu nèbhu sange mia hari ku? mèti ana èèna asa ne'e mai!

source_text: and they brought him to him, and he having seen him, immediately the spirit convulsed him, and he, having fallen on the earth, was wallowing-foaming.
target_text: hèia ra sa'u rèti ana èèna asa madha yesus. te ngaa ropa nidhu ladhe nèdhi yesus, na kalabhe ana ne mi rai, ka ana ne bèbhe kapod'e ètu rai, aa hèb'a na horo karaka.

source_text: and he questioned his father, how much time is it since this came to him? and he said, from childhood,
target_text: ka yesus karèi ama na, nèngu sèmi ne'e ne, pèri lod'o kèna? ka ama na dhaa, karèi nèti ana iiki ka mai.

source_text: and many times it also cast him into fire, and into water, that it might destroy him; but if you are able to do anything, help us, having compassion on us.
target_text: nidhu èèna nèbhu ae le neo pamadhe ana ne'e. na tule ne pèri-pèri hari kèna asa d'ara ai, aa na pacène le kahèi asa d'ara èi. de ama ku sue ja'a. ladhe bisa, na, ama puri-pa'èle ku ana ja'a la.

source_text: and jesus said to him, if you are able to believe! all things are possible to the one that is believing;
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka èu peka na ‘ladhe bisa'? ja'a bisa tao aa'i mèu-mèu, te ngaa hud'i èu parcaya uuru ku!

source_text: and immediately the father of the child, having cried out with tears, said, i believe, lord; be helping my unbelief.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mone èèna dhaa dènge oe tangi, aku nèngu na, ama, mema ja'a parcaya, te ngaa pa'èra hari ku lalèka ja'a ne'e!

source_text: jesus having seen that a multitude runs together, rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to it, spirit-mute and deaf-i charge you, come forth out of him, and you may no longer enter into him;
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi dhèu ae mai lingu, ka na paredha nidhu èèna, aku nèngu na, heh! nidhu bhelu! kalua pakaj'èu ka nèti ana ne'e! sèna ka na bisa tadèngi aa na padhai lii kahèi. èu baku maso ia ka asa d'ara ana ne'e!

source_text: and having cried, and convulsed him much, it came forth, and he became as dead, so that many said that he was dead,
target_text: ropa nidhu tadèngi lii yesus, hèia na pakèce. ka na hake ana ne mi rai, ka na rèbha-rèbha sène, heka nidhu kalua nèti d'ara ana èèna kèna. ana èèna kalau heka, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le. ka dhèu ètu sèra sa peka, aku rèngu na, waa! ana ne madhe le!

source_text: but jesus, having taken him by the hand, lifted him up, and he arose.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kèpe kacui-aai ana ne, ka na pakèd'i ne. hèia na kèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: and he having come into the house, his disciples were questioning him by himself, why were we not able to cast it forth?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, tèke eele era èèna, lasi dhuli èmu cue. ètu èmu èèna, rèngu mesa ra, ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ji'i bisa boe babège eele nidhu èèna?

source_text: and he said to them, this kind is able to come forth with nothing except with prayer and fasting.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, mi nanene paie! nidhu sèra mema bhelu. de ladhe miu manèngi boe a'èra nèti lamatua, na, miu bisa boe babège eele nidhu sèmi èèna.

source_text: and having gone forth there, they were passing through galilee, and he did not wish that any may know,
target_text: èle ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele era èèna, lasi taruu asa propensi galilea. lod'o èèna, yesus d'èi boe dhèu re'a nèngu ètu èèna,

source_text: for he was teaching his disciples, and he said to them, the son of man is being delivered into the hands of men, and they will kill him, and having been killed, the third day he will rise,
target_text: lula na neo aj'a ana madhutu na di. ka na lole dènge si, nèbhu heka dhèu pahie eele ja'a dènge dhèu leo. hèia ra pamadhe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. mema ja'a madhe, te ngaa d'ai camèd'a, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: but they were not understanding the saying, and they were afraid to question him.
target_text: yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, te ngaa ana madhutu na sèra malaa. rèngu bani heka karèi sasoa lii padhai lii nèngu.

source_text: and he came to capernaum, and being in the house, he was questioning them, what were you reasoning in the way among yourselves?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi d'ai kapernaum. ropa ra maso asa d'ara èmu èci, yesus karèi si, peka na, deo na miu pasisu ngaa ètu talora j'ara?

source_text: and they were silent, for they reasoned with one another in the way who is greater;
target_text: èci sa bani boe dhaa, lula ètu talora j'ara deo na, rèngu ako pasala d'ara, nèti ra pasisu, cee ka dhu kapai risi ètu talora rèngu.

source_text: and having sat down he called the twelve, and he says to them, if any wills to be first, he will be last of all, and minister of all.
target_text: hèia yesus madhèdi, ka na holo si, peka na, cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, mamuri nèngu hud'i sama sèmi dhèu haha dhu lalau-lalo'o dhèu.

source_text: and having taken a child, he set him in the midst of them, and having taken him in his arms, said to them,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus sa'u nare ana iiki èci, ka la'e asa talora rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na,

source_text: whoever may receive one of such children in my name, receives me, and whoever may receive me, does not receive me, but him who sent me.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a, ho na lalau-lalo'o dhèu sèmi ana iiki ne, èèna sama sèmi nèngu lalau-lalo'o ja'a kahèi. aa nèngu lalau-lalo'o ama ku kahèi, dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: and john answered him, saying, teacher, we saw a certain one casting out demons in your name, who does not follow us, and we forbade him, because he does not follow us.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus dhu ngara na yohanis, peka na, ama! ca tèka ji'i ngèdhi ca dhèu pake kolongara ama ku, ho na babège eele nidhu. te ngaa ji'i kai ne, lula nèngu dhèu èdhi boe.

source_text: and jesus said, do not forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name, and will be readily able to speak evil of me:
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, baku mi kai ne! te dhèu dhu pake kolongara ja'a, ho na tao tadha malaa, nèngu pa'ele iie boe kolongara ja'a.

source_text: for he who is not against us is for us;
target_text: ladhe nèngu palab'a boe dènge èdhi, nèngu na dhèu èdhi.

source_text: for whoever may give you to drink a cup of water in my name, because you are christ's, truly i say to you, he may not lose his reward;
target_text: de mi sanèd'e paie! ladhe abhu dhèu ne'a, na, miu madhutu kristus, ka na soru-bara miu, tatu ama lamatua bhèlu boe rui-j'aj'èra nèngu. masi ka dhèu dhu hia miu èi iia ca galaa èèna ka, ama lamatua bhèlu boe tatao nèngu èèna.

source_text: and whoever may cause to stumble one of the little ones believing in me, better is it for him if a millstone is hanged around his neck, and he has been cast into the sea.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii hari dènge ra, peka na, mage-mage, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao ana iiki èci kako sala j'ara, toke ana ne parcaya heka ja'a! be'a risi hia dhèu èèna, rare hadhu aae cue, ho èki mi ladha goro ne, ho pacène ne asa talora dhasi.

source_text: and if your hand may cause you to stumble, cut it off; it is better for you to enter into life maimed, than having the two hands, to go away into gehenna, into the fire-the unquenchable-
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake kacui-aai èu, na, poro eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge kacui-aai cabèka di. baku d'ai ra core èu asa d'ara ai heo robhe-robhe dènge kacui-aai kateme.

source_text: where their worm is not dying, and the fire is not being quenched.
target_text: naraka èèna, mema era j'aj'èra. ai na madhe boe. sèmi èèna kahèi, èru-èru kamoke dènge ra'a taruu ngaa-ngaa dhu hèu ètu èèna.

source_text: and if your foot may cause you to stumble, cut it off; it is better for you to enter into life lame, than having the two feet to be cast into gehenna, into the fire-the unquenchable-
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake haga èu, na, poro eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge haga cabèka di. baku d'ai ra core èu asa d'ara ai heo robhe-robhe dènge haga kateme.

source_text: where their worm is not dying, and the fire is not being quenched.
target_text: naraka èèna, mema era j'aj'èra. ai na madhe boe. sèmi èèna kahèi, èru-èru kamoke dènge ra'a taruu ngaa-ngaa dhu hèu ètu èèna.

source_text: and if your eye may cause you to stumble, cast it out; it is better for you to enter into the kingdom of god one-eyed, than having two eyes, to be cast into the gehenna of fire-
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake musi madha èu, na, ed'o eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge musi madha cabèka di. baku d'ai ra core èu asa d'ara ai heo robhe-robhe dènge musi madha kateme.

source_text: where their worm is not dying, and the fire is not being quenched;
target_text: ‘naraka èèna, mema era j'aj'èra. ai na, madhe boe. sèmi èèna kahèi, èru-èru kamoke dènge ra'a taruu ngaa-ngaa dhu hèu ètu èèna. '

source_text: for everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be salted with salt.
target_text: a'aj'a ja'a ne, mema bia. de ladhe cee dhu madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i taha taruu, sèmi dhèu dhu neo paga sisi hud'i masi uuru ku, sèna ka sisi paga èèna taha nèbhu.

source_text: the salt is good, but if the salt may become saltless, in what will you season it? have in yourselves salt, and have peace in one another.
target_text: masi mema be'a. èdhi pake ho pasèro nganga'a. te ngaa ladhe masi sèro heka, guna na ngaa? dhoka bhori eele di. miu hud'i j'aj'i sèmi masi kahèi, sèna ka mamuri pasue dènge dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i. de mi pasisu ia ka, peka na, cee ka dhu kapai, aa cee ka dhu ana iiki.

source_text: and having risen from there, he comes to the coasts of judea, through the other side of the jordan, and again multitudes come together to him, and as he had been accustomed, again he was teaching them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi asa propensi yudea dènge era-era ètu cabèka dhimu loko yarden. ètu mia-mia, dhèu ae mai lingu rare yesus. hèia na aj'a si, sèmi biasa.

source_text: and the pharisees, having come near, questioned him if it is lawful for a husband to put away a wife, tempting him,
target_text: dhèu parisi pèri-pèri mai neo pamanahu ne. ra karèi ne sèmi ne'e ka, madhutu a'abhu agama èdhi, ladhe mone dhu dènge le d'ara èmu, bisa pa'ia hari, do aad'o?

source_text: and he answering said to them, what did moses command you?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu sanèd'e, do? atora dhèu èmu-kamali dhu musa hia èdhi uru èèna, tasamia?

source_text: and they said, moses permitted to write a bill of divorce, and to put away.
target_text: ra dhaa, peka na, nanori musa peka, dhèu bisa pa'ia-pa'ela, sad'i dhèu mone tao uru ku sasuri pa'ia dènge dhèu èmu na.

source_text: and jesus answering said to them, for the stiffness of your heart he wrote you this command,
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala si, peka na, nanene, ee! musa suri sèmi èèna, lula miu kètu hadhu.

source_text: but from the beginning of the creation god made them a male and a female;
target_text: baku bhèlu lii lolo dhu uru tèka, lod'o lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha! dhu suri tèke, peka na, ‘ama lamatua paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha, mone dènge bhèni.

source_text: on this account will a man leave his father and mother, and will cleave to his wife,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone tèke eele ina-ama na, ho mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu na,

source_text: and they will be-the two-for one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh;
target_text: sèna ka dua ra j'aj'i mi èci. '

source_text: what god therefore joined together, do not let man separate.
target_text: ladhe lamatua pa'èci le rèngu dua ra, dhèu rai-haha baku pacèri eele si!

source_text: and in the house his disciples again questioned him of the same thing,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi mesa ra asa d'ara èmu cue. ètu èèna, rèngu karèi ne lii aj'a deo sa.

source_text: and he says to them, whoever may put away his wife, and may marry another, commits adultery against her;
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, dhèu mone cee dhu ia eele dhèu èmu na, ho na madhèdi hari dènge dhèu bhèni leo, nèngu bersina.

source_text: and if a woman may put away her husband, and is married to another, she commits adultery.
target_text: èci èèna ka, dènge dhèu bhèni. ladhe nèngu ia eele dhèu èmu na, ho na leo hari dènge mone leo, nèngu bersina kahèi.

source_text: and they were bringing to him children that he might touch them, and the disciples were rebuking those bringing them,
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu rèti ana-ana rèngu asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus sabaj'a hia si, ho hia lii mèngi-nale. te ngaa ana madhutu yesus kai dhèu sèra.

source_text: and jesus having seen, was much displeased, and he said to them, permit the children to come to me, and do not forbid them, for of such is the kingdom of god;
target_text: yesus ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka na nasa dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa ana iiki sèra mai asa ja'a. baku magee si. te dhèu sèmi sèra ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: truly i say to you, whoever may not receive the kingdom of god as a child-he may not enter into it;
target_text: miu sanèd'e paie! dhèu cee dhu neo mai asa katanga-madha lamatua, d'ara na kateme hud'i d'èi paraga dènge ne, èci èèna ka ana iiki dhu d'ara d'èi paraga dènge ina-ama ra. ladhe sèmi boe èèna, rèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: and having taken them in his arms, having put his hands on them, he was blessing them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus liku nare ana iiki se, ka na tao kacui-aai na mi dedha kètu ana iiki se èci-èci, ho na hia si lii mamèngi.

source_text: and as he is going forth into the way, one having run and having kneeled to him, was questioning him, good teacher, what may i do that i may inherit continuous life?
target_text: ropa yesus si neo pakèd'i, dhèu kaja èci rai mai neo paraga dènge ne. hèia na pacud'u ètu madha yesus, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ama mese dhu hua iia! ja'a neo karèi ciki. ja'a tao tasamia, sèna ka ja'a ke'a tare'a-re'a, na, ja'a ne maso sorga ho mamuri taruu pa'èci dènge ama lamatua?

source_text: and jesus said to him, why do you call me good? no one is good except one-god;
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka èu ne peka na, ja'a ne ‘hua iia'? dhèu rai-haha ne èci sa dhu hua iia boe. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu hua iia.

source_text: you have known the commands: you may not commit adultery, you may not murder, you may not steal, you may not bear false witness, you may not defraud, honor your father and mother.
target_text: èu me'a le, lii paredha ama lamatua sèra nèti uru ka, dhu peka na: ‘baku pamadhe dhèu; baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu-kamali boe èu; baku mana'u; baku j'aj'i sakasii kapod'e-kabèli; baku monya ho parame more mèdha-panyau dhèu; aa pakab'ua ina-ama èu. '

source_text: and he answering said to him, teacher, all these i have kept from my youth.
target_text: dhèu èèna dhaa, peka na, tare'a, ama mese! nèti ana ngèru ka mai, ja'a madhutu le lii paredha sèra aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: and jesus having looked on him, loved him, and said to him, one thing you lack: go away, whatever you have-sell, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven, and come, follow me, having taken up the cross.
target_text: yesus rasa kasia dènge dhèu ne'e, hèia na peka, tare'a! te ngaa j'ara èci era. lèpa ka asa èmu èu, lamu pahia aa'i su'i-kakaja èu. kab'ua na lamu pala-bagi mi dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa. èle èèna, heka mai kèna, ho madhutu ja'a. pe bèli-camèd'a lamatua pala-bagi hia èu hari kakaja-sasu'i dhu leo ètu sorga.

source_text: and he-gloomy at the word-went away sorrowing, for he was having many possessions.
target_text: ropa dhèu ne tadèngi nare lii padhai lii yesus èèna, d'ara na laho mae-mae. la'e ka èmu dènge d'ara dhu pèd'a bia, lula nèngu dhèu kaja tare'a.

source_text: and jesus having looked around, says to his disciples, how hardly will they who have riches enter into the kingdom of god!
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe la'e-mai, aa peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, mi nanene! dhèu kaja carui titu kèna maso sorga!

source_text: and the disciples were astonished at his words, and jesus again answering says to them, children, how hard it is to those trusting on riches to enter into the kingdom of god!
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai lii yesus èèna, ana madhutu na bingu. ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, mi nanene paie! mema carui ladhe dhèu neo j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. baku ngee èèna mud'a!

source_text: it is easier for a camel to enter through the eye of the needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of god.
target_text: dhèu kaja maso sorga ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua, sama carui dènge badha onta ci'u dhu kapai maso asa oka na re ro'a j'aj'au.

source_text: and they were astonished beyond measure, saying to themselves, and who is able to be saved?
target_text: lii padhai lii yesus ne asa pamalaa dhèu se'e aa'i-aa'i si. ka ra pakarèi, peka na, ladhe tare'a sèmi èèna, cee ka dhu bisa abhu mamuri dènge ama lamatua?

source_text: and jesus, having looked on them, says, with men it is impossible, but not with god; for all things are possible with god.
target_text: ka yesus ladhe si èci-èci, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, madhutu dhèu rai-haha, na, carui. te ngaa baku bhèlu, madhutu ama lamatua, aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i.

source_text: and peter began to say to him, behold, we left all, and we followed you.
target_text: èle èèna ka, petrus padhai lii, peka na, ama, ji'i tèke eele le ngaa-ngaa dhu j'aj'i unu ji'i, ho madhutu èu. de ji'i abhu bab'ala na ngaa?

source_text: and jesus answering said, truly i say to you, there is no one who left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or fields, for my sake, and for the good news', who may not receive a hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brothers, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and fields, with persecutions, and in the age that is coming, continuous life;
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, ja'a neo peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a, aa tèke eele ina-ama na, a'ari na, ana-èpu na, oka-tedhe na, sasab'a-la'a na, dènge isi èmu aa'i-aa'i, ho la'e peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua mi dhèu ètu mia-mia, lèpa loo limuri, nèngu abhu hari ngaa-ngaa sèra, d'ai cangasu hari. aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu tèke eele sèra, èèna na nèngu abhu risi hari. aa nèngu abhu j'aj'èra kahèi, lula madhutu ja'a. te ngaa ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, nèngu mamuri taruu pa'èci dènge ama lamatua. bab'ala nèngu, sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: and many first will be last, and the last first.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu dhu padedha iisi, madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, limuri mai nèngu j'aj'i dhèu haha d'ai seli. te ngaa dhèu dhu ngee, na, nèngu dhèu haha di, madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, limuri mai nèngu j'aj'i dhèu kapai.

source_text: and they were in the way going up to jerusalem, and jesus was going before them, and they were amazed, and following they were afraid. and having again taken the twelve, he began to tell them the things about to happen to him:
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa kota yerusalem. yesus kako uuru. ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua dènge dhèu leo dhu kako pa'èci madhutu ne re limuri. rèngu sanèd'e lii padhai dhu yesus peka dènge rèngu uru èèna, peka na, dhèu neo pamadhe ne ètu yerusalem. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bingu dènge madha'u. hèia yesus paroa nare ana madhutu na sèra mesa ra, ho na peka hari dènge rèngu dhèu neo tao ngaa mi dedha nèngu ètu yerusalem.

source_text: behold, we go up to jerusalem, and the son of man will be delivered to the chief priests, and to the scribes, and they will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the nations,
target_text: yesus peka dènge si, mi nanene! èdhi neo lati asa yerusalem. ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ètu nèi, dhèu neo pahie eele ja'a asa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra. èle èèna, ra uku-ked'i pamadhe ja'a. ra tule eele ja'a asa dhèu leo dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: and they will mock him, and scourge him, and spit on him, and kill him, and the third day he will rise again.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra padhai lii pamakae ja'a. ra paru'e ilu mi ja'a. aa ra dhedhe pamae iisi ja'a. èle èèna, heka ra pamadhe ja'a kèna. mema ja'a madhe tare'a. te ngaa d'ai camèda, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: and there come near to him james and john, the sons of zebedee, saying, teacher, we wish that whatever we may ask for ourselves, you may do for us;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana sabadeus, nuka yakobis dènge yohanis, mai asa yesus. ka ra manèngi, peka na, ama mese! ji'i neo padhai lii dènge ama ciki.

source_text: and he said to them, what do you wish me to do for you?
target_text: ka yesus karèi si, miu neo ngaa?

source_text: and they said to him, grant to us that, one on your right hand and one on your left, we may sit in your glory;
target_text: ra dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama! bèli-camèd'a, ladhe ama mèd'u paredha, ji'i manèngi ama pamadhèdi ji'i dua mi, èci re sebhe g'ana, èci hari re kariu, sèna ka ji'i paredha hèi.

source_text: and jesus said to them, you have not known what you ask; are you able to drink of the cup that i drink of, and with the immersion that i am immersed with-to be immersed?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu dua mi se me'a boe lii manèngi miu èèna. èèna na, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae. de tasamia? miu ngee, na, miu se bisa pasae j'aj'èra dènge ja'a toke madhe, do?

source_text: and they said to him, we are able; and jesus said to them, of the cup indeed that i drink of, you will drink, and with the immersion that i am immersed with, you will be immersed;
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i bisa, ama! ka yesus b'ala, peka na, mema, èèna na, miu pasae j'aj'èra kahèi, sama sèmi ja'a.

source_text: but to sit on my right and on my left is not mine to give, but-to those for whom it has been prepared.
target_text: te ngaa cee dhu madhèdi re sebhe g'ana, do sebhe kariu ja'a, èèna hak ja'a aad'o. te dhu hak ka ama lamatua dhu pama'ète mema le, na, cee-cee ka dhu madhèdi ètu era sèra.

source_text: and the ten having heard, began to be much displeased at james and john,
target_text: ropa ana madhutu dhu leo sèra tadèngi lii manèngi yakobis dènge yohanis sèmi èèna, ka ra nasa bia.

source_text: but jesus having called them near, says to them, you have known that they who are considered to rule the nations exercise lordship over them, and their great ones exercise authority on them;
target_text: hèia yesus paroa aa'i-aa'i si, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, miu me'a le, sina ma? dhèu-dhèu kapai dhu rèd'u paredha j'eli ana kabarai sèna ka rèngu bisa boe kalau-karèto. dhèu kapai kabarai dhu tadhe boe lamatua hia paredha risi eele, ka ana kabarai bisa heka doa kètu.

source_text: but not so will it be among you; but whoever may will to become great among you, he will be your minister,
target_text: te ngaa miu baku tao sèmi èèna! nèti talora miu, cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku ana pua-paleha ho lalau dhèu leo.

source_text: and whoever of you may will to become first, he will be servant of all;
target_text: cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, nèngu hud'i tao ngi'u na sama sèmi ènu.

source_text: for even the son of man did not come to be ministered to, but to minister, and to give his life as a ransom for many.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a mai hia boe dhèu lalau-lalo'o ja'a. te ngaa ja'a mai ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu ae, dènge hia mamuri ja'a ho sui kore dhèu ae nèti koasa sasala-sasigo rèngu.

source_text: and they come to jericho, and as he is going forth from jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, a son of timaeus-bartimaeus the blind-was sitting beside the way begging,
target_text: yesus dènge ana madhutu na, dènge dhèu ae titu kèna kako lasi kota jeriko. ropa rèngu neo kako taruu, dhèu bèdhu èci madhèdi ètu sebhe j'ara, na kanata ai ho manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu dhu kako re èèna. ngara na bartimeos, ana nèti timeos.

source_text: and having heard that it is jesus the nazarene, he began to cry out, and to say, the son of david-jesus! deal kindly with me;
target_text: ropa na tadèngi dhèu dhu kako mai sèra, yesus nèti rae nasaret na kahèi, ka na rodhe, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu daud, ee! ji'i mate èu nèbhu ae le! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: and many were rebuking him that he might keep silent, but the more abundantly he cried out, son of david, deal kindly with me.
target_text: ropa ra nanene lii rodhe na, hèia dhèu sèra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, èu mau-mau ku laa! te ngaa na rodhe asa aae, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu daud, ee! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: and jesus having stood, he commanded him to be called, and they call the blind man, saying to him, take courage, rise, he calls you;
target_text: hèia yesus titu taha, ka na peka, mèti ku na mai sa ne'e! ka ra lasi peka dènge dhèu bèdhu èèna, peka na, èu mau-mau ka laa! te ama mese paroa èu nèi. de mai lati ka!

source_text: and he, having cast away his garment, having risen, came to jesus.
target_text: ropa nanene nare, ka bartimeos pèci eele sig'i kalolo na, hèia na kèd'i titu la'e paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: and answering, jesus says to him, what do you will i may do to you? and the blind man said to him, rabboni, that i may see again;
target_text: ka yesus karèi ne, peka na, èu parluu ngaa? dhèu bèdhu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! ja'a manèngi ho ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: and jesus said to him, go, your faith has saved you: and immediately he saw again, and was following jesus in the way.
target_text: yesus peka hari dènge ne, lula èu parcaya, ja'a bisa tao paie musi madha èu. ne'e ne kahèi musi madha èu èle dènge! de lamu ka! ka musi madha bartimeos èle dènge. èle ka la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: and when they come near to jerusalem, to bethphage, and bethany, to the mount of olives, he sends forth two of his disciples,
target_text: ropa ra dètu dènge kota yerusalem, ka ra dhuli uuru dua rae, ngara na betfage dènge betania, ètu sebhe ledhe saitun. ètu èèna, yesus si mate ciki oo'e di. ka na pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua lasi uuru.

source_text: and says to them, go away into the village that is in front of you, and immediately, entering into it, you will find a colt tied, on which no one of men has sat, having loosed it, bring it:
target_text: na pua si, peka na, miu dua mi lami uuru asa d'ara rae nèi. ropa miu maso lami, miu mèdhi ana badha keled'ei ci'u, dhu ra èki ètu èèna, dhu dhèu dhae manya'e mèka. lami ho lècu eele dhari a'èki na, ho ère mèti mai asa ne'e.

source_text: and if anyone may say to you, why do you do this? say that the lord has need of it, and immediately he will send it here.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu karèi miu, ‘nga tao ka miu ère mèti ana keled'ei ne? ' mi peka dènge si, ‘lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. ladhe pake nare, na, na hia hari mai. '

source_text: and they went away, and found the colt tied at the door outside, by the two ways, and they loose it,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu na dhèu dua sèra lasi, ka rèdhi ana keled'ei ci'u dhu èki tèke ètu madha èmu cue ètu sebhe j'ara. ra lècu eele dhari èki na, ka ra ère rèti mai.

source_text: and certain of those standing there said to them, what do you-loosing the colt?
target_text: ka dhèu-dhèu dhu titu ètu èèna, peka na, we! nga tao ka miu pakako mèti keled'ei dhèu?

source_text: and they said to them as jesus commanded, and they permitted them.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. ho ladhe na pake nare, na, ji'i ngèti hari mai. ka dhèu sèra soro tèke si lasi pakako rèti ana keled'ei èèna.

source_text: and they brought the colt to jesus, and cast their garments on it, and he sat on it,
target_text: hèia ra rèti ana keled'ei èèna asa yesus. ka ra hèle sig'i-kalolo rèngu mi dedha keled'ei, ka yesus manya'e.

source_text: and many spread their garments in the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees, and were strewing in the way.
target_text: ropa oe maso d'ara kota, ka dhèu ae rare sig'i-kalolo, ka ra hèle mi dedha j'ara oka-hoo. dhèu cahag'e lasi para rèu palam ètu sebhe j'ara, ho ra tao mi talora j'ara oka-hoo. tatao sèmi èèna na, sama sèmi tadha èci dhu peka na, rèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: and those going before and those following were crying out, saying, hosanna! blessed is he who is coming in the name of the lord;
target_text: dhèu cahag'e kako uru ètu madha yesus; aa cahag'e kako limuri. ka ra pa'oo, peka na, hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lamatua hia berkat mi dhèu dhu mai pake kolongara na, lula ama lamatua hia ne mai!

source_text: blessed is the coming kingdom, in the name of the lord, of our father david; hosanna in the highest!
target_text: hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua neo pakèd'i hari paredha dhèu aae daud! hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu era dedha risi eele!

source_text: and jesus entered into jerusalem, and into the temple, and having looked around on all things, it being now evening, he went forth to bethany with the twelve.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai d'ara kota, ka yesus si maso asa madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka yesus ladhe palème era èmu èèna. te ngaa, lula lod'o nihia ae le, ka ra lèpa hari asa rae betania.

source_text: and on the next day, they having come forth from bethany, he hungered,
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, ka rèngu kalua nèti betania lasi asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara ka yesus manganga.

source_text: and having seen a fig tree far off having leaves, he came, if perhaps he will find anything in it, and having come to it, he found nothing except leaves, for it was not a time of figs,
target_text: ka na ladhe nèdhi ana aaj'u èci ètu sebhe j'ara. hua aj'u na, dhu dhèu ra'a. yesus la'e padètu ho neo ne'a aj'u na, hua do aad'o. na ladhe aj'u èèna hua boe cue sa. te mema d'ai mèka hèru hua. rèu heka mare kèna.

source_text: and jesus answering said to it, no longer from you-throughout the age-may any eat fruit; and his disciples were hearing.
target_text: ka yesus peka mi aj'u èèna, lula èu hia boe ja'a hua, mulai ti deo ne'e, èu bisa heka hia hua èu asa dhèu leo! ana madhutu yesus sèra tadèngi na padhai lii dènge nasa sèmi èèna.

source_text: and they come to jerusalem, and jesus having gone into the temple, began to cast forth those selling and buying in the temple, and he overthrew the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those selling the doves,
target_text: yesus si kako taruu asa yerusalem, d'ai nèi ka yesus maso asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu madha èmu èèna, dhèu tao pasa ho ra pahia koro j'aha dhu biasa dhèu pake tao korban ho ra sabaj'a. ropa yesus nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka na lalèta si asa li'u. na tule eele mei dhu ra pake ho pasilu doi sèra, aa na tule paguri eele bagu dhu ra pake pahia manu-bhui sa.

source_text: and he did not permit that any might carry a vessel through the temple,
target_text: ka yesus kai si aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka ra rèti ia ka mèdha rèngu re d'ara madha èmu èèna.

source_text: and he was teaching, saying to them, has it not been written: my house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations? and you made it a den of robbers!
target_text: ka na aj'a si, peka na, miu me'a le lii dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke le, peka na: ‘ja'a tao èmu ne'e, sèna ka suku aa'i-aa'i mai sabaj'a ètu ne'e. ' te ngaa miu tao èmu ne j'aj'i era pakaboko dhèu parapo.

source_text: and the scribes and the chief priests heard, and they were seeking how they will destroy him, for they were afraid of him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching;
target_text: ropa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra re'a rare tatao yesus sèmi èèna, ka ra nasa dènge ne. ka ra tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa ra madha'u, lula dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus.

source_text: and when evening came, he was going forth outside the city.
target_text: d'ara lod'o cèna sa, yesus si kalua hari nèti kota yerusalem lèpa lasi j'unu asa rae betania.

source_text: and in the morning, passing by, they saw the fig tree having been dried up from the roots, and peter having remembered says to him, rabbi, behold, the fig tree that you cursed is dried up.
target_text: bèli mad'ae èèna, yesus si lasi hari asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara, ka ra rèdhi aj'u dhu yesus padhai lii med'a na. ka ana madhutu yesus sèra malaa, lula rèngu rèdhi aj'u èèna mango le d'ai amo. hèia petrus sanèd'e lii padhai lii yesus med'a na. ka na peka na, ama! ladhe ku! aj'u dhu ama dhoo med'a na, madhe le!

source_text: and jesus answering says to them, have faith from god;
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a, we! sad'i miu parcaya ama lamatua sèmi èèna, na, j'aj'i kahèi.

source_text: for truly i say to you that whoever may say to this mountain, be taken up, and be cast into the sea, and may not doubt in his heart, but may believe that the things that he says come to pass, it will be to him whatever he may say.
target_text: ladhe miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, miu bisa pua ledhe hia na pidha asa d'ara dhasi. pe lamatua pidha eele ledhe èèna, sad'i miu baku parcaya dènge d'ara cabèka. miu parcaya mi ama lamatua, hud'i dènge d'ara kateme ku.

source_text: because of this i say to you, all whatever-praying-you ask, believe that you receive, and it will be to you.
target_text: baku bhèlu! sad'i miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, ngaa dhu miu manèngi, tatu ama lamatua bisa hia miu.

source_text: and whenever you may stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone, that your father who is in the heavens may also forgive you your trespasses;
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci sabaj'a, aa te ngaa na tèka d'ara era dènge dhèu leo, nèngu hud'i la'e pabe'a uuru ku dènge dhèu èèna. ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, ama miu ètu sorga heka saku eele sasala miu kèna.

source_text: and, if you do not forgive, neither will your father who is in the heavens forgive your trespasses.
target_text: ladhe abhu nèti miu dhu tèka d'ara dènge dhèu, ho mo'o boe hia abho, na, tatu ama miu ètu sorga no'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala miu kahèi.

source_text: and they come again to jerusalem, and in the temple, as he is walking, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi taruu. ropa d'ai yerusalem, ka ra maso hari asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa maso asa madha èmu èèna, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka yahudi sèra mai,

source_text: and they say to him, by what authority do you do these things? and who gave you this authority that you may do these things?
target_text: ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, cee ka dhu pua èu mai tao maruru ètu ne'e med'a na? cee ka hia èu hak!

source_text: and jesus answering said to them, i will question you-i also-one word; and answer me, and i will tell you by what authority i do these things;
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a, na, rèngu neo tenge j'ara ho pamanahu ne. ka na b'ala si, peka na, ja'a neo karèi miu kahèi. miu dhaa uuru ku ja'a, heka ja'a dhaa miu kèna.

source_text: the immersion of john-was it from heaven or from men? answer me.
target_text: ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: miu aa'i-aa'i mi tadhe yohanis, tuka sarani èèna, sina ma? cee ka dhu pua nèngu la'e sarani dhèu? lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha?

source_text: and they were reasoning with themselves, saying, if we may say, from heaven, he will say, why then did you not believe him?
target_text: ra pajiko la'e-mai, ka ra padhue, peka na, eea! nara èdhi le! ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka dhu pua yohanis, ' na b'ala hari, peka na, ‘nga tao ka miu parcaya boe yohanis! '

source_text: but if we may say, from men… they were fearing the people, for all were holding that john was indeed a prophet;
target_text: te ngaa èdhi bisa boe peka kahèi, na, ‘dhèu rai-haha dhu pua ne. ' te aad'o na, dhèu ae tao dènge èdhi. lula dhèu ae parcaya, yohanis èèna, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: and answering they say to jesus, we have not known; and jesus answering says to them, neither do i tell you by what authority i do these things.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i nge'a boe! ka yesus dhaa hari si, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ko'o boe peka kahèi, cee ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: and he began to speak to them in allegories: a man planted a vineyard, and put a hedge around, and dug a wine vat, and built a tower, and gave it out to farmers, and went abroad;
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii hari dènge kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra. ka na lole pake lii upama èci, peka na, dhèu èci la'e tao oka ho neo sèla anggor ètu dedha rai na. ka na tao tedhe reo nare oka èèna, aa tao bak cue ho kanate èi anggor asa d'ara la'e kahèi. hèia na patitu èmu madhenga oka cue dhu dedha. èle èèna ka, na hia dhèu leo seb'a oka èèna, ho ra pabagi èi anggor. hèia na pakèd'i asa rai leo la'e.

source_text: and he sent to the farmers at the due time a servant, that from the farmers he may receive from the fruit of the vineyard,
target_text: lod'o d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu hua anggor, ka lamatua oka pua ana paleha na èci la'e asa dhèu sab'a oka sèra, ho na manèngi pala na.

source_text: and they, having taken him, severely beat him, and sent him away empty.
target_text: ropa d'ai nèi, ka dhèu seb'a sèra kèpe rare, ka game ne. hèia ra pua ne lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: and again he sent to them another servant, and having cast stones at that one, they wounded him in the head, and sent him away-dishonored.
target_text: ka lamatua oka pua hari ana paleha leo èci. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra dhedhe panu'a kètu na. ka ra pamakae ne, dènge magèle eele ne.

source_text: and again he sent another, and that one they killed; and many others, some beating, and some killing.
target_text: hèia lamatua oka èèna pua hari ana paleha leo èci la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra hake pamadhe ne. ra tao samia èèna ka, lamatua oka pua taruu ana paleha na la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra game cahag'e, aa pamadhe cahag'e.

source_text: having yet therefore one son-his beloved-he also sent him to them last, saying, they will respect my son;
target_text: ate eele dhodhoka ana mone mesa dhu pasue nèti lamatua oka. lula na abhu heka j'ara dhu leo, ka lamatua oka na pua ana d'èlu na la'e. na pajiko, peka na, ‘sèmi ja'a pua ana d'èlu ja'a la'e, na, rèngu sèmi rare dènge be'a, aa ra nanene ne. '

source_text: and those farmers said among themselves, this is the heir, come, we may kill him, and the inheritance will be ours;
target_text: hèia na pua ana na la'e. ropa dhèu seb'a sèra rèdhi ana na mai, ka ra papeka isi-aanga ra, peka na, ‘we! mi ladhe ku laa! mone heka nèi pua ana d'èlu na mai! ladhe ama na madhe, nèngu ne'e ka dhu sèmi nare aa'i-aa'i mèdha pusaka ama na. de mai ti pamadhe ne, sèna ka èdhi tare pusaka na! '

source_text: and having taken him, they killed, and cast him forth outside the vineyard.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra kèpe, ka ra pamadhe ne, hèia ra core eele ngi'u aae na asa li'u tedhe la'e. lii pakasame ne, d'ai sange ne'e ka.

source_text: what therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus karèi dhèu kapai sèra, peka na, madhutu ngangee miu, na, lamatua oka èèna tao dhèu seb'a sèra tasa mera mia? madhutu ngangee ja'a, tatu nèngu mai ho pamadhe aa'i dhèu seb'a sèra, sèna ka na hia dhèu leo hari seb'a oka anggor na.

source_text: and this writing you did not read: a stone that the builders rejected, it became the head of a corner;
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti baca le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘abhu hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu sèra core eele le, te ngaa limuri ne, j'aj'i le hadhu padhèdi.

source_text: this was from the lord, and it is wonderful in our eyes.
target_text: ama lamatua mesa na dhu pili nare, ka na pamadhèdi hadhu ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi ladhe, na, be'a titu kèna! '

source_text: and they were seeking to lay hold on him, and they feared the multitude, for they knew that he spoke the allegory against them, and having left him, they went away;
target_text: dhèu kapai sèra re'a dènge, na, yesus padhai lii paraga, pake lii pakasame èèna. rèngu sèra sama sèmi dhèu seb'a oka anggor èèna. hèia ra tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe yesus. te ngaa ra madha'u dènge dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus. ka ra kako eele ne.

source_text: and they send to him certain of the pharisees and of the herodians, that they may ensnare him in discourse,
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu kapai yahudi se pua pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dènge dhèu nèti partei herodes, lasi pakarèi dènge yesus, ho ra neo sahèdhe ne.

source_text: and they having come, say to him, teacher, we have known that you are true, and you are not caring for anyone, for you do not look to the face of men, but in truth teach the way of god; is it lawful to give tribute to caesar or not? may we give, or may we not give?
target_text: ka ra karèi ne, peka na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a, na, d'ara ama ku mola, aa d'èi boe kapod'e-kabèli. ama me'a d'ara dhèu. ama peka dad'èi lamatua dènge mola-mola, lula ama pili boe rèhu dhèu. de, ji'i neo karèi ama ku ca j'ara. madhutu atora agama yahudi, èdhi bisa b'ae bea asa dhèu aae kapai dhu paredha roma, do aad'o?

source_text: and he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, why do you tempt me? bring me a denarius, that i may see;
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le, na, rèngu neo sahèdhe ne, sèna ka na padhai lii lab'a paredha roma. ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, nga tao ka miu neo sahèdhe ja'a dènge lii karèi sèmi èèna! cob'a pad'elo ku mi ja'a doi pudhi cue!

source_text: and they brought, and he says to them, whose is this image, and the inscription? and they said to him, caesar's;
target_text: ka ra j'ole doi pudhi cue hia ne. hèia yesus nare, ka laladhe. ka na karèi si, peka na, rèhu dènge ngara cee ètu doi pudhi ne? ka ra dhaa, peka na, èèna dhèu aae kapai paredha roma!

source_text: and jesus answering said to them, give back the things of caesar to caesar, and the things of god to god; and they wondered at him.
target_text: ka yesus peka, naa, ladhe sèmi èèna, ngaa dhu unu dhèu paredha, hia asa dhèu paredha la'e. te ngaa dhu unu ama lamatua, hia asa ama lamatua la'e. ropa tadèngi rare, lii b'ala na, ka ra malaa, lula yesus peka dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, dhèu sèra bisa heka sahèdhe ne.

source_text: and the sadducees come to him, who say there is not a resurrection, and they questioned him, saying,
target_text: abhu partei agama dhu leo èci, ngara na partei saduki. rèngu aj'a, peka na, dhèu madhe bisa heka mamuri. ca tèka, abhu dhèu saduki pèri-pèri mai neo sahèdhe yesus.

source_text: teacher, moses wrote to us that if anyone's brother may die, and may leave a wife, and may leave no children, that his brother may take his wife, and raise up seed to his brother.
target_text: ka ra padhai lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama mese! musa suri tèke le hia èdhi atora, peka na: ladhe dhèu mone èci madhe tèke eele dhèu èmu na, te ngaa rèngu dènge boe kolo, na, ari dhèu mone na bisa leo nare hari bhèni balu èèna, sèna ka abhu kolo ho baku pa'ele kolongara a'a na dhu madhe èèna.

source_text: there were then seven brothers, and the first took a wife, and dying, he left no seed;
target_text: mema musa aj'a sèmi èèna. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: abhu dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. mone uru leo uuru èmu, te ngaa madhe, abhu mèka kolo.

source_text: and the second took her, and died, not having left seed, and the third in like manner,
target_text: ka ari na leo nare bhèni balu èèna. nèbhu boe ka ari na madhe, te ngaa abhu boe kolo kahèi. ari na ka tèlu, sèmi èèna kahèi; na leo nare bhèni balu èèna, te ngaa abhu mèka kolo, nèngu madhe.

source_text: and the seven took her, and left no seed, last of all the woman also died;
target_text: taruu-taruu sèmi èèna ka, d'ai ana limuri tèka madhe kahèi. nèbhu boe, hèia bhèni balu èèna madhe.

source_text: in the resurrection, then, whenever they may rise, of which of them will she be wife-for the seven had her as wife?
target_text: naa! ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: dhèu bhèni èèna, leo le dènge mone dhèu pidhu! d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, bhèni ne j'aj'i dhèu èmu cee, nèti dhèu pidhu sèra?

source_text: and jesus answering said to them, do you not go astray because of this, not knowing the writings, nor the power of god?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, lii karèi miu sèra, tadha, na, miu me'a iia mèka isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua! miu me'a boe koasa lamatua kahèi. de miu sala titu kèna!

source_text: for when they may rise out of the dead, they neither marry nor are they given in marriage, but are as messengers who are in the heavens.
target_text: mi nanene! sèmi ne'e: ètu sorga dhèu paleo boe èmu. dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua pamamuri hari, ra paleo heka èmu. sèmi èèna kahèi, ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: and concerning the dead, that they rise: have you not read in the scroll of moses at the bush, how god spoke to him, saying, i am the god of abraham, and the god of isaac, and the god of jacob;
target_text: aa ja'a peka mi miu lula-nèti dhèu madhe mamuri hari, do aad'o. musa suri tèke lula-nèti ana aaj'u dhu ai na'e, te ngaa kèpu boe. miu sanèd'e lii lolo èèna, do aad'o? ropa ai na'e ana aaj'u èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na, ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èu, nuka abraham, isak, dènge yakob. toke d'ai sange ne'e, rèngu aa'i-aa'i manèngi-mangaj'i mi ja'a era. '

source_text: he is not the god of dead men, but a god of living men; you then go greatly astray.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, bèi-baki èdhi sèra madhe nèbhu le. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua peka nare le, na, nèngu j'aj'i lamatua rèngu era. nèti èèna ka, èdhi te'a, na, rèngu mamuri hari le. de masi ka dhèu madhe le, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. de dhèu mamuri dhu manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu madhe aad'o, sina ma? nèti èèna ka, ladhe miu kèpe taruu a'aj'a dhu peka na, dhèu madhe mamuri heka, èèna miu sala ae!

source_text: and one of the scribes having come near, having heard them disputing, knowing that he answered them well, questioned him, which is the first command of all?
target_text: ètu lod'o èèna, abhu mese agama èci dhu nanene yesus padhai lii dènge dhèu nèti partei saduki sèra. madhutu a'abhu mese agama èèna, na, yesus dhaa lèke le lii karèi rèngu. hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, ama! ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: atora ad'a dènge lii paredha agama èdhi ae titu kèna. madhutu a'abhu ama, nèti lii paredha dhu mai nèti musa, mia ka dhu hua iia risi?

source_text: and jesus answered him, the first of all the commands-hear, o israel: the lord is our god, the lord is one;
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, lii paredha dhu hua iia risi, peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘miu dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi! mi nanene paie! ama lamatua èèna, mema lamatua èdhi, aa kètu èdhi kahèi. nèngu dhoka mesa na di, lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: and you will love the lord your god out of all your heart, and out of all your soul, and out of all your understanding, and out of all your strength-this is the first command;
target_text: de miu hud'i sue risi eele ne nèti aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i d'èi pa'èci dènge ne dènge d'ara kateme, aa tadhe mèu ne, dènge sab'a èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. '

source_text: and the second is like it, this, you will love your neighbor as yourself-there is no other command greater than these.
target_text: aa lii paredha ka dua peka na: ‘èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. ' dua paredha se'e ka dhu hua iia risi. abhu heka lii paredha leo dhu risi eele nèti dua paredha se'e.

source_text: and the scribe said to him, well, teacher, in truth you have spoken that there is one god, and there is none other but he;
target_text: ka mese agama èèna b'ala hari, peka na, tare'a! ama ku peka lèke kèna. te ama lamatua j'aj'i kètu èdhi. lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: and to love him out of all the heart, and out of all the understanding, and out of all the soul, and out of all the strength, and to love one's neighbor as one's self, is more than all the whole burnt-offerings and the sacrifices.
target_text: èdhi hud'i sue risi ne, toke d'ara d'èi ho pa'èci dènge ne, tadhe mèu ne, dènge sab'a èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. èdhi hud'i sue dhèu leo kahèi sama sèmi èdhi sue ngi'u èdhi unu ti. lamatua d'èi risi eele tatao sèmi èèna, nèti èdhi madhutu dhodhoka atora agama di. tatao sèmi èèna be'a risi, nèti èdhi tèti badha ho lati tunu hia lamatua, do tèti mèdha leo hia ne.

source_text: and jesus, having seen him that he answered with understanding, said to him, you are not far from the kingdom of god; and no one dared question him anymore.
target_text: ropa yesus nanene nare dhèu ne dhaa sèmi èèna, ka na pangee, na, mese agama ne ne'a dènge be'a le. hèia yesus peka na, èu oe j'aj'i unu ama lamatua kèna. èle èèna ka, dhèu leo sèra bani heka pakarèi dènge yesus, lula dhèu èci sa segi boe ne.

source_text: and jesus answering said, teaching in the temple, how do the scribes say that the christ is son of david?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus aj'a dhèu ae sèra ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i era. ka na karèi si, peka na, madhutu ngangee miu, na, tasamia? mese agama sèra aj'a, peka na, kristus èèna dhu lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka mai. madhutu ngangee rèngu, na, kristus èèna dhoka ana-èpu daud. te ngaa a'aj'a sèmi èèna d'ai lèke mèu mèka.

source_text: for david himself said in the holy spirit, the lord said to my lord, || sit on my right hand, || until i place your enemies-your footstool;
target_text: lula, nèti uru ka mai, roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci pake daud ho suri, peka na, ‘ama lamatua peka le mi lamatua ja'a, na, mai ho madhèdi mi era dhu hua iia, re bab'oa g'ana ja'a. pe èèna na ja'a tao musu èu pahaha iisi, toke ra bisa boe ded'e kètu mi èu. '

source_text: therefore david himself calls him lord, and from where is he his son? and the great multitude were hearing him gladly,
target_text: de èdhi te'a, na, dhèu aae daud paroa kristus èèna, peka na, ‘lamatua' na. nèti èèna ka, ladhe dhèu sèra peka, na, kristus èèna dhoka ana-èpu daud di, èèna d'ai mèka. lula nèngu èèna j'aj'i lamatua nèti daud kahèi. ropa yesus peka nare sèmi èèna, dhèu ae sèra d'èi titu kèna nanene ne.

source_text: and he was saying to them in his teaching, beware of the scribes who will to walk in long robes, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
target_text: ka yesus peka hari si, miu hud'i pajiko paie ku mese agama. rèngu d'èi pasia pake kodho madhera d'ai rai, lasi paraga dènge dhèu ae, sèna ka dhèu dhu rèdhi rèngu sèra, koa si, peka na, ‘ladhe ku laa! dhèu sèra, dhèu kapai! '

source_text: and first seats in the synagogues, and first couches at the banquets,
target_text: ladhe sèmi rèngu maso asa èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, do lasi ra'a-sisi, ra tenge era madhèdi dhu be'a risi, sèna ka dhèu ae rèdhi si.

source_text: who are devouring the widows' houses, and for a pretense are making long prayers; these will receive more abundant judgment.
target_text: de hua iia mi pajiko paie! rèngu kapod'e-kabèli bhèni balu ho parame rare èmu bhèni balu sèra. te ngaa ètu madha dhèu ae, rèngu pahuni bhabhelu ra sèra dènge j'ara titu ho sabaj'a pamadhera aae, sèna ka dhèu peka na, rèngu se dhèu mola. te ngaa limuri mai, na, ama lamatua hia huku dhu bia risi asa rèngu.

source_text: and jesus having sat down opposite the treasury, was beholding how the multitude puts brass into the treasury, and many rich were putting in much,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus la'e madhèdi patangara dènge boaraka derma ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. na ladhe dhèu mai pamaso doi kolete asa d'ara boaraka èèna. ka na ladhe dhèu kaja sèra parèu doi ae.

source_text: and having come, a poor widow put in two mites, which are a penny.
target_text: te ngaa abhu bhèni balu èci dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa mai manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na pamaso dua doi asa d'ara boaraka èèna. dua doi dhu na pamaso èèna, kab'ua ciki ood'e di.

source_text: and having called near his disciples, he says to them, truly i say to you that this poor widow has put in more than all those putting into the treasury;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus gape ana madhutu na, ka na peka, mi ladhe ku bhèni balu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa nèi. na pamaso dhoka dua doi di, te ngaa nèngu hia risi eele nèti dhèu leo sèra.

source_text: for all, out of their abundance, put in, but she, out of her want, put in all that she had-all her living.
target_text: dhèu leo sèra hia kolete nèti doi sisa rèngu. te ngaa bhèni balu ne hia aa'i mèu-mèu doi nèngu asa lamatua.

source_text: and as he is going forth out of the temple, one of his disciples says to him, teacher, see! what stones! and what buildings!
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra kalua nèti d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa rèngu d'ai li'u, hèia ana madhutu na èci paj'uj'u asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na peka, ama! ladhe ku èmu ne'e! ra tao rare, saraga bia. ra pagod'o rare hadhu sèra, mera titu kèna!

source_text: and jesus answering said to him, see these great buildings? there may not be left a stone on a stone that may not be thrown down.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, èmu ne mema saraga titu kèna! te nèbhu heka, dhèu paguri eele ne. ka hadhu-hadhu sèra, èci sa pamadhèdi heka ètu dedha èci.

source_text: and as he is sitting at the mount of olives, opposite the temple, peter, and james, and john, and andrew, were questioning him by himself,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi asa ledhe saitun, ka na madhèdi ètu era dhu patangara dènge èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. hèia petrus, yakobis, yohanis dènge anderias mai padhai lii dènge yesus.

source_text: tell us when these things will be? and what is the sign when all these may be about to be fulfilled?
target_text: ra karèi, aku rèngu na, ama! lole hari ku, lii dhu ama ku peka dènge ji'i deo na. lod'o mia sèra sa j'aj'i? aa tadha-tadha na, samia?

source_text: and jesus answering them, began to say, take heed lest anyone may lead you astray,
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sad'i miu pajiko paie-iie, sèna ka baku lèke tipu.

source_text: for many will come in my name, saying, i am he, and many they will lead astray;
target_text: te ladhe èèna na, dhèu ae mai tèb'a kakara, ho ra peka na, ‘ja'a ne kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua moa nèti uru ka mai. ' aa ra leko-monya dhèu ae.

source_text: and when you may hear of wars and reports of wars, do not be troubled, for these ought to be, but the end is not yet;
target_text: ladhe miu mèdhi dhèu pamusu, do tadèngi lii lolo dhèu papara-pakèj'i dènge pakasiro ètu mia-mia, miu baku madha'u kahèi. sèra sa hud'i j'aj'i uuru ku. te ngaa lod'o èle rai-haha èèna dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: for nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom, and there will be earthquakes in various places, and there will be famines and troubles; these are the beginning of travails.
target_text: dhèu nèti ca suku mai pamusu dènge suku leo, rai èci mai pamusu dènge rai leo. ètu mia-mia, j'aj'i rai opo dènge kabake-manganga. sèra sa j'aj'i tadha sama sèmi dhèu bhèni èci dhu kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi.

source_text: and take heed to yourselves, for they will deliver you up to sanhedrins, and to synagogues, you will be beaten, and before governors and kings you will be set for my sake, for a testimony to them;
target_text: de hua iia, na, miu mage-mage! te èèna na dhèu mai kèpa miu, ho ra nuni asa dhèu paredha agama dhu pama'ète lii agama. aa ra game miu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ho èèna na rèti miu asa madha dhèu dhu dènge koasa, lula miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa be'a kahèi, ne'e ne miu abhu tebho ho peka kolongara ja'a mi rèngu.

source_text: and to all the nations it is first necessary that the good news be proclaimed.
target_text: te dhèu unu ama lamatua hud'i lasi uuru ku lole lii lolo be'a ja'a mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, heka lod'o èle rai-haha ne d'ai kèna.

source_text: and when they may lead you, delivering up, do not be anxious beforehand what you may speak, nor premeditate, but whatever may be given to you in that hour, that speak, for it is not you who are speaking, but the holy spirit.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ladhe ra èki rèti miu asa era pama'ète lii langu, miu baku madha'u, peka na, ‘èèna na ja'a neo padhai lii ngaa? do, ja'a neo dhaa ngaa? ' ladhe d'ai lod'o èèna, miu padhai lii madhutu ngaa dhu roh mola-mèci ama lamatua peka dènge miu.

source_text: and brother will deliver up brother to death, and father child, and children will rise up against parents, and will put them to death,
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu cue, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na a'ari nèngu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu ana dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na ama d'èlu na tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu ina-ama dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na ana d'èlu rèngu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe si.

source_text: and you will be hated by all because of my name, but he who has endured to the end-he will be saved.
target_text: de èèna na, dhèu d'èi boe miu, taga miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa dhèu cee dhu bisa taha toke d'ai èle lod'o èèna, tatu ama lamatua hia mamuri mi nèngu.

source_text: and when you may see the abomination of the desolation, that was spoken of by daniel the prophet, standing where it should not whoever is reading let him understand, then those in judea, let them flee to the mountains;
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, èèna na, abhu dhèu èci dhu bhelu-katub'a risi eele mai. ho na mai maso ka titu ètu era laluri ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, dhu madhutu iia-iia na, nèngu bisa boe ètu era èèna, ho na pahera era èèna. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua tèke eele era èèna. ladhe miu mèdhi le sèmi èèna, na, mi pajiko paie-iie! cee dhu baca lii ne'e, pajiko paie kahèi! èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra, dètu ae le. ladhe mèdhi sèmi èèna, na, dhèu-dhèu ètu propensi yudea lega-rai asa kolo ledhe lasi.

source_text: and he on the housetop, do not let him come down into the house, nor come in to take anything out of his house;
target_text: rèngu hud'i rai pamèri-mèri, sèna ka baku abhu j'aj'èra. ladhe dhèu mai le asa li'u, lèpa ia ka rare mèdha asa d'ara èmu.

source_text: and he who is in the field, do not let him turn to the things behind, to take up his garment.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu ètu d'ara oka, baku lèpa èmu rare mèdha-papake.

source_text: and woe to those with child, and to those giving suck, in those days;
target_text: dhu j'èra risi, dhèu bhèni dhu dènge babia, dènge ina dhu pasusu ana rara iisi hiu, lula rèngu rai rare boe.

source_text: and pray that your flight may not be in winter,
target_text: de hua iia risi miu sabaj'a, sèna ka lod'o j'aj'èra sèra baku lèke dènge hèru èj'i lai.

source_text: for those days will be tribulation, such as has not been from the beginning of the creation that god created, until now, and may not be again;
target_text: te j'aj'èra lod'o èèna, bia titu kèna! mulai nèti ama lamatua tao rai-haha, toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu rèdhi mèka j'aj'èra dhu bia sèmi èèna. j'aj'èra bia sèmi èèna, lod'o limuri, j'aj'i heka hari.

source_text: and if the lord did not shorten the days, no flesh had been saved; but because of the chosen, whom he chose to himself, he shortened the days.
target_text: ladhe ama lamatua pab'ab'e boe lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu mamuri. te ngaa, taga ama lamatua sue dhèu dhu na hag'e nare sèra, ka na pab'ab'e lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra sèra.

source_text: and then, if any may say to you, behold, here is the christ, or, behold, there, you may not believe;
target_text: ladhe lod'o d'ai na, miu tadèngi dhèu mai peka, aku rèngu na, ‘ladhe ku! kristus ètu ne'e! ' aa dhèu leo hari peka, aku rèngu na, ‘aad'o! kristus ètu nèi! ' miu baku nanene kahèi!

source_text: for there will rise false christs and false prophets, and they will give signs and wonders, to seduce, if possible, also the chosen;
target_text: te ladhe èèna na, dhèu mai ho tèb'a kakara, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus! ' aa cahag'e hari peka na, ‘ja'a ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. ' èèna na ra tao tadha malaa ae-ae dènge koasa nidhu, ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu. rèngu patangi-tenge j'ara sèna ka dhèu unu ama lamatua lèke tipu kahèi!

source_text: and you, take heed; behold, i have foretold you all things.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu pajiko paie-iie! mema lod'o j'aj'èra bia èèna d'ai mèka, te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e uuru miu!

source_text: but in those days, after that tribulation, the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give her light,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka hari dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe èle lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, na, ‘madha lod'o j'aj'i maroga, aa hèru heo heka.

source_text: and the stars of the sky will be falling, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.
target_text: hua hètu-hua hètu bèbha nèti dedha-liru mai, aa koasa-koasa ètu dedha-liru j'aj'i kaco-balo. '

source_text: and then they will see the son of man coming in clouds with much power and glory,
target_text: èle èèna, heka dhèu ladhe rèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. èèna na ja'a mai dènge ra'i-liru nèti dedha. hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi a'èra dènge dadedha ja'a.

source_text: and then he will send his messengers, and gather together his chosen from the four winds, from the end of the earth to the end of heaven.
target_text: ka ja'a paredha ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, ho puru lasi oru-kaboko dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a hag'e kore nèti mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne; nèti suu haa d'ai suu dhimu, nèti suu badae toke d'ai suu balèu.

source_text: and from the fig tree learn the allegory: when the branch may already become tender, and may put forth the leaves, you know that the summer is near;
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, ja'a kore upama nèti ana aaj'u. ladhe rèu na mulai karara, èèna tadha hèru hadhu dètu le!

source_text: so you, also, when you may see these coming to pass, you know that it is near, at the doors.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe miu mèdhi lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra sèra j'aj'i, sama sèmi lii peka ja'a deo na, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, mamai ja'a dètu ae le.

source_text: truly i say to you that this generation may not pass away until all these things may come to pass;
target_text: ne'e ne ja'a peka dènge miu kèna! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri se, èèna na abhu cahag'e dhu dhae madhe mèka, te lod'o-lod'o dhu pènu dènge j'aj'èra na d'ai le.

source_text: the heaven and the earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
target_text: masi ka liru dènge rai-haha ne ele, te ngaa lii holo-nori ja'a ele boe, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: and concerning that day and the hour no one has known-not even the messengers who are in heaven, not even the son-except the father.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii, peka na, dhèu èci sa re'a boe lod'o do jam dhu ja'a mai hari. ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga sèra re'a boe kahèi. ja'a mesa ku, ke'a boe kahèi. dhoka ama ku mesa na di, dhu ne'a.

source_text: take heed, watch and pray, for you have not known when the time is;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu aa'i-aa'i mi hud'i pajiko paie, lula miu me'a boe lod'o d'ai na.

source_text: as a man who is gone abroad, having left his house, and given to his servants the authority, and to each one his work, also commanded the doorkeeper that he may watch;
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a laku tèke eele miu kèna, te ngaa èèna na ja'a mai hari. sama sèmi dhèu dhu la'e tèke eele èmu nèngu, ho la'e asa rai kaj'èu. na pua ana-ana nèngu j'aga paie èmu. aa na bagi hia si sasab'a. ka na paredha ana madhenga èmu, sèna ka na j'aga paie, toke d'ai nèngu lèpa hari.

source_text: watch, therefore, for you have not known when the lord of the house comes, at evening, or at midnight, or at rooster-crowing, or at the morning;
target_text: miu hud'i j'aga mèda-mèu kahèi, lula miu me'a boe lod'o mia ja'a mai hari, sama sèmi ana madhenga èmu ne'a boe lod'o lamatua èmu na lèpa. lèpa lod'o nihia, talora mèda, oe mèu, lod'o rea, do lod'o nètu; miu me'a boe jam èèna.

source_text: lest, having come suddenly, he may find you sleeping;
target_text: mage dhoka na mai sahèka, te abhu miu dhu bhèj'i luu era.

source_text: and what i say to you, i say to all, watch!
target_text: de, ngaa dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne'e, ja'a peka lème dènge dhèu leo kahèi, ‘miu hud'i pajiko paie, ho mi soru mamai ja'a. ' d'ai sange ne'e ka, lamatua yesus padhai lii lula-nèti lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra dhèu rai-haha, dènge ana madhutu na sèra ètu ledhe saitun.

source_text: and the passover and the unleavened bread were after two days, and the chief priests and the scribes were seeking how, by guile, having taken hold of him, they might kill him; and they said, not in the celebration, lest there will be a tumult of the people.
target_text: èle èèna ka, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tenge j'ara neo kèpe yesus dènge mau-mau. te rèngu neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa ètu d'ara padhue èèna, ra peka na, taha ku! baku parai kèpe ne, lula lod'o kalela dètu le. mage dhoka dhèu ae sèra patao dènge èdhi. rèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, lula dii dua lod'o ka, d'ai lod'o kalela dhèu yahudi, dhu biasa ra peka na, ‘paska' dènge ‘pesta roti dhu pake boe ragi'. kalela se pasanèd'e rèngu lod'o bèi-baki ra kalua nèti rai masir.

source_text: and he, being in bethany, in the house of simon the leper, at his reclining, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment, of spikenard, very precious, and having broken the alabaster box, poured it on his head;
target_text: ètu rae betania, abhu ca dhèu ngara na simon. uru èèna, dhèu madenge dènge ne, lula nèngu pèd'a kusta. te ngaa limuri ne, èle le nèti papèd'a na. hèia lod'o kalela dhae d'ai mèka, na, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra lasi ra'a-rinu ètu èmu simon. ètu talora ra'a-rinu era, dhèu bhèni èci mai paraga yesus. nèd'u dènge boto èci dhu ra tao nèti hadhu. isi boto ne, èi hèu mèngi asli dhu kab'ua titu kèna, dhu ra tao nèti amo aaj'u hèu mèngi. hèia bhèni ne pamae hèb'a boto èèna, ka na pasuti èi hèu mèngi mi kètu yesus, ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, nèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: and there were certain much displeased within themselves, and saying, for what has this waste of the ointment been made?
target_text: te ngaa ètu èèna, abhu dhèu leo dhu ra'a-rinu pa'èci kahèi. ropa dhèu se rèdhi dhèu bhèni ne tao sèmi èèna, hèia ra nasa. ka ra padhai lii padedha iisi, peka na, ngaa ka unu bhèni nèi? na bhori eele èi hèu mèngi kab'ua aae èèna!

source_text: for this could have been sold for more than three hundred denarii, and given to the poor; and they were murmuring at her.
