target_text: de atora ne paj'uj'u, na, èdhi hud'i pasae tare ku huku madhe, ho pacèri nèti lamatua, lula èdhi tao boe madhutu atora aa'i-aa'i sèra. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa atora ne èra taruu era nèti lamatua. te ngaa roh lamatua èra risi eele hari nèti èèna, te nèngu ka pad'elo j'ara sèna ka èdhi pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for also even that which has been glorious, has not been glorious-in this respect, because of the superior glory;
target_text: de atora dhu uru èèna dhèu pangee, na, dedha titu kèna, limuri ne dadedha na sèmi heka uru èèna, te ne'e ne abhu le dhu dedha risi.

source_text: for if that which is being made useless is through glory, much more that which is remaining is in glory.
target_text: atora se dhu uru èèna, kaha'a nuka sèmi rèhu musa, nèbhu-nèbhu ku heka kaha'a na ele. musa dènge atora se mema dedha tare'a, te ngaa dhu dedha risi hari, nuka dhu taha taruu dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: having, then, such hope, we use much freedom of speech,
target_text: ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi nge'a mèu, na, lii pajaji hiu lamatua èèna taha taruu, dhu ma'ète boe ciki sa. nèti èèna ka, ji'i padhai lii mola-mola dhu pa'abhe boe.

source_text: and are not as moses, who was putting a veil on his own face, for the sons of israel not to look steadfastly into the end of that which is being made useless,
target_text: ji'i tao boe sama sèmi musa. te nèngu hud'i pa'abhe ku rèhu na dènge bèla, sèna ka dhèu isra'el bisa boe rèdhi rèhu na, ho re'a na, kaha'a èèna ele le, do dhae.

source_text: but their minds were hardened, for to this day the same veil at the reading of the old covenant remains unwithdrawn-which in christ is being made useless-
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua tao ngangee dhèu isra'el sèra topo. te toke d'ai sange ne'e, ladhe rèngu baca ètu sasuri lamatua nèti lii pajaji dhu dhui èèna, nuka sèmi bèla èci dhu hutu nare kètu ra, ka ro'o boe nanene aa ro'o boe re'a. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa bhoke d'ara rèngu, sèna ka rèngu bisa re'a mèu. dhodhoka kristus mesa na.

source_text: but until today, when moses is read, a veil lies on their heart,
target_text: toke d'ai sange ne'e, ladhe dhèu yahudi baca sasuri musa, rèngu nanene, te ngaa re'a iia boe. ne'e ne j'aj'i lula rèngu nanene pake boe d'ara ra, lula abhu dhu pa'abhe d'ara rèngu.

source_text: and whenever they may turn to the lord, the veil is taken away.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu mulai parcaya kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, na, kristus ka dhu bhoke d'ara dhèu èèna, sèna ka nèngu bisa ne'a mèu. èèna sama sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua, peka na, nèngu bhoke eele le bèla dhu pahutu rèhu na.

source_text: and the lord is the spirit; and where the spirit of the lord is, there is liberty;
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, lod'o musa padhai lii, peka na, lamatua, sasoa na, roh ama lamatua. ladhe èdhi abhu le roh ne, nèngu tao èdhi j'aj'i mi dhèu bebas.

source_text: and we all, with unveiled face, beholding the glory of the lord in a mirror, are being transformed into the same image, from glory to glory, even as by the spirit of the lord.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, na tao èdhi asa tabha èra, sama sèmi nèngu. rèhu èdhi parluu heka pahutu. aa èdhi pangee dhoka dadedha lamatua èdhi, te roh na ka dhu soru-bara èdhi.

source_text: because of this, having this ministry, according as we received kindness, we do not faint,
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pad'elo le rasa kasia na mi dedha ji'i. nèti èèna ka, na pua le ji'i ho lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti lii pajaji hiu na. nèti èèna ka, ji'i taha taruu, dhu nge'a boe roe.

source_text: but renounced for ourselves the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor deceitfully using the word of god, but by the manifestation of the truth recommending ourselves to every conscience of men, before god;
target_text: de karèi nèti uru ka ji'i pama'ète ngare le, na: ji'i peka-padhai mola-mola, na, ji'i tao boe j'ara-j'ara bhabhelu-katub'a sama sèmi dhèu leo. dhèu sèra tao pahuni-pahuni sèna ka dhèu baku ladhe rèdhi. aa rèngu dhu re'a boe makae. te ngaa ji'i ngo'o boe kapod'e dhèu. ji'i kahèi padhai lii hèb'a hua boe lula lii holo-nori ama lamatua, te ngaa ji'i aj'a-nori dènge mola-mola madhutu ngaa dhu lèke. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parisa unu ra lii padhai ji'i ètu madha lamatua, aa nile unu ra, ji'i se dhèu sèmi ngaa sa.

source_text: and if our good news is also veiled, it is veiled in those perishing,
target_text: ladhe dhèu ro'o boe sèmi rare lii lolo be'a lamatua dhu ji'i aj'a sèra, rèngu laho kahèi, lula rèngu cèri eele nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: in whom the god of this age blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that there does not shine forth to them the enlightening of the good news of the glory of the christ, who is the image of god;
target_text: dhèu aae nidhu, nuka sèmi lamatua èci dhu dhèu lasi sogo-tagu. na ad'u-ue pa'ele iie kahadhu dhèu cahag'e, ka d'ara dhèu se j'aj'i maroga kiu-kiu. rèngu se dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua èdhi. lula rèngu bèdhu, bisa boe ladhe rèdhi saraa nèti ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka rèngu bisa boe re'a lii lolo be'a lula-nèti kristus. rèngu re'a boe kahèi dadedha kristus. te kristus ne, ca ropa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for we do not preach ourselves, but christ jesus-lord, and we are ourselves your servants because of jesus;
target_text: ji'i padhai lii boe padedha iisi ji'i. te ngaa ji'i padhai lii padedha kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. dhu ji'i padhai lula ngi'u ji'i dhodhoka sèmi ne'e di: nuka ji'i tao iisi ji'i nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha, sèna ka laladhe-leru miu lula ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus.

source_text: because it is god who said, light will shine out of darkness, who shined in our hearts, for the enlightening of the knowledge of the glory of god in the face of jesus christ.
target_text: uru-uru sèra ama lamatua dhu peka nèdhi le, na, hud'i dènge ku saraa dhu heo ètu era maroga. hèia na tao saraa na ho pasaraa d'ara èdhi. te nèngu d'èi pala-bagi èdhi saraa na. sasoa na, ropa èdhi pangee lula-nèti kristus, èdhi sanèd'e kahèi dadedha ama lamatua.

source_text: and we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellence of the power may be of god, and not of us,
target_text: masi ka ji'i se dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa lamatua hia mèdha dhu kab'ua ètu d'ara ji'i. ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu èci tèke mèdha na dhu kab'ua ètu d'ara èru rai. mèdha dhu kab'ua ne, nuka saraa ama lamatua. de dhu lèke ka, koasa dhu kapai dhu ji'i unu, mai boe nèti ji'i, te ngaa kapua na nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: being in tribulation in every way, but not crushed; perplexed, but not despairing;
target_text: de masi ka dhèu ènyi raruri ji'i ètu mia-mia, te ngaa ji'i taha taruu. masi ka ji'i nge'a aa'i boe, te ngaa ji'i ele boe ngangee.

source_text: persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
target_text: masi ka dhèu paj'èra ji'i ae-ae, te ngaa ama lamatua pa'ana-lalu eele boe ji'i. masi ka dhèu dhedhe ji'i, te ngaa rèngu bisa boe palaho ji'i.

source_text: at all times carrying around in the body the dying of the lord jesus, that the life of jesus may also be revealed in our body,
target_text: lula ji'i abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae, nèti èèna ka ladhe ji'i ètu mia, ji'i bisa lolo dènge dhèu, peka na, yesus abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae kahèi, lod'o na madhe. te masi ka dhèu paj'èra ji'i rupa-rupa, te ngaa ji'i madhe boe. ne'e ne pasanèd'e dhèu, peka na, yesus mamuri taruu ètu d'ara ji'i.

source_text: for we who are living are always delivered up to death because of jesus, that the life of jesus may also be revealed in our dying flesh,
target_text: mema tare'a! ae le mamuri ji'i dhu abhu j'aj'èra oe madhe, lula ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa re'a, na, yesus pala mamuri dhu lèke mi ji'i, masi ka bèli-camèd'a ji'i madhe.

source_text: so that, death indeed works in us, and life in you.
target_text: de masi ka lèpa limuri ji'i madhe, te ngaa ji'i madha'u boe padhue-padhai lula-nèti kristus. te ji'i sadia madhe sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: and having the same spirit of faith, according to that which has been written: i believed, therefore i spoke; we also believe, therefore we also speak;
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua dhu suri, na, lula ja'a parcaya lamatua, nèti èèna ka ja'a padhai lii. ngangee ji'i sama kahèi. lula ji'i lèka lamatua, nèti èèna ka ji'i hud'i lole ku dènge dhèu lula-nèti yesus kristus.

source_text: knowing that he who raised up the lord jesus, will also raise us up through jesus, and will present us with you,
target_text: ji'i nge'a, na, ama lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari kètu èdhi, yesus kristus nèti mamadhe na. èèna na nèngu kahèi ka dhu pamamuri hari èdhi, lula èdhi pa'èki dènge yesus. bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua patitu èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti ètu madha na, sèna ka sèmi nare èdhi.

source_text: for all things are because of you, that the grace having been multiplied, because of the thanksgiving of the more, may abound to the glory of god;
target_text: lamatua tao j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka soru-bara miu. nèngu neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na kahèi mi dhèu dhu asa tabha ae. èèna na lii manèngi makasi rèngu mi lamatua asa tabha ae, aa ra mangaku dadedha na kahèi.

source_text: for this reason, we do not faint, but if our outward man also decays, yet the inward is renewed day by day;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi taha taruu, aa ele boe ngangee. masi ka ngi'u èdhi asa roe-bhilu, te ngaa ama lamatua asa pa'èra d'ara èdhi nèti ca lod'o asa ca lod'o.

source_text: for the momentary light matter of our tribulation works out for us more and more an exceedingly continuous weight of glory-
target_text: te madhutu ngangee èdhi, lod'o limuri ne èdhi dhu abhu sasusa rupa-rupa. te ngaa èdhi hud'i sanèd'e ku, bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo ded'e èdhi padedha-dedha. nèti èèna ka èdhi hud'i te'a, na, ngaa dhu j'aj'i se'e dènge boe sasoa!

source_text: we are not looking to the things seen, but to the things not seen; for the things seen are temporary, but the things not seen are continuous.
target_text: de èdhi hud'i ngee paie-iie ku mi j'ara-j'ara dhu tèdhi mèka. baku pangee dhoka mi dhu ladhe tèdhi di. te j'ara-j'ara dhu ladhe tèdhi, taha boe nare nèbhu. te ngaa j'ara dhu tèdhi mèka sèra ka dhu taha taruu, aa dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: for we have known that if the tent of our earthly house may be thrown down, we have a building from god, a house not made with hands-perpetual-in the heavens,
target_text: te èdhi te'a, na, ngi'u aae ne, èdhi pake taha ètu rai-haha di, nuka sèmi paleo dhu èdhi patitu taha. masi ka ngi'u aae èdhi ele iie, te ngaa èdhi baku pangee, lula ama lamatua dhu sadia tèke le era dhu be'a èci hia èdhi ètu sorga. era ne'e, j'aj'i boe nèti pa'ue-ai dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa j'aj'i nèti pa'ue-ai lamatua. nèti èèna ka, era ne'e taha taruu.

source_text: for also in this we groan, earnestly desiring to clothe ourselves with our dwelling that is from heaven,
target_text: te ngi'u aae èdhi ne roe-bhilu ètu rai-haha ne. ka èdhi neo titu kèna abhu ngi'u hiu dhu èdhi pake ètu sorga.

source_text: if so be that, having clothed ourselves, we will not be found naked,
target_text: hèia ropa èdhi d'ai era nèi, èdhi sama boe sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe mèdha-papake ètu ngi'u, te ngaa pake mèdha hiu ètu ua èdhi. te èdhi j'aj'i boe samanga di, te ngaa ètu nèi èdhi abhu ngi'u hiu kahèi.

source_text: for we also who are in the tent groan, being burdened, seeing we do not wish to unclothe ourselves, but to clothe ourselves, that the mortal may be swallowed up of life.
target_text: ngi'u aae èdhi dhu ele iie ne, tao èdhi mangeta, lula rasa j'èra. masi ka sèmi èèna, to'o boe madhe, ho tèke eele ngi'u aae ne. aad'o! èdhi neo abhu ngi'u dhu hiu, sèna ka tèke eele ngi'u dhui, gati dènge mamuri hiu dhu lèke.

source_text: and he who worked us to this very thing is god, who also gave to us the deposit of the spirit;
target_text: ama lamatua ne'e ka dhu pa'èra èdhi ho sèmi tare mamuri dhu hiu. nèngu kahèi bagi hia èdhi roh na, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha nèti lii pajaji na.

source_text: having courage, then, at all times, and knowing that being at home in the body, we are away from home from the lord-
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi taha dènge d'ara èra taruu. èdhi te'a, na, lod'o èdhi mamuri era ètu d'ara ngi'u aae ne'e ne, èdhi pakaj'èu nèti lamatua.

source_text: for we walk through faith, not through sight-
target_text: nèti èèna ka èdhi mamuri dènge parcaya mi ama lamatua. èdhi mamuri boe dènge ngaa dhu èdhi ladhe tèdhi ètu rai-haha ne di.

source_text: we have courage, and are well pleased, rather, to be away from the home of the body, and to be at home with the lord.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi te'a tare'a-re'a kahèi, na, ladhe èdhi madhe tèke eele ngi'u aae ne, ho lati mamuri sama-sama dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga, na, tatu èdhi karej'e risi eele hari.

source_text: we are also ambitious for this reason, whether at home or away from home, to be well pleasing to him,
target_text: masi ka èdhi mamuri taruu ètu rai-haha ne, do madhe ètu ne'e sèna ka mamuri ètu nèi, te ngaa dhu lèke ka, èdhi hud'i pakarej'e ku d'ara lamatua. te dad'èi èdhi kèna.

source_text: for it is necessary for all of us to have appeared before the judgment seat of the christ, that each one may receive the things done through the body, in reference to the things that he did, whether good or evil;
target_text: baku bhèlu. bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i lasi paraga dènge kristus. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pama'ète lii langu madhutu tatao dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha. hèia kristus b'ala dhu pamèci dènge tatao dhu dhèu ad'u-ue. te kristus ne'a, dhèu ne tao be'a do tao dhu karehe.

source_text: having known, therefore, the fear of the lord, we persuade men, and we are revealed to god, and i also hope to have been revealed in your consciences;
target_text: lula ji'i nge'a, na, bèli-camèd'a kristus parisa mamuri ji'i, nèti èèna ka ji'i hud'i madha'u, aa pakab'ua ne. ka ji'i sab'a pa'èra-èra ho pamako dhèu, sèna ka ra parcaya kristus. ama lamatua dhu ne'a d'ara mola ji'i. ja'a d'èi kahèi, ladhe miu me'a d'ara mola ji'i se.

source_text: for we do not again recommend ourselves to you, but we are giving occasion to you of glorifying in our behalf, that you may have something in reference to those glorifying in face and not in heart;
target_text: ji'i padedha boe iisi ji'i ètu madha miu. aad'o! te ngaa ji'i dhoka hia miu j'ara dhu be'a, sèna ka miu bisa pakab'ua ji'i dhu dènge boe makae. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, miu bisa dhaa lii dhèu dhu hèb'a aae. te rèngu dhèu dhu koa iisi lula sasab'a-la'a rèngu dhu dhèu ladhe rèdhi, aa te ngaa d'ara rèngu mola boe.

source_text: for whether we were beside ourselves, it was to god; whether we be of sound mind, it is to you,
target_text: ladhe miu pangee, na, ji'i se huj'u, hèia ji'i padhai lii sèmi èèna ho pakako sasab'a lamatua. masi ka miu me'a boe, te ngaa lamatua ne'a. ladhe ji'i padhai lii pake ngangee dhu mola, na, ji'i padhai lii sèmi èèna, ho soru-bara miu.

source_text: for the love of the christ constrains us, having judged thus: that if one died for all, then the whole died,
target_text: kristus sue èdhi titu kèna. ne'e ne ka dhu pa'èra d'ara ji'i, ho pakako sasab'a-la'a ji'i. te ji'i parcaya, na, dhèu èci, nuka kristus, madhe gati dhèu aa'i-aa'i. sasoa na, èèna sama sèmi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti madhe tèke eele mamuri dhui, aa dhu dènge heka hak ngaa-ngaa ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and he died for all, that those living may no longer live to themselves, but to him who died for them, and was raised again.
target_text: kristus madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, mamuri heka madhutu dad'èi mesa ra. te ngaa rèngu hud'i mamuri madhutu dad'èi kristus, lula nèngu madhe le gati rèngu, hèia na mamuri hari.

source_text: so that we, from now on, have known no one according to the flesh, and even if we have known christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him thus no longer;
target_text: de karèi nèti deo ne'e, èdhi baku nile dhèu madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha. masi ka uru èèna èdhi nile kristus pake ngangee dhèu biasa. te ngaa limuri ne, ji'i nile heka nèngu sèmi èèna.

source_text: so that if anyone is in christ-he is a new creature; the old things passed away, behold, all things have become new.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge kristus j'aj'i le dhèu hiu, dhu unu mamuri hiu. dhèu ne sèmi heka uru èèna, lula mamuri dhui na ele le. te limuri ne, dhu hiu abhu le.

source_text: and all things are of god, who reconciled us to himself through jesus christ, and gave to us the ministry of the reconciliation,
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, ama lamatua ka dhu tao. nèngu ka dhu padame, sèna ka èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge ne, lula kristus saku eele le sasala-sasigo èdhi. hèia na pangèd'u èdhi sasab'a, ho èdhi pad'elo j'ara sèna ka dhèu leo kahèi bisa padame hari dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: how that god was in christ-reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses; and having put in us the word of the reconciliation,
target_text: sanèd'e, te lod'o kristus pea ètu rai-haha ne era, ama lamatua dhu pake ne ho lere nèti dhèu padame hari dènge ama lamatua. de nèngu ige heka sasala dhèu, ka rèngu dui heka hahuku nèti sasala. hèia na pua èdhi lati peka dènge dhèu, na, rèngu bisa pabe'a dènge nèngu.

source_text: in behalf of christ, then, we are ambassadors, as if god were calling through us, we implore, in behalf of christ, be reconciled to god;
target_text: te èdhi j'aj'i duta kristus. de ama lamatua pake èdhi ho tèti dhèu mai, sèna ka padame dènge ne. lula ji'i j'aj'i duta kristus, nèti èèna ka ji'i manèngi miu kahèi, na, lamatua d'èi titu kèna, ladhe miu pabe'a hari dènge ne.

source_text: he made him having not known sin to be sin in our behalf, that we may become the righteousness of god in him.
target_text: kristus mesa na tao nèdhi boe sala. te ngaa ama lamatua hia ne pasae sasala-sasigo èdhi. lamatua tao j'ara ne hia èdhi, lula mamadhe kristus bhoke j'ara, sèna ka èdhi bisa mamuri dènge d'ara mola, sama sèmi lamatua d'ara mola kahèi.

source_text: and also working together we call on you that you do not receive the grace of god in vain-
target_text: lula ji'i sab'a sama-sama dènge lamatua, ji'i pasanèd'e miu sèmi ne'e: ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na ae-ae mi dedha miu. de miu baku sèmi mere d'ara hua iia na iia-iia d'ara.

source_text: for he says, in an acceptable time i heard you, and in a day of salvation i helped you, behold, now is a well-accepted time; behold, now, a day of salvation.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na dhu suri tèke, peka na, ropa d'ai ka lod'o na, ja'a nanene lii èu. ja'a soru-bara èu kahèi, ropa ja'a pala-bagi mamuri mi dhèu. de nanene pabe'a-be'a! ne'e ne, d'ai lod'o dhu hua iia èèna kèna. te ne'e ne, d'ai lod'o lamatua kèna ho pala-bagi mamuri mi dhèu.

source_text: in nothing giving any cause of offense, that the ministry may not be blamed,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ji'i j'aga mamuri ji'i pabe'a-be'a sèna ka mamuri mola. te ji'i ngo'o boe bhabhae dhèu dhu neo mai asa j'ara mamuri lamatua. aa ji'i neo padhai mola-mola kahèi, sèna ka dhèu baku pa'ele iie kolongara ji'i.

source_text: but in everything recommending ourselves as god's servants; in much patience, in tribulations, in necessities, in distresses,
target_text: aa aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i sab'a, ji'i tenge j'ara ho pad'elo, na, ji'i dhèu sab'a dhu be'a nèti ama lamatua. de masi ka ji'i abhu susa, do paraga dènge j'aj'èra, do mamuri ètu d'ara talora aae patao-palaha, ji'i taha taruu.

source_text: in stripes, in imprisonments, in insurrections, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,
target_text: ji'i taha kahèi ètu d'ara lod'o dhèu gama ji'i, lod'o ra pamaso ji'i asa d'ara bèdho, lod'o ra patao-palaha, lod'o ji'i sab'a bia, lod'o ji'i abhu boe pasaruru musi madha, aa lod'o ji'i manganga.

source_text: in pureness, in knowledge, in long-suffering, in kindness, in the holy spirit, in unhypocritical love,
target_text: ji'i taha dènge d'ara mola kahèi. ji'i nge'a ae lula-nèti ama lamatua. ji'i taha dènge d'ara taleo. ji'i tao dhu be'a hia dhèu. ji'i soro tèke roh lamatua ator ji'i. sasue ji'i mola-mola mi dedha dhèu.

source_text: in the word of truth, in the power of god, through the armor of righteousness, on the right and on the left,
target_text: ladhe ji'i padhai lii, ji'i padhai dhu lèke, dhu nge'a boe monya. ji'i sèmi ngare koasa nèti lamatua kahèi, sèna ka tao dhu be'a. ji'i nuka sèmi sordad'u dhu ngèd'u rèka dhu tesa nèti lamatua, sèna ka lab'a musu, aa segi taruu.

source_text: through glory and dishonor, through evil report and good report, as leading astray, and true;
target_text: ji'i taha kahèi masi ka dhèu pakab'ua, do pahahe ji'i; masi ka dhèu padhai lii pamanahu ji'i, do ra j'aga kolongara ji'i; masi ka dhèu monya, peka na, ji'i kapod'e-kabèli dhèu, do ra peka na, ji'i padhai lii dhu lèke.

source_text: as unknown, and recognized; as dying, and behold, we live; as disciplined, and not put to death;
target_text: abhu dhu tadhe boe ji'i, te ngaa abhu dhèu ae kahèi dhu re'a ngara ji'i. pèri-pèri hari kèna, ji'i se oe madhe, te ngaa ji'i mamuri era. dhèu huku ji'i bia pèri-pèri hari kèna, te ngaa ji'i madhe boe.

source_text: as sorrowful, and always rejoicing; as poor, and making many rich; as having nothing, and possessing all things.
target_text: masi ka ji'i rasa bia, te ngaa ji'i karej'e-karae taruu kahèi. masi ka ji'i dènge boe doi-dhari, te ngaa ji'i tao dhèu ae j'aj'i kaja ètu d'ara ra. èèna nuka sèmi ji'i unu boe ngaa-ngaa, te ngaa ji'i unu aa'i mèu-mèu kahèi.

source_text: our mouth has been open to you, o corinthians, our heart has been enlarged!
target_text: ji'i padhai lii paled'a-led'a hia miu dhu ètu kota korintus ne. aa ji'i sue miu tare'a-re'a.

source_text: you are not restricted in us, and you are restricted in your own yearnings,
target_text: ji'i pad'elo le sasue ji'i mi dedha miu dènge d'ara kateme. te ngaa sasue miu mi ji'i kura, lula dènge boe d'ara kateme.

source_text: and as a repayment of the same kind as to children i say it, be enlarged-also you!
target_text: de ja'a neo holo miu nuka sèmi holo ana-ana ja'a. be'a risi miu sue ji'i dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: do not become yoked with others-unbelievers, for what partaking is there to righteousness and lawlessness?
target_text: baku pakadheb'e dènge dhèu dhu parcaya boe kristus. te miu sama boe dènge rèngu. dhèu parcaya dhu mamuri mola, sama boe dènge dhèu dhu lab'a lamatua, de nia boe ladhe ra tenge j'ara ho sab'a pa'èci. dhèu be'a dènge dhèu be'a boe, pantas boe pa'èci. èèna nuka sèmi saraa bisa boe pa'èci dènge maroga.

source_text: and what fellowship to light with darkness? and what concord to christ with belial? or what part to a believer with an unbeliever?
target_text: kristus bisa boe d'ara èci dènge dhèu aae nidhu, si? sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu dhu parcaya ama lamatua abhu pusaka, te ngaa dhèu dhu parcaya boe abhu boe pala.

source_text: and what agreement to the temple of god with idols? for you are a temple of the living god, according as god said, i will dwell in them, and will walk among them, and i will be their god, and they will be my people,
target_text: de a'abhu miu, sa mia? ele boe miu pangee, na, miu bisa lami asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a ama lamatua sèna ka pahaha iisi mi nèngu, èle na lami sogo-tagu hari asa èmu sogo-tagu nidhu, do? bisa boe, si? te lamatua èèna, ama lamatua dhu mamuri. nèngu j'aj'i kètu èdhi kahèi. ka èdhi j'aj'i le sama sèmi èmu sabaj'a na, lula nèngu pea ètu d'ara èdhi. te lamatua suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na, peka na, èmu ja'a ètu talora aae dhèu-dhèu ja'a. ja'a laku-mai nèti talora aae rèngu kahèi. ja'a neo j'aj'i ama lamatua rèngu. rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a kahèi.

source_text: for this reason, come forth out of the midst of them, and be separated, says the lord, and do not touch an unclean thing, and i will receive you,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lamatua suri sèmi ne'e kahèi, na, miu hud'i kalua nèti talora aae rèngu, aa pacèri nèti rèngu, sèna ka miu baku j'aj'i sama sèmi rèngu. d'ara miu hud'i mola-mèci. aa miu hud'i pakaj'èu nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu pakaj'alu d'ara miu, dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a sèmi kore miu dènge be'a.

source_text: and i will be for a father to you, and you will be sons and daughters to me, says the lord almighty.
target_text: ja'a neo j'aj'i ama miu; aa miu j'aj'i ana-ana ja'a. se'e se ka dhu kètu èdhi peka tèke, nèngu ka dhu unu koasa risi aa'i.

source_text: having, then, these promises, beloved, may we cleanse ourselves from every defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting sanctification in the fear of god;
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lula ama lamatua padhadha tèke le ho pala-bagi èdhi j'ara se aa'i-aa'i, nèti èèna ka èdhi hud'i pamèu ku d'ara dènge mamuri èdhi. baku tèke eele hahera ciki sa hèi ètu mamuri èdhi. te èdhi neo sèna ka mamuri èdhi mola-mèci tare'a-re'a hia mi ama lamatua, sèna ka pad'elo, na, èdhi madha'u dènge pakab'ua nèngu.

source_text: receive us; no one did we wrong; no one did we ruin; no one did we defraud;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! hia ji'i tebho. bhoke d'ara miu ho sèmi mere ji'i dènge be'a. baku soro kabodho mi ji'i. te uru èèna, lod'o ji'i ètu talora aae miu, ji'i tao ngèdhi boe sala ngaa-ngaa mi dhèu èci sa. ji'i dadugu ngèdhi mèka dhèu ho ad'u-ue sasala. ji'i kapod'e-kabèli ngèdhi mèka dhèu, sèna ka abhu oto nèti rèngu kahèi.

source_text: i do not say it to condemn you, for i have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and to live together;
target_text: lii padhai ja'a ne, neo boe pèci sasala asa dedha miu. te ja'a dhu peka le, na, ji'i sue miu. de tasa mera mia èèna ka, ji'i se dhu pa'èki dènge miu, masi ka ji'i madhe do mamuri.

source_text: great is my freedom of speech to you, great my glory on your behalf; i have been filled with the comfort, i hyper-abound with the joy on all our tribulation,
target_text: ne'e ne ja'a parluu heka pangee ae-ae, te ja'a lèka miu. ja'a koa miu, aa miu pa'èra d'ara ja'a kahèi. de masi ka ji'i abhu susa rupa-rupa, te ngaa d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae taruu, lula miu.

source_text: for we also, having come to macedonia, our flesh has had no relaxation, but on every side we are in tribulation: fightings outside, fears within;
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ji'i dhiu asa propensi makedonia, ngi'u ji'i roe-bhilu. te ji'i abhu susa nèti g'ana-kariu. ji'i pab'ala d'ara lii dènge dhèu dhu parcaya boe. d'ara ji'i madha'u kahèi.

source_text: but he who is comforting the cast-down-god-he comforted us in the coming of titus;
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu pa'èra dhèu dhu ele ngangee. hèia nèngu pa'èra d'ara ji'i, ropa na pua titus mai dènge ji'i.

source_text: and not only in his coming, but also in the comfort with which he was comforted over you, declaring to us your longing desire, your lamentation, your zeal for me, so that i rejoiced the more,
target_text: nèti mamai titus ne'e ka d'ara ji'i èra hari. te nèngu peka na, lod'o nèngu ètu nèi era, miu dhu pa'èra d'ara na. lii lolo nèngu ne'e ka, pa'èra d'ara ji'i. nèngu lolo kahèi, na, miu neo titu kèna mèdhi rèhu ja'a, aa miu manyasa kahèi lula lii langu dhu uru èèna j'aj'i ètu talora aae miu. aa titus peka kahèi, na, miu tenge j'ara ho soru-bara ja'a. nèti èèna ka, d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae.

source_text: because even if i made you sorry in the letter, i do not regret-if even i regretted-for i perceive that the letter, even if for an hour, made you sorry.
target_text: ja'a ke'a, na, isi sasuri ja'a uru èèna dhu pasanèd'e miu dènge lii sakaa, èèna ka dhu papèd'a d'ara miu. te ngaa ja'a manyasa boe ja'a suri sasuri èèna. aa te ngaa lod'o èèna ja'a ako manyasa, ropa ke'a, na, nèti sasuri ja'a ka d'ara miu pèd'a, masi ka nare boe nèbhu.

source_text: i now rejoice, not that you were made sorry, but that you were made sorry to conversion, for you were made sorry toward god, that you might receive damage from us in nothing;
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, d'ara ja'a karej'e. ja'a karej'e boe lula uru èèna miu ètu d'ara susa. aad'o! ja'a karej'e lula lod'o èèna, sasuri ja'a dhu pamako miu sèna ka ele-ho'a. hèia miu mangaku sasala miu, aa tèke eele j'ara-j'ara dhu karehe, sèna ka kabèli hari ho madhutu j'ara mamuri mola nèti lamatua. te lamatua ka dhu tao miu manyasa. j'ara ne, nèti boe ji'i dhu tao miu j'aj'i maruru.

source_text: for sorrow toward god works conversion to salvation without regret, and the sorrow of the world works death,
target_text: te ladhe èdhi manyasa ètu d'ara èdhi, madhutu dad'èi lamatua, na, èdhi ae eele nèti tao j'ara dhu bhèlu, hèia lèpa hari madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu mola. ne'e ne ka dhu pakaj'èu èdhi nèti hahuku ama lamatua, ka èdhi mamuri heka dènge d'ara manyasa taruu. te ngaa ladhe èdhi dhoka manyasa ètu hèb'a di, sama sèmi dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, èèna na èdhi cèri eele nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: for behold, this same thing-your being made sorry toward god-how much diligence it works in you! but defense, but displeasure, but fear, but longing desire, but zeal, but revenge; in everything you approved yourselves to be pure in the matter.
target_text: miu pangee sèku! lod'o miu baca sasuri ja'a, ja'a ke'a na, miu manyasa kahèi. èèna palèke dènge dad'èi lamatua. ne'e ne ka pa'èra miu ho miu core eele bhabhèlu nèti mamuri miu. miu roe-bhilu le ètu d'ara bhabhelu miu. miu madha'u kahèi, mage dhoka manahu hari asa d'ara bhabhelu-katub'a. miu neo mèdhi ja'a, aa pa'èra taruu ho tao j'ara be'a. miu pa'èra kahèi ho neo huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala. lula miu tao j'ara dhu lèke sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka miu mola-mèci. dènge j'ara ne'e, abhu boe dhu bisa pèci sasala asa miu.

source_text: if, then, i also wrote to you-not for his cause who did wrong, nor for his cause who suffered wrong, but for our diligence in your behalf being revealed to you before god-
target_text: de sasuri ja'a uru èèna, hia boe mi dhèu dhu tao bhabhelu, do, mi dhèu dhu lèke j'aj'èra nèti bhabhelu na. te ngaa ja'a suri sasuri èèna hia miu, sèna ka ja'a pad'elo, na, lii padhai miu ètu madha lamatua èèna tare'a-re'a. aa miu tare'a-re'a sue ji'i.

source_text: because of this we have been comforted in your comfort, and more abundantly the more we rejoiced in the joy of titus, that his spirit has been refreshed from you all;
target_text: se'e se aa'i-aa'i ra pa'èra d'ara ja'a. miu pa'èra d'ara titus kahèi, sèna ka d'ara na bisa mera-milu. sèra sa, asa pakarej'e d'ara ji'i.

source_text: because if i have boasted anything to him in your behalf, i was not put to shame; but as we spoke to you all things in truth, so also our boasting before titus became truth,
target_text: ja'a koa-kad'iri miu ètu madha titus, lula tatao miu dhu be'a. ja'a peka kahèi dènge ne, na, miu pamakae mèdhi mèka ja'a. te j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i lolo ngèdhi dènge miu sèra lèke tare'a. aa j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i lolo dènge titus lula-nèti miu lèke tare'a kahèi.

source_text: and his yearnings are more abundantly toward you, remembering the obedience of you all, how you received him with fear and trembling;
target_text: de lod'o-lod'o na ngee nèdhi tatao dènge lii padhai miu, sasue na mi dedha miu asa tabha. aa nèngu sanèd'e kahèi ropa na dhiu asa miu, ka miu sèmi mere ne dènge be'a, te ngaa isi sasuri ja'a j'aj'i ngangee mi miu.

source_text: i rejoice, therefore, that in everything i have courage in you.
target_text: d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae, lula ja'a bisa parcaya miu ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. de d'ara ja'a kabèdhi heka dènge miu!

source_text: and we make known to you, brothers, the grace of god, that has been given in the assemblies of macedonia,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! dad'èi ji'i ka ladhe miu me'a mèu d'ara hua iia ama lamatua, dhu na pad'elo mi dedha juma'at-juma'at ètu propensi makedonia.

source_text: because in much trial of tribulation the abundance of their joy, and their deep poverty, abounded to the riches of their liberality;
target_text: te masi ka rèngu abhu susa ae-ae, te ngaa d'ara rèngu karej'e taruu. nèti èèna ka, masi ka rèngu unu boe ngaa-ngaa, te ngaa ra hia doi ae-ae dènge d'ara mola-mèci, ho soru-bara dhèu parcaya dhu abhu sasusa.

source_text: because, according to their power, i testify, and above their power, they were willing of themselves,
target_text: ja'a bisa lole kahèi, na, dhu rèngu hia sèra, hia aa'i nèti dhu rèngu bisa hia. aa ra hia risi nèti sèra sa kahèi. abhu boe dhèu dhu laka-seti si.

source_text: with much plea calling on us to receive the favor and the fellowship of the ministry to the holy ones,
target_text: rèngu mesa ra ka dhu tare'a-re'a manèngi, sèna ka ji'i bhoke j'ara hia si. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa abhu bagian ho soru-bara dhèu dhu abhu susa ètu yerusalem.

source_text: and not according as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the lord, and to us, through the will of god,
target_text: uru èèna, ji'i sanao sèna ka ra tao sèmi ne'e, te ngaa dhu ra tao èèna, risi nèti dhu ji'i sanao! dhu uru j'ara, rèngu hia mamuri ra asa ama lamatua. hèia ra peka kahèi, na, ji'i neo soro mamuri ji'i, sèna ka lalau-lalo'o miu, lula èèna ka dhu madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: so that we exhorted titus, that, according as he began before, so also he may also finish this favor to you,
target_text: lula conto nèti juma'at-juma'at ètu makedonia sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka ji'i manèngi titus lèpa hari asa miu ètu korintus, sèna ka miu soru-bara kahèi dhèu unu lamatua dhu abhu sasusa ètu yerusalem. te uru èèna, nèngu ka dhu mulai pakaboko doi-dhari ho hia si. hèia limuri ne, ji'i manèngi sèna ka nèngu bisa tao pamèci sasab'a-la'a miu ho soru-bara dhèu.

source_text: but even as in everything you abound, in faith, and word, and knowledge, and all diligence, and in your love to us, that also in this grace you may abound;
target_text: sasab'a miu hia ama lamatua èèna, be'a titu kèna. conto sèmi: parcaya miu èra, lii padhai miu be'a; miu me'a ae j'ara-j'ara lamatua; miu sab'a dènge maj'èni; aa miu sue ji'i d'ai seli. nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo ho miu soru-bara kahèi dhèu unu lamatua dhu abhu sasusa, dènge j'ara hia si doi ae-ae.

source_text: i do not speak according to command, but because of the diligence of others, and proving the genuineness of your love,
target_text: ja'a paredha boe miu ètu korintus, sèna ka hia si doi ae-ae, te ngaa ja'a neo cob'a miu. te juma'at-juma'at ètu makedonia neo le soru-bara dhèu sèra. de dènge j'ara ne'e miu bisa pad'elo, na, miu tare'a-re'a sue dhèu dhu ètu d'ara sasusa kahèi.

source_text: for you know the grace of our lord jesus christ, that because of you he became poor-being rich, that you may become rich by that poverty.
target_text: te miu me'a, na, kètu èdhi, yesus kristus pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi miu. mema nèngu kaja. te ngaa na pama'ète nare ho tao iisi na j'aj'i dhèu unu boe ngaa-ngaa sèna ka soru-bara miu, ho miu j'aj'i kaja ètu madha j'ara ae-ae.

source_text: and i give an opinion in this: for this is expedient to you, who not only to do, but also to will, began before-a year ago,
target_text: ranga-jahi na, miu mulai pakaboko le doi ho hia rèngu. mesa boe miu hia doi-dhari di, te ngaa miu soru-bara nèti d'ara miu kahèi. de madhutu a'abhu ja'a, miu hud'i tao ku sèmi ne'e:

source_text: and now also finish doing it, that even as there is the readiness of the will, so also the finishing, out of that which you have,
target_text: uru èèna, miu pama'ète mere le neo soru-bara dhèu unu lamatua dhu abhu sasusa ètu yerusalem nèi. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ngaa dhu miu dhae pakaboko mere mèka, na, pa'oru aa'i si ho hia ka. aa ca ngaa dhu miu bisa hia, na, hia laa. dhu lèke ka, hia dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: for if the willing mind is present, it is well-accepted according to that which anyone may have, not according to that which he does not have;
target_text: te ladhe èdhi hia dènge d'ara kateme madhutu ngaa dhu èdhi bisa hia, èèna be'a kèna. sad'i madhutu dad'èi èdhi. te dhèu baku hia ngaa-ngaa dhu pabia nèngu, lula laka-seti nèti dhèu leo.

source_text: for i do not speak that for others to be released, and you pressured,
target_text: ja'a d'èi boe pabia miu, sèna ka dhèu leo abhu samaa. te dad'èi ja'a ka, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti tago sama-sama sasusa dhèu se'e.

source_text: but by equality, at the present time your abundance-for their want, that also their abundance may be for your want, that there may be equality,
target_text: te limuri ne, miu dhu unu risi, aa rèngu dhu unu ciki. lod'o limuri, rèngu bisa b'ala kahèi, ladhe miu dhu unu ciki. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa tago sama-sama.

source_text: according as it has been written: he who gathered much, had nothing over; and he who gathered little, had no lack.
target_text: èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, na, dhèu dhu abhu ae, risi boe nèti ngaa dhu rèngu parluu. aa dhèu dhu abhu ciki, kura boe nèti ngaa dhu rèngu parluu.

source_text: and thanks to god, who is putting the same diligence for you in the heart of titus,
target_text: ja'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu pamako titus, sèna ka neo soru-bara miu, sama sèmi ja'a neo soru-bara miu.

source_text: because he indeed accepted the exhortation, and being more diligent, he went forth to you of his own accord,
target_text: mema ji'i manèngi sèna ka nèngu dhiu ngad'o miu. aa te ngaa, èèna madhutu dad'èi nèngu mesa na. nèti èèna ka, nèngu mesa na neo dhiu soru-bara miu, nèti boe lii manèngi ja'a.

source_text: and we sent with him the brother, whose praise in the good news is through all the assemblies,
target_text: te ngaa nèngu dhiu boe mesa na. te ji'i pua le a'ari ji'i ca dhèu, ho kako palere dènge ne. juma'at aa'i-aa'i ètu ne'e tadhe mèu dhèu ne, lula nèngu sab'a bia ho peka-padhai dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a lamatua.

source_text: and not only so, but who was also appointed by vote by the assemblies, our fellow-traveler, with this favor that is ministered by us, to the glory of the same lord, and your willing mind;
target_text: kètu juma'at se dhu pili ne kahèi, ho palere-lere dènge ji'i, sèna ka soru-bara ji'i ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a ji'i dhu hua iia ne. ji'i pakako sasab'a ne, sèna ka pad'elo dadedha lamatua èdhi, aa tao dhu be'a hia dhèu susa sèra ètu yerusalem.

source_text: avoiding this, lest anyone may blame us in this abundance that is ministered by us,
target_text: ji'i tenge j'ara sèna ka tao dhu lèke, ho baku abhu dhèu dhu pasala ji'i, peka na, ji'i sab'a lèke boe lod'o ji'i ngèti doi sèra papala mi dhèu dhu parluu.

source_text: providing right things, not only before the lord, but also before men;
target_text: te ji'i pangee paie-iie, sèna ka tao dhu lèke nèti d'ara dhu mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua, aa ètu madha dhèu ae kahèi.

source_text: and we sent our brother with them, whom we proved being diligent many times in many things, and now much more diligent, by the great confidence that is toward you,
target_text: abhu a'ari èci hari dhu ji'i pua dhiu palere dènge titus si, ho rèti doi sèra. ji'i ladhe paie-iie le mamuri nèngu. aa ji'i nge'a, na, nèngu neo sab'a bia hia miu kahèi. dhèu ne maj'èni, lula ne'a le, na, miu tao dhu lèke.

source_text: whether-about titus-my partner and fellow-worker toward you, whether-our brothers, apostles of assemblies-glory of christ;
target_text: ladhe dhèu karèi miu lula-nèti titus, peka mi rèngu, na, titus èèna a'ari ja'a dhu sab'a taruu dènge ja'a hia miu. dhèu parcaya ètu era leo kahèi hag'e rare le dhèu rèngu, sèna ka rèngu kahèi rèti doi sèra asa yerusalem. rèngu pakaboko le ho neo dhiu. titus sama-sama dènge rèngu kahèi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pad'elo dadedha kristus sèmi èèna.

source_text: the showing therefore of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf, show to them, even in the face of the assemblies.
target_text: de miu hud'i pad'elo sasue miu mi dhèu dhu rèti doi sèra. aa pad'elo dènge ra, tasamia ka ji'i koa-kad'iri miu. dènge j'ara èèna, dhèu-dhèu parcaya nèti juma'at ètu mia-mia re'a, na, miu sue rèngu.

source_text: for indeed, concerning the ministry that is for the holy ones, it is superfluous for me to write to you,
target_text: dhu lèke, ja'a parluu heka suri hia miu, ho manèngi miu soru-bara dhèu parcaya unu lamatua.

source_text: for i have known your readiness of mind, which in your behalf i boast of to macedonians, that achaia has been prepared a year ago, and your zeal stirred up the greater part,
target_text: te ja'a ke'a le, miu d'èi titu kèna soru-bara dhèu sèmi sèra. ja'a d'èi palolo dènge dhèu parcaya ètu makedonia kahèi, lula-nèti babe'a d'ara miu. ja'a palolo le, peka na, miu nèti propensi akaya dhu pa'èra le karèi nèti ranga-jahi ni, ho pa'adhu doi bantuan. ja'a lolo le kahèi, lula-nèti maj'èni miu ka dhu pamako dhèu leo, ho soru-bara dhèu-dhèu susa.

source_text: and i sent the brothers, that our boasting on your behalf may not be made vain in this respect; that, according as i said, you may be ready,
target_text: ka ja'a pua le a'ari èdhi, sèna ka ra pad'elo, na, ngaa dhu ji'i palolo lula-nèti miu se, leko-monya boe. ja'a peka sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu pa'èra mema.

source_text: lest if macedonians may come with me, and find you unprepared, we may be put to shame that we do not say-you in this same confidence of boasting.
target_text: te ladhe abhu dhèu makedonia mai palere dènge ja'a, aa miu dhae pa'èra mèka, na, èdhi ta'e makae. mage dhoka lalèka ja'a mi dedha miu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: therefore i thought it necessary to exhort the brothers, that they may go before to you, and may make up before your formerly announced blessing, that this be ready, as a blessing, and not as covetousness.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pangee, na, be'a risi ladhe a'ari èdhi dhiu uuru asa miu, sèna ka miu aa'i-aa'i mi bisa ator uuru ku doi bantuan sèra, madhutu lii pamoa miu uru èèna. miu hud'i hia nèti babe'a d'ara miu, baku hia dènge d'ara cabèka.

source_text: and remember this: he who is sowing sparingly, will also reap sparingly; and he who is sowing in blessings, will also reap in blessings;
target_text: dhu mola-mola, sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu dhu sèle hini ciki, èèna na abhu hua-hela ciki kahèi. aa dhèu dhu sèle hini pa'ae-ae, èèna na abhu hari hua-hela ae-ae kahèi.

source_text: each one, according as he purposes in heart, not out of sorrow or out of necessity, for god loves a cheerful giver,
target_text: ca dhèu-dhèu ka hud'i pama'ète unu na, nèngu neo hia ca ngaa. baku hia dènge d'ara cabèka. baku hia lula dhèu laka-seti. te ama lamatua sue dhèu dhu hia dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: and god is able to cause all grace to abound to you, that in everything always having all sufficiency, you may abound to every good work,
target_text: lamatua bisa hia miu mèngi-nale rupa-rupa. nèngu bisa hia miu ae risi eele kahèi, sèna ka miu baku kura ngaa-ngaa. te ladhe miu parluu, èèna na miu abhu risi nèti dhu miu parluu. dènge j'ara ne, miu bisa papala dhu karisi, sèna ka soru-bara sasab'a aa'i-aa'i dhu nèti babe'a.

source_text: according as it has been written: he dispersed abroad, he gave to the poor, his righteousness remains throughout the age,
target_text: dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, ama lamatua d'èi pala-bagi hia dhèu unu aad'o, nèti d'ara hua iia na. nèngu tao dhu lèke taruu, te d'ara mola na èèna, taha taruu.

source_text: and may he who is supplying seed to the sower, and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,
target_text: lamatua ka dhu hia hini, sèna ka dhèu sab'a sèle oka-tedhe. lamatua ka dhu hia nganga'a, sèna ka èdhi ta'a. lamatua èèna kahèi, ka dhu hia miu mèngi-nale, ho miu bisa tao dhu lèke. èèna sama sèmi miu dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, hèia lamatua hia miu hini, ho miu sèle. aa hua-hela dhu miu abhu sèra, lamatua hia hari ae-ae, nèti ca lod'o asa ca lod'o.

source_text: being enriched to all liberality in everything, which works thanksgiving through us to god,
target_text: te lamatua neo pala-bagi hia miu risi nèti dhu miu parluu, sèna ka miu bisa soru-bara dhèu leo, dènge d'ara be'a miu. de ladhe miu soru-bara le dhèu leo, tatu dhèu se manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: because the ministry of this service not only is supplying the wants of the holy ones, but is also abounding through many thanksgivings to god,
target_text: te bantuan dhu miu hia mi dhèu unu lamatua ètu nèi, tatu pasamaa si. aa dènge j'ara ne'e kahèi, miu manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: through the proof of this ministry glorifying god for the subjection of your confession to the good news of the christ, and for the liberality of the fellowship to them and to all,
target_text: te lod'o miu soru-bara dhèu leo sèra, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, miu parcaya tare'a-re'a. j'ara ne'e kahèi tao dhèu leo sèra koa-kio ama lamatua. te rèngu bisa rèdhi dènge re'a, na, parcaya miu mi lii lolo be'a kristus leko-monya boe. èèna, lula miu tao madhutu lalèka miu. hèia ropa miu hia bantuan dènge d'ara kateme mi rèngu, aa hia mi dhèu leo kahèi, na, èèna ka dhu tao rèngu koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and by their supplication in your behalf, longing after you because of the exceeding grace of god on you;
target_text: aa dhèu dhu sèmi rare bantuan nèti miu sèra, èèna na ra sabaj'a hia miu. rèngu neo rèdhi miu kahèi, lula ama lamatua dhu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na ae-ae mi dedha miu.

source_text: thanks also to god for his unspeakable gift!
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu hia iia èdhi hadia èci dhu be'a titu kèna, nuka yesus! kab'ua na risi aa'i ngaa-ngaa! nèti èèna ka, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti sama-sama peka dènge ama lamatua, na, makasi!

source_text: and i, paul, myself, call on you-through the meekness and gentleness of the christ-who in presence am indeed humble among you, and being absent, have courage toward you,
target_text: ja'a, paulus, ka dhu suri sasuri ne. tatu abhu nèti miu dhu pangee, na, ladhe ja'a sama-sama dènge miu, ja'a makae padhai lii paled'a. te ngaa ladhe miu dènge boe ja'a, na, ja'a bani padhai lii dhu pa'abhe boe. sèmi èèna ka, si? aa te ngaa, ja'a dhu pasanèd'e le miu, na, kristus ne dhu lii mako dènge d'ara hua iia mi dedha miu.

source_text: and i implore you, that, being present, i may not have courage, with the confidence with which i reckon to be bold against certain reckoning us as walking according to the flesh;
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e nèti miu dhu ro'o boe nanene lii ja'a. rèngu peka, tatao ji'i beda boe dènge tatao dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne. de ladhe ja'a dhiu, ele boe ja'a padhai lii dènge rèngu pake boe pa'abhe. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka mema dènge miu aa'i-aa'i mi, sèna ka ladhe ja'a d'ai èèna, ja'a tao heka lii taka dènge rèngu.

source_text: for walking in the flesh, we do not war according to the flesh,
target_text: masi ka èdhi se dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa ladhe èdhi pab'ala lii dènge dhèu leo, èdhi pakadhii boe, sèmi dhèu ètu rai-haha ne dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: for the weapons of our warfare are not fleshly, but powerful to god for bringing down of strongholds,
target_text: ladhe èdhi patao dènge dhèu, baku bhèlu, te rèka èdhi sama boe dènge rèka dhèu rai-haha ne. aa ladhe èdhi patao dènge dhèu kètu hadhu, na, èdhi unu koasa lamatua, dhu bisa palaho ngangee rèngu.

source_text: bringing down reasonings, and every high thing lifted up against the knowledge of god, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of the christ,
target_text: koasa lamatua bisa palaho aa'i ngangee dènge tatao dhu palab'a dènge lamatua, dhu tao dhèu ho ro'o boe tadhe lamatua. koasa nèngu kahèi bisa pad'elo j'ara, ho gati j'ara ngangee èdhi dhu dhui, dènge j'ara ngangee dhu hiu. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa pangee madhutu a'aj'a kristus.

source_text: and being in readiness to avenge every disobedience whenever your obedience may be fulfilled.
target_text: ae ka nèti miu mulai d'èi nanene kristus, aa tao madhutu dad'èi na aa'i-aa'i. te ngaa abhu cahag'e nèti miu dhu ro'o boe nanene ne. de ji'i dhu pa'èra le ho huku si.

source_text: you see the outward appearance. if anyone has trusted in himself to be christ's, let him reckon this again from himself, that according as he is christ's, so also we are christ's;
target_text: miu d'èi laladhe ngaa dhu ladhe mèdhi ètu li'u di. te ngaa miu hud'i ladhe ku d'ara dhèu. de ladhe dhèu pangee, na, nèngu dhèu pajuu-paleha kristus, sanèd'e paie-iie, te ji'i se dhèu pajuu-paleha kristus kahèi, sèmi nèngu.

source_text: for even if i will also boast anything more abundantly concerning our authority, that the lord gave us for building up, and not for casting you down, i will not be ashamed,
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, ja'a padhai lii ae risi eele lula-nèti koasa dhu ji'i abhu nèti lamatua. sèmi èèna ka, si? aad'o! te lamatua hia koasa èèna ho pa'èra miu, aa pa'ele iie boe miu. de ja'a soro tèke eele boe dhèu dhu pamakae ja'a, lula rèngu pa'ele iie sasab'a-la'a ja'a.

source_text: that i may not seem as if i would terrify you through the letters,
target_text: ja'a neo boe pamadha'u miu dènge sasuri ja'a sèra.

source_text: because the letters indeed, says one, are weighty and strong, and the bodily presence weak, and the speech despicable.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sèra peka, na, baku pusi-pahae dènge paulus. te masi ka isi sasuri na bia dènge sakaa, te ngaa ladhe patoo madha, nèngu roe aala-aala, aa lii padhai dhu dènge boe koasa.

source_text: this one-let him reckon thus: that such as we are in word, through letters, being absent, such also, being present, we are in deed.
target_text: te ngaa sèna ka dhèu dhu padhai lii omo koso sèra re'a, na, ngaa dhu ji'i suri ètu d'ara sasuri nèti kaj'èu, beda boe dènge ngaa dhu ji'i peka-padhai, ladhe ji'i ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: for we do not make bold to rank or to compare ourselves with certain of those commending themselves, but they, measuring themselves among themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are not wise,
target_text: dhèu sèra sa d'èi padedha iisi, peka na, rèngu ka dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu kapai nèti kristus. ji'i bani boe pasoro ngi'u ji'i dènge dhèu sèmi sèra. me'a, sina ma? ele boe ji'i se èra boe sama sèmi rèngu! dhèu sèmi sèra sa, dhodhoka tenge dhèu dhu sama sèmi rèngu di. sèna ka rèngu pa'èra èci dènge èci, lula rèngu se ca ropa! gagoa ra sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: and we will not boast ourselves in regard to the unmeasured things, but after the measure of the line that the god of measure appointed to us-to reach even to you;
target_text: aa te ngaa ji'i padedha boe iisi, ladhe dènge boe kolo-kapua na. ji'i dhoka padhai lii sèmi èèna lula-nèti sasab'a dhu lamatua pangèd'u mi ji'i. ngaa dhu ji'i tao hia miu sèra, dhoka tao madhutu ngaa dhu lamatua pua ji'i sab'a. te ji'i sab'a boe dhu leo nèti èèna.

source_text: for we do not stretch ourselves too much, as not reaching to you, for even to you we came in the good news of the christ,
target_text: dhu lèke ka, ji'i se padhai lii karisi boe, lod'o ji'i koa-kad'iri miu. te ji'i ka dhu mai lole lii lolo be'a kristus hia miu. ka miu sèmi mere lii padhai ji'i kahèi. ladhe lamatua pua boe ji'i, te ngaa ji'i koa-kad'iri miu, na, èèna mema lèke boe.

source_text: not boasting of the things not measured, in other men's labors, and having hope-your faith increasing-in you to be enlarged, according to our line-into abundance,
target_text: ladhe dhèu leo ka dhu sab'a, na, ji'i padedha boe iisi, peka na, èèna rui-j'aj'èra ji'i na. te madhutu mola-mola na, parcaya miu hud'i asa tabha èra. dènge j'ara ne'e, rui-j'aj'èra ji'i ètu dedha miu karèi nèti uru ka asa tabha taruu.

source_text: to proclaim good news in the places beyond you, not in another's line in regard to the things made ready, to boast;
target_text: hèia ji'i bisa la'a peka-padhai lii lolo be'a kristus asa era-era dhu pakaj'èu nèti era miu, dhu abhu mèka dhèu sab'a ètu era sèra. dènge j'ara ne'e, sasab'a ji'i patogo boe dènge sasab'a dhèu dhu ra pakako le ètu èèna.

source_text: and he who is boasting-let him boast in the lord;
target_text: te abhu ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri, na, ladhe dhèu neo padedha iisi, na, hud'i padedha iisi dhoka lula-nèti kètu èdhi, ama lamatua di.

source_text: for he who is commending himself is not approved, but he whom the lord commends.
target_text: ladhe abhu ca dhèu dhu padhai lii dedha lula-nèti mamuri nèngu unu na, èèna sasoa na hèb'a-hua. te ngaa ladhe lamatua ka dhu koa-kad'iri dhèu ne'e, heka lèke kèna!

source_text: o that you were bearing with me a little of the folly, but you also bear with me:
target_text: ja'a neo padhai lii sama sèmi dhèu goa. de miu nanene sèku! lii ja'a sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: for i am zealous for you with zeal of god, for i betrothed you to one husband, a pure virgin, to present to christ,
target_text: ja'a nuka sèmi ama miu, aa miu nuka sèmi ana bhèni ja'a dhu dhèu lii d'ai le. dhèu dhu lii d'ai miu èèna, nuka kristus. ka ja'a ate sale boe miu, sèna ka ladhe d'ai lod'o miu kab'i, miu kalora iisi era. hèia ja'a j'aga miu, sèna ka dhèu leo baku gagai miu, ho pa'ele iie parcaya miu.

source_text: and i fear, lest, as the serpent deceived eve in his subtlety, so your minds may be corrupted from the simplicity that is in the christ;
target_text: ne'e ne miu madhutu j'ara mamuri kristus dènge d'ara mola. te ngaa ja'a madha'u, mage dhoka dhèu tipu rare, miu sèna ka miu piku eele nèti j'ara mola èèna, nuka sèmi uru èèna mege tipu nare hawa. mege ne bisa tipu sèmi èèna, lula nèngu baki nèti kapod'e-kabèli!

source_text: for if, indeed, he who is coming preaches another jesus whom we did not preach, or you receive another spirit which you did not receive, or other good news which you did not accept-well were you bearing it,
target_text: ladhe lod'o-lod'o miu paraga dènge dhèu sèmi sèra sa, ho ra aj'a-nori miu lula-nèti yesus ropa leo dhu sama boe dènge yesus dhu ji'i aj'a-nori miu, na, tasamia ka miu lèka lii padhai ra? uru èèna, miu bhoke le d'ara miu ho sèmi mere roh mola-mèci lamatua, sèna ka na ator miu. te ngaa tasamia ka limuri ne, miu neo hari sèmi mere roh ropa leo èci? uru èèna, miu lèka lii lolo be'a kristus dhu ji'i aj'a miu. te ngaa tasamia ka limuri ne miu parcaya hari a'aj'a ropa leo?

source_text: for i reckon that i have been nothing behind the very chiefest apostles,
target_text: dhèu se padedha iisi ra, peka na, rèngu ka dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu kapai risi. madhutu ngangee miu, hak rèngu se risi nèti hak ja'a, do? aad'o! ja'a pake boe ngangee sèmi sèra.

source_text: and even if a commoner in speech-yet not in knowledge, but in everything we were made evident in all things to you.
target_text: masi ka ja'a d'èlu-mèu boe ètu d'ara lii padhai pake lii dedha, te ngaa ke'a mèu sasoa nèti ngaa dhu ja'a padhue-padhai. miu dhu me'a le j'ara se'e, lula ja'a peka pahari-pahari le dènge miu.

source_text: did i do sin-humbling myself that you might be exalted, because i freely proclaimed the good news of god to you?
target_text: lod'o ja'a aj'a miu lii holo-nori ama lamatua, ja'a manèngi boe miu ogo-oru hia ja'a. ja'a tao iisi nuka sèmi ana iiki sa, sèna ka bisa ded'e padedha miu. teko-teko nèti j'ara ne'e ka miu neo pasala ja'a, do?

source_text: i robbed other assemblies, having taken wages, for your ministry;
target_text: te dhèu parcaya nèti juma'at era leo sèra ka dhu tago ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa ladhe-leru miu. ne'e èci èèna ka dènge ja'a kore nèti rèngu ho soru-bara miu.

source_text: and being present with you, and having been in want, i was chargeable to no one, for the brothers supplied my lack-having come from macedonia-and i kept myself burdenless to you in everything, and will keep.
target_text: lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ladhe ja'a parluu ngaa-ngaa, na, ja'a manèngi boe miu, aa pabia boe miu. a'ari èdhi dhu mai nèti propensi makedonia ka dhu soru-bara ja'a. te ngaa ja'a pabia kèdhi mèka miu, aa bèli-camèd'a ja'a pabia boe miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: the truth of christ is in me, because this boasting will not be stopped in regard to me in the regions of achaia;
target_text: lii holo-nori kristus ne lèke tare'a-re'a. ja'a lèka mèu, na, lii padhai ja'a lèke kahèi, lula ja'a pa'èki dènge kristus. abhu boe ca dhèu sa ètu propensi akaya dhu bisa kutu hèb'a ja'a, aa kai ja'a sèna ka baku padhai lii padedha, peka na, ja'a pabia boe miu sèmi èèna.

source_text: for what reason? because i do not love you? god has known!
target_text: nga tao ka ja'a peka sèmi ne'e? ele boe, lula ja'a sue boe miu, do? masi ka miu pangee sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua ne'a, na, ja'a sue miu.

source_text: and what i do, i also will do, that i may cut off the occasion of those wishing an occasion, that in that which they boast they may be found according as we also;
target_text: j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao kèdhi le, ja'a tao taruu. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu dhu tema padedha iisi, peka na, tatao rèngu sèra èci èèna ka dènge tatao ji'i, na, padhai lii rèngu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: for those such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into apostles of christ,
target_text: rèngu peka, na, lamatua ka dhu pajuu-paleha rèngu. rèngu se, dhèu sab'a dhu d'èi leko-monya dhèu! dhèu se tao iisi ra nuka sèmi dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu lèke nèti kristus. aa te ngaa rèngu se dhoka padhai lii hèb'a-hua!

source_text: and no wonder-for even satan transforms himself into a messenger of light;
target_text: miu baku cag'ag'a! te dhèu aae nidhu kahèi tao iisi na sama sèmi ana-ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhu nèti saraa aa d'ara be'a.

source_text: it is no great thing, then, if his servants also transform themselves as servants of righteousness-whose end will be according to their works.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu baku malaa ladhe dhèu sab'a na neo tao iisi ra nuka sèmi dhèu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara mola. sanèd'e, te èèna na ama lamatua b'ala bhabhelu-katub'a rèngu.

source_text: again i say, may no one think me to be a fool; and if otherwise, receive me even as a fool, that i also may boast a little.
target_text: ladhe mo'o, na, ja'a padhai lii hari ciki sama sèmi dhèu goa. te ja'a neo padhai lii padedha iisi ciki.

source_text: that which i speak, i do not speak according to the lord, but as in foolishness, in this the confidence of boasting;
target_text: dhu ja'a suri padedha iisi ne, dhoka neo padhai lii sama sèmi dhèu goa sa. te lii padhai ja'a ne kapua na nèti boe lamatua èdhi.

source_text: since many boast according to the flesh, i also will boast:
target_text: abhu dhèu ae dhu d'èi ded'e padedha ngi'u ra madhutu tatao dhèu rai-haha ne. de ja'a neo padhai lii padedha iisi kahèi sama sèmi rèngu.

source_text: for you gladly bear with the fools-being wise,
target_text: te miu dhu pangee, na, ngangee miu mola ladhe paraga dènge ca dhèu dhu kahadhu bia, na, miu soro tèke ne, si?

source_text: for you bear, if anyone is bringing you under bondage, if anyone devours, if anyone takes away, if anyone exalts himself, if anyone strikes you on the face;
target_text: ladhe dhèu leo tao miu madhutu dad'èi rèngu, na, miu soro tèke si. nuka sèmi: ladhe dhèu tao miu sèmi ènu sa, miu soro tèke ne, do? ladhe abhu dhu mana'u mèdha miu, miu soro tèke ne, do? ladhe abhu dhèu tipu miu, miu soro tèke ne, do? ladhe dhèu tao iisi nuka sèmi dhèu kapai, aa pahahe miu nuka sèmi ana iiki sa, na, miu soro tèke ne, do? sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tèb'e miu, na, miu soro tèke ne sène.

source_text: i speak in reference to dishonor, how that we were weak, and in whatever anyone is bold-in foolishness i say it-i also am bold.
target_text: te ngaa baku nasa! te ja'a makae, lula ji'i roe aala-aala. te ji'i lake ngare boe tao sèmi èèna, sama sèmi dhèu sèra tao mi dedha miu. te ngaa ladhe rèngu neo padedha iisi lula ngaa sa, ja'a bani padedha iisi sèmi èèna kahèi. te ngaa baku bhèlu, te ja'a padhai lii sèmi dhèu goa na!

source_text: are they hebrews? i also! are they israelites? i also! are they seed of abraham? i also!
target_text: rèngu se dhèu ibrani tare'a-re'a, do? oo! ja'a kahèi dhèu ibrani. rèngu dhèu isra'el, do? oo! ja'a kahèi. rèngu sèra ana-èpu abraham, do? oo! ja'a kahèi.

source_text: are they servants of christ? as if beside myself i speak-i am more; in labors more abundantly, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequently, in deaths many times.
target_text: rèngu sèra dhèu sab'a hia kristus, do? oo! ja'a kahèi sèmi èèna. baku bhèlu, te ja'a padhai lii paleko ne! mema, ja'a peka na, ja'a sama sèmi rèngu. aa te ngaa ja'a risi nèti rèngu. te ja'a sab'a bia risi. ra bèdho ja'a ae risi. ra game ja'a ae risi. ja'a kahèi oe madhe pahari-pahari ae risi nèti rèngu.

source_text: five times i received from jews forty stripes except one;
target_text: ètu d'ara adhe-aai dhèu ja'a, dhèu yahudi, ra hake paparu ja'a lèmi hari. lod'o-lod'o ra hake paparu ja'a, na, ra hake tèlu nguru ceo hari pake gui.

source_text: three times i was beaten with rods, once i was stoned, three times i was shipwrecked, i have passed a night and a day in the deep;
target_text: tèlu hari, dhèu hake ja'a pake aj'u. ca tèka dhèu pèci neo pamadhe ja'a. ja'a molo dènge kapa tèlu hari. d'ara ca mèu ca mèda, ja'a leb'o-leb'o ètu d'ara dhasi.

source_text: journeys many times, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my own race, perils from nations, perils in city, perils in wilderness, perils in sea, perils among false brothers;
target_text: ja'a laku kaj'èu asa mia-mia pahari-pahari. ètu d'ara kakako ne, ja'a paraga dènge j'aj'èra rupa-rupa, dhu tao ja'a oe madhe. nuka sèmi: nèti èi aae lala ètu d'ara loko aae, nèti parapo, nèti dhèu ja'a dhèu yahudi, nèti dhèu yahudi boe, aa nèti dhèu dhu tao ngi'u ra sama sèmi a'ari dhèu parcaya, aa te ngaa rèngu leko-monya. ja'a oe madhe kahèi ètu talora lèu, ètu d'ara kota, dènge era dhèu pea boe.

source_text: in laboriousness and painfulness, many times in watchings, in hunger and thirst, many times in fastings, in cold and nakedness;
target_text: ja'a sab'a bia, aa paraga dènge sasusa ae-ae. lod'o ae ka dhu ja'a bisa boe bhèj'i. ja'a manganga dènge koko-kamango kahèi. pahari-pahari ku'a boe ngaa-ngaa. abhu kahèi lod'o dhu ja'a unu boe mèdha-papake, ka maringi oe madhe.

source_text: apart from the things without-the crowding on me that is daily-the care of all the assemblies.
target_text: aa ladhe mo'o boe ige j'ara se'e, na, ige sèmi ne'e ka: te bèli-bèli ja'a j'aj'i ngangee kapai, lula ngee kèdhi a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya dhu pakaboko ètu mia-mia.

source_text: who is weak, and i am not weak? who is stumbled, and i am not burned?
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu rasa roe-bhilu dhu bisa boe sab'a ngaa-ngaa, na, sanèd'e ja'a. te ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu dadugu dhèu-dhèu parcaya sèna ka tao j'ara karehe sama-sama dènge rèngu, na, ja'a makae, aa nasa.

source_text: if it is necessary to boast, i will boast of the things of my weakness;
target_text: ladhe ja'a neo padedha iisi, na, be'a risi ja'a padedha iisi lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu pad'elo raroe ja'a. tare'a!

source_text: the god and father of our lord jesus christ-who is blessed for all ages-has known that i do not lie!
target_text: kètu èdhi yesus, dènge ama na, ama lamatua re'a, na, ja'a monya boe. dhu lèke, ladhe dhèu koa-kio ne toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: in damascus the governor under aretas the king was watching the city of the damascenes, wishing to seize me,
target_text: conto nuka sèmi, uru èèna ètu kota damsik, gubernur nèti dhèu aae aretas pua dhèu mate ho kèpe ja'a ètu hèb'a tedhe kota.

source_text: and i was let down through a window in a rope basket, through the wall, and fled out of his hands.
target_text: te ngaa angalai ja'a pamaso ja'a asa d'ara karogo èci. ka ra dulu ja'a dènge dhari re li'u tembok kota. hèia gubernur kèpe nare boe ja'a. de sanèd'e, ladhe ja'a mesa-mesa ku, tatu bisa boe, si?

source_text: to boast, really, is not profitable for me, for i will come to visions and revelations of the lord.
target_text: ladhe miu mo'o, na, ja'a padedha iisi hari ciki, masi ka gaguna aad'o. te ngaa ja'a neo peka dènge miu j'ara-j'ara dhu lamatua èdhi pad'elo le dènge ja'a ètu d'ara tanila.

source_text: i have known a man in christ, fourteen years ago-whether in the body i have not known, whether out of the body i have not known, god has known-such a one being snatched up to the third heaven; and i have known such a man-whether in the body, whether out of the body, i have not known, god has known- that he was snatched up to the paradise, and heard unutterable sayings, that it is not possible for man to speak.
target_text: ja'a tadhe ca dhèu unu kristus. canguru èpa tèu dhu la'e, abhu dhu ded'e ne asa dedha-liru dhu dedha aae. te ngaa ja'a ke'a boe, na ca'e dènge ngi'u aae, do dhoka roh nèngu di. dhodhoka lamatua di ne'a. ja'a ke'a kahèi, na, ropa ded'e ne asa era hua iia lamatua èèna, nèngu tadèngi lii padhai dhu be'a titu kèna, dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa boe peka-padhai.

source_text: of such a one i will boast, and of myself i will not boast, except in my weaknesses,
target_text: de mi dhèu sèmi èèna, ja'a neo padhai lii padedha. te ngaa ja'a ko'o boe padedha iisi lula-nèti ngi'u ja'a unu ku. ja'a ded'e dhoka raroe-bhilu ja'a, aa j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a bisa boe tao kore.

source_text: for if i may wish to boast, i will not be a fool, for i will say truth; but i refrain, lest in regard to me anyone may think anything above what he sees me, or hears anything of me;
target_text: ladhe ja'a neo padedha iisi, na, ja'a parluu boe monya, te ja'a dhu dènge j'ara ae dhu lèke, dhu ja'a bisa peka-padhai. te ngaa ja'a mau-mau, sèna ka dhèu baku pangee, na, ja'a dènge kolo-karisi nèti ngaa dhu rèngu tadèngi aa ladhe rèdhi nèti ja'a.

source_text: and that by the exceeding greatness of the revelations i might not be exalted too much, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of satan, that he might batter me, that i might not be exalted too much.
target_text: risi-risi hari, lamatua dhu pad'elo le dènge ja'a j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai titu kèna. te ngaa ja'a abhu susa kahèi, sèna ka ja'a baku pamone. te dhèu aae nidhu pua ana pajuu na èci, ho mai kakèj'i taruu ja'a, nuka sèmi dhudhu dhu pakèj'i ètu d'ara isi ja'a ne. waa! ja'a j'èra titu kèna!

source_text: i called on the lord three times concerning this thing, that it might depart from me,
target_text: tèlu hari kèna, ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pakaj'èu eele j'aj'èra ne nèti ja'a.

source_text: and he said to me, my grace is sufficient for you, for my power is perfected in weakness; most gladly, therefore, will i rather boast in my weaknesses, that the power of the christ may rest on me:
target_text: te ngaa lamatua peka na, ja'a pad'elo le d'ara hua iia ja'a mi èu, de èèna d'ai le, sèna ka èu me'a, na, nèti d'ara raroe ka koasa ja'a asa tabha. nèti èèna ka ja'a d'èi padedha iisi ètu d'ara raroe ja'a, sèna ka ja'a ke'a, na, koasa kristus ètu d'ara mamuri ja'a.

source_text: for this reason i am well pleased in weaknesses, in damages, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses-for christ; for whenever i may be weak, then i am powerful;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe a'èra ja'a mesa ku bisa boe sab'a ngaa èci sa, na, d'ara ja'a mau-mau sène. de ropa dhèu pahahe ja'a, do pasusa ja'a, do paj'èra ja'a, do game ja'a, lula ja'a j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, na, d'ara ja'a mau-mau sène. te ladhe ja'a mesa ku bisa boe, na, ja'a abhu koasa nèti kristus, ho bisa èra tao j'ara sèra.

source_text: i have become a fool-boasting; you compelled me; for i ought to have been commended by you, for i was behind the very chiefest apostles in nothing-even if i am nothing.
target_text: miu mamuri nuka sèmi me'a boe, na, lamatua pua nèdhi mèka ja'a dhiu peka-padhai dènge miu. nèti èèna ka, mo'o do mo'o boe, ja'a ako padhai lii ciki sèmi dhèu goa. madhutu iia-iia na, miu se'e ka dhu padhai lii padedha ja'a. ja'a ne mema dènge boe kab'ua, te ngaa ladhe pasoro ja'a dènge dhèu kapai sèra dhu peka na, lamatua pua-paleha rèngu, na, rèngu sèra risi boe ja'a.

source_text: the signs, indeed, of the apostle were worked among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds,
target_text: ladhe lamatua pua dhèu ho lole lula-nèti nèngu, dhèu ne tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa pake koasa, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, na, lamatua ka dhu pua-paleha nèngu. te ngaa baku bhèlu, te lod'o ja'a ètu talora aae miu, ja'a tao tadha malaa kahèi sèmi sèra. aa ja'a sab'a mau-mau.

source_text: for what is there in which you were inferior to the rest of the assemblies, except that i myself was not a burden to you? forgive me this injustice!
target_text: te ngaa baku nasa! dhodhoka ca j'ara di, dhu ja'a tao boe ètu talora miu, dhu dhèu leo tao ètu juma'at leo. nuka ja'a manèngi boe miu ogo ja'a.

source_text: behold, a third time i am ready to come to you, and i will not be a burden to you, for i do not seek yours, but you, for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children,
target_text: sèmi ne'e! ja'a dhu tèlu hari kèna pa'èra kore le ho dhiu ngad'o miu. ja'a parluu boe miu ogo mamuri ja'a. ja'a ko'o boe mèdha-panyau miu kahèi. te madhutu ad'a èdhi, lèke boe ladhe ana iiki tèka mèdha-panyau hia ina-ama ra. dhu lèke nuka ina-ama ka dhu sadia tèke mèdha-panyau hia ana niki ra. de ja'a parluu boe ladhe miu sadia tèke mèdha-panyau hia ja'a, te miu se sama sèmi ana-ana ja'a! dhu ja'a parluu, dhoka mamuri dènge sasue miu.

source_text: and i will most gladly spend and be entirely spent for your souls, even if, loving you more abundantly, i am loved less.
target_text: ja'a d'èi hèli mèdha hia miu. ja'a d'èi sab'a bia kahèi, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. ladhe ja'a sue miu d'ai seli, na, miu hud'i sue ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. nga tao ka miu papènyi sasue miu? lèke boe, sina ma?

source_text: and be it so, i did not burden you, but being crafty, i took you with guile;
target_text: ètu talora miu, abhu dhu peka na, ja'a pabia boe miu. te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu peka na, ja'a dhèu dhu mèu pakapod'e miu, sèna ka miu madhutu dad'èi ja'a.

source_text: anyone of those whom i have sent to you-did i take advantage of you by him?
target_text: de tasamia? ele boe dhèu dhu ja'a pua dhiu asa miu sèra, tipu rare miu, do? aad'o!

source_text: i begged titus, and sent with him the brother; did titus take advantage of you? did we not walk in the same spirit? did we not walk in the same steps?
target_text: te ja'a dhu pamako titus ho dhiu asa miu. ja'a pua a'ari dhèu parcaya èci sèna ka dhiu palere dènge titus kahèi. titus pakapod'e miu, do? aad'o, si? te titus dènge ja'a ne, ca ropa. ji'i sab'a j'ara dhu sama, te ngangee ji'i dua mi sama kahèi.

source_text: again, do you think that we are making defense to you? we speak before god in christ; and all things, beloved, are for your up-building,
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! tao-tao miu dhu pangee, na, ji'i siri iisi ji'i ètu madha miu, do? aad'o! te aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i peka-padhai se, ama lamatua dhu ne'a le. de ji'i bisa boe pahuni ngaa-ngaa nèti nèngu. ji'i pa'èki kahèi dènge kristus. lula ji'i sue miu, nèti èèna ka aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i tao sèra, sèna ka bisa pa'èra miu.

source_text: for i fear lest, having come, i may not find you such as i wish, and i may be found by you such as you do not wish, lest there be strifes, envyings, wraths, revelries, slanders, whisperings, puffings up, insurrections,
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhiu ngad'o miu, ja'a pangee mage dhoka miu j'aj'i boe sama sèmi dad'èi ja'a. te mage dhoka abhu dhu patao-palaha, d'èi boe dhèu karisi nèngu, tèka d'ara, abhu dhu pangee dhoka mamuri nèngu mesa na, abhu dhu pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu, abhu dhu padhai-kakoli dhèu, abhu dhu padedha iisi, aa abhu dhu maruru jahu lulu-lulu. mage dhoka ja'a kahèi j'aj'i boe sama sèmi dad'èi miu.

source_text: lest again having come, my god may humble me in regard to you, and i may mourn many of those having sinned before, and having not changed their mind concerning the uncleanness, and whoredom, and licentiousness, that they practiced.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhiu ka asa miu, ja'a j'aj'i ngangee, lula tatao-tatao miu. mage dhoka ama lamatua neo pamakae ja'a ètu madha miu. mage dhoka ja'a pabia dhèu, lula, nèti miu abhu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara bhelu-katub'a era, te ngaa ele-ho'a boe, sèna ka madhutu j'ara mola nèti lamatua. rèngu se dhèu kaj'alu! te abhu dhu ad'u j'ara makae dènge mone do bhèni dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe. ra ad'u-ue j'ara makae rupa-rupa dhu re'a heka makae d'ara.

source_text: i come to you this third time; on the mouth of two or three witnesses will every saying be established;
target_text: de ne'e ne kali ka tèlu kèna ja'a neo dhiu ngad'o miu. ladhe abhu dhu neo galaa dhèu, na, baku bhèlu atora na. te sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua dhu suri, peka na, ladhe abhu dhu neo galaa dhèu èci, hud'i dènge ku dua do tèlu sakasii dhu lii èci, heka sèmi mere kèna. te ladhe abhu boe lii èci sèmi èèna, baku sèmi mere lii galaa èèna.

source_text: i have said before, and i say it before, as being present, the second time, and being absent, now, i write to those having sinned before, and to all the rest, that if i come again, i will not spare,
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a dhiu kali ka dua asa miu uru èèna, ja'a pasanèd'e le dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara bhabhelu-katub'a sèra. limuri ne, ja'a pasanèd'e hari rèngu sama-sama dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu d'ara bhelu-katub'a sèra. nuka sèmi uru èèna, dhu ja'a peka kore le, na, ladhe ja'a j'aj'i mai hari, ja'a soro tèke boe rèngu sèra.

source_text: since you seek a proof of the christ speaking in me, who is not weak to you, but is powerful in you,
target_text: miu tenge bukti, dhu peka na, kristus padhai lii re ja'a. ladhe kristus neo ator miu, na tao dènge koasa kapai ètu talora aae miu. te nèngu sab'a boe dènge roe.

source_text: for even if he was crucified from weakness, yet he lives from the power of god; for we also are weak in him, but we will live with him from the power of god toward you.
target_text: lod'o dhèu pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, mema na roe aala-aala, lula na patalale eele koasa na. te ngaa ama lamatua pangèd'u le kristus koasa, hèia na mamuri hari le. ka masi ka ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu na, dhu rasa na, ji'i ètu d'ara raroe era, te ngaa ama lamatua hia le ji'i mamuri hiu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i bisa ladhe-leru miu pake koasa nèngu.

source_text: try yourselves, if you are in the faith; prove yourselves; do you not know yourselves, that jesus christ is in you, if you are not disapproved of in some respect?
target_text: parisa d'ara miu unu mi dhu peka na, miu parcaya tare'a mi kristus, do aad'o. koasa na bisa tèdhi ètu d'ara mamuri miu, do aad'o? uji mamuri miu sèmi èèna. te ladhe kristus pa'èki boe dènge miu, miu j'aj'i boe dhèu unu na.

source_text: and i hope that you will know that we are not disapproved of;
target_text: ladhe miu parisa ji'i, na, miu bisa ladhe mèdhi koasa kristus ètu d'ara mamuri ji'i. dènge j'ara ne'e, ji'i lolos.

source_text: and i pray before god that you do no evil, not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is right, and we may be as disapproved;
target_text: ji'i sabaj'a kahèi manèngi ama lamatua, sèna ka miu baku manahu asa d'ara sasala ngaa-ngaa. ji'i pusi-pahae boe dhèu d'èi, do d'èi boe, nèti sasab'a-la'a ji'i. te ngaa ji'i d'èi ladhe miu tao dhu lèke, masi ka dhèu cahag'e tule eele ji'i. masi ka dhèu tule eele ji'i sèmi èèna, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: for we are not able to do anything against the truth, but for the truth;
target_text: te ji'i bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa, ho lab'a j'ara dhu lèke. ji'i nge'a dhoka tao dhu lèke di.

source_text: for we rejoice when we may be weak, but you may be powerful; and we also pray for this-your perfection!
target_text: ladhe miu j'aj'i èra, aa ji'i j'aj'i roe èèna ka, ji'i karej'e-karae. te ji'i sabaj'a, ho manèngi lamatua tao pamèci miu.

source_text: because of this, these things-being absent-i write, that being present, i may not treat any sharply, according to the authority that the lord gave me for building up, and not for casting down.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, masi ka ja'a pakaj'èu dènge miu, ja'a suri tèke le j'ara se'e se, ho ladhe d'ai ka lod'o ja'a dhiu, ja'a tao heka lii sakaa dènge miu. ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua èdhi. te ngaa na pangèd'u hak dènge koasa mi ja'a, sèna ka pa'ele iie boe miu, te ngaa pa'èra miu.

source_text: from now on, brothers, rejoice; be made perfect, be comforted, be of the same mind, be at peace, and the god of love and peace will be with you.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue aa'i-aa'i! lii ja'a dhu limuri tèka ne, dhoka lii maho'o di. pamola j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. nanene paie-iie lii holo-nori ja'a. mamuri d'ara èci. miu èci dènge èci hud'i pabe'a-be'a. kapua sasue nèti ama lamatua. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua bera-bera taruu dènge miu, aa na soru-bara miu, ho miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: greet one another in a holy kiss.
target_text: miu hud'i pamaho'o aa pa'uu dhu pantas dènge dhèu mola-mèci unu ama lamatua. dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua ètu se'e, pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi hia miu.

source_text: all the holy ones greet you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu. ja'a manèngi ho ama lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi dedha miu. ja'a manèngi kahèi sèna ka roh mola-mèci lamatua pad'elo d'ara be'a na, ho hud'i laa miu mamuri d'ara èci. sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: paul, an apostle-not from men, nor through man, but through jesus christ, and god the father, who raised him out of the dead- and all the brothers with me, to the assemblies of galatia:
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ja'a pa'adhu sasuri ne asa a'ari aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus ètu juma'at-juma'at ètu propensi galati. a'ari dhu sama-sama dènge ja'a ètu ne'e, pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi hia miu. ja'a pasanèd'e miu, na, ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a. nèti boe dhèu rai-haha ne. yesus kristus èèna, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua pua mai le. kristus madhe, te ngaa lamatua pamamuri hari ne. hèia ra pua-paleha ja'a, ho laku peka-padhai lii lolo be'a dènge dhèu-dhèu.

source_text: grace to you and peace from god the father and our lord jesus christ,
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a mi ama èdhi, ama lamatua, aa kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi ho rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, sèna ka miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of the present evil age, according to the will of our god and father,
target_text: kristus madhe, sèna ka saku eele aa'i sasala èdhi aa pakaj'èu èdhi nèti bhabhelu-katub'a rai-haha ne. aa'i-aa'i dhu kristus ad'u-ue sèra, madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: to whom is the glory through the ages of the ages. amen.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i koa-kio ne taruu! dhu lèke kèna!

source_text: i wonder that you are so quickly removed from him who called you in the grace of christ to another good news-
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a ke'a heka tao miu sa mia! ama lamatua hag'e nare le miu, lula na neo ho miu me'a d'ara hua iia na. te ngaa tasamia ka miu malai titu kèna lami madhutu lii lolo leo

source_text: not that there is another, except there are certain who are troubling you, and wishing to pervert the good news of the christ;
target_text: dhu lèke boe? uuru èèna, ja'a aj'a le dhu mola-mola lii lolo be'a nèti yesus kristus. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra mai pakapod'e lii lolo be'a èèna, toke miu malaa-maloha.

source_text: but even if we or a messenger out of heaven may proclaim good news to you different from what we proclaimed to you-let him be accursed!
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! te bèli-camèd'a lamatua huku dhèu dhu aj'a lii lolo be'a dhu sama boe dènge dhu ji'i aj'a-nori uru èèna. masi ka dhèu nèti ji'i do, ana pajuu nèti sorga do, hud'i laa lamatua hia ne mamadhe-mamopo!

source_text: as we have said before, and now say again: if anyone may proclaim to you good news different from what you received-let him be accursed!
