source_text: walk in wisdom toward those outside, redeeming the time,
target_text: mamuri dènge mola ètu talora aae dhèu dhu parcaya mèka kristus. pake paie-iie lod'o dhu taleo dhu ama lamatua hia miu.

source_text: your word always being seasoned with salt in grace-to know how it is necessary for you to answer each one.
target_text: ladhe miu padhai lii, padhai dènge lii mako, dhu palèke dènge d'ara dhèu. mage padhai dhu paroca dhèu. pake lii-lii dhu lèke, sèna ka miu bisa dhaa hari dènge be'a, ladhe abhu dhèu pakarèi dènge miu.

source_text: tychicus will make known to you all the things concerning me-the beloved brother, and faithful servant, and fellow-servant in the lord-
target_text: pe tikikus dhiu lole dènge miu, j'ara mamuri ja'a. nèngu ne a'ari pasue èdhi dhu ladhe-leru dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua dhu ne'a boe roca. uru èèna, nèngu pakako sasab'a lamatua sama-sama dènge ja'a kahèi.

source_text: whom i sent to you for this very thing, that he might know the things concerning you, and might comfort your hearts,
target_text: ja'a pua na dhiu, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara miu, aa lole dènge miu j'ara mamuri ji'i ètu ne'e.

source_text: with onesimus the faithful and beloved brother, who is of you; they will make known to you all things that are here.
target_text: ja'a pua onesimus kahèi lèpa palere dènge ne. onesimus ne a'ari pasue dhu sab'a ne'a boe roca kahèi. nèngu ne, dhèu miu. dua ra, pe lole dènge miu j'ara-j'ara dhu j'aj'i le ètu ne'e.

source_text: aristarchus greets you, my fellow-captive, and marcus, the nephew of barnabas concerning whom you received commands-if he may come to you, receive him,
target_text: aristarkus hia lii maho'o kahèi hia miu. ra taha ne ètu d'ara bui sama-sama dènge ja'a. markus, a'ari nèti barnabas, hia lii maho'o kahèi. uru èèna, ja'a moa mema le dènge miu, na, ladhe markus dhiu pangad'o dènge miu, na, sèmi mere ne dènge be'a.

source_text: and jesus who is called justus, who are of circumcision: these are the only fellow-workers for the kingdom of god who become a comfort to me.
target_text: yesus, dhu èdhi pangare ne, yustus hia lii maho'o kahèi mi miu. nèti angalai aa'i-aa'i dhu sama-sama pakako sasab'a ama lamatua, dhoka rèngu tèlu ra se'e ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu sarani nèti suku yahudi. aa rèngu se'e ka dhu pa'èra d'ara ja'a.

source_text: epaphras greets you, who is of you, a servant of christ, always striving for you in the prayers, that you may stand perfect and made full in all the will of god,
target_text: angalai miu epapras ètu ne'e, aa na hia miu lii maho'o kahèi. nèngu ne dhèu sab'a hia yesus kristus. nèngu ne ka dhu loe boe sabaj'a hia miu dènge a'èra na, aa na manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pa'èra dènge tao pamèci miu, aa tao miu j'aj'i me'a mèu dad'èi na.

source_text: for i testify to him that he has much zeal for you, and those in laodicea, and those in hierapolis.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e mema miu, na, epapras ne, dhu sab'a bia hia miu dènge dhèu-dhèu kristen ètu kota laodikia dènge kota herapolis.

source_text: lucas greets you, the beloved physician, and demas;
target_text: abhu lii maho'o kahèi nèti demas dènge dote lukas dhu èdhi sue.

source_text: those in laodicea greet you-brothers, and nymphas, and the assembly in his house;
target_text: ja'a hia lii maho'o mi a'ari dhèu parcaya ètu kota laodikia. baku bhèlu hia lii maho'o ja'a mi mama nimfa dènge dhèu-dhèu parcaya dhu tema pakaboko ètu d'ara èmu na.

source_text: and when the letter may be read with you, cause that it may also be read in the assembly of the laodiceans, and the letter from laodicea that you also may read;
target_text: pe, ladhe miu aa'i-aa'i mi ètu kota kolose baca mere sasuri ne, na, mi pa'adhu hia dhèu-dhèu parcaya ètu kota laodikia, sèna ka rèngu baca kahèi. aa miu hud'i baca kahèi sasuri dhu ja'a pa'adhu kèdhi hia rèngu uru sèra.

source_text: and say to archippus, see to the ministry that you received in the lord, that you may fulfill it.
target_text: pasanèd'e arkipus, peka na, èu baku bhèlu pakako toke pa'èle, sasab'a dhu èu sèmi more nèti lamatua.

source_text: the salutation is by my hand, paul. remember my bonds. the grace is with you! amen.
target_text: baku bhèlu, peka na, ra taha ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne era. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu. sasuri ne, ja'a ènyi ai pake kacui-aai ja'a unu ku. salam nèti ja'a, paulus

source_text: paul, and silvanus, and timotheus, to the assembly of thessalonians in god the father and the lord jesus christ: grace to you and peace from god our father and the lord jesus christ!
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a paulus, dènge angalai ja'a silas dènge timotius. sasuri ne, ji'i pa'adhu hia miu dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i mi ètu kota tesalonika. miu ka dhu pama'ète mere le, ho madhutu ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ji'i manèngi, sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu, ho miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: we always give thanks to god for you all, making mention of you in our prayers,
target_text: ji'i loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula parcaya miu. mèu-mèda ji'i sabaj'a hia miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: unceasingly remembering your work of faith, and the labor of the love, and the endurance of the hope, of our lord jesus christ, in the presence of our god and father,
target_text: ji'i sanèd'e sasab'a dhu miu sab'a, lula miu parcaya ama lamatua, aa sue ne. miu loe boe nèti j'ara èèna, lula era sarai miu ka lamatua yesus. ji'i loe boe kahèi ngèti j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i asa katanga madha ama lamatua.

source_text: having known, beloved brothers, by god, your divine selection,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i nge'a ama lamatua sue miu. nèti èèna ka, na hag'e nare miu j'aj'i dhèu nèngu.

source_text: because our good news did not come to you in word only, but also in power, and in the holy spirit, and in much assurance, even as you have known of what sort we became among you for your sake,
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ji'i dhiu asa tesalonika, ji'i peka-padhai dènge miu lii lolo be'a ama lamatua. lod'o èèna, miu pasa dhilu paie-iie ho nanene lii padhai lii ji'i. miu mesa boe dhoka nanene lii ji'i di, te ngaa miu mèdhi unu mi kahèi koasa ama lamatua nèti roh na dhu mola-mèci èèna. j'ara èèna ka dhu tao miu tare'a-re'a sèmi mere lii lolo be'a èèna. lod'o èèna, miu mèdhi unu mi j'ara mamuri ji'i dhu tasa mera mia, sèna ka me'a tare'a-re'a, j'ara-j'ara lamatua.

source_text: and you became imitators of us and of the lord, having received the word in much tribulation with joy of the holy spirit,
target_text: lula miu pama'ète mere le ho madhutu dad'èi lamatua, nèti èèna ka miu mamuri madhutu tatao ji'i, aa madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus kahèi. te ngaa lod'o miu heka sèmi mere lii lolo be'a èèna, abhu dhèu dhu pasusa miu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara miu kalau boe-karèto boe, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci pakarej'e d'ara miu.

source_text: so that you became patterns to all those believing in macedonia and achaia,
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, miu pad'elo j'ara hia dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ètu propensi makedonia dènge propensi akaya.

source_text: for from you has sounded forth the word of the lord, not only in macedonia and achaia, but also in every place your faith toward god went forth, so that we have no need to say anything,
target_text: mesa boe ètu sèi di. te lii lolo be'a lamatua dhu pale-lème le tesalonika nèti miu se'e ka toke mia-mia. de ji'i peka ngaa hari, lula dhèu aa'i-aa'i tadèngi le lalèka miu mi lamatua.

source_text: for they themselves declare concerning us what entrance we had to you, and how you turned to god from the idols, to serve a living and true god,
target_text: ètu mia-mia dhèu palolo, peka na, miu uru na sèmi mere ji'i dènge d'ara kateme. ka miu core eele mèdha-mèdha sogo-tagu mi, hèia mai madhutu lamatua dhu tare'a-re'a. te miu me'a le, na, lamatua èèna nuka ama lamatua dhu mamuri. nèti èèna ka, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti madhutu ne.

source_text: and to wait for his son from the heavens, whom he raised out of the dead-jesus, who is rescuing us from the anger that is coming.
target_text: rèngu palolo kahèi, na, miu tatae mamai ana ama lamatua nèti sorga, nuka yesus. uru èèna dhèu pamadhe ne, te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari ne. lod'o ama lamatua huku dhèu rai-haha ne, na, lamatua yesus ka dhu pakaj'èu èdhi nèti nanasa ama lamatua.

source_text: for you have known, brothers, that our entrance to you has not been in vain,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a le lod'o ji'i dhiu sab'a ètu tesalonika, èi kabhèsu ji'i suti boe iia d'ara.

source_text: but having both suffered before, and having been mistreated as you have known in philippi, we were bold in our god to speak to you the good news of god in much conflict,
target_text: miu sanèd'e kahèi lod'o ji'i dhiu mèka asa tesalonika, dhèu nèti kota pilipi dhu tao le pasusa dènge paj'èra ji'i. te ngaa lula lamatua pa'èra d'ara ji'i, ka ji'i bani lole lii lolo be'a lamatua dènge miu, masi ka dhèu ae dhu pamusu dènge ji'i.

source_text: for our exhortation is not out of deceit, nor out of uncleanness, nor in guile,
target_text: lod'o èèna, ji'i ngèti lii lolo be'a hia miu asa tesalonika, ngèti boe lii aj'a-nori dhu koe-kapengo. te ji'i dhiu tao boe pagoa dènge pakapod'e-kabèli miu.

source_text: but as we have been approved by god to be entrusted with the good news, so we speak, not as pleasing men, but god, who is proving our hearts,
target_text: aad'o! uru èèna ji'i dhiu dènge d'ara mola. ama lamatua mesa na dhu paj'uj'u ji'i, ho ngèti lii lolo be'a na asa miu. ji'i se neo boe pakarej'e d'ara dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa pakarej'e d'ara lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu patigi nèdhi d'ara ji'i, sèna ka ne'a, mola do koe.

source_text: for at no time did we come with speech of flattery as you have known, nor in a pretext for covetousness god is witness,
target_text: miu me'a kahèi, na, ji'i se hèb'a mènyi boe, ngaa hari tenge leto ca doi sa nèti miu. ama lamatua dhu ne'a d'ara ji'i.

source_text: nor seeking glory from men, neither from you nor from others, being able to be burdensome, as christ's apostles.
target_text: sasab'a ji'i ne tenge boe lii koa-kad'iri nèti dhèu rai-haha, do nèti miu, aa nèti dhèu leo kara kahèi.

source_text: but we became gentle in your midst, as a nurse may nurture her own children,
target_text: ji'i se dhèu pajuu-paleha kristus. ji'i dènge hak kahèi, tao ngi'u sama sèmi dhèu aae-dhèu kapai, te ngaa ji'i ngo'o boe padedha iisi sèmi èèna. lod'o sèra, ji'i tao ngi'u ji'i èci èèna ka dènge ana iiki ètu talora aae miu. ji'i pad'elo sasue mi dedha miu kahèi, nuka sèmi ina dhu pasusu ana na.

source_text: so being desirous of you, we are well-pleased to impart to you not only the good news of god, but also our own souls, because you have become beloved to us,
target_text: ji'i dhiu ho mesa boe dhoka ngèti lii lolo be'a hia miu di, te ngaa ji'i soro iisi kateme aae kahèi, lula ji'i sue miu seli eele.

source_text: for you remember, brothers, our labor and travail, for working night and day not to be a burden on any of you, we preached the good news of god to you;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ele boe miu sanèd'e era, ji'i sab'a dhu nge'a boe j'èra mèu-mèda, ho abhu unu mi nganga'a-nganginu. te ji'i d'èi boe paj'èra miu lod'o ngèti lii lolo be'a asa miu.

source_text: you are witnesses-god also-how piously and righteously and blamelessly we became to you who believe,
target_text: miu mèdhi unu mi, sèmi èèna kahèi ama lamatua, ropa dhu ji'i bera-bera dènge miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu parcaya le, ji'i mamuri dènge d'ara mola, dhu tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: even as you have known how we are exhorting each one of you, as a father his own children, and comforting, and testifying,
target_text: miu me'a kahèi, ji'i lalau-lalo'o miu, èci èèna ka dènge ama matana ladhe-leru ana-ana na,

source_text: for your walking worthily of god, who is calling you to his own kingdom and glory.
target_text: nuka sèmi: pa'èra d'ara miu aa'i-aa'i mi, pasanèd'e dènge pamako miu sèna ka mamuri dhu mèci, ho pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. te nèngu ka j'aj'i dhèu aae, dhu paroa le miu sèna ka j'aj'i ana kabarai na, aa abhu pakab'ua bera-bera dènge nèngu.

source_text: and because of this we also continually give thanks to god, that, having received the word of god by your hearing from us, you accepted, not the word of men, but as it truly is, the word of god, who also works in you who believe;
target_text: ji'i ma'ète boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula lod'o miu tadèngi lii lolo nèti ji'i, miu sèmi mere boe lii holo-nori nèti dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa lii holo-nori èèna kapua na nèti ama lamatua. nèngu unu na ka dhu sab'a ètu d'ara miu dhèu parcaya.

source_text: for you became imitators, brothers, of the assemblies of god that are in judea in christ jesus, because you suffered such things, even you, from your own countrymen, as they also from the jews,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu heka madhutu j'ara lamatua kèna, te ngaa dhèu-dhèu miu pasusa le miu. de miu se abhu j'aj'èra èci èèna ka dènge dhèu parcaya ètu propensi yudea, dhu dhèu yahudi rèngu mesa ra paj'èra rèngu lula ra lèka yesus kristus.

source_text: who put to death both the lord jesus and their own prophets, and persecuted us, and they are not pleasing god, and are contrary to all men,
target_text: abhu dhèu yahudi dhu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ropa ama lamatua pua dhèu rèti lii padhai na mai asa rèngu, ka rèngu paj'èra dènge hake pamadhe si. ra pamadhe lamatua yesus dènge j'ara sèmi èèna kahèi. limuri ne, ra tenge j'ara ho babèga eele ji'i kahèi. rèngu pamusu dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka ama lamatua d'èi boe rèngu.

source_text: forbidding us to speak to the nations that they might be saved, so as to always fill up their sins, but god's anger came on them-to the end!
target_text: ngaa hari, ra tenge j'ara ae-ae sèna ka ji'i pakako ia ka lii lolo be'a hia dhèu leo. dhèu yahudi se ro'o boe ho lamatua pala-bagi mamuri hia dhèu leo kara kahèi. dènge j'ara èèna ka, sasala rèngu sèmi tao udhu sa. hèia ama lamatua nasa, ka huku si.

source_text: and we, brothers, having been taken from you for the space of an hour-in presence, not in heart-hurried more abundantly to see your face in much desire;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! masi ka èdhi pakaj'èu, te ngaa pakaj'èu boe ètu d'ara. ji'i tenge-tenge j'ara, ho ladhe abhu lod'o dhu taleo, ji'i dhiu hari pa'asu-pareo dènge miu, te d'ara ji'i neo ae le.

source_text: for this reason we wished to come to you i, indeed, paul, both once and again, and satan hindered us;
target_text: ja'a mesa ku neo ae le kahèi dhiu pangad'o dènge miu, te ngaa dhèu aae nidhu loe boe bhabhae ja'a.

source_text: for what is our hope, or joy, or garland of rejoicing? are not even you before our lord jesus christ at his coming?
target_text: miu me'a, nga tao ka ji'i neo dhiu paraga dènge miu, sina ma? lula ji'i maena miu. miu ka dhu pakarej'e dènge pa'adhu d'ara ji'i. ladhe miu aad'o, cee hari ka dhu kèpe pa'èra kolongara lamatua yesus! ladhe lamatua lèpa hari mai, d'ara ji'i taleo, lula miu se'e ka.

source_text: for you are our glory and joy.
target_text: mema tare'a! miu se'e se ka dhu pakab'ua sasab'a ji'i aa pataleo d'ara ji'i.

source_text: for this reason, enduring no longer, we thought good to be left in athens alone, and sent timotheus-our brother, and a servant of god, and our fellow-workman in the good news of the christ-to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith,
target_text: sèna ka miu me'a, ca hari ni ji'i kako tèke eele miu èèna, madhutu boe dad'èi ji'i. ji'i neo ae le dhiu paraga dènge miu, te ngaa bisa mèka. lula ji'i ngo'o heka mate panèbhu, hèia ji'i pama'ète le ho pua timotius dhiu. te ngaa ja'a dènge silas pea ètu kota atena. timotius ne a'ari ji'i. nèngu ne angalai ji'i ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a, dhu bera-bera pakako lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. ji'i pua na dhiu, ho na aj'a miu aa pa'èra d'ara miu, sèna ka miu asa parcaya èra ama lamatua.

source_text: that no one be moved in these tribulations, for you have known that we are set for this,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe miu paraga dènge sasusa, d'ara miu roe boe. kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka miu. te miu me'a le, dhèu cee dhu parcaya kristus, tatu na paraga dènge j'aj'èra.

source_text: for even when we were with you, we said to you beforehand that we are about to suffer tribulation, as it also came to pass, and you have known it;
target_text: ca hari ni, lod'o ji'i dènge miu era, ji'i pasanèd'e le miu, peka na, dhèu cee dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, bèli-camèd'a paraga dènge rupa-rupa sasusa. limuri ne j'aj'i le, si!

source_text: because of this also, i, no longer enduring, sent to know your faith, lest he who is tempting tempted you, and our labor might be in vain.
target_text: lula ja'a susa titu kèna nèti j'aj'èra miu se'e ka, nèti èèna ka ja'a pua timotius dhiu asa tesalonika, ho ji'i nge'a mèu kèna, miu parcaya era lamatua, do aad'o. te ja'a mage-mage, dhèu aae nidhu dadugu miu, ho miu soro kabodho mi lamatua. ladhe j'aj'i ka sèmi èèna, sasab'a ji'i uru sèra, ele iie d'ara!

source_text: and timotheus now having come to us from you, and having declared good news to us of your faith and love, and that you always have a good remembrance of us, desiring much to see us, as we also to see you,
target_text: lai-lai ne, timotius lèpa hari mai nèti tesalonika. ka nèti lii dhu pakarej'e d'ara ji'i. na lolo, na, miu parcaya kristus era, aa miu èci pasue dènge èci. na peka kahèi, na, miu ngee ji'i sèmi mia dhu ji'i sanèd'e miu kahèi.

source_text: because of this we were comforted, brothers, over you, in all our tribulation and necessity, through your faith, because now we live, if you may stand fast in the lord.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! masi ka ètu ne'e ji'i ako rasa bia, lula abhu susa ae nèti mia-mia, te ngaa ropa tadèngi lii lolo timotius, ka d'ara ji'i tare'a-re'a abhu karej'e. lula limuri ne ji'i nge'a le miu parcaya lamatua era.

source_text: for what thanks are we able to repay to god for you, for all the joy with which we delight because of you in the presence of our god,
target_text: de ji'i manèngi makasi ae-ae mi lamatua dènge d'ara dhu karej'e titu kèna, lula miu madhutu ne taruu.

source_text: exceedingly imploring night and day, that we might see your face, and perfect the things lacking in your faith?
target_text: mèu-mèda ji'i loe boe sabaj'a sèna ka catèka sa èdhi paraga hari. ji'i neo aj'a miu sèna ka pamèci d'ara miu ètu j'ara mamuri lamatua.

source_text: and our god and father himself, and our lord jesus christ, direct our way to you,
target_text: ji'i sanao sèna ka ama lamatua èdhi, aa kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, bhoke j'ara sèna ka ji'i dhiu paraga hari dènge miu.

source_text: and the lord cause you to increase and to abound in the love to one another, and to all, even as we also to you,
target_text: ji'i manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia miu asa pasue risi eele hari. nuka sèmi èèna kahèi miu dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra asa pasue, sèmi dhu ji'i sue miu.

source_text: in order to have established your hearts, blameless in sanctification before our god and father, at the coming of our lord jesus christ with all his holy ones.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna lamatua pa'èra d'ara miu, ho mamuri mola dènge mera-milu, toke bèli-camèd'a lamatua yesus lèpa hari mai dènge dhèu unu na, miu bisa titu kahèi ètu katanga madha ama lamatua èdhi, dènge dui heka sasala-sasigo.

source_text: as to the rest, then, brothers, we request, and call on you in the lord jesus, as you received from us how it is necessary for you to walk and to please god, that you may abound the more,
target_text: de a'ari, sèmi ne'e ka! ji'i pamako miu sèna ka miu mamuri pamaho'o d'ara ama lamatua, sèmi dhu ji'i aj'a le miu. mema mamuri miu madhutu le j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i, te ngaa lula èdhi j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua yesus, ka ji'i manèngi miu ho tenge j'ara dhu be'a risi hari.

source_text: for you have known what commands we gave you through the lord jesus;
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a le ngaa dhu ji'i aj'a miu, pake koasa nèti lamatua yesus.

source_text: for this is the will of god-your sanctification: that you abstain from the whoredom,
target_text: dad'èi ama lamatua nuka: mamuri mola-mèci! baku mamuri kaj'alu ètu d'ara pa'èci bhèni-mone.

source_text: that each of you know to possess his own vessel in sanctification and honor,
target_text: miu hud'i me'a lalau ngi'u miu unu mi, sèna ka mamuri mola-mèci ho dhèu pakab'ua miu.

source_text: not in the affection of desire, as also the nations that were not knowing god,
target_text: baku mamuri madhutu dad'èi d'ara mi, sèmi dhèu dhu dhae tadhe mèka ama lamatua.

source_text: that no one goes beyond and defrauds his brother in the matter, because the lord is an avenger of all these, as we also spoke to you before and testified,
target_text: mage abhu dhèu dhu neo tao karehe, aa neo tenge oto dhu risi nèti dhèu dhu sama-sama parcaya ama lamatua. te ama lamatua ka, kètu dhu èèna na b'ala bhabhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i sèra. j'ara se'e, ji'i peka le dènge miu pèri-pèri hari, aa pasanèd'e le miu karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: for god did not call us to uncleanness, but in sanctification.
target_text: te ama lamatua paroa nare le èdhi sèna ka j'aj'i mi dhèu unu na. madhutu dad'èi na, èdhi hud'i mamuri dènge mola-mèci, baku dènge kaj'alu, sèmi dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae. baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: he, therefore, who is despising, does not despise man, but god, who also gave his holy spirit to us.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu cee ka dhu madhutu boe lii holo-nori ne, nèngu èèna sèmi boe ji'i, aa tule eele ama lamatua kahèi dhu hia le miu roh na dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: and concerning the brotherly love, you have no need of my writing to you, for you yourselves are god-taught to love one another,
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, suri hari ia ka hia miu j'ara-j'ara pasue a'ari dènge a'ari, lula ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka le, na, miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci.

source_text: for you do it also to all the brothers who are in all macedonia; and we call on you, brothers, to abound still more,
target_text: ji'i tadèngi le, miu sue a'ari aa'i-aa'i ètu propensi makedonia nèi. te ngaa a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i manèngi sèna ka miu sue dhèu leo risi eele hari.

source_text: and to study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you,
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka miu mamuri dènge mera-milu. baku soro iisi sa d'ara lii langu dhèu leo, te ngaa èci-èci ka laladhe mamuri na. miu hud'i sab'a tenge nganga'a-nganginu dènge kacui-aai miu mesa mi. baku maena dhèu leo. se'e se ji'i pasanèd'e le miu, karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: that you may walk properly to those outside, and may have lack of nothing.
target_text: ladhe miu mamuri sèmi èèna, miu pabia boe dhèu leo. ladhe dhèu dhu lèka boe kristus rèdhi miu mamuri sèmi èèna, tatu ra peka na, waa! dhèu dhu madhutu lamatua yesus sèra, mamuri ra mola tare'a, nga!

source_text: and i do not wish you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, that you may not sorrow, as also the rest who have no hope,
target_text: a'ari! limuri ne, ja'a neo peka ngaa èci, sèna ka miu me'a mèu, j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti dhèu madhe. èdhi te'a, na, dhèu dhu madhe le, bèli-camèd'a, na mamuri hari. de ladhe nèti dhèu unu lamatua èci madhe, miu baku tao ngi'u mi j'èra nuka sèmi dhèu leo dhu re'a boe j'ara èèna.

source_text: for if we believe that jesus died and rose again, so also god will bring with him those asleep through jesus,
target_text: te èdhi te'a, na, yesus dhu madhe le, ka ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. de ladhe sèmi èèna, tatu ama lamatua pamamuri hari kahèi dhèu parcaya dhu madhe sèra, aa oru nare si aa'i-aa'i ra bera-bera dènge lamatua yesus.

source_text: for we say this to you in the word of the lord, that we who are living-who remain over to the coming of the lord-may not precede those asleep, because the lord himself, with a shout, with the voice of a chief-messenger, and with the trumpet of god, will come down from heaven, and the dead in christ will rise first; then we who are living, who are remaining over, will be snatched up together with them in the clouds to meet the lord in the air, and so we will always be with the lord;
target_text: de ladhe lamatua yesus mai hari, na puru nèti sorga asa rai-haha ne, èèna na dènge paredha dhu lii mèdhu aae. ka kètu kapai nèti ana-ana pajuu ètu sorga hia paredha ho tiu tèbhe. hèia dhèu unu lamatua dhu madhe sèra, mamuri hari. ka rèngu dènge èdhi dhu mamuri era, lèke ded'e asa ra'i-liru, ho aa'i-aa'i ti soru mamai lamatua yesus. èle èèna na, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti mamuri pa'èci dènge ne taa-taa. mi nanene pabe'a-be'a, lula ngaa dhu ji'i peka ne, lamatua unu na ka dhu peka-padhai.

source_text: so, then, comfort one another with these words.
target_text: de ladhe sèmi èèna, miu hud'i pa'èki lii aj'a-nori ne, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara miu èci dènge èci.

source_text: and concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need of my writing to you,
target_text: de a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i suri ia ka laa, peka na, mamai lamatua lèke hake pèri, do tanggal pèri.

source_text: for you have thoroughly known that the day of the lord so comes as a thief in the night,
target_text: lula miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, mamai na dènge sahèka, sèmi dhèu mana'u dhu mai re mèda.

source_text: for when they may say, peace and security, then sudden destruction comes on them, as the travail on her who is with child, and they will not escape;
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae dhu madhèdi mau-mau, te ngaa cag'ag'a laa paraga dènge j'aj'èra. mamai na sama kahèi dènge dhèu bhèni dhu cag'ag'a laa kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi. ladhe paraga le j'ara ne'e, èdhi pakaj'èu iisi tasamia hari! èci èèna ka dènge mamai lamatua.

source_text: but you, brothers, are not in darkness, that the day may catch you as a thief; you are all sons of light, and sons of day; we are not of night, nor of darkness, so, then, we may not sleep as also the others, but watch and be sober,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! mage dhoka mamai na nuka sèmi dhèu mana'u dhu mai re talora mèda, lèke dènge miu dhu bhèj'i luu. mage lèke miu sèmi èèna kahèi! èdhi mamuri heka ètu d'ara maroga, sèmi dhèu leo dhu bhèj'i luu era. de èdhi dhu lèka le lamatua yesus, mamuri le ètu d'ara saraa, ti pa'èra soru mamai ne, aa j'aga paie mamuri èdhi. j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i miu me'a le!

source_text: for those sleeping, sleep by night, and those making themselves drunk, are drunken by night,
target_text: te dhèu dhu bhèj'i, na, bhèj'i re mèda. aa dhèu dhu mahu, na, mahu re mèda.

source_text: and we, being of the day-let us be sober, putting on a breastplate of faith and love, and a helmet-a hope of salvation,
target_text: te ngaa miu baku sèmi èèna, lula èdhi dhu mamuri le ètu d'ara saraa. miu hud'i j'aga paie mamuri miu. ladhe miu parcaya taruu lamatua aa mamuri pasue, èèna sama sèmi sordad'u dhu pake kodho bèsi dhu pa'abhe kakara. aa ladhe miu maena taruu mi lamatua yesus dhu hia miu pakaj'èu nèti nanasa ama lamatua, èci èèna ka dènge sordad'u dhu pa'abhe kètu na dènge solo bèsi.

source_text: because god did not appoint us to anger, but to the acquiring of salvation through our lord jesus christ,
target_text: ama lamatua hag'e boe èdhi ho na huku ti. te ngaa na hag'e èdhi sèna ka abhu mamuri, sad'i èdhi lèka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: who died for us, that whether we wake-whether we sleep-we may live together with him;
target_text: te na madhe le gati èdhi. de ladhe na lèpa hari mai, èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge ne, masi ka èdhi madhe le, do mamuri era.

source_text: for this reason, comfort one another, and build up one another, as also you do.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, pake lii-lii ja'a se'e, sèna ka hia karej'e dènge pa'èra èci dènge èci, sèmi dhu miu tao le karèi nèti uru èèna ka.

source_text: and we ask you, brothers, to know those laboring among you and leading you in the lord and admonishing you,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! sanèd'e ho pakab'ua ina-ama dhu j'aj'i kètu ètu juma'at. te rèngu sèra sab'a dhu re'a boe j'èra hia miu, aa pasanèd'e miu, sèna ka miu baku manahu asa d'ara sasala.

source_text: and to esteem them very abundantly in love, because of their work; be at peace among yourselves;
target_text: pad'elo sasue miu dènge ra, sèna ka re'a, na, miu pakab'ua si, lula rèngu sab'a bia hia miu. mamuri dame èci dènge èci.

source_text: and we exhort you, brothers, admonish the disorderly, comfort the feeble-minded, support the weak, be patient to all;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! abhu pèri-pèri j'ara era dhu ji'i neo pasanèd'e miu: dhèu dhu bai-eed'a sèra, peka si sèna ka ra sab'a dènge d'ara maj'èni. dhu d'ara roe, pa'èra si. dhu haha, sarimu mere si. taha d'ara aa lii mako mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: see that no one may render evil for evil to anyone, but always pursue that which is good, both to one another and to all;
target_text: sanèd'e, bhabhelu baku b'ala dènge bhabhelu. te ngaa tenge j'ara sèna ka tao be'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. baku tao be'a dhoka dènge dhèu èdhi di, te ngaa dènge dhèu leo kara kahèi.

source_text: always rejoice;
target_text: pakarej'e d'ara taruu.

source_text: continually pray;
target_text: sabaj'a mèu-mèda.

source_text: give thanks in everything, for this is the will of god in christ jesus in regard to you.
target_text: sad'i paraga dènge ngaa èèna ka, j'aj'èra, do karej'e-karae, manèngi makasi mi lamatua. te ama lamatua d'èi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu yesus kristus tao sèmi èèna.

source_text: do not quench the spirit;
target_text: baku magee sasab'a roh lamatua.

source_text: do not despise prophesyings;
target_text: ladhe abhu ca dhèu nèti talora dhèu parcaya dhu peka na, nèngu abhu le lii moa nèti ama lamatua, mage miu pusi-pahae boe lii padhai na!

source_text: prove all things; hold fast to that which is good;
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i kanucu ku paie-iie lii èèna mai tare'a nèti lamatua, do aad'o. ladhe tare'a, na, madhutu.

source_text: abstain from all appearance of evil;
target_text: te ngaa pakaj'èu nèti ngaa-ngaa dhu karehe.

source_text: and may the god of peace himself sanctify you wholly, and may your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved, unblameably at the coming of our lord jesus christ; he who is calling you is steadfast, who also will do it.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a manèngi ama lamatua ho pamèu d'ara dènge mamuri miu aa'i-aa'i mi. nèngu èèna ka dhu uri ho èdhi bisa mamuri dame èci dènge èci. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, ladhe d'ai lod'o mamai hari lamatua èdhi, yesus kristus, miu bisa titu ètu katanga madha na dènge ngi'u aae miu, d'ara miu, dènge samanga miu dhu dènge boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. j'ara na sèmi èèna ka! te lamatua yesus dhu paroa miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, dhu monya boe. ngaa dhu na peka, na tao madhutu sama sèmi èèna ka. de èèna na, na lere nèti miu dènge mola-mèci asa katanga madha ama lamatua.

source_text: brothers, pray for us.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku bhèlu manèngi-mangaj'i hia ji'i ètu ne'e.

source_text: greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu hia lii maho'o ji'i kahèi mi dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra!

source_text: i charge you by the lord, that the letter be read to all the holy brothers.
target_text: ja'a manèngi dènge kolongara lamatua yesus, ho miu baca hia juma'at aa'i-aa'i ra isi sasuri ja'a ne.

source_text: the grace of our lord jesus christ is with you! amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka. saloom, paulus

source_text: paul, and silvanus, and timotheus, to the assembly of thessalonians in god our father, and the lord jesus christ:
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a paulus, aa angalai ja'a, silas dènge timotius. sasuri ne'e, ji'i pa'adhu hia miu dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i ètu kota tesalonika. miu ka dhu pama'ète mere le, ho madhutu ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: grace to you and peace from god our father and the lord jesus christ!
target_text: ji'i manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra hia miu, ho miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: we always ought to give thanks to god for you, brothers, as it is fitting, because your faith increases greatly, and the love of each one of you all abounds to one another,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dhu lèke, ladhe èdhi loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula miu asa parcaya ne, aa asa pasue èci dènge èci.

source_text: so that we ourselves glory in you in the assemblies of god, for your endurance and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that you bear-
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ji'i palolo dènge dhèu sarani ètu mia-mia, lula-nèti mamuri miu. ji'i palolo, peka na, masi ka dhèu leo paj'èra miu, te ngaa miu rai boe nèti parcaya mi.

source_text: a token of the righteous judgment of god, for your being counted worthy of the kingdom of god, for which you also suffer,
target_text: se'e se peka na, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua j'ue lii langu miu dènge mola. te j'aj'èra dhu miu pasae èèna ka, hia miu nia j'aj'i mi dhèu unu na. aa nèngu èèna, dhèu aae miu.

source_text: since it is a righteous thing with god to give back to those troubling you-tribulation,
target_text: baku madha'u, te lamatua pama'ète lii langu dènge boe bia cabèka. mi ladhe, ee! bèli-camèd'a na b'ala mi dhèu dhu paj'èra miu.

source_text: and to you who are troubled-rest with us in the revelation of the lord jesus from heaven, with messengers of his power,
target_text: aa nèngu hia miu ae mere d'ara nèti j'aj'èra dhu mi pasae kahèi. sèmi èèna mi dedha ji'i kahèi. se'e se j'aj'i, lod'o lamatua yesus puru mai nèti sorga, palere-lere dènge ana pajuu na sèra dhu èra titu kèna.

source_text: in flaming fire, giving vengeance to those not knowing god, and to those not obeying the good news of our lord jesus christ,
target_text: rèngu puru mai dènge ai dhu heo robhe-robhe. hèia na b'ala mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ro'o boe tadhe ama lamatua, aa dhu madhutu boe lii lolo be'a nèti lamatua yesus.

source_text: who will suffer justice-continuous destruction-from the face of the lord, and from the glory of his strength,
target_text: na hia huku dhu bia titu kèna mi rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka palaho si taa-taa. na babège si nèti katanga madha na, ka ra rasa heka koasa lamatua dhu kapai.

source_text: when he may come to be glorified in his holy ones, and to be wondered at by all those believing-because our testimony was believed among you-in that day;
target_text: lod'o na mai èèna, dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ra paca'e padedha-dedha kolongara na, aa ra pakab'ua ne. bèli-camèd'a miu ètu talora aae dhèu-dhèu parcaya sèra kahèi, lula miu sèmi mere le lii lolo be'a dhu uru èèna ji'i peka le dènge miu.

source_text: for which we also always pray for you, that our god may count you worthy of the calling, and may fulfill all the good pleasure of goodness, and the work of faith in power,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mèu-mèda ji'i ma'ète boe manèngi-mangaj'i hia miu, sèna ka madhutu a'abhu ama lamatua, na, miu nia j'aj'i dhèu unu na. ji'i manèngi sèna ka na hia koasa na mi miu kahèi, ho miu bisa tao madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a madhutu ngaa dhu miu parcaya, aa madhutu ngaa dhu miu neo tao.

source_text: that the name of our lord jesus christ may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our god and lord jesus christ.
target_text: ladhe miu mamuri dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, dhèu ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua yesus. aa miu abhu koa-kad'iri kahèi, lula miu madhutu ne. se'e aa'i-aa'i ra, mai nèti babe'a d'ara ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: and we ask you, brothers, in regard to the coming of our lord jesus christ, and of our gathering together to him,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ne'e ne ji'i neo peka dènge miu pèri lod'o kètu èdhi, yesus kristus puru mai, aa dènge j'ara tasamia èdhi bisa pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: that you are not quickly shaken in mind, nor be troubled, neither through spirit, neither through word, neither through letters as through us, as that the day of the lord has arrived;
target_text: dhèu baku pagoa miu ho mi ele ngangee ropa tadèngi dhèu peka, na, lamatua dhu mai hari le. masi ka ra peka, na, rèngu tadèngi nèti roh lamatua, do nèti dhèu, do abhu sasuri nèti ji'i, mage miu lèka kahèi. te sèra sa ra leko-monya!

source_text: do not let anyone deceive you in any way, because if the departure may not come first, the man of lawlessness may not be revealed-the son of destruction,
target_text: baku soro tèka dhèu pagoa miu. te bèli-camèd'a ca dhèu dhu bhelu-katub'a cèu uuru mai, heka lamatua yesus lèpa hari kèna. dhèu ne'e ne, palab'a dènge lamatua, toke dhèu ae madhutu ne ho palab'a dènge lamatua kahèi. dhèu ne'e ne mema seli-kolane! nèti èèna ka, nèngu hud'i maso ku asa d'ara naraka.

source_text: who is opposing and is raising himself up above all called god or worshiped, so as for him to have sat down in the temple of god, proclaiming that he is god.
target_text: na padedha iisi na risi nèti dewa aa'i-aa'i ra, aa palab'a aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu sogo-tagu. toke na maso asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, ka na padedha iisi, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, lamatua!

source_text: do you not remember that, yet being with you, i said these things to you?
target_text: miu sanèd'e, do aad'o? uru èèna ja'a dhu peka le dènge miu, lula dhèu èèna, lod'o dhu ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era, si?

source_text: and now, you have known what is restraining, for his being revealed in his own time,
target_text: limuri ne, d'ai mèka lod'o ho dhèu bhelu-katub'a èèna pacèu iisi na, lula abhu dhu pahèb'e ne era. aa miu me'a kahèi ngaa ka dhu pahèb'e ne!

source_text: for the secret of lawlessness already works, only the one now restraining will do so until he may come out of the midst,
target_text: limuri ne dhèu bhelu èèna sab'a pahuni-pahuni era, lula abhu dhu pahèb'e ne. te ngaa ladhe bèli-camèd'a dhu pahèb'e na, patabuli ka ai na,

source_text: and then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the lord will consume with the spirit of his mouth, and will nullify at the appearance of his coming,
target_text: hèia dhèu bhelu ne cèu mai dènge pahuni heka sasab'a na. te ngaa lèke dènge lod'o kapai mamai lamatua yesus, ka na palaho dhèu bhelu-katub'a ne dènge pake lii ca hèb'a doko di.

source_text: whose coming is according to the working of satan, in all power, and signs, and lying wonders,
target_text: te ngaa lod'o lamatua yesus dhae d'ai mèka, dhèu aae nidhu hia koasa kapai hia mi dhèu bhelu ne, sèna ka bisa na tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa, hèia dhèu pangee, na, nèngu ne pake koasa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and in all deceitfulness of the unrighteousness in those perishing, because they did not receive the love of the truth for their being saved,
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu ae ka dhu lèke tipu nèti dhèu bhelu-katub'a ne. rèngu se'e ka dhu d'èi palaho iisi ra. ama lamatua dhu bhoke j'ara hia si mamuri, te ngaa ro'o boe sèmi dad'èi na dhu hua iia èèna, aa ro'o boe parcaya ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: and because of this god will send to them a working of delusion, for their believing the lie,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua pabèdhu d'ara ra nèti ngaa dhu lèke, sèna ka hud'i laa ra parcaya mi kapod'e-kabèli sèra.

source_text: that they may be judged-all who did not believe the truth, but were well pleased in the unrighteousness.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e ka, ama lamatua hia si huku dhu bia, lula rèngu lèka boe ngaa dhu tare'a. te rèngu d'èi risi tao dhu karehe.

source_text: and we ought to give thanks to god always for you, brothers, beloved by the lord, that god chose you from the beginning to salvation, in sanctification of the spirit, and belief of the truth,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ji'i loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, lula na sue miu. te lod'o na paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, nèngu pama'ète nare le, sèna ka hia miu mamuri. ka na hia roh na ho pamèu miu, lula miu parcaya ngaa dhu tare'a.

source_text: to which he called you through our good news, to the acquiring of the glory of our lord jesus christ;
target_text: lod'o ji'i lole lii lolo be'a dènge miu, ama lamatua pake lii lolo be'a na ho ère miu, sèna ka miu me'a dadedha dènge kapai nèti lamatua yesus kristus.

source_text: so, then, brothers, stand fast, and hold the traditions that you were taught, whether through word, whether through our letter;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! taha d'ara dènge kèpe pa'ère-ère lii holo-nori dhu ji'i peka le dènge miu. sanèd'e kahèi aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ji'i.

source_text: and may our lord jesus christ himself, and our god and father, who loved us, and gave continuous comfort, and good hope in grace, comfort your hearts, and establish you in every good word and work.
target_text: ji'i manèngi-mangaj'i taruu mi ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ji'i manèngi sèna ka rèngu pa'èra d'ara miu, ho miu bisa tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. ji'i manèngi sèmi èèna, lula ji'i nge'a ama lamatua sue titu kèna mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. lula d'ara na hua iia, nèti èèna ka nèngu loe boe pa'èra d'ara èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa sanao-maena taruu mi nèngu.

source_text: as to the rest, pray, brothers, concerning us, that the word of the lord may run and may be glorified, as also with you,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku bhèlu sabaj'a hia ji'i. sabaj'a sèna ka lii lolo be'a lamatua, pale-palème asa mia-mia dènge malai, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa pakab'ua lii lolo be'a èèna, sèmi dhu lod'o miu abhu lii lolo be'a ca hari ni.

source_text: and that we may be delivered from the unreasonable and evil men, for not all are of the faith;
target_text: sabaj'a sèna ka ji'i pakaj'èu nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu tao kaco, aa nèti dhèu bhelu leo sèra, te dhèu aa'i boe dhu parcaya lii lolo be'a èèna.

source_text: but faithful is the lord who will establish you, and will guard you from the evil one;
target_text: te ngaa lamatua kèpe pa'ère lii padhai na. nèngu tao pa'èra miu, aa na bhiri miu nèti dhu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and we now have confidence in the lord, that which we command you both do and will do;
target_text: aa ji'i nge'a tare'a kahèi, na, lamatua yesus hia miu madhutu ngaa dhu ji'i lole le dènge miu. ka tatu miu tao madhutu le sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and the lord direct your hearts to the love of god, and to the endurance of the christ.
target_text: ji'i sanao ho lamatua yesus sanoro miu, sèna ka asa me'a, na, ama lamatua sue miu, ka miu èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, nuka sèmi kristus uru èèna taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra na.

source_text: and we command you, brothers, in the name of our lord jesus christ, to withdraw yourselves from every brother walking disorderly, and not after the tradition that you received from us,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a peka mema miu dènge ale ngara lamatua yesus kristus! baku lami pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu bai-eed'a dhu re'a dhoka rodha di. te rèngu sèra madhutu boe èdhi dhu maj'èni sab'a bia.

source_text: for you have known how it is necessary to imitate us, because we did not act disorderly among you;
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, miu hud'i laladhe ku j'ara mamuri ji'i, lod'o ji'i pea ètu talora aae miu. miu mèdhi unu mi. ji'i ngo'o boe core eele lod'o iia d'ara.

source_text: nor did we eat bread of anyone for nothing, but in labor and in travail, working night and day, not to be chargeable to any of you;
target_text: ji'i sab'a bia mèu-mèda, sèna ka ji'i baku pabia miu. ji'i sèmi boe iia d'ara, nganga'a-nganginu nèti dhèu.

source_text: not because we have no authority, but that we might give ourselves to you as a pattern, to imitate us;
target_text: ji'i se dhèu sab'a nèti lamatua. de ji'i dènge hak kahèi manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti miu. te ngaa ji'i ngo'o boe tao sèmi èèna. ji'i neo pad'elo j'ara dhu be'a sèna ka miu madhutu.

source_text: for even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if anyone is not willing to work, neither let him eat,
target_text: uru èèna, ji'i hia le kahèi atora dhu peka na, dhèu cee dhu ro'o boe sab'a, baku hia ra'a-rinu.

source_text: for we hear of some walking disorderly among you, working nothing, but being busybodies,
target_text: ji'i tadèngi lii, peka na, nèti talora aae miu abhu dhèu dhu bai-eed'a, ro'o boe sab'a. rèngu sèra re'a dhoka bhute dènge soro iisi ra asa d'ara lii langu dhèu leo.

source_text: and such we command and exhort through our lord jesus christ, that working with quietness, they may eat their own bread;
target_text: ji'i pasanèd'e dhèu sèmi sèra, dènge kolongara lamatua yesus kristus, sèna ka rèngu ele-ho'a. be'a risi rèngu sab'a tenge nganga'a-nganginu dènge èi kabhèsu unu ra.

source_text: and you, brothers, may you not be weary doing well,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu baku roca tao j'ara dhu be'a!

source_text: and if anyone does not obey our word through the letter, note this one, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed,
target_text: miu patadhe paie-iie dhèu-dhèu dhu ro'o boe madhutu ngaa dhu ji'i suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne. hud'i rèngu sène, sèna ka ra'e makae.

source_text: and do not count as an enemy, but admonish as a brother;
target_text: sad'i miu baku tao si nuka sèmi musu miu. te ngaa kai si dènge be'a, sèmi miu kai a'ari miu mesa mi.

source_text: and may the lord of peace himself always give to you peace in every way; the lord is with you all!
target_text: lamatua èèna, dhèu aae mera-milu. ja'a manèngi ho na hia miu mera-milu ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. ja'a maena, sèna ka lamatua bera-bera dènge miu.

source_text: the salutation by the hand of me, paul, which is a sign in every letter; thus i write.
target_text: ja'a pa'èle sasuri ne dènge kacui-aai ja'a unu ku, sèna ka miu me'a, na, sasuri ne tare'a-re'a nèti ja'a. lii limuri tèka, oe pa'èle sasuri leo aa'i-aa'i sèra, ja'a ka dhu suri kahèi.

source_text: the grace of our lord jesus christ is with you all! amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka d'ara hua iia lamatua yesus kristus rai eele boe nèti miu aa'i-aa'i mi. sasuri ne d'ai sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: paul, an apostle of jesus christ, according to a command of god our savior, and of the lord jesus christ our hope, to timotheus-genuine child in faith: grace, kindness, peace, from god our father and christ jesus our lord!
target_text: timotius dhu be'a. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua ded'e le ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. aa lamatua yesus, era sanao-maena dhu hia èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge nèngu, lula ama lamatua pakaj'èu èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo. timotius! èu ne, nuka sèmi ana matana ja'a, lula ja'a ka dhu pad'elo j'ara ka èu parcaya kristus. ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka ama lamatua èdhi, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia rèngu, aa hia èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: according as i exhorted you to remain in ephesus-i going on to macedonia-that you might charge certain ones not to teach any other thing,
target_text: uru èèna, dua ti ètu kota epesus. lod'o ja'a neo laku asa propensi makedonia, ja'a manèngi èu ho pea ètu epesus. te lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu dhu pab'ingu dhèu sarani sèra dènge aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu lamu kai si, ho ra loe eele ka.

source_text: nor to give heed to fables and endless genealogies, that cause questions rather than the stewardship of god which is in faith.
target_text: aa dhèu sèra core eele lod'o iia d'ara kahèi lasi palolo nanuku, pab'ala lii dènge kapod'e-kabèli nèti bèi-baki toke lai ana lai èpu. j'ara sèmi sèra, dhoka hia dhèu patao-palaha, aa hia boe ra mamuri dènge parcaya mi ama lamatua.

source_text: and the end of the charge is love out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of unhypocritical faith,
target_text: ja'a holo èu, sèna ka èu aj'a dhèu parcaya sèra ho mamuri pasue èci dènge èci kahèi. sasue ra hud'i mai nèti d'ara dhu mèu, nèti ngangee dhu mola, aa nèti parcaya dhu koe-kapengo boe.

source_text: from which certain men, having swerved, turned aside to vain discourse,
target_text: te ngaa abhu mese cahag'e dhu kako sala le j'ara, ra tèke eele lii holo-nori. hèia lasi core eele lod'o iia d'ara dènge padhue-padhai j'ara-j'ara dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: willing to be teachers of law, not understanding either the things they say, nor concerning what they confidently assert,
target_text: rèngu padedha iisi ra, peka na, rèngu mese dhu aj'a madhutu atora musa. ra tao iisi ra sèmi mese aae, te ngaa re'a boe ngaa dhu rèngu aj'a-nori èèna.

source_text: and we have known that the law is good, if anyone may use it lawfully;
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti te'a, huku musa èèna be'a, sad'i èdhi pake ne madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: having known this, that law is not set for a righteous man, but for lawless and insubordinate persons, ungodly and sinners, impious and profane, murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, manslayers,
target_text: atora sèra suri boe hia mi dhèu dhu mamuri mola le. te ngaa pala mi dhèu palab'a, dhu d'èi boe nanene paredha, dhu mamuri pakaj'èu nèti lamatua, dhu d'èi ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a, dhu pusi-pahae boe lamatua, dhu pamud'e j'ara-j'ara dhu hua iia, dhu tuka pamadhe dhèu, dènge dhu pamadhe ina dènge ama ra.

source_text: whoremongers, homosexuals, enslavers, liars, perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is adverse to sound doctrine,
target_text: atora sèra suri kahèi hia dhèu kajeo dènge bhèni do dènge mone, aa mone dhu tao j'ara makae dènge mone, dhu rai rèti dhèu ho sui dènge doi-dhari, dhèu dhu kapod'e-kabèli, dhu j'aj'i sakasii omo koso, aa hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu d'èi palab'a lii aj'a dhu lèke.

source_text: according to the good news of the glory of the blessed god, with which i was entrusted.
target_text: a'aj'a dhu lèke sèra, mai nèti lii lolo be'a ama lamatua dhu na pangèd'u mi ja'a. aa lamatua èèna, ama lamatua dhu kapai risi eele. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ded'e ne padedha-dedha.

source_text: and i give thanks to him who enabled me-christ jesus our lord-that he reckoned me steadfast, having put me to the ministry,
target_text: ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae mi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, lula na lèka ja'a, ka na hia ja'a bisa pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: who before was speaking slander, and persecuting, and insulting, but i found kindness, because, being ignorant, i did it in unbelief, and the grace of our lord exceedingly abounded, with faith and love that is in christ jesus.
target_text: masi ka uru èèna, ja'a d'èi padhai pa'ele iie kolongara yesus, aa paj'èra dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri na. ja'a d'èi ènyi raruri si. bhabhelu ja'a sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna, ja'a ke'a boe ngaa dhu ja'a tao, aa parcaya mèka yesus kristus. te ngaa ama lamatua core eele boe ja'a. ka na pad'elo sasue na mi ja'a. mia hari kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, loe boe pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a! nèngu hia mèngi-nale dhu ae hia ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa parcaya ne, aa ja'a bisa sue dhèu leo kahèi nuka sèmi nèngu sue ja'a.

source_text: the word is steadfast, and worthy of all acceptance, that christ jesus came into the world to save sinners-of whom i am first;
target_text: èdhi biasa tadèngi le, peka na, yesus kristus mai le asa rai-haha, ho pala-bagi mamuri mi dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala. mema tare'a sèmi èèna! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra dhu ad'u-ue sasala, ja'a ka dhu bhelu risi eele.

source_text: but because of this i found kindness, that jesus christ might first show forth all long-suffering in me, for a pattern of those about to believe on him to continuous life.
target_text: masi ka ja'a bhelu sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua huku boe ja'a. te nare ja'a j'aj'i mi tadha sena ka pad'elo sasue yesus kristus mi dhèu dhu bhelu risi eele, nuka sèmi ja'a ne'e ne. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, dhèu leo dhu tao sala sèra bisa parcaya ne kahèi, ka ra abhu mamuri taa-taa dènge ne.

source_text: and to the king of the ages, the incorruptible, invisible, only wise god, is honor and glory through the ages of the ages! amen.
target_text: koa-kio kolongara lamatua! lula dhoka nèngu di, ama lamatua; dhu leo aad'o! nèngu ne, dhèu aae dhu paredha taa-taa. mamuri na dènge boe too-lane. mamadhe aad'o ètu nèngu. dhèu bisa boe rèdhi ne dènge musi madha. pakab'ua dènge koa-kio aa'i-aa'i hia mi nèngu di! tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: i commit to you this charge, child timotheus, according to the prophecies that went before on you, that you may war in them the good warfare,
target_text: ana timotius dhu be'a! ja'a neo peka dènge èu ngaa dhu hud'i èu tao ku ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a èu. aa'i-aa'i se, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka tèke le lula-nèti èu ne. ladhe èu madhutu lii se'e dènge mola-mola, èu sèmi ca dhèu sordad'u dhu bisa pamusu dènge be'a, ho lab'a bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: having faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away, made shipwreck concerning the faith,
target_text: kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka èu mi yesus kristus. aa j'aga paie, sèna ka d'ara èu mola taruu. te abhu kahèi dhèu leo dhu ro'o heka nanene d'ara iiki ra, dhu pa'ele iie parcaya rèngu, nuka sèmi kapa rage nare hadhu aae.

source_text: of whom are hymenaeus and alexander, whom i delivered to satan, that they might be instructed not to speak evil.
target_text: himeneus dènge aleksander si, ra sèmi èèna ka! nèti èèna ka, ja'a soro le rèngu asa dhèu aae nidhu. ja'a tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka aj'a si loe eele pakarehe kolongara lamatua,

source_text: i exhort, then, first of all, there be made supplications, prayers, intercessions, thanksgivings, for all men-
target_text: dhu uru tèka miu tao: ja'a manèngi miu sabaj'a hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i. ladhe miu mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, manèngi sèna ka na ladhe-leru dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. aa manèngi makasi, lula na tao le babe'a mi rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for kings, and all who are in authority, that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all piety and gravity,
target_text: sabaj'a sèmi èèna kahèi hia dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha. dènge j'ara ne'e èdhi bisa mamuri mera-milu, dènge dame, madhutu dad'èi lamatua, mamuri pamèci dènge dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi lamatua.

source_text: for this is right and acceptable before god our savior,
target_text: manèngi-mangaj'i sèmi èèna ka dhu be'a. j'ara ne'e ne ka pakarej'e d'ara lamatua, dhu hia èdhi mamuri.

source_text: who wills all men to be saved, and to come to the full knowledge of the truth;
target_text: dad'èi lamatua ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra abhu mamuri, aa re'a mia ka dhu lèke. nuka sèmi:

source_text: for there is one god, also one mediator of god and of men-the man christ jesus,
target_text: ama lamatua èèna, dhoka èci di. aa kalete dhoka èci di dhu padame èdhi dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua, nuka, yesus kristus. aa yesus tare'a-re'a dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: who gave himself as a ransom for all-the testimony in its own times-
target_text: na soro iisi na, ho sui èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti nèti sasala-sasigo èdhi. lèke dènge lod'o na, ka ama lamatua bhoke le pasaraa lii lolo be'a èèna hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: in regard to which i was set a preacher and apostle-truth i say in christ, i do not lie-a teacher of nations, in faith and truth.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua hag'e nare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na, sèna ka laku peka-padhai dènge dhèu yahudi boe ètu mia-mia, aa nori si sèna ka ra parcaya lamatua yesus, dènge mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne, tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna. ja'a leko-monya boe.

source_text: i intend, therefore, that men pray in every place, lifting up holy hands, apart from anger and deliberation;
target_text: dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe ètu mia-mia miu pakaboko ho manèngi-mangaj'i, hud'i dènge ku d'ara dhu mola-mèci. baku panasa. baku patao-palaha. ladhe sabaj'a, bisa ded'e kacui-aai asa ama lamatua, ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, d'ara miu mola-mèci tare'a-re'a.

source_text: also the women in like manner, in orderly apparel, to adorn themselves with modesty and sobriety, not in braided hair, or gold, or pearls, or clothing of great price, but-which becomes women professing godly piety-through good works.
target_text: dad'èi ja'a kahèi ladhe dhèu-dhèu bhèni re'a lalau iisi ra pake mèdha-papake dhu pantas. dhu tao bhèni j'aj'i bhèni iia, lula boe nèti pasaraga rèu kètu, do pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae dhu nèti makae, do pake risi eele mèdha hualaa, doi pudhi dènge mutiara. te dhu tao bhèni sèra j'aj'i bhèni iia, nuka d'ara dhu hua iia, aa rèngu tao dhoka j'ara dhu be'a. èèna ka pamèci dènge dhèu bhèni dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: let a woman learn in quietness in all subjection,
target_text: ladhe dhèu sarani pakaboko ho nanene lii holo-nori, na, bhèni sa kahèi madhutu atora, sèna ka pasa dhilu ra be'a-be'a ho nanene lii holo-nori dènge d'ara kateme. baku pagagai sèna ka tao maruru.

source_text: and i do not allow a woman to teach, nor to rule a husband, but to be in quietness,
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, lèke boe ladhe dhèu bhèni ded'e ngi'u ra ho paredha aa aj'a dhèu mone. be'a risi bhèni sèra taha d'ara.

source_text: for adam was formed first, then eve,
target_text: te ama lamatua paj'aj'i uuru adam, heka hawa kèna.

source_text: and adam was not deceived, but the woman, having been deceived, came into transgression,
target_text: aa adam dhu uru boe lèke ag'o nèti dhèu aae nidhu, te ngaa dhèu bhèni. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu rai-haha mulai lab'a paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: and she will be saved through the childbearing, if they remain in faith, and love, and sanctification, with sobriety.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu bhèni abhu mamuri lula rèngu rara iisi ana. sad'i rèngu parcaya tare'a-re'a mi kristus, mamuri pasue, mamuri dènge d'ara mola-mèci, aa mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: the word is steadfast: if anyone longs for overseership, he desires a right work;
target_text: mema tare'a sèmi lii dhèu, dhu peka na, dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i kètu juma'at, nèngu hag'e nare le sasab'a èci dhu hua iia titu kèna.

source_text: it is required, therefore, the overseer to be blameless, a husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, respectable, a friend of strangers, apt to teach,
target_text: kètu juma'at èèna, hud'i dhèu dhu kolongara be'a. nèngu hud'i satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di. nèngu hud'i taha nare d'ara na, dhèu dhu patao-palaha boe, dhu dhèu pakab'ua ne, dhu d'èi bhoke babèdho èmu ho dhèu lasi pangad'o dènge ne, aa bisa aj'a-nori dhèu leo.

source_text: not given to wine, not a striker, but gentle, not contentious, not a lover of money,
target_text: baku dhèu dhu tema mahu, baku dhèu dhu nasa dènge kacui-aai malai. dhu lèke ka, dhèu dhu d'ara hua iia, dhu d'èi tenge dame, aa dhu manga'a boe doi-dhari.

source_text: leading his own house well, having children in subjection with all dignity,
target_text: nèngu hud'i ne'a uri d'ara èmu na dènge be'a. ana-ana na re'a pakab'ua dènge d'èi nanene ne.

source_text: and if anyone has not known how to lead his own house, how will he take care of an assembly of god?
target_text: te ladhe dhèu èèna ne'a boe lalau-lalo'o d'ara èmu na, na, tasa mera mia nèngu bisa ladhe-leru juma'at lamatua.

source_text: not a new convert, lest having been puffed up he may fall to a judgment of the devil;
target_text: be'a risi, pili dhèu dhu mamuri palèke dènge dad'èi kristus. de baku ded'e kètu juma'at nèti dhèu dhu parcaya nèbhu mèka mi yesus. te èèna na, rèngu sèra bisa padedha iisi malai. mage dhoka lamatua huku si, sama sèmi lamatua huku dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: and it is required of him also to have a good testimony from those outside, that he may not fall into reproach and a snare of the devil.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at sèra hud'i dhèu dhu rai lesa re'a pakab'ua ne kahèi. dènge sèmi èèna nèngu makae boe. aa dhèu aae nidhu bisa boe pabèbhe ne kahèi.

source_text: servants, in like manner, dignified, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not given to shameful gain,
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu soru-bara kètu juma'at. rèngu sèra hud'i dhèu dhu dènge kolongara be'a, dhèu dhu he'o kajari boe, dhu tema boe rinu mahu, aa dhu d'èi boe ra'e a'oto ae-ae.

source_text: having the secret of the faith in a pure conscience,
target_text: d'ara rèngu hud'i mola-mèci, aa rèngu hud'i kèpe pa'èra ku lii holo-nori dhu lamatua bhoke pasaraa hia èdhi, dhèu parcaya se'e.

source_text: and let these also first be proved, then let them minister, being unblameable.
target_text: ladhe paie-iie mamuri dènge sasab'a ra. ladhe abhu boe sasala si, heka ded'e si ho soru-bara kètu juma'at sèra.

source_text: women, in like manner, dignified, not false accusers, vigilant, faithful in all things.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu èmu ra. rèngu sèra hud'i bhèni dhu mamuri madhutu madha j'ara dènge tatao dhu be'a. mage dhèu dhu tema padhai-kakoli pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu leo. rèngu hud'i dhèu dhu re'a taha rare d'ara, aa dhèu lèka si kahèi.

source_text: servants-let them be husbands of one wife, leading the children well, and their own houses,
target_text: aa dhu soru-bara kètu juma'at sèra hud'i mone dhu satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di. nèngu èèna hud'i ne'a uri d'ara èmu na, aa uri ana-ana na dènge be'a.

source_text: for those who ministered well acquire a good step to themselves, and much boldness in faith that is in christ jesus.
target_text: rèngu dhu lalau-lalo'o dhèu sarani dènge be'a, tatu dhèu asa pakab'ua si. aa rèngu asa bani, dènge boe madha'u lole parcaya rèngu mi yesus kristus.

source_text: i write to you these things, hoping to come to you soon, and if i delay, that you may know how it is required to conduct yourself in the house of god, which is an assembly of the living god-a pillar and foundation of the truth,
target_text: timotius! ja'a sanao sèna ka nèbhu boe ja'a dhiu ngad'o èu. ladhe ja'a pakai, do ako nena ciki, na, ele boe sasuri ne d'ai uuru èu. sasuri ne ja'a suri ho peka dènge èu, na, dhèu unu lamatua sèra hud'i ra mamuri tasa mera mia ku. baku bhèlu, peka na, lamatua èèna, ama lamatua dhu mamuri. dhèu unu na nuka sèmi èmu dhu dènge era padhèdi, aa dènge agarii talora dhu èra. èmu sèmi èèna ka dhu titu èra, sama sèmi dhèu unu lamatua dhu kèpe pa'èra lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu tare'a, aa rèngu bisa bara ho pakako dènge be'a.

source_text: and confessedly, great is the secret of piety: who was revealed in flesh, declared righteous in the spirit, seen by messengers, preached among nations, believed on in the world, taken up in glory!
target_text: lamatua pasabhoka le rahasia dhu kapai nèti lalèka èdhi. kapua na sèmi ne'e ka: kristus èèna, ca dhèu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le karèi nèti uru ka. aa kristus èèna mai le asa rai-haha ne, pake rupa dhèu rai-haha sèmi èdhi. roh lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii, peka na, yesus èèna, nuka kristus. aa ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga sèra rèdhi na kahèi. ama lamatua dhu ded'e nèti le asa sorga, ka nedhe padedha-dedha ne. lii lolo na pale-lème le suku-suku ètu rai-haha ne. ètu mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i parcaya le nèngu. kapua lalèka èdhi sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: and the spirit expressly says that in latter times some will depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits and teachings of demons,
target_text: te ngaa ne'e ne, roh ama lamatua dhu peka paled'a le, na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu sarani cahag'e patalale eele ngaa dhu èdhi parcaya. ho lasi madhutu roh-roh dhu sala aa dhu leko-monya, aa lasi madhutu lii holo-nori nidhu bhelu sèra.

source_text: speaking lies in hypocrisy, being seared in their own conscience,
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nori sèmi sèra, padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu sèra mema dhèu dhu kapod'e-kabèli! dhèu sèra sa, d'ara iiki ra dhu bèdhu le.

source_text: forbidding to marry-to abstain from meats that god created to be received with thanksgiving by those believing and acknowledging the truth,
target_text: ra aj'a dhèu, baku paleo èmu. aa ra aj'a dhèu luri rupa-rupa nganga'a. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu tao nganga'a-nganginu sèra, ho ladhe dhèu parcaya ra'a, rèngu manèngi makasi mi nèngu. te rèngu re'a mia dhu lèke.

source_text: because every creature of god is good, and nothing is to be rejected, with thanksgiving being received,
target_text: ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua tao sèra, tare'a-re'a be'a. de baku luri rupa-rupa. dhèu hud'i sèmi rare aa'i-aa'i sèra dènge manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: for it is sanctified through the word of god and intercession.
target_text: te èdhi te'a, na, lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge lii manèngi-mangaj'i èdhi sèra ka pamèu si.

source_text: placing these things before the brothers, you will be a good servant of jesus christ, being nourished by the words of the faith, and of the good teaching, which you followed after,
target_text: timotius! pasanèd'e j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra. ladhe èu tao madhutu sèmi èèna, èu j'aj'i dhèu sab'a dhu be'a nèti yesus kristus. lii holo-nori ama lamatua sèra ka dhu tao èu parcaya ne, aa hia me'a mèu, mia ka lii holo-nori dhu lèke. èu kèpe pa'èra-èra le lii holo-nori lamatua sèra! sèra nuka sèmi nganga'a dhu pa'èra ngi'u èu.

source_text: but reject the profane and old women's fables, and exercise yourself to piety,
target_text: baku core eele lod'o iia d'ara dènge palolo omo koso dhu lèke boe dènge dad'èi ama lamatua. baku pusi-pahae dènge lii lolo bhèni heka dhu nèti laluri rupa-rupa. be'a risi pa'èra taruu ngi'u dènge d'ara èu pabe'a-be'a, sèna ka mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: for bodily exercise is to little profit, but piety is profitable to all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is coming;
target_text: olaraga pa'èra ngi'u na, be'a. masi ka babe'a na ciki oo'e di. te ngaa pa'èra ngi'u dènge d'ara ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua ètu j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra, babe'a na ae seli eele. babe'a na mesa boe mamuri ètu rai-haha deo ne'e di, te ngaa mamuri lèpa limuri kahèi.

source_text: the word is steadfast, and worthy of all acceptance;
target_text: lii se'e se, lèke tare'a-re'a! de tèke paie mi d'ara, ho baku bhèlu eele.

source_text: for this we both labor and are reproached, because we hope on the living god, who is savior of all men-especially of those believing.
target_text: èdhi tao era maena mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri. nèngu na ka dhu hia mamuri mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i, risi-risi mi èdhi dhu parcaya na. nèti èèna ka, èdhi sab'a dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: charge these things, and teach;
target_text: nori lii se'e aa'i-aa'i. aa pua dhèu sèra ho madhutu lii holo-nori sèra.

source_text: let no one despise your youth, but become a pattern of those believing in word, in behavior, in love, in spirit, in faith, in purity;
target_text: baku soro tèka dhèu sèra pahae boe èu, lula èu ana ngèru era. èu hud'i j'aj'i conto hia dhèu parcaya sèra, nèti lii padhai èu, nèti kakako èu, nèti d'ara sasue èu mi dedha dhèu, nèti parcaya èu mi yesus kristus, dènge mamuri èu dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: until i come, give heed to the reading, to the exhortation, to the teaching;
target_text: ètu d'ara miu tatae mamai ja'a, baku bhèlu baca lii holo-nori lamatua hia mi dhèu parcaya sèra. pa'èra d'ara si, aa nori si paie-iie.

source_text: do not be careless of the gift in you, that was given you through prophecy, with laying on of the hands of the eldership;
target_text: pake pabe'a-be'a karunya dhu lamatua pangèd'u le mi èu, dhu èu sèmi lod'o kètu-kètu juma'at sabaj'a dènge tao kacui-aai mi dedha kètu èu. lod'o èèna, rèngu peka lii moa lamatua kahèi lula-nèti j'ara mamuri dènge sab'a-la'a èu. de baku soro tèke karunya dhu èu abhu èèna.

source_text: be careful of these things; be in these things, that your advancement may be evident in all things;
target_text: pakako dènge maj'èni j'ara sèra. sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ladhe rèdhi mamuri dènge sab'a-la'a èu asa be'a.

source_text: take heed to yourself and to the teaching; remain in them, for doing this thing, you will save both yourself and those hearing you.
target_text: j'aga sèna ka èu mamuri dènge mola. aa j'aga sèna ka èu loe boe aj'a dhu lèke j'ara. ladhe èu pa'èra dènge j'ara sèra, pe lamatua bhoke j'ara hia èu, dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu nanene lii padhai èu, sèna ka miu pakaj'èu nèti bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: you may not rebuke an elder, but exhort him as a father, younger persons as brothers,
target_text: baku tao lii sakaa dènge dhèu mone dhu heka risi nèti èu. te ngaa dènge lii mako, nuka sèmi èu padhai lii dènge ama mu. aa mi dhèu dhu ngèru risi, pa'èra d'ara si, tao nuka sèmi ari mu.

source_text: aged women as mothers, younger ones as sisters-in all purity;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu bhèni dhu heka risi sèra. padhai lii dènge rèngu, nuka sèmi èu padhai lii dènge ina mu. aa ladhe padhai lii dènge ana bhèni ngèru, tao si nuka sèmi ana hèni èu. d'ara èu hud'i mola dènge si.

source_text: honor widows who are really widows; and if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them first learn to show piety to their own house, and to give back a repayment to the parents, for this is right and acceptable before god. and she who is really a widow and desolate, has hoped on god, and remains in the supplications and in the prayers night and day,
target_text: dhèu sarani hud'i soru-bara bhèni balu dhu dènge heka a'ari sèna ka ladhe-leru si. te ngaa bhèni balu dhu ana-èpu era, na, rèngu ka dhu hud'i ladhe-leru ne. aj'a si, sèna ka re'a b'ala sasue ina ra dhu rèngu abhu sèra. dènge sèmi èèna ka, rèngu sab'a hia ama lamatua, ho pakarej'e d'ara na. te ngaa bhèni balu dhu tare'a-re'a mamuri mesa di, nèngu dènge boe ca dhèu sa dhu ladhe-leru ne. nèngu dhoka maena mi ama lamatua di. mèu-mèda na manèngi sasue ama lamatua. dhèu sarani hud'i ladhe-leru ku bhèni balu sèmi sèra sa.

source_text: but she given to luxury while living has died;
target_text: te ngaa bhèni balu dhu d'èi dhoka mamuri na karej'e-karae di, masi ka na mamuri era, te ngaa dènge heka kab'ua, sama sèmi dhèu dhu madhe le.

source_text: and charge these things, that they may be blameless;
target_text: pasanèd'e j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi dhèu sarani sèra, sèna ka dhèu leo baku pa'ele iie kolongara rèngu.

source_text: and if anyone does not provide for his own, and especially for those of the household, he has denied the faith, and he is worse than an unbeliever.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu ro'o boe ladhe-leru a'ari na, risi-risi hari isi èmu na, èèna sama sèmi nèngu pèci eele lalèka nèngu mi lamatua. nèngu bhelu risi nèti dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: a widow-do not let her be enrolled under sixty years of age, having been a wife of one husband,
target_text: ladhe neo ded'e bhèni balu ho soru-bara kètu juma'at, j'ara na sèmi ne'e ka: umur nèngu bisa boe kura nèti 60 tèu; uru na nèngu satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di;

source_text: being testified to in good works: if she brought up children, if she entertained strangers, if she washed holy ones' feet, if she relieved those in tribulation, if she followed after every good work;
target_text: dhèu re'a, na, nèngu ca dhèu dhu tema tao babe'a mi dhèu; dhu ladhe-leru ana-ana na dènge be'a; dhu bhoke tèke kacui-aai ho leru dhèu leo; dhu soru-bara dhèu parcaya sèra ètu d'ara sasab'a, masi ka dhu samaa èèna ka; dhu d'èi soru dhèu ètu d'ara sasusa; aa dhu bhori mema ho soru-bara ètu madha j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: and be refusing younger widows, for when they may revel against the christ, they wish to marry,
target_text: baku pili bhèni balu dhu ngèru era, ho sab'a ètu d'ara juma'at. te mage dhoka cèu ètu d'ara na, ho neo hari leo-èmu. ladhe sèmi èèna, rèngu se abhu heka lod'o dhu taleo, ho lalau dhèu sarani dènge be'a.

source_text: having judgment, because they cast away the first faith,
target_text: te ladhe lod'o dhu rèngu pake hia juma'at èèna kura, èci èèna ka dènge rèngu pa'ele iie lii pajaji rèngu ètu katanga madha lamatua. èèna na, dhèu pasala si.

source_text: and also at the same time, they learn to be idle, going around the houses; and not only idle, but also tattlers and busybodies, speaking things they should not;
target_text: mage dhoka rèngu bai-eed'a, aa maso-kalua èmu dhèu, padhai-kaked'u pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. aa dhu karehe risi eele hari, rèngu soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhèu leo, dènge padhai dhu lèke boe.

source_text: i intend, therefore, younger ones to marry, to bear children, to be mistress of the house, to give no occasion to the opposer of reviling;
target_text: be'a risi eele, bhèni balu dhu ngèru era leo hari èmu, sèna ka rara iisi, aa ladhe-leru d'ara èmu rèngu. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu dhu pamusu dènge èdhi abhu boe j'ara ho pa'ele iie kolongara èdhi.

source_text: for some already turned aside after satan.
target_text: abhu bhèni balu ngèru cahag'e dhu kako sala j'ara. rèngu se madhutu j'ara dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: if any believing man or believing woman has widows, let them relieve them, and do not let the assembly be burdened, that it may relieve those who are really widows.
target_text: ladhe abhu bhèni dhu parcaya lamatua, dhu a'ari ra j'aj'i le bhèni balu, na, bhèni ne hud'i ladhe-leru ku bhèni balu èèna. baku soro tèke hia juma'at ladhe-leru. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna juma'at bisa ladhe-leru bhèni balu dhu leo, dhu tare'a-re'a dènge heka a'ari.

source_text: let them, the well-leading elders, be counted worthy of double honor, especially those laboring in word and teaching,
target_text: dhèu dhu ladhe-leru juma'at dènge be'a, miu hud'i pakab'ua risi ne, aa b'ae gaji dènge be'a. risi-risi rèngu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara kateme, ho lole pataraa lii holo-nori lamatua, aa aj'a j'ara mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: for the writing says, you will not muzzle an ox treading out, and, worthy is the workman of his reward.
target_text: te dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, ladhe pake sapi j'èli puru are nèti huri, mage mi kape hèb'a na kahèi, sèna ka bisa na'a. aa dhu suri kahèi, peka na, cee ka dhu sab'a, na, nèngu hud'i abhu gaji ku.

source_text: do not receive an accusation against an elder, except on two or three witnesses.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu galaa kètu juma'at, baku sad'i sèmi mere di! hud'i abhu ku dua do tèlu sakasii dhu lii èci, heka mi sèmi mere ho parisa ne.

source_text: reprove those sinning before all, that the others may also have fear;
target_text: ladhe miu kai ne, te ngaa na mamuri taruu madhutu d'ara sasala èèna, kai hari ne ètu madha juma'at. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, dhèu leo bani boe madhutu tatao èèna.

source_text: i fully testify, before god and the lord jesus christ, and the chosen messengers, that you may keep these things, without prejudging, doing nothing by partiality.
target_text: pakako aa'i atora se'e mi juma'at dhu hag'e boe, aa baku bia cabèka. ja'a pangèd'u sasab'a ne'e mi d'ara kacui-aai èu, ètu katanga madha ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus. ana pajuu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare ètu sorga, j'aj'i sakasii kahèi!

source_text: be quickly laying hands on no one, nor be having fellowship with the sins of others; be keeping yourself pure;
target_text: baku pamèri ded'e dhèu j'aj'i kètu juma'at. ladhe uuru ku paie-iie ne. te ladhe miu ded'e sad'i ngara di, hèia dhèu ne tao sala, na, miu pasae sasala èèna kahèi, lula tatao na. j'aga paie ngi'u èu sèna ka mamuri mola taruu.

source_text: no longer be drinking water, but be using a little wine, because of your stomach and of your frequent sicknesses;
target_text: ja'a tadèngi èu kabake pèd'a taruu. be'a risi nèti deo ne'e, èu pab'ali èi dènge anggor ciki tao sèmi èi na'i. baku minu dhoka èi iia di.

source_text: the sins of certain men are evident beforehand, leading before to judgment, but some also they follow after;
target_text: ladhe paie-iie! abhu sasala dhèu dhu cèu mema. rèngu d'ai mèka madha hakim, te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a le èèna. te ngaa abhu dhèu leo kahèi dhu nèbhu-nèbhu ku, heka sasala ra cèu kèna.

source_text: in like manner the right works are also evident beforehand, and those that are otherwise are not able to be hid.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu tao be'a sèra. abhu mema dhu led'a. te ngaa cahag'e pahuni-pahuni tao dhu be'a. te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, ngaa dhu rèngu tao sèra, nèbhu-nèbhu cèu asa li'u kahèi. bisa boe pahuni tatao dhu be'a.

source_text: as many as are servants under a yoke, let them reckon their own masters worthy of all honor, that evil may not be spoken of the name of god and the teaching;
target_text: abhu lamatua dhu ènu na parcaya lamatua yesus. rèngu hud'i pakab'ua lamatua ra, sèna ka dhèu leo abhu boe j'ara ho padhai lii pamanahu kolongara ama lamatua, aa pamud'e dènge lii aj'a-nori èdhi.

source_text: and those having believing masters, do not let them slight them, because they are brothers, but rather let them serve, because they are steadfast and beloved, who are partaking of the benefit. be teaching and exhorting these things;
target_text: abhu ènu dhu lamatua na parcaya le lamatua yesus. ènu ne bisa boe pahaha lamatua na, lula lamatua na dhu parcaya lamatua yesus. masi ka tasamia èèna ka, rèngu hud'i lalau ku pabe'a risi hari lamatua ra, lula rèngu dènge rèngu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, dhèu parcaya dhu hud'i mamuri pasue ku. timotius! aj'a aa'i-aa'i se, aa pa'èra d'ara dhèu sarani sèra, sèna ka tao madhutu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: if anyone be teaching otherwise, and does not consent to sound words-those of our lord jesus christ-and to the teaching according to piety,
target_text: lii aj'a-nori èdhi dhu lèke èèna, j'aj'i kapua nèti d'ara mamuri èdhi dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu nori leo nèti lii aj'a se'e, dhèu sèra dhu core eele le lii lamatua yesus kristus dhu lèke.

source_text: he is proud, knowing nothing, but unhealthy about questions and word-striving, out of which come envy, strife, slanders, evil-surmisings,
target_text: dhèu sèmi èèna, padedha iisi, te ngaa goa. papèd'a rèngu ka d'èi dhoka tenge lii langu, aa pab'ala d'ara lii. j'ara se'e se ka dhu tao dhèu ho: tèka d'ara, patao-palaha, pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu leo, aa pangee dhu lèke boe mi dhèu leo.

source_text: wranglings of men wholly corrupted in mind, and destitute of the truth, supposing the piety to be gain; depart from such;
target_text: dhèu sèmi se'e, loe boe patao-palaha. ngangee ra karehe bia. re'a heka mia ka dhu be'a. rèngu ngee, ladhe rèngu maj'èni dènge j'ara-j'ara agama, rèngu bisa j'aj'i dhèu kaja-su'i.

source_text: but it is great gain-the piety with contentment;
target_text: mema, agama bisa hia a'oto mi dhèu. te mamuri dènge lamatua èèna ka dhu hia dhèu karej'e nèti ngaa dhu rèngu unu. èèna, heka agama dhu lèke kèna.

source_text: for we brought nothing into the world-because neither are we able to carry out anything;
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! lod'o rara iisi èdhi, èdhi tèti boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa asa rai-haha ne. aa ladhe lod'o madhe, tèti boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa kahèi nèti rai-haha ne.

source_text: but having food and raiment-with these we will suffice ourselves;
target_text: de sad'i dènge nganga'a, mèdha-papake sèra sa nia le!

source_text: and those intending to be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and many desires, foolish and hurtful, that sink men into ruin and destruction,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu neo kaja, mud'a titu kèna lèke dadugu-rariu rupa-rupa, aa lèke sasii g'ana-kariu, lula rèngu pangee dhoka mèdha-panyau di. j'ara se'e se ka dhu pa'ele iie mamuri rèngu.

source_text: for the love of money is a root of all the evils, which certain ones longing for went astray from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows;
target_text: te sue doi-dhari, èèna j'aj'i mi amo nèti rupa-rupa bhabhelu. abhu dhèu cahag'e magèle dhoka doi-dhari di, toke ra pakaj'èu nèti parcaya ra dhu lèke. hèia rèngu mesa ra pa'ele iie mamuri ra.

source_text: and you, o man of god, flee these things, and pursue righteousness, piety, faith, love, endurance, meekness.
