source_text: and no one takes the honor to himself, but he who is called by god, as also aaron.
target_text: dhèu bisa boe ded'e iisi na, sèna ka j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama. te dhoka ama lamatua di dhu dènge hak, sèna ka hag'e nare dhèu sèmi èèna, nuka sèmi uru-uru sèra na ded'e harun, a'a musa.

source_text: so also the christ did not glorify himself to become chief priest, but he who spoke to him: you are my son, today i have begotten you;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge kristus. na ded'e boe iisi na, ho j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama. te uru èèna, ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu ded'e ne, peka na, èu ne, ana ja'a, doe ne'e, ja'a ded'e èu ho mèd'u paredha.

source_text: just as he also says in another place, you are a priest throughout the age, according to the order of melchizedek;
target_text: ètu era leo nèti sasuri lamatua dhu mola-mèci, dhu suri kahèi, peka na, èu j'aj'i kètu agama dhu ca ropa dènge ca dhèu dhu mamuri uru èèna, nuka melkisedek, te ngaa èu j'aj'i kètu agama toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: who in the days of his flesh having offered up both prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard in respect to that which he feared,
target_text: ètu lod'o oe èle mamuri yesus ètu rai-haha ne, na loe boe sabaj'a dènge tangi d'ara pèd'a, manèngi ama lamatua sèna ka hia ne a'èra. te ne'a, na, koasa lamatua bisa hia ne mamuri. hèia ama lamatua sèmi nare lii manèngi yesus, lula na madhutu mola-mola dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: though being a son, he learned obedience by the things which he suffered,
target_text: te yesus ne, ana ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra, ho ne'a madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: and having been made perfect, he became the cause of continuous salvation to all those obeying him,
target_text: èle èèna ka, na tao madhutu mola-mola dad'èi lamatua aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, nèngu j'aj'i le kapua mamuri bagi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ne, ho mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: having been called by god a chief priest according to the order of melchizedek,
target_text: te lamatua ded'e nare le yesus j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama, ca ropa dènge melkisedek, dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama uru sèra.

source_text: concerning the word, of whom we have much to speak, and of hard explanation to say, since you have become dull of hearing,
target_text: j'ara ae era dhu ja'a neo lole dènge miu lula-nèti kristus dènge melkisedek, te ngaa ako carui paled'a j'ara se'e, lula miu nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu me'a mèu mèka dènge be'a.

source_text: for even owing to be teachers, because of the time, again you have need that one teach you what are the elements of the beginning of the oracles of god, and you have become having need of milk, and not of strong food,
target_text: aa te ngaa, miu dhu parcaya nèbhu le. madhutu iia-iia na, miu j'aj'i le mese ho aj'a-nori dhèu leo. te ngaa te'a boe na, miu cakaraa ana rara iisi hiu, dhu ne'a mèka na'a, te ne'a dhoka ninu susu di. miu parluu dhèu era ho aj'a miu lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu carui mèka nèti sasuri lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: for everyone who is partaking of milk is unskilled in the word of righteousness-for he is an infant,
target_text: ja'a pakasame miu dènge ana rara iisi hiu, lula miu me'a mèka j'ara-j'ara dhu carui boe nèti kristus, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri mola.

source_text: and the strong food is of perfect men, who because of the use are having the senses exercised, to both the discernment of good and of evil.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o ana iiki ne kapai, nèngu ninu heka susu, te ngaa na'a nganga'a dhu sakaa. èèna èci èèna ka, dènge dhèu aj'a ne toke ne'a mèu a'aj'a lamatua, sèna ka ne'a mia ka dhu be'a, aa mia ka dhu karehe.

source_text: for this reason, having left the word of the beginning of the christ, we may advance to perfection, not laying again a foundation of conversion from dead works, and of faith on god,
target_text: de miu hud'i aj'a paie-iie ku a'aj'a dhu carui risi, lula miu dhu aj'a nèbhu ae le a'aj'a dhu carui mèka lula-nèti kristus. nèti èèna ka limuri ne, baku dhoka aj'a pahari-pahari a'aj'a dhu carui mèka sèra, nuka sèmi: dhèu hud'i tèke eele ku sasala rèngu aa'i-aa'i; a'aj'a lula-nèti dhèu hud'i parcaya ku ama lamatua;

source_text: of the teaching of immersions, also of laying on of hands, also of the resurrection of the dead, and of continuous judgment,
target_text: a'aj'a lula-nèti sarani; a'aj'a lula-nèti bane ai mi dhèu sèna ka dhèu èèna sèmi nare roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci; a'aj'a lula-nèti ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu nèti mamadhe ra; aa a'aj'a dhu èèna na dhèu lasi asa katanga madha lamatua, ho sèmi rare lii pama'ète, dhu peka na, cee ka dhu bisa mamuri taa-taa dènge ne, aa cee ka dhu bisa boe.

source_text: and this we will do, if god may permit,
target_text: te ngaa ladhe lamatua hia ijin, na, èdhi j'aj'i heka ana iiki dhu te'a dhoka tinu susu di. te ja'a neo aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu carui risi hari.

source_text: for it is impossible for those once enlightened, having also tasted of the heavenly gift, and having become partakers of the holy spirit, and tasted the good saying of god, also the powers of the coming age, and having fallen away, to renew them again to conversion, having crucified to themselves the son of god again, and exposed to public shame.
target_text: aa te ngaa, abhu le dhèu dhu re'a mèu lii a'aj'a kristus, aa dhu rasa le d'ara hua iia lamatua kahèi, toke na hia si roh na dhu mola-mèci. rèngu re'a le lii holo-nori lamatua, aa rasa le koasa na dhu na neo pake lod'o èle rai-haha ne. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu se tèke eele le parcaya ra, aa ra soro kabodho mi kristus. nèti èèna ka, bisa heka abhu j'ara ho rèngu bisa lèpa hari manèngi abho, sèna ka mamuri pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. te ladhe dhèu ro'o boe ele-ho'a, èèna sama sèmi rèngu ka dhu paku pamadhe hari ana ama lamatua ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, hèia ra nyanyèi ne ètu madha dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: for the earth, having drunk in the rain coming on it many times, and is bringing forth herbs fit for those because of whom it is also dressed, partakes of blessing from god,
target_text: dhèu sèmi sèra, èci èèna ka dènge rai dhu hèu mèngi boe, nèti èèna ka abhu boe hua-hela dhu be'a. te ngaa ladhe abhu ka èj'i, rai dhu hèu mèngi bisa hia hua-hela dhu dènge guna mi lamatua oka. hèia ama lamatua papuru mamèngi-nale, sèna ka hua-hela nèti rai ne asa tabha ae.

source_text: but that which is bearing thorns and briers is disapproved of, and near to cursing, whose end is for burning;
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu soro kabodho mi kristus, nuka sèmi rai dhu pènu dènge dhudhu dènge sete di. aa dhudhu-sete se guna boe mi ngaa-ngaa èci sa. nèbhu boe, ama lamatua mai ho huku rai èèna. hèia na labhu pakèpu aa'i dhudhu dènge sete se, dhu gaguna ra aad'o.

source_text: but we are persuaded, concerning you, beloved, the things that are better, and accompanying salvation, though even thus we speak,
target_text: a'ari pasue! masi ka ja'a ako padhai lii bia ciki, te ngaa ja'a ke'a kahèi, na, miu rai eele boe kristus. te miu parcaya ne kahèi, aa mamuri miu kahèi abhu hua-hela dhu be'a.

source_text: for god is not unrighteous to forget your work, and the labor of love that you showed to his name, having ministered to the holy ones and ministering;
target_text: de sanèd'e, te d'ara ama lamatua mola, aa na bhèlu boe èi kabhèsu miu. te miu sab'a bia le, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu unu na sèra, aa mi sue si. mema karèi nèti uru ka, miu pakako le sasab'a na. aa miu pakako taruu sasab'a na era.

source_text: and we desire each one of you to show the same diligence, to the full assurance of the hope to the end,
target_text: te limuri ne, ja'a d'èi ladhe miu sab'a èra risi hari, sèna ka tao madhutu taruu toke pa'èle. dènge sèmi èèna, miu bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere babe'a aa'i-aa'i dhu miu sanao nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: that you may not become slothful, but followers of those who through faith and patient endurance are inheriting the promises.
target_text: sad'i miu baku bai-eed'a! miu hud'i laladhe nèti dhèu dhu parcaya nèbhu le mi ama lamatua. te rèngu tino sanao-maena mi nèngu, toke ra sèmi rare aa'i dhu lamatua pajaji le.

source_text: for god, having made promise to abraham, seeing he was not able to swear by any greater, swore by himself, saying, blessing i will indeed bless you, and multiplying i will multiply you; and so, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise; for men swear by the greater, and the oath is for confirmation of the end of all their controversy,
target_text: conto nuka sèmi abraham. uru èèna, ama lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge ne pake lii subha. ladhe dhèu rai-haha ded'e subha, nèngu tema pake kolongara ama lamatua, sèna ka lamatua j'aj'i sakasii na, lula lamatua risi nèti nèngu. aa ladhe paraga dènge lii langu, dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, na, lii dhu dhèu ne peka èèna lèke tare'a, lula na subha pake kolongara ama lamatua. èèna mema j'ara dhèu rai-haha kèna. te ngaa lod'o ama lamatua ded'e subha dènge abraham, lamatua pake kolongara nèngu unu na, lula abhu boe dhu risi nèti nèngu. na jaji, peka na, èèna na, ja'a hia mèngi-nale ae-ae, mi èu dènge ana-èpu mu, bèli-camèd'a rèngu bèba-kacanga, toke dhèu bisa boe ige rare si. ama lamatua padadha nare sèmi èèna, hèia abraham parcaya, aa sanao-maena taruu mi lamatua, masi ka d'ai nèbhu ae ku, heka sèmi nare ngaa dhu lamatua pajaji sèra.

source_text: in which god, more abundantly willing to show to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed by an oath,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, èdhi te'a, ladhe lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge dhèu unu na, nèngu pa'èki lii pajaji ne pake subha, ho j'aj'i mi tate'a, ngaa dhu na moa èèna, mema lèke aa ub'a boe.

source_text: that through two immutable things, in which it is impossible for god to lie, we may have a strong comfort, having fled for refuge, to lay hold on the hope being set before us,
target_text: te abhu dua j'ara dhu bisa boe ub'a. ka èci, nuka lii pajaji ama lamatua. aa èci hari, nuka lii subha lamatua, dhu na pake j'aj'i mi tate'a nèti lii pajaji na. de ladhe ama lamatua dhu moa le j'ara èci, tatu na tao madhutu, lula nèngu bisa boe omo koso. nèti èèna ka, èdhi baku pangee rupa-rupa dènge lii pajaji na. èdhi dhu rai lati le, sèna ka tenge mamuri nèti nèngu, de limuri ne, èdhi dhoka mate di, ho sanao dhoka mi nèngu di.

source_text: which we have, as an anchor of the soul, both sure and steadfast, and entering into that within the veil,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, d'ara èdhi taleo nuka sèmi koha dhu rai eele nèti d'ara rii, ho la'e panahu ètu hèb'a-namo. te era maena èdhi dhoka kristus di, dhu j'aj'i le kètu kapai risi agama èdhi. uru èèna, lèke dènge lod'o kalela dhèu yahudi, kètu kapai risi agama rèngu maso asa kama luri mola-mèci re bèla gorden, sèna ka paraga dènge ama lamatua ètu èèna.

source_text: to where a forerunner entered for us-jesus, having become chief priest throughout the age after the order of melchizedek.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, yesus dhu la'e uuru le, ho bhoke j'ara hia èdhi. te nèngu kètu kapai risi agama kahèi, dhu ca ropa dènge melkisedek, dhu uru èèna. te ngaa yesus kapai risi nèti kètu agama uru èèna, lula na ae nèdhi boe pakako sasab'a-la'a na.

source_text: for this melchizedek, king of salem, priest of god most high, who met abraham turning back from the striking of the kings, and blessed him, to whom also abraham divided a tenth of all first, indeed, being interpreted, king of righteousness, and then also, king of salem, which is, king of peace, without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, and having been like the son of god, remains a priest continually.
target_text: uru èèna, melkisedek j'aj'i dhèu aae kota salem. nèngu kahèi kètu agama nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele èèna. ngara melkisedek ne, sasoa na, dhèu aae d'ara mola. aa dhèu aae salem, sasoa na, dhèu aae dame. èci sa re'a boe j'aj'aj'i melkisedek ne nèti mia. èci sa re'a boe kahèi ina dènge ama na, aa bèi-baki na. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re'a lod'o rara iisi na, aa lod'o mamadhe na. dhèu re'a dhoka, nèngu dhèu aae kota salem, aa kètu agama nèti ama lamatua. te ngaa nèngu ne, nuka sèmi ana ama lamatua, lula nèngu ama agama dhu pakako taruu sasab'a na kahèi. ca tèka, pèri-pèri dhèu aae dènge sordad'u ra mai parame rèti mèdha-panyau angalai abraham. ka abraham dènge angalai na lasi pamusu dènge dhèu aae se, toke abraham segi si. hèia mèdha-panyau nèti angalai na sèra, abraham nèti aa'i hari. ropa abraham lèpa asa rai na, hèia melkisedek kalua nèti kota salem, ho la'e soru ne. ka na hia abraham berkat, peka na, hud'i laa ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele èèna, hia èu mèngi-nale. èle ka abraham hia melkisedek ca pala nèti canguru pala, nèti mèdha aa'i-aa'i dhu na parame nare hari sèra. abraham pabagi hia ne, lula melkisedek ne kètu agama nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele.

source_text: and see how great this one is, to whom abraham the patriarch also gave a tenth out of the best of the spoils,
target_text: de pangee paie-iie melkisedek ne! abraham bagi hia ne ca pala nèti canguru pala, nèti mèdha aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a risi dhu na parame nare hari. de dhu lèke, nuka melkisedek ne dhèu kapai.

source_text: and those, indeed, out of the sons of levi receiving the priesthood, have a command to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, their brothers, even though they came forth out of the loins of abraham;
target_text: aa te ngaa lod'o sèra, ama lamatua ded'e mèka dhèu j'aj'i ama agama. toke d'ai ku lod'o lewi, ana-èpu èci nèti abraham, heka ama lamatua ded'e ne dènge ana-èpu na, sèna ka j'aj'i ama agama hia mi ana-èpu abraham aa'i-aa'i ra. èle èèna ka, ama lamatua papuru atora na dhu peka na, dhèu nèti suku lewi dènge hak ho abhu ca pala nèti canguru pala nèti rui-j'aj'èra a'ari ra suku leo sèra ètu isra'el.

source_text: and he who was not reckoned by genealogy of them, received tithes from abraham, and he has blessed him having the promises,
target_text: te ngaa melkisedek ne, ana-èpu boe nèti lewi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abraham bagi hia ne ca pala nèti canguru pala, lula na pangee, na, melkisedek ne dhèu kapai. lod'o èèna abraham dhu sèmi nare le lii pajaji nèti ama lamatua ho hia ne berkat. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa melkisedek peka kahèi, na, hud'i laa ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele èèna, hia èu mèngi-nale.

source_text: and apart from all controversy, the less is blessed by the better-
target_text: ne'e ne ka j'aj'i mi tadha, na, melkisedek ne, dhèu kapai. lula dhèu dhu hia berkat tatu kapai risi nèti dhèu dhu sèmi nare berkat.

source_text: and here, indeed, men who die receive tithes, and there he who is testified to that he was living,
target_text: ama agama aa'i-aa'i ra dènge hak abhu ca pala nèti canguru pala. te ngaa, lula rèngu dhèu rai-haha biasa, nèbhu-nèbhu ra madhe kahèi. kètu agama melkisedek abhu kahèi ca pala nèti canguru pala. te ngaa na mamuri taruu, lula sasuri mola-mèci lamatua peka boe na, nèngu madhe.

source_text: and so to speak, through abraham even levi who is receiving tithes, has paid tithes, for he was yet in the loins of the father when melchizedek met him.
target_text: lula abraham bagi hia melkisedek ca pala nèti canguru pala nèti mèdha na sèra, dhèu bisa pangee, na, abraham tago nare kahèi ana-èpu na dhu rara iisi mèka. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, èdhi bisa pangee, na, nèngu b'ae mema le unu ana-èpu na lewi, ca pala nèti canguru pala.

source_text: if indeed, then, perfection were through the levitical priesthood-for the people under it had received law-what further need, according to the order of melchizedek, for another priest to arise, and not to be called according to the order of aaron?
target_text: lod'o ana-èpu lewi sèra j'aj'i ama agama, lamatua pili nare harun, a'a musa, ho j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama dhu partama. sasab'a nèti ama agama sèra, nuka soru-bara dhèu, sèna ka mamuri mola, pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. masi ka rèngu mamuri madhutu atora agama aa'i-aa'i sèra, te ngaa kètu agama ca ropa dènge harun, lake nare boe tao dhèu se mola-mèci. nèti èèna ka, rèngu parluu kètu agama leo, dhu ca ropa dènge melkisedek.

source_text: for the priesthood being changed, of necessity also, a change comes of the law,
target_text: te ngaa ladhe kètu agama rupa hiu gati eele kètu agama rupa dhui, tatu atora dhui hud'i gati eele kahèi.

source_text: for he of whom these things are said in another tribe has had part, of whom no one gave attendance at the altar,
target_text: de te'a mèu le, kètu agama rupa hiu èèna, nuka yesus. te rara iisi ne, nèti boe suku lewi, te ngaa nèti suku leo. madhutu atora musa, kètu agama ca ropa dènge harun, dhoka mai nèti suku lewi di, bisa boe nèti suku leo.

source_text: for it is evident that out of judah has arisen our lord, in regard to which tribe moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a, na, kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, j'aj'i nèti suku yahuda. madhutu atora musa, abhu mèka dhu j'aj'i kètu agama nèti suku ne'e.

source_text: and it is yet more abundantly most evident, if according to the likeness of melchizedek there arises another priest,
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua pake heka atora dhui, lula abhu le yesus dhu j'aj'i kètu agama rupa hiu, nuka sèmi melkisedek.

source_text: who did not come according to the law of a fleshly command, but according to the power of an endless life,
target_text: te madhutu atora musa, kètu agama rupa dhui hud'i mai ku nèti suku lewi. te ngaa yesus mai boe nèti suku èèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua ded'e ne, sèna ka j'aj'i kètu agama rupa hiu, lula nèngu dènge koasa ho mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia, aa abhu boe dhu bisa palaho ne.

source_text: for he testifies, you are a priest-throughout the age, according to the order of melchizedek;
target_text: te sasuri lamatua suri, peka na, èu j'aj'i kètu agama ca ropa dènge melkisedek, dhu uru èèna, te ngaa èu j'aj'i kètu agama toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: for an annulling indeed comes of the command going before because of its weakness, and unprofitableness
target_text: sasoa na, atora dhui dènge boe koasa, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu rai-haha. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua pake heka atora dhui, dhu uru èèna na pangèd'u mi musa.

source_text: for nothing did the law perfect, and the bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to god.
target_text: te masi ka dhèu mamuri madhutu atora dhui sèra, te ngaa sasala ra era. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne, ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara dhu be'a risi, ho èdhi bisa mamuri padame dènge ne.

source_text: and inasmuch as it is not apart from oath for those indeed apart from oath have become priests, and he became priest with an oath through him who is saying to him, the lord swore, and will not regret, you are a priest throughout the age, according to the order of melchizedek,
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ama lamatua ded'e ana-èpu lewi ho j'aj'i ama agama, lamatua pajaji boe, aa subha boe ngaa-ngaa dènge rèngu. te ngaa lod'o ama lamatua ded'e yesus j'aj'i kètu agama, na pajaji, peka na, ja'a ne, lamatua! ja'a subha, ja'a ub'a boe ngaa-ngaa dhu ja'a pajaji le. ja'a ded'e èu j'aj'i kètu agama, sèna ka èu pakako taruu sasab'a-la'a mu.

source_text: by so much also has jesus become guarantee of a better covenant,
target_text: dènge lii pajaji sèmi èèna, ama lamatua pake yesus j'aj'i mi tate'a hia èdhi, dhu peka na, nèngu neo pa'èki lii pajaji dhu be'a risi dènge èdhi.

source_text: and those indeed are many who have become priests, because by death they are hindered from remaining;
target_text: uru èèna, kètu agama rupa dhui gati taruu, lula ra madhe. nèti èèna ka, hud'i abhu ku kètu agama ae-ae.

source_text: and he, because of his remaining throughout the age, has the inviolable priesthood,
target_text: te ngaa yesus, kètu agama rupa hiu dhu mamuri taa-taa, aa na loe boe pakako sasab'a-la'a na. nèti èèna ka, parluu boe dhèu gati ne.

source_text: from where also he is able to save to the very end, those coming through him to god-ever living to make intercession for them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus bisa hia mamuri mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu neo mai re nèngu asa madha ama lamatua. nèngu bisa tao sèmi èèna, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. aa nèngu j'aj'i dhèu d'ara, dhu loe boe manèngi ama lamatua ho soru-bara rèngu.

source_text: for also such a chief priest was fitting for us-holy, innocent, undefiled, separate from the sinners, and having become higher than the heavens,
target_text: yesus kètu kapai risi agama dhu lalau-lalo'o èdhi. te nèngu ne, dhèu mola-mèci dhu dènge boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. nèngu ne, sama boe dènge dhèu rai-haha biasa, dhu re'a dhoka ad'u-ue sasala di. te ama lamatua dhu nedhe ne padedha-dedha, risi nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu sorga dènge rai-haha.

source_text: who has no daily necessity, as the chief priests, to first offer up sacrifice for his own sins, then for those of the people; for this he did once, having offered up himself;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus be'a risi nèti kètu agama rupa dhui aa'i-aa'i ra. uru sèra, rèngu bèli-bèli hud'i roro badha tao korban, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo rèngu unu ra. èle ku, heka ra tao korban hia dhèu biasa kèna. te ngaa yesus parluu boe tao korban pahari-pahari sèmi èèna, lula na saraka ngi'u na ca tèka èèna ka di, sèna ka j'aj'i korban. ne'e ne d'ai aa'i kèna, ho lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for the law appoints men as chief priests, having weakness, but the word of the oath that is after the law appoints the son having been perfected throughout the age.
target_text: madhutu atora musa, rèngu ded'e dhèu rai-haha biasa ho j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama. te ngaa sasala ra era. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua tao lii pajaji hiu, peka na, nèngu ded'e ana na j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama. te ana na, madhutu taruu dad'èi na.

source_text: and the sum concerning the things spoken of is: we have such a chief priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the greatness in the heavens,
target_text: de lii padhai ja'a dhu kab'ua, sèmi ne'e ka: limuri ne, èdhi dènge le kètu kapai risi agama dhu be'a risi nèti uru sèra. nèngu ne'e, nuka yesus. nèngu dhu madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu sorga, ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele.

source_text: a servant of the holy places, and of the true dwelling place, which the lord set up, and not man,
target_text: aa na pakako sasab'a na ètu era sabaj'a dhu asli ètu sorga. era ne'e ne, pa'ue-ai ama lamatua mesa na, nèti boe dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: for every chief priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, from where it is necessary for this one to also have something that he may offer;
target_text: kètu kapai risi agama tema nèti mèdha persembahan dènge korban hia ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, yesus hud'i nèti korban kahèi.

source_text: for if, indeed, he were on earth, he would not be a priest there being the priests who are offering the gifts according to the law,
target_text: te ngaa yesus pakako boe sasab'a na ètu rai-haha. lula ètu rai-haha ne, abhu le ama agama dhu hia mèdha persembahan dènge korban asa ama lamatua madhutu atora musa.

source_text: who to an example and shadow serve of the heavenly things, as moses has been divinely warned, being about to construct the dwelling place, for, see, he says, that you will make all things according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain,
target_text: ra pakako sasab'a ra ètu d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i, dhu ca ropa dènge era sabaj'a dhu asli ètu sorga. te lod'o musa neo tao paleo ne, ama lamatua pasanèd'e ne, peka na, sanèd'e paie-iie! èu hud'i tao ku palèke mola-mola dènge rupa dhu ja'a pad'elo dènge èu ètu kolo ledhe nèi!

source_text: but now he has obtained a more excellent service, how much he is also mediator of a better covenant, which has been sanctioned on better promises,
target_text: te ngaa sasab'a yesus ne, kapai risi nèti ama agama rupa dhui aa'i-aa'i ra. te limuri ne, ama lamatua pa'èki le lii pajaji dhu be'a risi, lula na pake yesus j'aj'i kalete kahèi, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha bisa padame dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for if that first were faultless, a place would not have been sought for a second.
target_text: uru èèna, na pa'èki lii pajaji dènge musa, ropa na papuru atora sèra. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu rai-haha bisa boe mamuri mola-mèci madhutu atora ne. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bisa boe pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne, parluu abhu lii pajaji dhu be'a risi hari.

source_text: for finding fault, he says to them, behold, days come, says the lord, and i will complete with the house of israel, and with the house of judah, a new covenant,
target_text: te lod'o uru sèra, ama lamatua dhu kai le dhèu unu na, lula rèngu sisu pahari-pahari atora na. ropa na taha nare heka d'ara, hèia na nasa, ka peka, aku nèngu na, nanene paie-iie, te ja'a ne lamatua! tatu ja'a neo pa'èki hari lii pajaji hiu dènge dhèu isra'el sèra, aa dènge suku yahuda.

source_text: not according to the covenant that i made with their fathers, in the day of my taking them by their hand, to bring them out of the land of egypt-because they did not remain in my covenant, and i did not regard them, says the lord-
target_text: lii pajaji dhu ja'a neo pa'èki dènge rèngu èèna, sama boe dènge lii pajaji uru èèna dhu hia mi bèi-baki ra. te uru èèna, ja'a kadhèi kacui-aai ra, ho lere si kalua nèti rai masir. te ngaa rèngu tao boe madhutu ngaa dhu ra pajaji dènge ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pusi-pahae heka si.

source_text: because this is the covenant that i will make with the house of israel, after those days, says the lord, giving my laws into their mind, and i will write them on their hearts, and i will be to them for a god, and they will be to me for a people;
target_text: lii pajaji dhu èèna na ja'a pa'èki dènge suku isra'el, isi na sèmi ne'e ka: pe ja'a tao atora ja'a ètu d'ara ngangee ra. pe ja'a suri paredha ja'a, ètu d'ara rèngu. hèia ja'a j'aj'i lamatua ra, aa rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: and they will not each teach his neighbor, and each his brother, saying, know the lord, because they will all know me-from the small one of them to the great one of them,
target_text: bèli-camèd'a rèngu parluu heka aj'a-nori angalai ra, dènge a'ari ra, peka na, ‘miu hud'i tadhe ku lamatua! ' te rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra tadhe mèu ja'a, mulai nèti ana iiki-iiki toke d'ai kapai aae.

source_text: because i will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and i will remember their sins and their lawlessnesses no more.
target_text: lula ja'a neo pad'elo rasa kasia ja'a mi rèngu, nèti èèna ka ja'a pabhèlu eele sasala-sasigo ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: in the saying new, he has made the first obsolete, and what is becoming obsolete and growing old is near disappearing.
target_text: lod'o lamatua padhai lii nare, na neo pa'èki lii pajaji hiu dènge ra, sasoa na, lii pajaji dhui pake heka. nèbhu heka, na ele.

source_text: it had, indeed, then even the first dwelling place ordinances of service, also a worldly sanctuary,
target_text: ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu sèmi ne'e: lod'o ama lamatua pa'èki hiu-hiu lii pajaji dènge bèi-baki èdhi, nèngu papuru atora kahèi, sèna ka ra tao era manèngi-mangaj'i, ho ra bisa pahaha iisi mi nèngu madhutu dad'èi atora sèra.

source_text: for a dwelling place was prepared, the first, in which was both the lampstand, and the table, and the bread of the presentation-which is called holy;
target_text: ètu era manèngi-mangaj'i ne, abhu madha èmu dènge paleo aae cue. ètu d'ara kama re madha nèti paleo ne, abhu era tatèka labhu dènge mei èci dhu ama agama tèke roti dhu rèngu neo hia ama lamatua. kama re madha ne, ra peka na, kama mola-mèci ama lamatua.

source_text: and after the second veil a dwelling place that is called holy of holies,
target_text: abhu kahèi bèla bhabhiri kapai ca bèla dhu pa'abhe kama leo èci, dhu ra peka na, kama luri mola-mèci ama lamatua.

source_text: having a golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid all over with gold, in which is the golden pot having the manna, and the rod of aaron that budded, and the tablets of the covenant,
target_text: re madha bèla bhabhiri ne, abhu mei hualaa cue, era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi hia ama lamatua. aa ètu d'ara kama luri mola-mèci èèna, abhu boaraka hualaa èci, dhu ra peka na, boaraka pajaji. ètu d'ara boaraka ne, rèngu tao mèdha uuru sèra, sèna ka pasanèd'e dhèu lula-nèti j'ara lii pajaji ama lamatua dhu na pa'èki dènge rèngu. ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi toples hualaa cue dhu isi roti manna. roti ne'e ka dhu uru èèna ama lamatua papuru mai nèti dedha-liru hia mi bèi-baki èdhi, lod'o rèngu manganga ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a. ètu d'ara boaraka ne, abhu kahèi tatea unu harun, dhu uru èèna sub'u dadana hiu. abhu kahèi hadhu kabela, dhu uru èèna ama lamatua pake ho dule atora na dhu pangèd'u mi musa.

source_text: and over it cherubim of the glory, overshadowing the propitiatory covering, concerning which we are not to particularly speak now.
target_text: ètu katanga boaraka ne, abhu dhu dule rupa dua ana dhèu dhu saraga titu kèna. ana dhèu se, rupa ra nuka sèmi ana pajuu nèti sorga dhu dènge èla, dhu titu baa èla, ho bhiri boaraka ne, lula era ne j'aj'i mi tadha, ho pad'elo rasa kasia ama lamatua mi dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a pamadhera heka lii lole nèti mèdha-panyau se.

source_text: and these things having been thus prepared, into the first dwelling place, indeed, the priests go in at all times, performing the services,
target_text: rèngu pangèci mèdha-panyau ètu d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua mema sèmi èèna ka. bèli-bèli, ama agama sèra maso-kalua kama re madha ne, sèna ka ra pakako sasab'a ra ètu èèna.

source_text: and into the second, once in the year, only the chief priest, not apart from blood, which he offers for himself and the errors of the people.
target_text: te ngaa dhodhoka kètu kapai risi agama yahudi di, dhu bisa maso la'e asa d'ara kama luri mola-mèci èèna. aa nèngu maso leli boe, te ngaa maso sa d'ara dhoka ca tèu ca tèka. aa ladhe na maso, nèngu hud'i nèti dènge raa badha korban, ho pici asa katanga boaraka pajaji ne. sasoa nèti raa ne, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo nèti kètu agama dènge dhèu-dhèu unu na aa'i-aa'i, masi ka sasala dhu rèngu ad'u-ue dènge boe d'ara mase'a.

source_text: by this the holy spirit was making evident that the way of the holy places has not yet been revealed, the first dwelling place yet having a standing,
target_text: ama lamatua pake le roh mola-mèci na, sèna ka hia èdhi te'a, na, ladhe bèla bhabhiri abhu era ètu j'ara maso asa d'ara kama luri mola-mèci èèna, sasoa na, dhèu rai-haha bisa mèka maso asa madha ama lamatua, ladhe pake atora dhui era.

source_text: which is an allegory in regard to the present time, in which both gifts and sacrifices are offered, which are not able, in regard to conscience, to make perfect him who is serving,
target_text: se'e se j'aj'i mi conto dhu roh lamatua pake, sèna ka aj'a-nori èdhi dhu mamuri limuri ne. uru èèna, bèi-baki èdhi rèti mèdha persembahan dènge badha korban rèngu asa ama agama, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala ra. masi ka rèti korban ae-ae sèmi èèna, te ngaa korban sèra bisa boe pamèu d'ara ra, aa bisa boe pa'ele rasa sala ètu d'ara rèngu.

source_text: only on the basis of food, and drinks, and different immersions, and fleshly ordinances-until the time of reformation imposed on them.
target_text: de, ngaa dhu rèngu tao sèra, dhoka madhutu atora agama di. abhu atora dhu paredha, peka na, rèngu bisa boe ra'a ne'e, aa bisa boe rinu èèna. abhu atora dhu leo peka na, rèngu hud'i pamèu ku ngi'u ra dènge mèdha dhu ra pake madhutu dad'èi atora. aa te ngaa, madhutu iia-iia na, atora aa'i-aa'i sèra, ator dhoka ngi'u re li'u di, te ngaa ator boe d'ara dhèu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa atora sèra hud'i pakako taruu, toke ama lamatua gati dènge atora dhu hiu.

source_text: but christ having come, chief priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect dwelling place not made with hands-that is, not of this creation-
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne abhu le dhèu dhu uru èèna ama lamatua padhadha tèke, nuka kristus. na mai le sèna ka j'aj'i kètu agama kapai risi èdhi, aa na tao le j'ara dhu be'a hia èdhi. na pakako sasab'a-la'a na, sama sèmi kètu agama rupa dhui, te ngaa na sab'a ètu era sabaj'a dhu be'a risi eele. era manèngi-mangaj'i na, ètu boe rai-haha ne, te j'aj'i boe nèti pa'ue-ai dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: neither through blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once into the holy places, having obtained continuous redemption;
target_text: kristus maso asa d'ara kama luri mola-mèci èèna kahèi, ho paraga dènge ama lamatua, sama sèmi dhu kètu kapai risi agama dhu rupa dhui se tao ca tèu ca tèka. aa lod'o na maso la'e, na nèti raa hia ama lamatua kahèi. te ngaa raa ne leko-leo. te kristus nèti boe raa badha korban. dhu nèti, nuka raa nèngu unu na, lula nèngu madhe le j'aj'i korban hia èdhi. te ngaa kristus maso, nèti raa na dhoka ca tèka di, sèna ka patabuli eele èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: for if the blood of bulls, and goats, and ashes of a heifer, sprinkling those defiled, sanctifies to the purifying of the flesh,
target_text: de raa kristus èèna, mema kab'ua risi nèti raa badha. te madhutu atora musa, dhèu dhu tao sala sèra, kaj'alu, ka nia boe maso ho manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua. rèngu hud'i lasi ku asa kètu agama ho tao korban, sèna ka raa korban se pamèu hari rèngu. nèti korban sèra, ae ka dhu pake raa kahib'i dènge raa sapi. abhu kahèi atora èci, dhu peka na, ladhe dhèu goi lèke dhèu madhe, nèngu kaj'alu ètu madha lamatua. ladhe na neo hari j'aj'i mola-mèci, kètu agama hud'i nare ku ahu sisa nèti sapi èni dhu ra tunu. èle, na nèti ahu èèna, ho la'e ceb'e asa dhèu dhu kaj'alu èèna, ho sèna ka na mola-mèci hari.

source_text: how much more will the blood of the christ who through the perpetual spirit offered himself unblemished to god purify your conscience from dead works to serve the living god?
target_text: de ladhe raa badha bisa tao dhèu j'aj'i mola-mèci, risi-risi hari dènge raa kristus! te raa kristus èèna ka dhu patalale èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo, aa pamèu d'ara èdhi kahèi. te sasala èdhi ka dhu cèri eele èdhi nèti ama lamatua. lod'o yesus kristus madhe sèmi èèna, roh ama lamatua dhu mamuri taa-taa, soru-bara ne, sèna ka na soro iisi na asa lamatua, nuka sèmi badha korban dhu dènge boe tadha karehe ciki sa hèi ètu ngi'u na. de limuri ne èdhi bisa le pahaha iisi dènge d'ara kateme mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: and because of this, he is mediator of a new covenant, that his death having come for redemption of the transgressions under the first covenant, those called may receive the promise of the continuous inheritance,
target_text: lula raa kristus dhu kab'ua risi eele èèna, ka ama lamatua pake ne, ho ator lii pajaji hiu hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paroa nare si, j'aj'i dhèu unu na. te lod'o kristus madhe ho hia mamuri mi dhèu, nèngu sui nare kahèi bèi-baki èdhi nèti sasala dhu ra ad'u-ue uru-uru sèra, lod'o ama lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dhui dènge ra. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bisa mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: for where a covenant is, it is necessary to establish the death of the one having made it,
target_text: ja'a pakasame dènge dhèu abhu pusaka, nuka sèmi ca dhèu ama dhu tao sasuri pajaji, ho hia ana na pusaka. te ngaa ladhe ama na madhe, heka ana èèna abhu pusaka sèra.

source_text: for a covenant is affirmed at death, since it is not in force at all when the one having made it lives,
target_text: te ladhe ama na dhae madhe mèka, ana na bisa mèka abhu pusaka dhu ama na padhadha ètu d'ara sasuri pajaji èèna.

source_text: for which reason, not even the first has been initiated apart from blood,
target_text: èci èèna ka dènge lii pajaji ama lamatua dhu partama, dhu na pa'èki dènge bèi-baki èdhi sèra. ladhe abhu dhu madhe uuru, heka rèngu abhu ngaa dhu lamatua jaji. nèti èèna ka, korban rèngu pake raa badha ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, abhu dhu madhe le.

source_text: for every command having been spoken, according to law, by moses, to all the people, having taken the blood of the calves and goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, he sprinkled both the scroll itself and all the people,
target_text: uru èèna, musa oru nare bèi-baki èdhi, ka na peka aa'i paredha dhu abhu ètu d'ara atora dhu lamatua papuru mai. èle èèna ka, musa roro sapi dènge kahib'i sèna ka nare raa, ka na pab'ali dènge èi. musa nare dhari mea kahèi, ka na pa'èki dènge pèri-pèri ana aaj'u dhu rèu lutu. hèia na cèb'u asa d'ara raa èèna, ka pici mi sasuri lamatua, aa mi dhèu unu na aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: saying, this is the blood of the covenant that god enjoined to you,
target_text: lod'o musa pici raa ne, na padhai lii kahèi, peka na, raa ne'e ne j'aj'i mi tadha, dhu peka na, ama lamatua dhu pa'èki lii pajaji dènge miu. ladhe miu madhutu aa'i paredha na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu hia aa'i dhu na pajaji le sèra.

source_text: and he sprinkled both the dwelling place and all the vessels of the service with blood in like manner,
target_text: musa pici raa asa paleo manèngi-mangaj'i kahèi, dènge asa mèdha aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra, dhu ra pake ho pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: and with blood almost all things are purified according to the law, and forgiveness does not come apart from blood-shedding.
target_text: te madhutu atora lamatua, aa'i-aa'i dhu kaj'alu hud'i pamèu ku pake raa. nèti èèna ka, ladhe dhèu rai-haha neo j'aj'i mola-mèci nèti sasala ra, hud'i dènge ku raa korban.

source_text: it is necessary, therefore, the pattern indeed of the things in the heavens to be purified with these, and the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these;
target_text: ngaa dhu ja'a lole nèti j'ara bèi-baki èdhi dènge paleo manèngi-mangaj'i, se'e se dhoka conto di, sèna ka èdhi bisa te'a mèu, era manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua dhu asli ètu sorga. te ladhe kètu agama rupa dhui neo lasi asa d'ara paleo èèna ho manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, rèngu hud'i pamèu aa'i-aa'i ku pake raa badha korban. era manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua ètu sorga kahèi hud'i mèu taruu-taruu. te ngaa hud'i pake ku raa korban dhu kab'ua risi eele nèti raa badha.

source_text: for the christ did not enter into holy places made with hands-figures of the true-but into heaven itself, now to be manifested in the presence of god for us;
target_text: kama luri mola-mèci dhu kristus maso èèna, ètu boe d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i dhu dhèu rai-haha tao. te paleo dhu ètu rai-haha èèna, dhoka conto di nèti dhu asli. te ngaa kristus la'e unu na asa sorga ho sarii èdhi ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: nor that he may offer himself many times, even as the chief priest enters into the holy places every year with blood of others,
target_text: uru èèna, kètu kapai risi agama hud'i maso ku la'e asa d'ara kama luri mola-mèci èèna ca tèu ca tèka, aa nèti dènge raa badha hia ama lamatua. te ngaa kristus aad'o sèmi èèna. te nèngu parluu maso dhoka ca tèka di, nèti dènge raa nèngu unu na.

source_text: otherwise it was necessary for him to suffer many times from the foundation of the world, but now he has been revealed once, at the full end of the ages, for the annulling of sin through his sacrifice;
target_text: te ladhe tèu mai-tèu mai, hud'i na maso sama sèmi kètu agama dhu uru sèra, sasoa na, nèngu hud'i madhe ku pahari-pahari karèi nèti j'aj'aj'i rai-haha toke deo ne'e, sèna ka saku eele aa'i sasala nèti dhèu èci-èci. te ngaa na tao boe sèmi èèna. te ropa d'ai lod'o na, nèngu madhe j'aj'i korban dhoka ca tèka èèna di, ho core eele aa'i sasala dhu dhèu ad'u-ue.

source_text: and as it is reserved for men to die once, and after this-judgment,
target_text: dhu lèke ka, dhèu rai-haha madhe dhoka ca tèka di. èle èèna, nèngu hud'i la'e asa madha ama lamatua ho ama lamatua parisa ne.

source_text: so also the christ, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, apart from a sin-offering, for salvation to those waiting for him!
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi kristus. nèngu madhe, aa saraka ngi'u na ho j'aj'i korban ca tèka èèna ka. aa bèli-camèd'a na lèpa hari mai. te ngaa na mai uri heka sasala dhèu, lula na tao pa'èle aa'i le sasab'a èèna. te ngaa dhu na uri, nuka pala mamuri hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sanao-maena mi nèngu.

source_text: for the law having a shadow of the good things coming-not the very image of the matters, every year, by the same sacrifices that they offer continually, is never able to make perfect those coming near,
target_text: ladhe tare'a-re'a dhèu neo re'a mèu dad'èi ama lamatua, atora dhu na pangèd'u asa bèi-baki èdhi sèra, dhae led'a iia mèka. te aa'i-aa'i se nuka sèmi sanabhu nèti j'ara-j'ara hua iia dhu lamatua neo hia èdhi. de masi ka dhèu madhutu aa'i atora, aa rèti dènge badha korban taruu-taruu, te ngaa bisa boe saku pamèu sasala rèngu.

source_text: since, would they not have ceased to be offered, because of those serving having no more conscience of sins, having been purified once?
target_text: te ladhe atora ne bisa tao eele sasala dhèu, na, rèngu rèti heka badha korban, lula rèngu rasa heka sala. te ngaa sèmi boe èèna.

source_text: but in those sacrifices is a remembrance of sins every year,
target_text: te tèu mai-tèu mai rèngu manèngi pahari-pahari ho ama lamatua saku eele sasala ra,

source_text: for it is impossible for blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
target_text: lula, tatu boe raa badha dènge koasa, sèna ka saku eele sasala dhèu toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: for this reason, coming into the world, he says, sacrifice and offering you did not will, and a body you prepared for me; in burnt-offerings, and concerning sin-offerings, you did not delight.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, kristus peka sèmi ne'e, lod'o na mai asa rai-haha ne, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua! ama d'èi boe badha korban dènge mèdha persembahan dhu rèngu rèti. rèngu roro pamadhe badha ae-ae, sèna ka j'aj'i korban. ka rèngu tunu badha sèra, ho manèngi abho. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara ama karej'e boe. nèti èèna ka, ama pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi rèngu.

source_text: then i said, behold, i come in a volume of the scroll it has been written concerning me, to do, o god, your will;
target_text: hèia kristus tuhu hari lii, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a ka ne'e le! ja'a mai sèna ka tao madhutu dad'èi ama, nuka sèmi dhèu rèti lii padhai ama dhu suri mema lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: saying above, sacrifice, and offering, and burnt-offerings, and concerning sin-offering you did not will, nor delight in which are offered according to the law,
target_text: de dhu kristus peka partama, nuka: ama lamatua karej'e boe dènge badha korban, aa mèdha persembahan dhu rèngu rèti. rèngu roro pamadhe badha ae-ae, sèna ka j'aj'i korban. hèia ra tunu badha sèra, ho manèngi abho. te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, d'ara lamatua karej'e boe. de masi ka rèngu tao madhutu le pamèci dènge atora musa, te ngaa d'ara ama lamatua karej'e boe ciki sa.

source_text: then he said, behold, i come to do, o god, your will; he takes away the first that he may establish the second;
target_text: lod'o kristus padhai lii, peka na, ja'a mai, sèna ka tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua. sasoa na, kristus mai sèna ka tao eele j'ara dhui, ho gati dènge j'ara hiu.

source_text: in which will, we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of jesus christ once for all,
target_text: te dad'èi lamatua ka, yesus kristus j'aj'i korban ho madhe dhoka ca tèka di hia èdhi dhèu rai-haha. dènge j'ara ne'e, na pamèu èdhi toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and every priest, indeed, has daily stood serving, and offering the same sacrifices many times, that are never able to take away sins.
target_text: bèli-bèli kètu agama rupa dhui pakako taruu sasab'a ra, aa roro pamadhe badha korban. aa te ngaa korban se, dènge boe koasa sèna ka saku eele sasala dhèu.

source_text: but he, having offered one sacrifice for sin-to the end, sat down at the right hand of god-
target_text: te ngaa kètu kapai risi agama èdhi, nuka kristus, saraka ngi'u na ho madhe sèna ka j'aj'i korban hia èdhi. nèngu j'aj'i korban dhoka ca tèka èèna di. dènge tao sèmi èèna, na bhoke j'ara sèna ka saku eele sasala èdhi dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i ti. èle èèna, heka nèngu la'e madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua, ètu era dhu kab'ua risi eele.

source_text: as to the rest, expecting until he may place his enemies as his footstool,
target_text: ètu era nèi, na mate toke ama lamatua tao musu na sèra mai pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: for by one offering he has perfected to the end those being sanctified;
target_text: korban nèngu dhu ca tèka èèna, pama'ète eele koasa sasala-sasigo nèti dhèu dhu kristus pamèu si.

source_text: and the holy spirit also testifies to us, for after that he has said before,
target_text: roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka j'ara dhu sèmi èèna kahèi hia mi èdhi. te na padhai lii nèdhi, peka na,

source_text: this is the covenant that i will make with them after those days, says the lord, giving my laws on their hearts, and i will write them on their minds,
target_text: lamatua miu peka sèmi ne'e: ja'a pa'èki lii pajaji hiu dènge dhèu unu ja'a, ja'a tao atora ja'a ètu d'ara ngangee ra, dènge suri paredha ja'a ètu d'ara ra.

source_text: and, i will remember their sins and their lawlessness no more;
target_text: hèia na peka hari, na, èèna na ja'a sanèd'e heka sasala ra. aa ja'a pabhèlu eele tatao rèngu dhu karehe, lod'o rèngu sisu atora ja'a.

source_text: and where there is forgiveness of these, there is no longer offering for sin.
target_text: sasoa na, ladhe ama lamatua saku eele le sasala dhèu, èèna na rèngu parluu heka rèti badha korban, sèna ka pamaho d'ara lamatua.

source_text: having, therefore, brothers, boldness for the entrance into the holy places, by the blood of jesus,
target_text: de sèmi ne'e a'ari aa'i-aa'i! yesus pasuti le raa na, sèna ka cuhi d'ara ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi madha'u ia ka lati asa katanga madha na ètu era na dhu mola-mèci ètu sorga.

source_text: which is the way he initiated for us-new and living, through the veil, that is, his flesh-
target_text: pangee ku kama luri mola-mèci dhu dhui èèna. ètu era èèna, abhu bèla bhiri ca bèla dhu bhèla aae, dhu pa'abhe sèna ka dhèu baku lasi asa katanga madha ama lamatua. te ngaa dènge mamadhe yesus èèna, na bhoke j'ara hiu, ho dhèu bisa padhai lii patoo madha dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: and a great priest over the house of god,
target_text: risi-risi hari, yesus j'aj'i kètu agama dhu kapai risi, dhu uri dènge lalau-lalo'o isi èmu ama lamatua.

source_text: may we draw near with a true heart, in full assurance of faith, having the hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and having the body bathed with pure water;
target_text: de limuri ne èdhi dènge hak. nèti èèna ka, mai ti maso ho padhai lii patoo madha dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa èdhi hud'i parcaya ne tare'a-re'a dènge d'ara mola. te mamadhe yesus ka dhu pamèu le d'ara èdhi, toke èdhi pangee heka j'ara-j'ara bhelu-katub'a. aa èdhi hud'i mamuri mola, nuka sèmi ama agama rupa dhui sèra, hud'i diu ku èi, heka maso lasi pakako sasab'a lamatua.

source_text: may we hold fast the unwavering profession of the hope for he who promised is faithful,
target_text: mai ho èdhi kèpe pa'èra-èra kahèi, aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi mangaku le lula-nèti ama lamatua. aa èdhi hud'i sanao-maena mi nèngu kahèi, aa pangee ia ka dhu leo, te tatu na tao madhutu lii pajaji na.

source_text: and may we consider to provoke one another to love and to good works,
target_text: de mai èdhi patangi-tenge j'ara ho pamako a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra, sèna ka èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti pad'elo sasue ae-ae, aa dènge tao rupa-rupa j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as is a custom of some, but exhorting, and so much the more as you see the day coming near.
target_text: te ja'a tadèngi le, abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu ro'o heka pakaboko dènge a'ari ra dhèu parcaya. te ngaa mage miu sèmi èèna! te miu hud'i pa'asu-pareo ku, ho pa'èra d'ara èci dènge èci. risi-risi, lula lod'o mamai hari lamatua dètu le. pasanèd'e si sèmi èèna!

source_text: for if we are sinning willingly after receiving the full knowledge of the truth-there remains no more sacrifice for sins,
target_text: a'ari pasue! èdhi te'a le toke lutu-sela, j'ara-j'ara yesus kristus dhu mola. te ngaa ladhe èdhi soro kabodho mi yesus, aa ad'u-ue taruu sasala, sasoa na, abhu heka korban leo dhu bisa saku eele sasala èdhi.

source_text: but a certain fearful looking for of judgment, and fiery zeal, about to devour the opposers;
target_text: èdhi dhoka mate dènge d'ara madha'u, lula ama lamatua mai huku èdhi. te ai naraka heo robhe-robhe le, ho pakèpu dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu lab'a lamatua.

source_text: anyone having set aside a law of moses dies without mercies on the basis of two or three witnesses.
target_text: uru èèna, ladhe abhu ca dhèu dhu tule eele atora musa, aa abhu dua do tèlu dhèu dhu j'aj'i sakasii, na, dhèu èèna hud'i abhu huku madhe, hia boe ne abho.

source_text: of how much worse punishment will he be counted worthy who trampled on the son of god, and counted the blood of the covenant a common thing, by which he was sanctified, and having insulted the spirit of grace?
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pahahe ana ama lamatua, èèna sama sèmi nèngu pakab'ua boe raa yesus dhu na pasuti sèna ka pamèu dhèu èèna. aa no'o boe pane'a dènge lii pajaji dhu ama lamatua pa'èki dènge nèngu pake raa èèna ka. aa nèngu tao roh ama lamatua nasa kahèi. te roh èèna ka dhu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi nèngu. pangee ku laa! te dhèu sèmi ne'e ne, tatu pasae nare hahuku dhu bia risi nèti dhèu dhu tule eele atora musa.

source_text: for we have known him who is saying, vengeance is mine, i will repay, says the lord; and again, the lord will judge his people.
target_text: ama lamatua peka nèdhi le, na. ja'a dènge hak ho b'ala bhelu-katub'a dhèu. aa tatu ja'a hud'i tao ku madhutu sèmi èèna. aa dhu suri kahèi, na, lamatua ne, ama. bèli-camèd'a na huku dhèu unu na.

source_text: it is fearful to fall into the hands of the living god.
target_text: sanèd'e te ama lamatua mamuri taa-taa! dhèu tatu madha'u titu kèna, ladhe lamatua kèpe nare si!

source_text: but call to your remembrance the former days, in which, having been enlightened, you endured much conflict of sufferings;
target_text: miu hud'i sanèd'e ku lod'o miu mulai me'a j'ara-j'ara kristus, ka ngangee miu mulai mèu. te lod'o èèna, masi ka miu dhoka muri ètu d'ara sasusa dènge j'aj'èra ae-ae, te ngaa miu taha dènge parcaya taruu kristus.

source_text: this indeed, being made spectacles with both insults and afflictions, now this, having become partners of those so living,
target_text: abhu dhu pamakae dènge pahahe miu ètu madha dhèu ae. abhu kahèi dhu ra tao sèmi èèna mi angalai miu, dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: for you also sympathized with my bonds, and the robbery of your goods you received with joy, knowing that you have in yourselves a better substance in the heavens, and an enduring one.
target_text: miu rasa kasia aa pad'elo d'ara be'a mi dhèu dhu ra pamaso si asa d'ara bèdho. ladhe dhèu mana'u rèti mèdha-panyau miu, miu mau-mau sène, lula miu me'a, na, bèli-camèd'a miu abhu dhu be'a risi, dhu dhèu bisa heka mana'u rare.

source_text: you may not cast away, then, your boldness, which has great repayment of reward,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka miu. te èèna na lamatua b'ala hia miu, ae-ae.

source_text: for you have need of patience, that having done the will of god, you may receive the promise.
target_text: de taha taruu! te ladhe miu tao madhutu aa'i dad'èi lamatua, èèna na miu abhu aa'i dhu na jaji le hia miu.

source_text: for yet in a very, very little while, he who is coming will come, and will not linger,
target_text: dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua suri le lula-nèti dhèu dhu neo mai, peka na, baku paroe d'ara, te nèbhu boe, dhèu dhu neo mai èèna, cèu, aa na pamate heka.

source_text: but, the righteous will live by faith; and if he may draw back, my soul has no pleasure in him.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'ara mola, èèna na nèngu abhu mamuri, lula na parcaya ja'a. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pakaj'èu nèti ja'a, d'ara ja'a karej'e boe.

source_text: but we are not of those drawing back to destruction, but of those believing to a preserving of soul.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi, dhèu dhu pakaj'èu boe nèti ama lamatua. te dhèu dhu pakaj'èu nèti lamatua, bèli-camèd'a cèri eele nèti nèngu. te ngaa èdhi dhèu dhu parcaya ama lamatua. ka nèngu patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi, ho mamuri taruu dènge ne.

source_text: now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the proof of matters not being seen,
target_text: ladhe èdhi parcaya ama lamatua, sasoa na, èdhi lèka tare'a-re'a nèngu taruu. te ladhe na moa le hia èdhi j'ara èci, èdhi te'a, na, tatu na tao madhutu lii pajaji nèngu èèna. masi ka èdhi abhu mèka ngaa-ngaa, èdhi parcaya ne taruu.

source_text: for by this, the elders were well-attested.
target_text: abhu bèi-baki èdhi dhu parcaya sèmi èèna kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua sèmi nare si dènge be'a.

source_text: by faith we understand the ages to have been prepared by a saying of god, in regard to the things seen having not come out of things appearing.
target_text: rai-haha dènge liru dhu èdhi ladhe tèdhi ne, èdhi te'a, na, ama lamatua ka paj'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu. te ngaa na tao boe nèti mèdha dhu j'aj'i le, dhu dhèu bisa rèdhi. aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i se, j'aj'i nèti lii padhai na di.

source_text: by faith abel offered a better sacrifice to god than cain, through which he was testified to be righteous, god testifying of his gifts, and through it, he being dead, yet speaks.
target_text: habel parcaya ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, nèngu nèti mèdha persembahan dhu be'a risi nèti a'a na kaen. ama lamatua sèmi nare habel dènge mèdha persembahan na, lula d'ara na mola. de masi ka na madhe nèbhu le, te ngaa èdhi bisa tare conto nèti nèngu, lula lalèka na.

source_text: by faith enoch was translated-not to see death, and was not found, because god translated him; for before his translation he had been testified to-that he had pleased god well,
target_text: henok parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua nedhe nèti ne asa sorga, sèna ka baku madhe. dhèu patangi-tenge ne, te ngaa rage boe, lula lamatua dhu paca'e le. lamatua sèmi nare ne dènge be'a, te lamatua dhu peka, na, henok ne, dhèu dhu pakarej'e d'ara ja'a.

source_text: and apart from faith it is impossible to please him, for it is required of him who is coming to god to believe that he exists and that he becomes a rewarder to those seeking him.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e a'ari! dhu lèke ka, ama lamatua sèmi nare boe dhèu dhu parcaya boe nèngu. te dhèu dhu neo la'e asa madha ama lamatua hud'i parcaya, peka na, lamatua dhu mema-mema. aa nèngu hud'i parcaya kahèi, peka na, lamatua soru nare dhèu dhu patangi-tenge ne.

source_text: by faith noah, having been divinely warned concerning the things not yet seen, having feared, prepared an ark to the salvation of his house, through which he condemned the world, and he became heir of the righteousness according to faith.
target_text: noh parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. nèti èèna ka, noh parcaya lamatua ropa lamatua peka mema dènge ne, noh! sanèd'e, ee! èèna na ja'a palaho eele rai-haha ne, pake èi aae lala dhu dhèu rai-haha ne rèdhi mèka ca tèka sa. masi ka noh paraga nèdhi mèka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu nanene ka tao madhutu lii lamatua, hèia na tao kapa, sèna ka nèngu dènge isi èmu na abhu sod'a. lula lalèka na, ka lamatua cap ne dhèu d'ara mola. te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu lèka boe sèra, lamatua hia si hahuku dhu bia.

source_text: by faith abraham, being called, obeyed, to go forth into the place that he was about to receive for an inheritance, and he went forth, not knowing to where he goes.
target_text: abraham parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua paroa ne, peka na, abraham! kalua nèti rai èta-èsu èu ne, ho lamu asa era dhu pe ja'a pad'elo dènge mu. te rai èèna, bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i mi pusaka ana-èpu èu. tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, abraham tao madhutu, masi ka nèngu ne'a boe la'e asa era mia.

source_text: by faith he sojourned in the land of the promise as a strange country, having dwelt in dwelling places with isaac and jacob, fellow-heirs of the same promise,
target_text: ropa abraham d'ai era èèna, na patitu paleo, ho pea nuka sèmi dhèu tao mai ètu rai èèna dhu lamatua pajaji le dènge ne. ka ana na isak dènge èpu na yakob pea ètu èèna, te lamatua dhu padhadha le hia rai ne j'aj'i pusaka rèngu.

source_text: for he was looking for the city having the foundations, whose craftsman and constructor is god.
target_text: na sanao, sèna ka nèngu pea ètu kota cue dhu saraga titu kèna. te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu gambar ho pakèd'i kota ne.

source_text: and by faith sarah, herself barren, received power to conceive seed even after the time of life, seeing she judged him who promised faithful;
target_text: dhèu èmu abraham, ngara na sara, parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. masi ka nara iisi nèdhi mèka, aa dhu heka bhora le, te ngaa lamatua tao ne j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu ca nau-ca nadha. te nèngu parcaya, na, tatu ama lamatua tao madhutu ngaa dhu na jaji le.

source_text: for this reason, also, from one-and that of one who had become dead-were begotten as the stars of the sky in multitude, and innumerable as the sand that is by the seashore.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, masi ka nèngu heka bhora le, nèngu bisa nara iisi era, ka abhu ana-èpu ae-ae, toke ige rare boe. te dhèu se ae, nuka sèmi hua-hètu ètu dedha-liru, aa sèmi salae nebhe dhasi.

source_text: all these died in faith, having not received the promises, but having seen them from afar, and having been persuaded, and having greeted them, and having confessed that they are strangers and sojourners on the earth,
target_text: bèi-baki èdhi abraham, isak dènge yakob parcaya taruu ama lamatua, toke madhe. te ngaa rèngu dhae abhu mèka rai dhu lamatua pajaji èèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa rèngu ma'ète boe sanao dènge d'ara karej'e, te rèngu rèdhi le nèti kaj'èu. te rèngu dhu mangaku, na, rèngu se dhèu leo rai kara dhu pea manubha ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: for those saying such things make apparent that they seek a country;
target_text: aa te ngaa, ladhe dhèu peka sèmi èèna, èdhi te'a, na, rèngu d'èi titu kèna abhu rai cue dhu j'aj'i unu rèngu.

source_text: and if, indeed, they had been mindful of that from which they came forth, they might have had an opportunity to return,
target_text: ladhe rai dhu bèi-baki èdhi d'èi, nuka rai èta-èsu abraham, na, tatu rèngu bisa lèpa hari asa era nèi, lod'o mia èèna ka.

source_text: but now they long for better, that is, heavenly, for this reason god is not ashamed of them, to be called their god, for he prepared a city for them.
target_text: te ngaa rai èta-èsu dhu rèngu d'èi titu kèna, nuka rai èta-èsu dhu saraga bia ètu sorga. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua sèmi nare si dènge be'a, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na. te na pamèci nare le kota cue hia si ètu sorga.

source_text: by faith abraham has offered up isaac, being tried, even the one having received the promises offered up his only begotten, of whom it was said, in isaac will your seed be called,
target_text: parcaya abraham hali boe nèti ama lamatua, ropa lamatua uji parcaya na. nèti èèna ka, na tao madhutu paredha lamatua, ho saraka ana na isak j'aj'i korban. aa te ngaa uru èèna, lamatua dhu moa le, lula-nèti ana ne, peka na, nèti ana mu isak ne, bèli-camèd'a èu abhu ana-èpu udhu sobhu-sobhu, toke ra j'aj'i suku dhu kapai titu kèna.

source_text: reckoning that god is even able to raise up out of the dead, from where also in a figurative sense he received him.
target_text: te ngaa abraham pangee le, na, ama lamatua dhu dènge koasa, ho pamamuri hari dhèu madhe. mema, èèna ka dhu lèke, te lod'o èèna, sama sèmi nèngu abhu hari ana na j'aj'i le mi korban.

source_text: by faith, concerning coming things, isaac blessed jacob and esau.
target_text: isak parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. nèti èèna ka, na manèngi ho lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi ana na, yakob dènge esau.

source_text: by faith jacob, dying, blessed each of the sons of joseph and worshiped on the top of his staff.
target_text: yakob parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. nèti èèna ka, lod'o nèngu oe madhe, pakaseti kèd'i titu dènge kabodho kabhuku dènge kèpe tatea na, pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua. hèia manèngi ho lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi èpu na, ana nèti yusuf.

source_text: by faith joseph, dying, made mention concerning the outgoing of the sons of israel, and gave command concerning his bones.
target_text: yusuf parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. lod'o na oe madhe, nèngu parcaya, na, ama lamatua pe lere nèti dhèu na, dhèu isra'el sèra, kalua nèti rai masir. nèti èèna ka, na moa tèke mi rèngu, ho rèti rui na ropa rèngu tèke eele rai masir.

source_text: by faith moses, having been born, was hid three months by his parents, because they saw the child beautiful, and were not afraid of the decree of the king.
target_text: ina-ama musa parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. lod'o ina na nara iisi ne, ra pahuni ne toke d'ai tèlu hèru kateme, lula ra ladhe na mone iia. aa ra madha'u boe dhèu aae masir, masi ka paredha le dhèu, peka na, pamadhe aa'i ana-ana mone ibrani dhu rara iisi hiu!

source_text: by faith moses, having become great, refused to be called a son of the daughter of pharaoh,
target_text: ropa musa kapai mai, na parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. te uru èèna, ana bhèni dhèu aae masir, dhu ded'e nare le nèngu sèna ka j'aj'i mi ana na. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa musa d'èi boe ladhe dhèu pangee, na, nèngu ne a'ari nèti dhèu aae masir.

source_text: having chosen rather to be afflicted with the people of god, than to have sin's pleasure for a season,
target_text: te na pangee, na, be'a risi nèngu mamuri j'èra sama-sama dènge dhèu unu lamatua sèra. sad'i nèngu baku mamuri karej'e dènge j'ara bhelu-katub'a, dhu dhoka ètu d'ara ciki oo'e di.

source_text: having reckoned the reproach of the christ greater wealth than the treasures in egypt, for he looked to the repayment of reward.
target_text: nèngu soro tèke dhèu pahahe ne, lula nèngu sanao-maena taruu mi kristus, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua pajaji le neo hia na mai. nèngu taha sèmi èèna, lula ne'a, na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua bagi hia ne hadia dhu be'a risi nèti mèdha aa'i-aa'i ètu rai masir.

source_text: by faith he left egypt behind, having not been afraid of the wrath of the king, for as seeing the invisible one-he endured.
target_text: musa parcaya ama lamatua kahèi, lod'o na manèngi isin nèti dhèu aae masir, ho lere nèti bèi-baki èdhi kalua nèti rai masir. masi ka dhèu aae nasa titu kèna, te ngaa musa madha'u boe dènge ne. musa lèka taruu ama lamatua, masi ka tèdhi boe senu-salao na, te ngaa nuka sèmi musa dhu nèdhi.

source_text: by faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, so that he who is destroying the firstborn might not touch them.
target_text: musa parcaya lamatua kahèi, ropa rèngu pa'èra neo kalua nèti rai masir. te nèngu madhutu mèno paredha lamatua, aa pua bèi-baki èdhi tao paska hiu-hiu, dènge roro kahib'i-kalèbho, sèna ka tao badha korban. hèia rare raa kahib'i-kalèbho sèra, sèna ka tao tadha mi babèdho èmu ra. mèda èèna, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga puru mai pamadhe ana uuru aa'i-aa'i ètu rai masir. te ngaa na pamadhe boe ana uuru ètu èmu dhèu isra'el, lula ladhe nèdhi raa dhu ra pici ètu babèdho èmu.

source_text: by faith they passed through the red sea as through dry land, which having made an attempt to cross, the egyptians were swallowed up.
target_text: lod'o bèi-baki èdhi kalua nèti rai masir, rèngu parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. lula lalèka ra, ka lamatua cèri eele èi dhasi mi dua ètu dhasi mea, sèna ka rèngu kako asa cabèka dènge be'a, ètu dedha rai mango. te ngaa sordad'u masir dhu bata si sèra, madhe aa'i ètu d'ara dhasi, ropa neo pège asa cabèka.

source_text: by faith the walls of jericho fell, having been surrounded for seven days.
target_text: lod'o bèi-baki èdhi maso asa rai kana'an, rèngu parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. te rèngu madhutu paredha na, dènge kako rai-reo re li'u tembok ètu kota jeriko, toke pidhu lod'o kateme. ka tembok ne guri laho mae-mae.

source_text: by faith rahab the prostitute did not perish with those who disbelieved, having received the spies with peace.
target_text: lod'o èèna, rahab ètu kota èèna kahèi. uru èèna, nèngu j'aj'i bhèni kajeo. lula na parcaya ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka na sèmi nare mata-mata dhèu isra'el, aa palu'u si ètu d'ara èmu na. hèia lamatua pamadhe aa'i dhèu jeriko, lula ro'o boe nanene nèngu. te ngaa lamatua hia mamuri mi rahab, lula na lèka ne.

source_text: and what yet will i say? for the time will fail me recounting about gideon, also barak, and samson, and jephthah, also david, and samuel, and the prophets,
target_text: ja'a bisa padhai lii madhera hari era, j'ara-j'ara dhèu leo dhu parcaya ama lamatua. te ngaa ja'a abhu boe lod'o taleo, ho lole toke lutu, lula-nèti gideon, barak, simson, yefta, daud, samuel, dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo sèra.

source_text: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked righteousness, obtained promises, stopped mouths of lions,
target_text: rèngu se aa'i-aa'i ra parcaya ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhu segi dhèu aae-dhèu aae. abhu dhu pakako paredha dènge d'ara mola, ho sarii dhèu dhu sala boe, aa huku dhèu dhu sala. abhu dhu sèmi rare ngaa dhu lamatua jaji le. aa abhu kahèi segi badha singa.

source_text: quenched the power of fire, escaped the mouth of the sword, were made powerful out of weakness, became strong in battle, caused armies of the foreigners to give way;
target_text: abhu dhu pamadhe ai dhu heo robhe-robhe. abhu dhu ama lamatua ère nare si nèti dhèu dhu neo pamadhe si pake samala. abhu dhu roe, te ngaa ama lamatua pa'èra si. abhu dhu lamatua tao si ho èra aae ètu d'ara pamusu, toke musu rai.

source_text: women received their dead by a resurrection, and others were tortured, not accepting the redemption, that they might receive a better resurrection,
target_text: abhu kahèi ina-ina dhu paraga hari dènge dhèu rèngu dhu ama lamatua pamamuri hari si nèti mamadhe ra. te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu lèke j'aj'èra, lula parcaya ama lamatua. rèngu d'èi risi madhe, sèna ka baku tèke eele parcaya rèngu mi ama lamatua. te rèngu pa'èci taruu dènge ne. de rèngu dhu sanao-maena, na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo ded'e ra, sèna ka abhu mamuri dhu be'a risi hari ètu sorga.

source_text: and others received trial of mockings and scourgings, and yet of bonds and imprisonment;
target_text: abhu dhu pa-aape si, aa abhu dhu lèke gama. abhu dhu leo dhu lèke ngapi haga ra dènge ngangapi ètu d'ara bui.

source_text: they were stoned, they were sawn apart, they were tried; they died in the killing of the sword; they went around in sheepskins, in goatskins-being destitute, afflicted, injuriously treated,
target_text: abhu dhu madhe, lula lèke pèci dènge hadhu. abhu dhu roro pamadhe si, pake raroro. abhu dhu dhèu pare pamadhe si pake samala. abhu dhu mamuri dènge boe unu, toke ra pake ka'uri badha, lula abhu dhèu dhu paj'èra dènge pasusa si, toke babèga eele si,

source_text: of whom the world was not worthy; wandering in deserts, and mountains, and caves, and the holes of the earth;
target_text: ka rai lasi asa pad'a sod'a, ledhe-ledhe, d'ara loe, dènge asa d'ara ro'a rai. ra tao dhèu se'e dhu laku-laku boe, aa babège-lalèta si asa era dhu karehe. aa te ngaa lalèka ra èra titu kèna, toke dhèu ètu rai-haha ne nia boe pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi se'e se.

source_text: and all these, having been testified to through faith, did not receive the promise,
target_text: lamatua koa dhèu sèmi se'e se, lula ra parcaya ne. te ngaa toke ra madhe, rèngu abhu mèka ngaa dhu lamatua padhadha tèka.

source_text: god, having provided something better for us, that apart from us they might not be made perfect.
target_text: lamatua neo tao madhutu lii padhadha na dènge j'ara dhu be'a risi. lula na d'èi, sèna ka èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti bisa mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ne: nuka èdhi tadhe mèu le kristus, dènge rèngu dhu madhe uuru sèra.

source_text: therefore, we also having so great a cloud of witnesses set around us, having put off every weight, and the closely besetting sin, may we run the contest that is set before us through endurance,
target_text: de tasamia dènge èdhi dhu mamuri lod'o limuri ne? èdhi cakaraa dhèu dhu madhutu pa'uji rai. bèi-baki èdhi dhu parcaya ama lamatua, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra nuka sèmi dhèu dhu titu lingu rare èdhi, ho pa'èra d'ara èdhi. te ngaa èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge sasala era, sèra sa ka dhu pabia haga èdhi ka rai tara boe. nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i core eele ku sasala sèra aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka èdhi bisa rai èra. te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu pili èdhi, ho madhutu pa'uji rai ne, de èdhi hud'i taha ku, sèna ka rai taruu toke d'ai lane.

source_text: looking to the author and perfecter of the faith-jesus, who, for the joy set before him, endured a cross, having despised shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of god;
target_text: aa èdhi hud'i rai, mage piku g'ana-kariu, te ngaa ladhe dhoka asa yesus di. te nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, ho èdhi bisa parcaya ama lamatua. aa èèna na nèngu soru-bara èdhi, sèna ka èdhi parcaya taruu toke èle. sanèd'e, do aad'o? lod'o yesus dui j'aj'èra ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, dhèu pahahe ne, te ngaa na taha taruu, lii boe-ugu boe. te ne'a, na, j'aj'èra na èle kèna, ka d'ara na j'aj'i karae. èèna ka dhu lèke. te na madhe, hèia ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne, èle ka na nedhe pamadhèdi kristus ètu baboa g'ana na, ho paredha sama-sama dènge ne.

source_text: for again consider him who endured such contradiction from the sinners to himself, that you may not be wearied in your souls-being faint.
target_text: masi ka dhèu paj'èra bia ne, te ngaa na taha taruu. de miu baku bhèlu dènge j'aj'èra yesus, sèna ka miu bisa taha mere, aa baku roe.

source_text: you did not yet resist to blood-striving with sin;
target_text: miu lab'a le j'ara bhabhelu-katub'a, te ngaa lalab'a miu èra mèka, toke raa miu suti. tare'a si!

source_text: and you have forgotten the exhortation that speaks fully to you as to sons, my son, do not despise the discipline of the lord, nor be faint, being reproved by him,
target_text: ele boe miu bhèlu lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu na peka le dènge miu, nuka sèmi ca dhèu ama padhai lii dènge ana na, peka na, ana, ee! ladhe ama èdhi dhu huku ho aj'a èu, sèna ka èu mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke, na, èu baku pamud'e! aa ladhe na kai ho aj'a èu, na, èu baku paroe d'ara.

source_text: for whom the lord loves he disciplines, and he scourges every son whom he receives;
target_text: te ama èdhi kai ho aj'a dhèu dhu na sue. mema dhèu-dhèu dhu na sèmi nare j'aj'i ana na, nèngu kai ho aj'a si.

source_text: if you endure discipline, god bears himself to you as to sons, for who is a son whom a father does not discipline?
target_text: de ladhe ama lamatua kai ho aj'a miu sèna ka mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke, na, taha taruu aa sèmi mere. na tao sèmi èèna, lula miu j'aj'i le ana na. te ama aa'i-aa'i hud'i kai ho aj'a ana na, toke ana na bisa mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: and if you are apart from discipline, of which all have become partakers, then you are bastards, and not sons.
target_text: te ladhe ama lamatua kai boe ho aj'a miu sama sèmi ana na dhu leo sèra, sasoa na, miu se ana nèngu boe.

source_text: then, indeed, we have had fathers of our flesh, correctors, and we respected them; will we not much rather be subject to the father of the spirits, and live?
target_text: èdhi tema pakab'ua ama matana èdhi ètu rai-haha ne, lula na kai ho aj'a-nori ti, lod'o èdhi dhu ana iiki era. dhu lèke na kèna. te ngaa dhu be'a risi hari, èdhi hud'i nanene ku ama lamatua dènge be'a, lula nèngu ne, ama èdhi ètu sorga, aa na kai ho aj'a-nori èdhi, sèna ka èdhi mamuri madhutu j'ara na dhu lèke.

source_text: for they, indeed, for a few days, according to what seemed good to them, were disciplining, but he for profit, to be partakers of his separation;
target_text: ama matana èdhi kai ho aj'a èdhi, dhoka d'ara ciki oo'e di, madhutu ngaa dhu na ngee na be'a. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu ne'a risi, ngaa dhu èdhi parluu te'a. nèti èèna ka, na kai ho aj'a èdhi, sèna ka mamuri mola-mèci sama sèmi nèngu.

source_text: and all discipline for the present, indeed, does not seem to be of joy, but of sorrow, yet afterward it yields the peaceable fruit of righteousness to those exercised through it.
target_text: mema èdhi d'èi boe ladhe abhu lii kai. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, d'ara èdhi j'aj'i mau, lula te'a tare le mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: for this reason, lift up the hanging-down hands and the loosened knees; and make straight paths for your feet, so that which is lame may not be turned aside, but rather be healed;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! pa'èra kacui-aai miu dhu roe, aa pasamaa haga miu dhu bia. baku rai piku g'ana-kariu, te ngaa rai mola taruu, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara rèngu dhu roe-bhilu ho bisa rai taruu. miu hud'i pa'èra d'ara miu, sèna ka taha taruu ètu d'ara parcaya mi kristus.

source_text: pursue peace with all, and the separation, apart from which no one will see the lord,
target_text: a'ari dhu parcaya kristus! miu hud'i pa'èra ngi'u mi, sèna ka mamuri padame èci dènge èci. aa baku loe tenge j'ara ho mamuri mola-mèci. te dhèu dhu mola-mèci boe, bisa boe rèdhi ama lamatua.

source_text: observing lest anyone be failing of the grace of god, lest any root of bitterness springing up may give trouble, and through this many may be defiled;
target_text: pa'èra d'ara èci dènge èci, sèna ka mage dhoka abhu nèti miu dhu rai, toke rasa heka d'ara hua iia ama lamatua. aa j'aga paie ho baku soro tèke ladhe abhu dhu papèd'a d'ara ètu talora aae miu. te èèna nuka sèmi raco dhu pa'ele iie dhèu ae.

source_text: lest anyone be a fornicator, or a profane person, as esau, who in exchange for one morsel of food sold his birthright,
target_text: mage-mage aa j'aga ho baku abhu dhèu nèti miu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali nèngu. aa mage-mage aa j'aga ho baku abhu dhèu nèti miu dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua, nuka sèmi esau. esau ne, ana uuru isak. ca lod'o, esau lèpa dènge kabake manganga. na manèngi nganga'a ca pega nèti ari na yakob, ho b'ae pake hak ana uuru.

source_text: for you know that also afterward, wishing to inherit the blessing, he was disapproved of, for he did not find a place of conversion, though having sought it with tears.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi te'a, nèbhu boe ka, esau manyasa. te ropa isak neo manèngi lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi ana uuru na esau, te ngaa bisa heka, lula esau dhu hia iia d'ara le hak ana uuru na. nèti èèna ka, masi ka na tangi roma iisi, tasamia èèna ka, nèngu bisa heka abhu ngaa dhu uru èèna nèngu core eele.

source_text: for you did not come near to the mountain touched and scorched with fire, and to blackness, and darkness, and storm,
target_text: sèmi ne'e a'ari! èdhi bisa lati le asa madha ama lamatua, madhutu j'ara hiu dhu na bhoke nare le hia èdhi. te ngaa uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki èdhi bisa mèka sèmi èèna. te lod'o ama lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge rèngu, rèngu padètu dènge ledhe sinai. ètu dedha ledhe ne, abhu ai dhu heo. abhu ngèlu aae kahèi. aa maroga saguru nare ledhe ne, ka dhèu se madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: and a sound of a trumpet, and a voice of sayings, which those having heard begged that a word might not be added to them,
target_text: rèngu tadèngi lii tiu tèbhe kahèi, hèia lii dhu mèdhu aae nèti lamatua kalua nèti ledhe ne. ropa tadèngi lii lamatua, hèia asa ra madha'u, toke ra manèngi musa, peka na, ira ii! ji'i bisa heka taha dènge lii nèi!

source_text: for they were not bearing that which is commanded, and if a beast may touch the mountain, it will be stoned, or shot through with an arrow,
target_text: rèngu mema bisa boe taha, lula ngaa dhu lamatua paredha èèna, bia titu kèna. te na peka, na, ca dhèu sa bisa boe j'èli ledhe ne! masi ka dhèu, do badha! te dhèu cee dhu j'èli ledhe ne, hud'i lèke pèci toke madhe.

source_text: and so terrible was the sight, moses said, i am exceedingly fearful, and trembling.
target_text: ngaa dhu rèngu ladhe rèdhi ètu ledhe ne, mema pamadha'u tare'a, toke musa karèbha kahèi.

source_text: but you came to mount zion, and to the city of the living god, to the heavenly jerusalem, and to myriads of messengers,
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, j'ara asa lamatua bhoke tèke le, aa èdhi bisa patoo madha padhai lii dènge ne. limuri ne, èdhi lati asa ledhe cue, ngara na sion. ètu era ne'e, abhu kota yerusalem. kota yerusalem ne, ètu boe rai-haha ne, te ngaa kota yerusalem hiu ètu sorga, era pea ama lamatua. ètu nèi, abhu ana pajuu ama lamatua ae-ae, toke riho-riho, dhu loe boe tao pesta.

source_text: to the assembly-place and assembly of the firstborn registered in heaven, and to god the judge of all, and to spirits of righteous men made perfect,
target_text: ètu kota nèi kahèi, j'aj'i le era pakaboko dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya kristus. te ama lamatua dhu tao nare le daftar, ho suri ngara ra èci-èci ètu sorga. ètu era nèi kahèi, ama lamatua neo parisa aa tai-dadoo mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. aa ètu nèi kahèi, pakaboko dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna ama lamatua sèmi nare si dènge be'a, lula ra parcaya ne. ètu nèi, rèngu j'aj'i kateme ètu madha lamatua.

source_text: and to a mediator of a new covenant-jesus, and to blood of sprinkling, speaking better things than that of abel!
target_text: aa yesus kahèi ètu era nèi, dhu j'aj'i mi kalete hia ama lamatua dènge dhèu rai-haha. yesus madhe, pasuti raa na, sèna ka ama lamatua bisa pa'èki lii pajaji hiu dènge èdhi. nèti èèna ka, raa yesus ne, cuhi d'ara ama lamatua. te ngaa raa yesus leko-leo nèti raa habel ètu d'ara sasuri lii lolo dhu uru tèka. te lod'o kain pamadhe habel, raa habel dhu suti èèna, papana d'ara ama lamatua, toke na huku kain.

source_text: watch out lest you refuse him who is speaking, for if those did not escape who refused him who was divinely speaking on earth-much less we who turn away from him who speaks from heaven,
target_text: pasa dhilu pabe'a-be'a, ho nanene ngaa dhu ama lamatua neo peka dènge miu. baku tao sèmi bèi-baki èdhi dhu ro'o boe nanene lii padhai musa, lod'o na j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua ètu rai-haha ne. nèti èèna ka lamatua huku si. ngaa hari dènge èdhi se! ladhe èdhi to'o boe nanene lii na nèti sorga, tatu nèngu huku èdhi bia risi eele!

source_text: whose voice shook the earth then, and now he has promised, saying, yet once more-i shake not only the earth, but also heaven;
target_text: lod'o bèi-baki èdhi titu ètu ledhe sinai, lii lamatua dhu mèdhu èèna, tao rai opo. limuri ne na moa, na, bèli-camèd'a ja'a tao ne opo ca tèka hari. mesa boe rai di opo, te ngaa liru opo kahèi.

source_text: and this, yet once more, makes evident the removal of the things shaken, as of things having been made, that the things not shaken may remain;
target_text: lod'o lamatua peka, na, nèngu neo tao opo aa'i-aa'i ca tèka hari, sasoa na, lamatua neo pagaged'o aa'i-aa'i dhu na paj'aj'i ètu dedha-liru dènge ètu rai-haha ne, toke abhu dhu bisa boe taha. ele aa'i si. te dhu taha di, nuka dhu pea taruu.

source_text: for this reason, receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, may we have grace, through which we may serve god well-pleasingly, with reverence and fear,
