target_text: ama lamatua nèd'u paredha ètu sorga. èèna bisa boe laho. ngaa-ngaa tao boe! lula na neo sèmi nare, na, miu maso j'aj'i mi dhèu unu na ètu nèi. de mai ho èdhi manèngi makasi mi nèngu, pahaha iisi mi nèngu, aa ded'e padedha-dedha ne, lula dadedha na.

source_text: for our god is also a consuming fire.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi baku pamud'e kahèi, lula nanasa ama lamatua nuka sèmi ai dhu na'e pakèpu aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: let brotherly love remain.
target_text: de a'ari aa'i-aa'i! abhu pèri-pèri j'ara dhu ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu. baku bhèlu pasue taruu a'ari dhèu parcaya.

source_text: do not be forgetful of hospitality, for through this some entertained messengers unaware.
target_text: baku bhèlu bhoke d'ara sèna ka sèmi mere dhèu dhu miu tadhe boe asa d'ara èmu mi. te abhu pèri-pèri a'ari dhu sèmi rare dhèu, te ngaa re'a boe, na, dhèu sèra, ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga.

source_text: be mindful of those in bonds, as having been bound with them, of those maltreated, as yourselves also being in the body.
target_text: baku bhèlu tao ai-hèb'a mi dhèu ètu d'ara bui, te ra kèpa si lula ra parcaya kristus. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i soru-bara si, nuka sèmi miu ka dhu ra kèpe rare. aa mage bhèlu soru-bara dhèu dhu lèke j'aj'èra nèti dhèu. lalau si pabe'a-be'a, nuka sèmi miu mesa mi ka dhu abhu j'aj'èra èèna.

source_text: the marriage is to be honored by all, and the bed undefiled, for god will judge whoremongers and adulterers.
target_text: paleo èmu èèna, mola-mèci. te ngaa mage paleo èmu dhu mola-mèci ne, j'aj'i mi kaj'alu. te tatu ama lamatua huku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu èmu nèngu boe.

source_text: be without covetous behavior, being content with the things present, for he has said, no, i will not leave, no, nor forsake you,
target_text: baku manga'a doi-dhari. te ngaa miu hud'i mamuri nèti ngaa dhu miu abhu, te èèna d'ai le. ama lamatua dhu peka le, na, ja'a bhèlu boe miu. ja'a soro tèke boe miu.

source_text: so that we boldly say, the lord is to me a helper, and i will not fear what man will do to me.
target_text: de pa'èra d'ara miu, nuka sèmi dhu ra suri, na, lula lamatua ja'a neo soru-bara ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a madha'u boe. te abhu boe ca dhèu sa hèi, dhu bisa cèri eele ja'a nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: be mindful of those leading you, who spoke to you the word of god, who, considering the outcome of their behavior, imitate their faith:
target_text: baku bhèlu dhèu-dhèu dhu uru sèra aj'a-nori miu lii holo-nori ama lamatua. pajiko paie-iie j'ara mamuri ra, aa madhutu lalèka ra. te, dhu rèngu parcaya, nuka:

source_text: jesus christ-the same yesterday and today and for all ages.
target_text: yesus kristus ub'a nèdhi boe. nèti uru, doe ne'e, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e, nèngu hali boe.

source_text: do not be carried away with strange and manifold teachings, for it is good that by grace the heart is confirmed, not with meats, in which they who were occupied were not profited;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu baku madhutu rii nèti a'aj'a dhu sala. ama lamatua tao pa'èra le d'ara miu, lula na pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na dènge miu. lula boe nèti miu madhutu atora nganga'a-nganginu dhu guna boe.

source_text: we have an altar from which they who are serving the dwelling place have no authority to eat,
target_text: uru-uru sèra, ètu madha paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, abhu mei èci dhu era tèka badha korban. ama agama ka dhu lalau ètu sèra, dhu dènge hak ra'a sisi dhu sisa nèti dedha mei ne. te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi dhu dènge le mei leo. aa ama agama rupa dhui dènge boe hak ra'a ètu mei èèna.

source_text: for of those beasts whose blood is brought for sin into the holy places through the chief priest-of these the bodies are burned outside the camp.
target_text: uru èèna, tèu mai-tèu mai kètu kapai risi agama nèti raa badha korban, sèna ka tèke asa d'ara kama luri mola-mèci ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, lamatua pabhèlu eele sasala ra. èle na, pasae rèti badha ne lasi tunu asa li'u rae.

source_text: for this reason, also jesus-that he might sanctify the people through his own blood-suffered outside the gate;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge yesus. nèngu j'aj'i korban kahèi, sèna ka ama lamatua bisa saku eele sasala dhèu rai-haha. aa lod'o j'aj'èra na èèna, ra nuni rèti ne kahèi, ho pamadhe ne asa li'u kota yerusalem.

source_text: now then, may we go forth to him outside the camp, bearing his reproach;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mai ka èdhi lati asa yesus, ho parcaya ne taruu. masi ka dhèu pahahe èdhi, èdhi hud'i pa'èra sèmi tare ne, nuka sèmi yesus.

source_text: for we have no abiding city here, but we seek the coming one.
target_text: te èdhi dhoka manubha taha ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa èdhi sanao-maena, sèna ka pea ètu kota hiu cue ètu sorga toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: through him, then, we may always offer up a sacrifice of praise to god, that is, the fruit of lips, giving thanks to his name.
target_text: lula yesus j'aj'i le korban pala èdhi, nèti èèna ka èdhi parluu heka tèti badha korban asa ama lamatua. te ngaa abhu mèdha korban dhu leo era, dhu èdhi hud'i tèti ku hia ne, nuka, koa-kio dhu ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara na.

source_text: and do not be forgetful of doing good and of fellowship, for god is well-pleased with such sacrifices.
target_text: aa mage bhèlu tao j'ara be'a hia dhèu leo. ladhe ra parluu ngaa, lami soru-bara si. te sèra sa, j'aj'i nuka sèmi mèdha persembahan dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: be obedient to those leading you, and be subject, for these watch for your souls, as about to give account, that they may do this with joy, and not sighing, for this is unprofitable to you.
target_text: miu hud'i nanene ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uri miu. te dhèu se'e ka dhu j'aga miu mèda-mèu ètu d'ara mamuri miu dènge ama lamatua. bèli-camèd'a rèngu hud'i lapor ku sasab'a rèngu asa ama lamatua. de nanene paie si, sèna ka ra bisa sab'a aa lapor dènge d'ara karej'e. mage dhoka ra peka dènge d'ara dhu laho mae-mae, lula miu tèke eele j'ara mamuri yesus kristus. te ladhe sèmi èèna, na, miu oto boe.

source_text: pray for us, for we trust that we have a good conscience, willing to behave well in all things,
target_text: sabaj'a taruu hia ji'i. te d'ara ji'i mema mola, aa ji'i neo tao j'ara be'a taruu.

source_text: and i call on you to do this more abundantly, that i may be restored to you more quickly.
target_text: aa be'a risi hari, sabaj'a sèna ka ja'a bisa lèpa malai asa miu.

source_text: and the god of peace, who brought up the great shepherd of the sheep out of the dead-by the blood of a perpetual covenant-our lord jesus, make you perfect in every good work to do his will, doing in you that which is well-pleasing before him, through jesus christ, to whom is the glory through the ages of the ages! amen.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pamau d'ara èdhi. ja'a manèngi sèna ka na soru-bara miu, ho miu bisa madhutu aa'i dad'èi na. ja'a manèngi kahèi, ho na soru-bara èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, sèna ka te'a pakarej'e d'ara na. te ama lamatua pake le raa yesus kristus dhu suti èèna, sèna ka pa'èki lii pajaji hiu dènge èdhi. lii pajaji ne j'aj'i taruu toke d'ai mia-mia. ka ama lamatua pamamuri hari kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de yesus ka dhu ladhe-leru èdhi limuri ne, nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu be'a risi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi ded'e kolongara na padedha-dedha, aa koa-kio ne taa-taa! èèna ka dhu lèke.

source_text: and i beg you, brothers, endure the word of the exhortation, for i have also written to you through few words.
target_text: a'ari pasue! ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu sèmi mere lii holo ja'a ne dènge d'ara kateme. te sasuri ne bab'a iiki di.

source_text: know that the brother timotheus is released, with whom i will see you, if he may come more shortly.
target_text: abhu lii lolo dhu ja'a neo miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, nuka: a'ari èdhi timotius dhu kalua le nèti d'ara bui. ladhe na mai malai paraga dènge ja'a, èèna na ji'i dua mi palere-lere dhiu asa miu.

source_text: greet all those leading you, and all the holy ones. those from italy greet you.
target_text: ja'a pa'adhu lii maho'o hia kètu miu sèra, aa lii maho'o hia miu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus. a'ari nèti propensi italia hia miu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: the grace is with you all! amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na dènge miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka!

source_text: james, a servant of god and of the lord jesus christ, to the twelve tribes who are in the dispersion: greetings!
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, yakobis. ja'a ne'e ana pua-paleha nèti ama lamatua dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a tao sasuri ne'e hia miu dhèu yahudi dhu pea ètu kabarai dhèu, dhu d'èi madhutu lamatua yesus.

source_text: count it all joy, my brothers, when you may fall into manifold temptations,
target_text: a'ari! ja'a neo peka sèmi ne'e: ladhe miu abhu rupa-rupa j'aj'èra, na, baku paroe d'ara. sèmi mere dènge d'ara karej'e, te bèli-camèd'a abhu babe'a.

source_text: knowing that the proof of your faith works endurance,
target_text: te èdhi te'a, na, ladhe miu pa'èra-èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra sèmi èèna, aa pakaj'èu le nèti dadugu, aa miu parcaya lamatua era, èèna ka dhu asa tabha pa'èra d'ara miu, ladhe mi paraga hari dènge dadugu dhu leo.

source_text: and let the endurance have a perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
target_text: baku hari kabodho nèti j'aj'èra. te ngaa miu hud'i taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, toke miu abhu mamèci, aa kura boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa.

source_text: and if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask from god, who is giving to all generously, and not reproaching, and it will be given to him;
target_text: ladhe abhu nèti miu dhu re'a mèka j'ara kalua nèti j'aj'èra, miu bisa pakarèi mi lamatua dhu ne'a aa'i ngaa-ngaa. nèngu ka dhu bisa pad'elo j'ara kalua hia miu. nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara dènge d'ara karej'e, aa dhu ne'a boe nasa, ladhe miu manèngi.

source_text: but let him ask in faith, doubting nothing, for he who is doubting has been like a wave of the sea, driven by wind and tossed;
target_text: te ngaa ladhe manèngi mi nèngu, na, baku dènge d'ara kacanga. miu hud'i parcaya tare'a ku, na, nèngu bisa hia ngaa dhu miu manèngi. te ladhe dhèu manèngi dènge d'ara kacanga, èèna na nuka sèmi laka dhasi dhu pahaka la'e-mai ladhe lèke ngèlu.

source_text: for do not let that man suppose that he will receive anything from the lord- a soul-split man is unstable in all his ways.
target_text: dhèu dhu parcaya kalili boe sèmi èèna, èra boe ètu d'ara j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. baku maena, na, nèngu abhu ngaa-ngaa nèti lamatua.

source_text: and let the brother who is low rejoice in his exaltation,
target_text: dhèu unu aad'o dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, nèngu hud'i pakarej'e d'ara na, lula ama lamatua ded'e le nèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: but the rich in his becoming low, because he will pass away as a flower of grass; for the sun rose with the burning heat, and withered the grass, and the flower of it fell, and the beauty of its appearance perished, so also the rich in his way will fade away!
target_text: aa dhèu kaja dhu parcaya le lamatua yesus, nèngu hud'i karèj'e kahèi, lula lamatua aj'a ne sèna ka baku padedha iisi. limuri ne nèngu ne'a, na, bèli-camèd'a mèdha-panyau na ele aa'i mèu-mèu, nuka sèmi hela bunga dhu saraga, te ngaa ladhe lèke lod'o pana, na kamale eele. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu kaja sèra. masi ka rèngu bhute dènge urusan ra, te ngaa rèngu ele kahèi.

source_text: blessed is the man who endures temptation, because, becoming approved, he will receive the garland of life, which the lord promised to those loving him.
target_text: lamatua hia berkat mi dhèu dhu taha ètu d'ara dadugu-rariu. hèia na sèmi nare bab'ae rui-j'aj'èra na, nuka mamuri dhu lamatua padhadha le ho pala-bagi mi dhèu dhu sue ne. èèna nuka sèmi dhèu dhu segi ètu pa'uji olaraga dhu abhu solo juara.

source_text: let no one who is being tempted say, i am tempted from god, for god is not tempted by evils, and himself tempts no one,
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! ladhe nèti miu abhu dhu paraga dènge dadugu-rariu, aa neo ad'u-ue madha j'ara dhu sala, baku peka, na, ama lamatua ka dhu sèku ja'a. te ama lamatua neo boe tao sala. aa na sèku nèdhi boe dhèu, sèna ka tao sala.

source_text: but each one is tempted, being led away and enticed by his own desires;
target_text: te sasala mai nèti d'ara dhèu. ropa d'ara na neo ad'u-ue j'ara karehe, hèia na kapod'e kahadhu na, sèna ka tao j'ara kaj'alu.

source_text: afterward the desire having conceived, gives birth to sin, and sin having been perfected, brings forth death.
target_text: hèia na tao madhutu ngangee na dhu kaj'alu èèna. d'ai lod'o limuri, ama lamatua huku pamadhe dhèu dhu tao bhabhelu.

source_text: do not be led astray, my beloved brothers.
target_text: a'ari pasue! baku lèke tipu nèti j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: every good giving, and every perfect gift, is from above, coming down from the father of lights, with whom is no variation, or shadow of turning;
target_text: j'ara karehe sèra mai boe nèti lamatua. te ngaa nèngu ka dhu pala-bagi mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i, dènge ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu mola-mèci. nèngu ka dhu paj'aj'i madha lod'o, hèru dènge hua-hètu. aa'i-aa'i ra pea boe kalili mi ca'era ètu dedha-liru, aa tao mamaho ra dhu ub'a-ub'a. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu ub'a boe.

source_text: having willed it, he begot us with a word of truth, for our being a certain first-fruit of his creatures.
target_text: dad'èi lamatua hia mi èdhi sèmi ne'e: na hia mi èdhi lii holo-nori na dhu lèke. aa na pake lii holo-nori na ho hia èdhi mamuri. nèti ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu na paj'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne, na hag'e nare le èdhi j'aj'i mi hua-hela dhu uru tèka.

source_text: so then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to anger,
target_text: a'ari pasue! sanèd'e, ee! dhu be'a èèna sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu baku padhai lii leli di. be'a risi, ropa dhèu leo peka dhu be'a, nèngu pasa dhilu ho nanene uuru ku! aa dhèu baku nasa malai.

source_text: for the wrath of a man does not work the righteousness of god;
target_text: te ladhe dènge nasa, dhèu bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: for this reason, having put aside all filthiness and superabundance of evil, receive the implanted word in meekness, that is able to save your souls;
target_text: de miu hud'i tunu eele ku sasala mi aa'i-aa'i, sèmi dhèu dhu ko'o pamèu oka-tedhe, ka ra tunu maruru sèra. aa miu hud'i sèmi dènge pahaha iisi mi lii holo-nori lamatua. lii holo-nori sèra, nuka sèmi hini dhu sèle ètu d'ara miu. ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a lamatua saku eele sasala mi, aa na sèmi nare miu, sèna ka mamuri taa-taa dènge ne.

source_text: and become doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves,
target_text: ladhe miu me'a le lii holo-nori lamatua, miu hud'i tao madhutu. baku dhoka nanene di! ladhe miu d'èi dhoka nanene di, te ngaa tao madhutu boe, miu kapod'e-kabèli ngi'u miu unu mi.

source_text: because, if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, this one has been like to a man viewing his natural face in a mirror, for he viewed himself, and has gone away, and immediately he forgot what kind of man he was;
target_text: ladhe dhèu tadèngi le lii holo-nori èèna, te ngaa madhutu boe, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu lee rèhu na ètu d'ara tèru. ropa na hari kabodho nèti tèru, nèngu bhèlu eele dènge ka, rèhu na.

source_text: but he who looked into the perfect law-that of liberty, and continued there, not becoming a forgetful hearer, but a doer of work-this one will be blessed in his doing.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku loe parisa paie-iie lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu tesa, dhu bisa pakaj'èu dhèu nèti koasa sasala ra. pe lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi ngaa-ngaa dhu miu tao, sad'i miu nanene, aa tao madhutu lii-lii sèra. baku maso dhoka re dhilu kariu, aa kalua re dhilu g'ana!

source_text: if anyone thinks to be religious among you, not bridling his tongue, but deceiving his heart, the religion of this one is vain;
target_text: ladhe dhèu ngee, nèngu maj'èni ètu d'ara agama, te ngaa ne'a boe j'aga hèb'a na, nèngu monya ngi'u nèngu unu na. agama nèngu parcuma.

source_text: religion pure and undefiled with the god and father is this: to look after orphans and widows in their tribulation-to keep himself unspotted from the world.
target_text: te ngaa agama dhu lèke, nuka dhu dènge boe kaj'alu. èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua. agama dhu lèke èèna, tao d'ara dhèu d'èi soru-bara bhèni balu dènge ana lalu. dhèu dhu dènge agama sèmi sèra, hia boe dhèu ètu rai-haha ne dadugu rèngu asa j'ara karehe.

source_text: my brothers, do not hold the faith of the glory of our lord jesus christ in favor by appearance,
target_text: a'ari! tasamia ka miu peka, na, miu parcaya yesus kristus, kètu èdhi dhu kapai èèna, ladhe miu patema hag'e rèhu dhèu? baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: for if there may come into your synagogue a man with gold ring, in radiant clothing, and there may also come in a poor man in vile clothing,
target_text: sèmi abhu dhèu dua dhu lasi asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a miu. ca dhèu pake mèdha-papake dhu kale'e dènge kadheli hualaa pènu kacui-aai na. ca dhèu hari pake kodho kaj'alu.

source_text: and you may look on him bearing the radiant clothing, and may say to him, you-sit here well, and may say to the poor man, you-stand there, or, sit here under my footstool,
target_text: hèia miu bhute lami soru dhèu dhu pake mèdha-papake kale'e èèna, ho hia ne madhèdi ètu era be'a re madha. te ngaa dhu pake mèdha-papake kaj'alu èèna, miu pua ne, peka na, lamu titu sa kabodho nèi, ee! do aad'o na, madhèdi ètu rai ne!

source_text: you did not judge fully in yourselves, and became ill-reasoning judges.
target_text: dènge j'ara miu laladhe rèhu dhèu sèmi èèna, miu nuka sèmi dhèu pama'ète lii dhu bia cabèka. èèna mai nèti ngangee karehe dhu uli miu.

source_text: listen, my beloved brothers, did god not choose the poor of this world, rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom that he promised to those loving him?
target_text: a'ari pasue! ama lamatua hag'e nare le dhèu unu aad'o ètu rai-haha ne'e, sèna ka ra parcaya pa'èra mi nèngu. masi ka rèngu dhu dènge boe unu, te ngaa d'ara ra kaja. aa na hag'e si, ho ra abhu unu kahèi ètu d'ara paredha ama lamatua, dhu na pajaji hia mi dhèu-dhèu dhu sue ne.

source_text: but you dishonored the poor one. do the rich not oppress you and themselves draw you to judgment-seats?
target_text: te ngaa dènge miu ladhe rèhu dhèu sèmi èèna, miu pahaha le dhèu unu aad'o sèra. te ngaa rèngu tao boe ngaa-ngaa dhu karehe mi dedha miu. bhèlu le, do? dhèu kaja sèra ka dhu jajuku mi la'e-mai. aa rèngu sèra ka dhu tenge j'ara ho nuni pa'oro miu asa era pama'ète lii langu. rèngu abhu dhu kee, aa miu abhu sota na.

source_text: do they not themselves speak evil of the good name having been called on you?
target_text: miu se, dhèu unu lamatua yesus. te ngaa dhèu kaja sèra ka dhu padhai pa'ele iie kolongara lamatua yesus! nga tao ka miu lami pahaha iisi mi rèngu?

source_text: if, indeed, you fulfill royal law, according to the writing: you will love your neighbor as yourself, you do well;
target_text: heka lèke kèna, ladhe miu tao madhutu atora èci dhu dedha risi, dhu peka na, èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, nuka sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. atora ne dhu suri le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua.

source_text: but if you favor by appearance, you work sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors;
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu pili madhutu rèhu dhèu, aa mere d'ara dhèu kaja di, miu sisu le atora èèna. madhutu atora lamatua, miu sala le.

source_text: for whoever will keep the whole law, but will stumble in one point, he has become guilty of all;
target_text: dhèu dhu tao madhutu aa'i atora ama lamatua, te ngaa sisu atora èci di, èci èèna ka dènge nèngu sisu aa'i atora lamatua.

source_text: for he who is saying, you may not commit adultery, also said, you may not murder; but if you will not commit adultery, but will commit murder, you have become a transgressor of law;
target_text: lamatua hia le atora dhu peka, na, miu bhèni-mone baku tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali miu. aa na hia atora dhu leo kahèi, peka na, baku pamadhe dhèu. de ladhe miu tao boe j'ara karehe, te ngaa miu pamadhe dhèu, èci èèna ka, miu sisu le atora lamatua.

source_text: thus, speak and so act as one about to be judged by a law of liberty,
target_text: de ladhe miu neo padhai lii, ho neo tao madha j'ara èci, miu hud'i sanèd'e sèmi ne'e ku: pe ama lamatua ka dhu pama'ète, na, èdhi madhutu atora na ho sue dhèu leo, do aad'o. lula atora èèna ka dhu bisa patabuli èdhi nèti hahuku lamatua.

source_text: for the judgment without mercy is to him having not done mercy, and mercy exults over judgment.
target_text: te lamatua pusi-pahae boe dhèu dhu sue boe dhèu leo. te ngaa ladhe miu sue dhèu leo, tatu lamatua pahae miu kahèi. miu baku madha'u ladhe abhu hahuku nèti lamatua, lula na ige nare le sèra aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: what is the profit, my brothers, if anyone may speak of having faith, but he may not have works? is that faith able to save him?
target_text: a'ari! ladhe dhèu peka, na, nèngu parcaya lamatua, te ngaa tao boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa ho pad'elo parcaya na, èèna dènge boe guna ngaa-ngaa. parcaya sèmi èèna, bisa boe hia nèngu mamuri.

source_text: and if a brother or sister may be naked, and may be destitute of daily food,
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu sarani ca dhèu dhu dènge boe mèdha-papake do nganga'a dhu na'a bèli-bèli,

source_text: and anyone of you may say to them, depart in peace, be warmed, and be filled, but may not give to them the things necessary for the body, what is the profit?
target_text: te ngaa miu dhoka dènge lii padhai lii di, peka na, kako paie-iie, oo! hud'i laa lamatua hia èu berkat! mage lèke lai ngèlu toke pèd'a! baku madhe manganga! guna ngaa padhai lii sèmi èèna, ladhe tao boe ngaa èci sa ho soru-bara si?

source_text: so also faith, if it may not have works, is dead by itself.
target_text: de d'ai mèka ladhe peka, èu parcaya di! dènge parcaya di, aa dhu palèke boe dènge tatao, èèna peka mèka, na, ‘parcaya'. te tatao sèmi èèna, nuka sèmi parcaya dhu madhe le, dhu gaguna na aad'o ciki sa.

source_text: but someone may say, you have faith, and i have works. show me your faith without works, and i will show you my faith out of works.
target_text: abhu dhèu dhu tao lii langu, peka na, sad'i dhèu parcaya dhoka lamatua di, parluu heka tao j'ara dhu be'a. dhèu leo dhu tadhe boe lamatua, re'a tao j'ara dhu be'a kahèi. te ngaa j'ara nèngu sèmi ne'e: tadha nèti parcaya èu èèna, nuka tatao èu dhu be'a. te ngaa ladhe èu tao boe dhu be'a, ja'a kèdhi boe tadha nèti parcaya èu ne. ja'a bisa pad'elo parcaya ja'a, dènge j'ara ad'u-ue dhu be'a.

source_text: you believe that god is one; you do well! the demons also believe-and shudder!
target_text: èu madhutu a'aj'a dhu peka, na, ama lamatua èèna, dhoka nèngu di. dhu leo aad'o. be'a kahèi! te ngaa nidhu sèra be'a risi nèti èu, lula rèngu parcaya sèmi èèna kahèi, toke ra karèbha. de baku ngee, na, te'a dènge dhoka kahadhu di, d'ai le èèna. dhae!

source_text: and do you wish to know, o vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?
target_text: goa, ee! de me'a mèu le, si? parcaya dhu pad'elo boe dènge tatao be'a, gaguna na aad'o kahèi.

source_text: was not our father abraham considered righteous out of works, having brought up his son isaac on the altar?
target_text: tare conto nèti abraham. uru èèna, na sab'a madhutu ngaa dhu lamatua paredha ne, ho nèti ana na isak, sèna ka tao asa dedha mei sogo-tagu ho j'aj'i mi korban. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua peka na, abraham tao le dhu lèke.

source_text: do you see that faith was working with his works, and faith was perfected out of the works?
target_text: abraham parcaya ama lamatua, ka na sèmi nare paredha èèna, hèia na tao madhutu. de èdhi te'a, na, nèngu lèka tare'a-re'a lamatua, lula na tao madhutu lii paredha èèna.

source_text: and the writing was fulfilled that is saying, and abraham believed god, and it was reckoned to him for righteousness; and, friend of god he was called.
target_text: de se'e se j'aj'i sèmi dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, dhu peka na, abraham parcaya ama lamatua, hèia ama lamatua sèmi nare nèngu ho j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'ara mola. aa dhu suri kahèi, peka na, abraham èèna, angalai lamatua.

source_text: you see, then, that man is considered righteous out of works, and not out of faith only;
target_text: me'a mèu le, si? èdhi te'a, na, ama lamatua sèmi nare dhèu, ladhe parcaya na mi lamatua dhu tao nèngu d'èi sab'a madha j'ara hua iia. te ngaa ladhe dhoka parcaya di, d'ai mèka.

source_text: and in like manner also rahab the prostitute-was she not considered righteous out of works, having received the messengers, and having sent them forth by another way?
target_text: conto leo, nuka rahab, dhu uru èèna bhèni kajeo. lod'o dhèu kota jeriko tenge neo pamadhe dhèu mata-mata nèti isra'el, rahab ka pahuni si. hèia na pua si rai asa li'u re j'ara leo, sèna ka dhèu jeriko baku kèpe rare si. hèia lamatua sèmi nare ne, nuka sèmi dhèu bhèni dhu d'ara mola, lula na tao dhu be'a.

source_text: for as the body apart from the spirit is dead, so also the faith apart from works is dead.
target_text: parcaya dhu nèti boe hua-hela, èci èèna ka dènge ngi'u dhu dènge boe a'ae. sasoa na, madhe. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe dhèu peka, na, nèngu parcaya lamatua, te ngaa tao boe ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a, sèra dhu leko-monya! èèna peka mèka, na, parcaya dhu mamuri.

source_text: do not let many be teachers, my brothers, having known that we will receive greater judgment,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! abhu dhèu ae dhu neo aj'a-nori dhèu parcaya sèra. be'a kahèi! te ngaa sanèd'e paie-iie, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua parisa toke lutu dhèu dhu aj'a dhèu parcaya sèra. de dhèu baku sad'i aj'a di.

source_text: for we all make many stumbles; if anyone does not stumble in word, this one is a perfect man, able to also bridle the whole body;
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti ae ka padhai lii sala. te ngaa dhèu dhu taha nare hèb'a na, ho baku padhai leli, ne'a kahèi uri mamuri na.

source_text: behold, the bits we put into the mouths of the horses for their obeying us, and we direct their whole body;
target_text: tare conto sèmi jara. èdhi te'a uri jara dhu kapai ho madhutu dad'èi èdhi, dhoka dènge ère rarapa na.

source_text: behold, also the ships, being so great, and being driven by fierce winds, are directed by a very small rudder, wherever the impulse of the one steering wills,
target_text: conto leo hari, nuka kapa. ngèlu mèdhu tiu kapa aae madhutu dad'èi na. te ngaa uli dhu ana iiki-iiki bisa pod'e kad'uru kapa ne madhutu dad'èi juraga.

source_text: so also the tongue is a little member, and boasts greatly; behold, how much forest a little fire kindles!
target_text: èci èèna kahèi dènge he'o èdhi. masi ka he'o ana iiki, te ngaa tatao na kapai titu kèna! èèna nuka sèmi he'o ai dhu ana iiki te ngaa bisa tunu eele j'ami dhu kapai aae.

source_text: and the tongue is a fire, the world of the unrighteousness, so the tongue is set in our members, which is spotting our whole body, and is setting on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by gehenna.
target_text: hèb'a ne nuka sèmi he'o ai. re hèb'a, èdhi bisa pa'ele iie madha j'ara ae-ae. hèb'a èdhi bisa pa'ele iie kateme mamuri èdhi. bhelu-katub'a ae-ae ètu rai-haha ne, mai nèti d'ara hèb'a dhèu. aa dhèu aae nidhu pake hèb'a dhèu ho pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: for every nature, both of beasts and of birds, both of creeping things and things of the sea, is subdued, and has been subdued, by the human nature,
target_text: dhèu pamau rare rupa-rupa badha hui, badha dhu rod'o re rai, manu-bhui, dènge i'a ètu d'ara dhasi.

source_text: but no one of men is able to subdue the tongue-it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison;
target_text: te ngaa abhu mèka ca dhèu sa dhu pamau rare he'o na. te he'o ne, mèdha dhu bhelu, dhu uri tare boe. nèngu èci èèna ka dènge raco dhu lale lème d'ara ngi'u, toke pamadhe dhèu.

source_text: with it we bless the god and father, and with it we curse the men made according to the likeness of god; out of the same mouth comes forth blessing and cursing; it does not need, my brothers, these things to so happen;
target_text: dènge hèb'a èèna ka, dhèu koa-kio, aa dhèu padhèd'a. se'e se, lèke boe! èdhi pake hèb'a ho koa-kio ama lamatua. aa dènge hèb'a èèna kahèi, èdhi padhèd'a aapa dhèu dhu lamatua paj'aj'i madhutu rupa na. tasamia ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna?

source_text: does the fountain out of the same opening pour forth the sweet and the bitter?
target_text: abhu ètu mia èi ca madha, bisa kalua èi nèta dènge èi sèro.

source_text: is a fig tree able, my brothers, to make olives? or a vine figs? neither is salty water able to have made sweet water.
target_text: bisa boe, sina ma, nèti kanana kalua hua dhimu? aa tarae sina bisa kalua hua anggor? te aj'u ladhe hua na, hua madhutu rupa ra. èci èèna ka, èdhi bisa boe dhui èi nèta nèti dano èi sèro.

source_text: who is wise and intelligent among you? let him show his works out of good behavior in meekness of wisdom,
target_text: dhèu dhu ngangee madhera, aa ne'a j'ara dhu madhutu dad'èi lamatua, baku padedha iisi. te ne'a, mamèu na mai nèti lamatua. hud'i laa nèngu pad'elo mamèu na dènge j'ara mamuri dhu mola.

source_text: yet, if you have bitter zeal, and rivalry in your heart, do not glory, nor lie against the truth; this wisdom is not descending from above, but earthly, physical, demon-like,
target_text: baku padedha iisi, peka na, èu dhèu dhu dènge ngangee madhera, ladhe èu tèka d'ara era ho pabèbhe dhèu leo. èci èèna ka èu ne, dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. te mamuri sèmi èèna, peka boe, ‘ngangee madhera'. tatao nuka sèmi, tèka d'ara, d'èi pabèbha dhèu, sèra sa mai boe nèti ama lamatua. èèna na tatao dhèu rai-haha. sèra sa lèke mi dhèu dhu soro boe mamuri ra mi ama lamatua. tatao sèra madhutu dad'èi nidhu.

source_text: for where zeal and rivalry are, there is insurrection and every evil matter;
target_text: te ladhe tèka d'ara aa d'èi pabèbha dhèu, tatu abhu kahèi patao-palaha dènge rupa-rupa bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: but the wisdom from above, first, indeed, is pure, then peaceable, gentle, well-convinced, full of kindness and good fruits, uncontentious, and unhypocritical-
target_text: te ngaa ngangee madhera dhu mai nèti ama lamatua, nuka: dhu tao èdhi mamuri mola, pamau d'ara èdhi, d'èi pa'uru dhèu, taha tare d'ara, dènge lii mako. hua-hela nèti ngangee madhera èèna, nuka: tao èdhi d'ara hua iia, d'èi soru-bara dhèu, bia boe cabèka, aa kapod'e-kabèli boe dhèu leo.

source_text: and the fruit of righteousness in peace is sown to those making peace.
target_text: dhèu dhu uri padame, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu babe'a. j'ara èèna nuka sèmi dhèu dhu sèle hini, ho nèbhu-nèbhu na puu hua dhu be'a.

source_text: from where are wars and fightings among you? is it not from here, out of your passions warring in your members?
target_text: miu loe boe patao-palaha aa pagama èci dènge èci. tasamia ka sèmi èèna? èèna, lula ètu talora aae miu abhu dhèu dhu dhoka tenge j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: you desire, and do not have, so you murder; and you are zealous, and are not able to attain, so you fight and war; and you do not have, because of your not asking;
target_text: miu neo ae le abhu mèdha èci, te ngaa ai d'ai boe. hèia mi tèke d'ara, patao-palaha, dènge pagama, toke mangingi boe pamadhe dhèu. lula miu sabaj'a boe, aa manèngi boe nèti lamatua, nèti èèna ka miu abhu boe.

source_text: you ask, and you do not receive, because you ask badly, that you may spend it in your pleasures.
target_text: te ngaa masi ka miu sabaj'a toke padhe aj'u-hadhu, miu abhu boe ngaa dhu miu manèngi, lula manèngi madhutu dhodhoka dad'èi d'ara miu di.

source_text: adulterers and adulteresses! have you not known that friendship of the world is enmity with god? whoever, then, may intend to be a friend of the world, he is designated as an enemy of god.
target_text: mema miu satia boe! miu nuka sèmi dhèu èmu-kamali dhu èci pusi-pahae boe èci, aa tao j'ara makae di. ladhe miu pa'angalai dènge dad'èi rai-haha, miu pamusu dènge ama lamatua. j'ara èèna la'e sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: or, do you think that the writing says emptily, the spirit that has dwelt in us yearns with envy,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, lamatua hia le roh na ètu d'ara èdhi. aa madhutu dad'èi roh, èdhi madhutu ne taa-taa. te ama lamatua ne d'ara kura kahèi.

source_text: but god gives greater grace, for this reason it says, god sets himself up against proud ones, and he gives grace to lowly ones.
target_text: ngaa hari, ama lamatua neo hia tabha hari babe'a d'ara na. ka sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, lamatua lab'a dhèu dhu padedha iisi ra, te ngaa na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu dhu pahaha iisi ra.

source_text: be subject, then, to god; stand up against the devil, and he will flee from you;
target_text: de soro iisi mi asa adhe-aai ama lamatua, sèna ka madhutu dad'èi na. miu baku madhutu dad'èi dhèu aae nidhu. lab'a ne pa'èra-èra; baku golo. dènge sèmi èèna, na rai tèke eele miu.

source_text: draw near to god, and he will draw near to you; cleanse hands, you sinners! and purify hearts, you split-souled! be exceedingly afflicted, and mourn, and weep, let your laughter be turned to mourning, and the joy to heaviness;
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua. ladhe sèmi èèna, nèngu padètu-dètu dènge miu kahèi. wee, miu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara kaj'alu sèra! miu hud'i pamola ku j'ara mamuri miu. aa miu dhu d'ara kajari sèra! miu hud'i kako mola-mola madhutu lamatua, aa baku piku hari g'ana do kariu. nèbhu nare sange ne'e, miu mamuri karae dènge pasoa-pasoka di. de hua iia, ae eele ka! miu me'a le, na, d'ara miu kajari lula sasala-sasigo miu sèra. be'a risi miu ele-ho'a aa tangi dènge d'ara manyasa.

source_text: be made low before the lord, and he will exalt you.
target_text: ladhe tare'a-re'a miu me'a, na, miu dhu nia boe ètu katanga madha ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a na ded'e nare miu, sèna ka j'aj'i mi dhèu dhu nia ètu madha na.

source_text: do not speak against one another, brothers; he who is speaking against a brother, and is judging his brother, speaks against law, and judges law, and if you judge law, you are not a doer of law but a judge.
target_text: a'ari! baku padhai pakarehe kolongara èci dènge èci. te ladhe miu padhai le sèmi èèna, aa d'èi pèci sasala nèti èci asa èci, miu lab'a le atora nèti lamatua dhu peka na, èu hud'i sue ku a'ari èu, nuka sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. aa ladhe miu madhutu boe atora ne, miu ded'e iisi mi dedha risi nèti atora ama lamatua.

source_text: one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy; you-who are you that judges the other?
target_text: dhodhoka lamatua mesa na dhu tao atora èèna, dhu dènge hak ho pama'ète lii langu èdhi. dhoka nèngu di mesa na dhu dènge hak, sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi, do huku pamadhe ti. miu dènge boe hak ho pama'ète lii langu dhèu, do padhai pakarehe kolongara dhèu.

source_text: go, now, you who are saying, today and tomorrow we will go on to such a city, and will pass there one year, and traffic, and make gain,
target_text: sèmi ne'e! madhutu iia-iia na, miu me'a le ho baku peka na, deo ne'e, do bèli, ji'i neo la'a sa kota nèi! ji'i neo pea mi era nèi pe d'ai ca tèu sa. aa ji'i neo d'aga sèna ka abhu ku leto d'ai ciki sa.

source_text: who does not know the thing of tomorrow; for what is your life? for it is a vapor that is appearing for a little while, and then is vanishing;
target_text: èu me'a ngaa dhu j'aj'i lod'o bèli? dhèu èci sa re'a boe tasamia mamuri na. mamuri èdhi dhèu ne nuka sèmi sèb'u dhu tèdhi dhoka ètu d'ara ciki oo'e èèna, kaca'a laa ele.

source_text: instead, you ought to say, if the lord may will, we will live, and do this or that;
target_text: be'a risi miu peka na, ladhe lamatua sue, na, ji'i mamuri madhera. aa ladhe lamatua d'èi, hud'i laa ji'i tao ne'e.

source_text: but now you glory in your pride; all such glorying is evil;
target_text: te ladhe peka boe sèmi èèna, miu dhodhoka padedha iisi di. èci èèna ka dènge miu bhèlu eele lamatua ètu d'ara nanelu miu sèra. èèna sala kapai titu kèna!

source_text: to him, then, knowing to do good, and not doing it, it is sin to him.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! dhèu dhu re'a le ngaa dhu lèke, te ngaa tao boe madhutu, èci èèna ka dènge nèngu tao sala le.

source_text: go, now, you rich! weep, howling over your miseries that are coming on you; your riches have rotted, and your garments have become moth-eaten; your gold and silver have rotted, and the rust of them will be to you for a testimony, and will eat your flesh as fire. you have stored up treasure in the last days! behold, the reward of the workmen cries out, of those who in-gathered your fields, which has been fraudulently kept back by you, and the exclamations of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the lord of hosts; you lived in luxury on the earth, and were wanton; you nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter; you condemned-you murdered the righteous; he does not resist you.
target_text: miu dhèu kaja sèra, sanèd'e, ee! pasa dhilu ho nanene paie-iie! dhèu sab'a hia miu toke èi kabhèsu hae, te ngaa miu taha mere gaji ra. limuri ne rui-j'aj'èra ra pa'oo-parodha dhu peka nèti kapod'e-kabèli miu. tatu ama lamatua dhu kapai risi eele èèna, tadèngi le lii roma iisi dhèu sab'a sèra. sasab'a miu ètu rai-haha ne, dhoka tao pagaa ngi'u miu mesa mi, ka mamuri mi ha'a-ha'a, hèti-hèti. limuri ne miu nuka sèmi sapi kab'oi dhu neo lèke roro. miu huku dènge pamadhe le dhèu be'a sèra, dhu re'a boe siri iisi ra ètu madha miu. miu dhèu kaja sèra! tangi ka laa! pe miu pasae mere rupa-rupa j'aj'èra. mèdha-panyau miu, ele iia kèna. aa mèdha-papake miu dhu be'a sèra, ana ca ngèpi na'e aa'i si. hualaa iia dènge hualaa pudhi miu sèra, dènge heka kab'ua. aa bèli-camèd'a hualaa miu sèra ra'e hari miu, sèmi ai na'e aj'u mango. rai-haha oe èle kèna, te ngaa tasamia ka miu kabhèsu lutu pakaboko taruu mèdha dhu madhe sèra? mèdha-panyau miu unu mi ka dhu j'aj'i tadha, peka na, miu me'a boe mia ka dhu dènge kab'ua ètu madha lamatua!

source_text: be patient, then, brothers, until the coming of the lord; behold, the farmer expects the precious fruit of the earth, being patient for it, until he may receive rain-early and latter;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu hud'i taha d'ara ku, tatae mamai hari lamatua. ladhe ku laa dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, dhu tatae hèru puu-g'ètu. èj'i hua hiu, na sèle hini. mate hari èj'i limuri, ho na pamangèru ana nganga'a sèra. nèbhu-nèbhu ku heka hua kèna. d'ai lod'o puu-g'ètu, dhèu ne la'e puu.

source_text: you also be patient; establish your hearts, because the coming of the lord has drawn near;
target_text: miu hud'i taha d'ara sèmi èèna kahèi. pa'èra ngi'u, te nèbhu heka lamatua mai!

source_text: do not murmur against one another, brothers, that you may not be condemned; behold, the judge has stood before the door.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku ka'uu-kamuki èci dènge èci. ka'uu-kamuki taruu, pe lamatua ka dhu huku èu! ladhe ka, te ama hakim ètu dedha nèi, titu le ètu madha miu.

source_text: brothers, as an example of the suffering of evil and of patience, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the lord;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! madhutu conto nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra. masi ka rèngu paraga dènge susa rupa-rupa, te ngaa rèngu taha taruu ètu d'ara sasusa.

source_text: behold, we call those who are enduring blessed; you heard of the endurance of job, and you have seen the end from the lord, that the lord is very compassionate, and pitying.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu taha ètu d'ara sasusa, èdhi d'èi padedha ngara dhèu ne. nuka sèmi ayub. masi ka na abhu susa rupa-rupa, te ngaa na kalau-karèto boe. hèia lamatua sue ne, ka na ator aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i mi be'a hia ayub. lamatua tao sèmi èèna, lula d'ara na hua iia, pènu dènge sasue.

source_text: and before all things, my brothers, do not swear, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath, but let your yes be yes, and the no, no, that you may not fall under judgment.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dhu be'a risi miu baku j'oka subha. ladhe neo peka, oo, na, dhaa la oo. aa ladhe peka aad'o na, dhaa la aad'o. sèmi èèna, d'ai le! baku parisi dènge j'oka subha dhu ale ngara dhèu madhe ètu rai-haha ne. ngaa hari pasubha dènge kolongara lamatua dhu mamuri ètu dedha-liru. gaguna na aad'o dènge pasubha rupa-rupa. de ladhe taruu sèmi èèna, miu pasae mere huku, lula lii subha sèra.

source_text: does anyone suffer evil among you? let him pray; is anyone of good cheer? let him sing psalms;
target_text: ladhe nèti miu abhu sasusa, be'a risi na sabaj'a. aa dhu ètu d'ara karej'e, be'a risi na sod'a koa-kio lamatua.

source_text: is anyone sick among you? let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, having anointed him with oil, in the name of the lord,
target_text: ladhe ètu talora miu abhu dhu pèd'a, be'a risi paroa ina-ama juma'at. manèngi sèna ka ra pasuti èi lèngi mi dhèu pèd'a ne, aa sabaj'a pake kolongara lamatua, ho hud'i laa lamatua ka dhu puri-pa'èle ne.

source_text: and the prayer of faith will save the distressed one, and the lord will raise him up, and if he may have committed sins, they will be forgiven to him.
target_text: aa ladhe miu sabaj'a dènge lèka tare'a-re'a lamatua hia dhèu pèd'a, èèna na lamatua puri-pa'èle ne. aa ladhe na tao sala, pe lamatua saku eele sasala na sèra.

source_text: be confessing to one another the trespasses, and be praying for one another, that you may be healed; very strong is a working supplication of a righteous man;
target_text: ladhe nèti talora miu abhu dhu manahu asa d'ara sasala, na, miu mangaku sasala èci dènge èci. dènge j'ara èèna, miu èci sabaj'a hia èci, sèna ka miu j'aj'i be'a. dhèu dhu d'ara na mola-mèci, lii manèngi na pènu dènge koasa, aa nèti babe'a.

source_text: elijah was a similar-feeling man as us, and with prayer he prayed-not to rain, and it did not rain on the land three years and six months;
target_text: tare conto nuka sèmi elia. nèngu ne dhèu rai-haha cakaraa èdhi kahèi. te ngaa ropa na sabaj'a, manèngi èj'i mai boe, ka èj'i puru heka toke tèlu tèu dènge ca èta.

source_text: and again he prayed, and the sky gave rain, and the land brought forth her fruit.
target_text: hèia na sabaj'a hari ho èj'i mai, hèia èj'i mai dènge. j'u'u mangèru bidhu-bidhu, aa oka-tedhe hia hari isi rai.

source_text: brothers, if anyone among you may go astray from the truth, and anyone may turn him back,
target_text: a'ari sèra! ladhe abhu nèti miu dhu bèbhe asa d'ara sasala, ka rai eele nèti j'ara dhu lèke, hèia abhu dhèu dhu pamako ho na lèpa hari asa j'ara dhu mola nèti lamatua, èèna na be'a!

source_text: let him know that he who turned back a sinner from the straying of his way will save a soul from death, and will cover a multitude of sins.
target_text: sanèd'e ne'e paie-iie! ladhe miu soru-bara dhèu dhu tao sala, hèia na lèpa hari asa lamatua ka na tao heka sala, miu se pasod'a le dhèu èèna, hèia na mamuri taa-taa dènge lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, lamatua saku eele aa'i sasala na. d'ai sange ne'e ka! nèti ja'a, yakobis

source_text: peter, an apostle of jesus christ, to the chosen sojourners of the dispersion of pontus, galatia, cappadocia, asia, and bithynia, according to the foreknowledge of god the father, by the sanctification of the spirit, to the obedience and sprinkling of the blood of jesus christ: grace and peace be multiplied to you!
target_text: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, petrus, dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. ja'a suri sasuri ne'e hia miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le. nuka miu dhu mamuri pahag'a palème era ètu propensi pontus, propensi galati, propensi kapadokia, propensi asia, dènge propensi bitinia. a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! karèi nèti uru j'ara ka, ama lamatua hag'e nare mema le miu ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. roh na ka dhu pamèu miu j'aj'i mola-mèci hia nèngu, sèna ka miu bisa tao madhutu paredha aa'i-aa'i dhu yesus kristus hia miu. aa ladhe miu madhutu aa'i paredha na sèra, èèna nuka sèmi lamatua pici miu dènge raa yesus, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, peka na, miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu na dhu mola-mèci hia nèngu. ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu, ho mamuri miu asa tabha dame dènge mera-milu.

source_text: blessed is the god and father of our lord jesus christ, who, according to the abundance of his kindness begot us again to a living hope, through the resurrection of jesus christ out of the dead,
target_text: koa-kio hia aa'i mi ama lamatua! nèngu èèna, ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. lula d'ara lamatua hua iia titu kèna, nèti èèna ka nèngu kasia èdhi seli eele. yesus kristus madhe, te ngaa na mamuri hari. de ladhe kristus pamamuri èdhi, na hia èdhi mamuri hiu, nuka sèmi rara iisi hari èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi parcaya taruu kristus, lula èdhi sanao dènge èra, bèli-camèd'a nèngu ladhe-leru èdhi dènge be'a.

source_text: to an incorruptible inheritance, and undefiled, and unfading, reserved for you in the heavens,
target_text: sama sèmi èdhi dhèu rai-haha, ladhe ca dhèu ama madhe, tatu nèngu tèke eele mèdha-panyau na hia ana niki na. sèmi èèna kahèi, yesus dhu tèke le pusaka hia èdhi ètu sorga. te ngaa pusaka se dhu ele iie boe, laho boe, aa ele boe.

source_text: who, in the power of god are being guarded, through faith, to salvation, ready to be revealed in the last time,
target_text: miu parcaya, na, ama lamatua dènge koasa ho soru-bara miu. na piara dènge madhenga miu, sèna ka baku abhu dhu palaho miu. aa ladhe èle ka rai-haha ne, na neo pad'elo dènge j'ara tasamia nèngu hia miu mamuri.

source_text: in which you are glad, a little now, if it be necessary, being made to sorrow in various trials,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, d'ara miu karej'e, masi ka limuri ne miu rasa bia lula miu sili mere boe rupa-rupa sasusa.

source_text: so that the proof of your faith-much more precious than gold that is perishing, and being approved through fire-may be found to result in praise, and honor, and glory, at the revelation of jesus christ,
target_text: ama lamatua soro tèke èdhi paraga dènge dadugu-rariu, sèna ka na sèku neo ne'a mèu parcaya èdhi mi nèngu. ladhe èdhi taha ètu d'ara dadugu ne, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, parcaya èdhi lèke aa èra. èdhi bisa pakasame dènge hualaa. èdhi hud'i tunu pamèu hualaa ètu d'ara ai karoo, sèna ka ai na'e aa'i kaj'alu na, heka èdhi abhu hualaa isi adhu kèna. aa te ngaa, madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, lalèka èdhi kab'ua risi nèti hualaa. de ladhe parcaya èdhi taha ètu d'ara dadugu-rariu sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a ropa yesus kristus lèpa hari mai, ama lamatua koa-kad'iri èdhi, hèia na pad'elo kolo-karisi èdhi, aa na pakab'ua èdhi kahèi.

source_text: whom, having not seen, you love, in whom, now believing although not seeing, you are glad with unspeakable joy and have been filled with glory,
target_text: masi ka miu ladhe mèdhi mèka yesus, te ngaa miu sue ne. masi ka limuri ne miu mèdhi mèka nèngu, te ngaa miu parcaya ne. miu karej'e risi eele, masi ka abhu boe lii dhu pamèci, dhu bisa peka dènge dhèu lula-nèti d'ara karej'e miu.

source_text: receiving the outcome of the faith-salvation of your souls;
target_text: lula miu parcaya ne, ka upa miu, nuka ama lamatua patalale miu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo miu.

source_text: concerning which salvation the prophets sought out and searched out, who prophesied concerning the grace toward you,
target_text: dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra, pakanucu ho neo re'a mèu, j'ara tasa mera mia lamatua patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala ra. dhèu rèti lii padhai sèra dhu peka tèke le j'ara-j'ara lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu, lula nèngu dhu pa'èra mema le, sèna ka na hia miu mamuri.

source_text: searching in regard to what or what manner of time the spirit of christ that was in them was signifying, testifying beforehand of the sufferings of christ and the glory after these,
target_text: roh kristus dhu sab'a ètu d'ara rèngu, sèna ka peka mema, na, bèli-camèd'a kristus hud'i pasae ku sasusa, aa dènge j'ara tasamia nèngu dui j'aj'èra. ladhe èle aa'i ku se'e, heka ama lamatua ded'e ne padedha-dedha kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu rèti lii padhai sèra neo re'a lod'o mia madha j'ara se'e j'aj'i.

source_text: to whom it was revealed, that not to themselves, but to us they were ministering these, which now were told to you through those who proclaimed good news to you, by the holy spirit sent from heaven, to which things messengers desire to look into intently.
target_text: ka roh kristus èèna peka dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai se kahèi, na, rèngu rèdhi boe, te ngaa miu ka dhu mèdhi j'ara se j'aj'i. aa miu tadèngi j'ara se kahèi, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci nèti sorga pua le dhèu leo ho lole dènge miu lii lolo be'a lamatua. aa te ngaa, ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga neo rèdhi j'ara se'e se kahèi.

source_text: for this reason, having girded up the loins of your mind, being sober, hope perfectly on the grace that is being brought to you in the revelation of jesus christ,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pa'èra sèna ka me'a mèu j'ara se aa'i-aa'i. j'aga paie-iie sèna ka ngangee miu mola. bori pa'èra ho parcaya taruu yesus kristus toke na lèpa hari mai. lula lod'o èèna, ama lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu.

source_text: as obedient children, not fashioning yourselves to the former desires in your ignorance,
target_text: miu hud'i nanene paie-iie ku ama lamatua, sama sèmi ana-ana nanene lii ina-ama ra. uru èèna, miu me'a iia mèka j'ara mamuri lamatua dhu mola. te ngaa limuri ne me'a mèu le. de baku mamuri madhutu dad'èi miu dhu neo tao bhabhelu. te èèna, j'ara mamuri miu dhu dhui.

source_text: but according as he who called you is holy, you also, become holy in all behavior,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, limuri ne miu hud'i mamuri mola-mèci. te ama lamatua èèna, mola-mèci. nèngu ka dhu paroa nare miu ho j'aj'i ana-ana na. nèti èèna ka, mamuri miu kateme aae hud'i mola-mèci ku.

source_text: because it has been written: become holy, because i am holy;
target_text: te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua, peka na, miu hud'i mola-mèci ku, lula ja'a ne mola-mèci.

source_text: and if you call on the father, who is judging without favoritism according to the work of each, pass the time of your sojourn in fear,
target_text: miu d'èi padhai lii dènge ama lamatua nuka sèmi ama miu. nèngu dhèu pama'ète lii langu kahèi, dhu parisa mamuri dhèu èci-èci. te ngaa nèngu baka-leo nèti dhèu pama'ète lii langu dhu leo sèra. te na pama'ète lii langu dhèu dènge mola, dhu dènge boe koe-kapengo. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i j'aga paie ku mamuri miu. te miu nuka sèmi dhèu tao-mai dhu dhoka manubha ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: having known that, not with corruptible things-silver or gold-were you redeemed from your foolish behavior inherited from our forefathers,
target_text: miu me'a kahèi, na, kristus ka dhu tihe pama'ète le miu nèti mamuri miu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. j'ara mamuri rupa sèmi sèra ka dhu miu sèmi mere nèti bèi-baki miu, nuka sèmi pusaka. te ngaa sanèd'e, te kristus sui nare le miu, b'ae boe pake doi pudhi do hualaa dhu ele bèli-camèd'a.

source_text: but with precious blood, as of a lamb unblemished and unspotted-christ's-
target_text: te ngaa na b'ae-baj'a pake raa nèngu unu na. ne'e ne, kab'ua titu kèna! nèngu madhe nuka sèmi ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu ad'u-ue nèdhi boe sasala, dhu ra roro ne tao j'aj'i korban.

source_text: foreknown, indeed, before the foundation of the world, and revealed in the last times because of you,
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, nèngu ne'a aa'i le aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na kristus tao. te ngaa uru èèna, ama lamatua dhae patadhe mèka kristus mi dhèu rai-haha. limuri ku, heka nèngu pad'elo kristus sèna ka j'aj'i berkat hia miu.

source_text: who through him believe in god who raised him out of the dead, and gave glory to him, so that your faith and hope may be in god.
target_text: lula tatao kristus, ka miu bisa parcaya ama lamatua. te nèngu pamamuri hari kristus, aa ded'e ne padedha-dedha. ama lamatua ad'u-ue j'ara sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu parcaya ne, aa sanao ho na tao madhutu ngaa dhu nèngu padhadha tèke.

source_text: having purified your souls in the obedience of the truth through the spirit to unhypocritical brotherly love, love one another earnestly out of a pure heart,
target_text: miu tao madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. de limuri ne miu bisa sab'a pa'èra-èra hia lamatua. j'ara èèna ka tao miu pasue dènge d'ara kateme mi a'ari miu dhu parcaya sèra. sasue miu hud'i asa tabha èra, lula d'ara miu mola-mèci.

source_text: being begotten again, not out of corruptible seed, but incorruptible, through a word of god-living and remaining-throughout the age;
target_text: miu limuri ne, abhu le mamuri hiu. te ngaa mamuri hiu ne, mai boe nèti ina-ama miu dhu bèli-camèd'a madhe ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa miu abhu nèti ama èdhi ètu sorga dhu madhe boe. mamuri hiu unu mi ne, miu abhu re lii holo-nori ama lamatua. lii holo-nori nèngu ne, nèti mamuri dhu lèke, aa taha taruu.

source_text: because all flesh is as grass, and all glory of man as flower of grass; the grass withered, and the flower of it fell away,
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri, peka na, dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi j'u'u, do hela-bunga. te saraga ra taha nèbhu boe. j'u'u kamale dhae-dhae. hela-bunga kabhui eele kahèi. nèbhu boe madhe, hèia ela aa'i si.

source_text: but the saying of the lord remains-throughout the age; and this is the saying of good news that was proclaimed to you.
target_text: te ngaa lii holo-nori lamatua èdhi, taha taruu, dhu bisa boe ele. lii holo-nori lamatua èèna, nuka lii lolo be'a dhu ji'i peka le dènge miu.

source_text: having put aside, then, all evil, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envyings, and all evil speakings,
target_text: de miu baku tao bhabhelu èci sa. baku padhai-kakoli do kapod'e-kabèli dhèu. baku padhai lii leo tao leo. baku tèka d'ara ladhe mamuri dhèu leo risi èu. baku pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. core eele tatao se'e se!

source_text: as newborn babies, desire the reasonable, unspoiled milk, so that you may grow up to salvation,
target_text: ana rara iisi hiu d'èi dhoka èi susu ina ra. sèmi èèna kahèi d'ara miu hud'i d'èi dhoka me'a mèu lii holo-nori ama lamatua. te ne'e ne ka dhu asa pa'èra parcaya miu nèti ca lod'o asa ca lod'o. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu juu noo-noo j'aj'i kapai, dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: if it so be that you tasted that the lord is good,
target_text: te miu dhu rasa mèdhi le d'ara hua iia lamatua èdhi.

source_text: to whom coming-a living stone-having indeed been disapproved of by men, but with god-choice and precious,
target_text: pa'èki ngi'u miu dènge kristus. te nèngu nuka sèmi hadhu cue dhu mamuri. tuka hadhu core eele ne, lula ra ngee, na, hadhu ne guna boe. te ngaa madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, na, hadhu ne kab'ua titu kèna, hèia na pili nare ne, tao mi hadhu padhèdi dhu kab'ua risi eele.

source_text: and you yourselves are built up as living stones into a spiritual house, a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices acceptable to god through jesus christ.
target_text: miu hud'i pa'èki ku dènge kristus, sèna ka ama lamatua pake miu kahèi. dènge j'ara ne, miu sama sèmi hadhu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare ho patitu èmu hia roh na. miu nuka sèmi hadhu dhu mamuri kahèi, sama sèmi kristus. miu èci èèna ka dènge ama agama sèra, dhu mamuri mola-mèci hia mi ama lamatua. èèna nuka sèmi miu mèti mèdha korban hia ne. mèdha korban dhu miu mèti ne pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, lula yesus kristus madhe le hia miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: for this reason, also, it is contained in the writing: behold, i lay in zion a chief cornerstone, choice, precious, and he who is believing on him may not be put to shame;
target_text: te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua, peka na, ladhe ku laa! te ja'a padhèdi le hadhu uuru, ètu kota yerusalem ne'e, dhu ra pangare, na, ‘kota sion'. ja'a pili kore hadhu ne kahèi. madhutu ja'a, nèngu kab'ua bia. de dhèu dhu parcaya ne, bèli-camèd'a ra'e boe makae.

source_text: to you, then, who are believing-the preciousness; but to the unbelieving, the stone that the builders disapproved of-this one has become the head of the corner,
target_text: hadhu ne, nuka yesus. ka nèngu kab'ua titu kèna bagi mi dhèu dhu parcaya ne. te ngaa bagi mi dhèu dhu parcaya boe yesus kristus, sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua suri, peka na, hadhu dhu tuka sèra core eele, limuri ne j'aj'i le hadhu uuru, dhu kab'ua titu kèna.

source_text: and a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense-who are stumbling at the word, being unbelieving-to which they were also set.
target_text: abhu dhu suri kahèi, peka na, abhu hadhu dhu pakadhunu dhèu. abhu hadhu dhu pabèbhe dhèu. rèngu bèbha lula ro'o boe tao madhutu lii holo-nori lamatua. te ama lamatua dhu ator mema le, sèna ka ra bèbha.

source_text: but you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people acquired, that you may show forth the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his wonderful light,
target_text: te ngaa miu aad'o sèmi èèna. te miu j'aj'i dhèu dhu ama lamatua hag'e unu na. miu j'aj'i dhèu unu nèngu. miu sama sèmi ama agama dhu ladhe-leru dhèu aae. miu èci èèna kahèi dènge dhèu ca suku dhu mamuri mola-mèci hia mi ama lamatua. miu j'aj'i sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu bisa lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti d'ara hua iia ama lamatua dhu na pala-bagi hia miu. te lamatua pua le miu ho tèke eele bhabhelu-katub'a, sèna ka mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu be'a. se'e se nuka sèmi miu kalua nèti d'ara maroga, ho mamuri ètu d'ara saraa na dhu be'a risi eele.

source_text: who were once not a people, but are now the people of god; who had not found mercy, but now have found mercy.
target_text: uru èèna, miu sama sèmi ca suku dhu dènge boe kolongara. te ngaa limuri ne miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. uru èèna, miu pahae boe rasa kasia lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, miu sèmi mere le.

source_text: beloved, i call on you, as strangers and sojourners, to keep from the fleshly desires that war against the soul,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! miu dhoka mai manubha ètu rai-haha ne. te miu nuka sèmi dhèu tao-mai dhu mamuri ètu dedha rai dhèu. nèti èèna ka, ja'a loe boe manèngi sèna ka miu baku mamuri sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu-katub'a madhutu dad'èi d'ara ra. te ètu d'ara miu nuka sèmi pamusu sa. d'ara dhu neo tao karehe lab'a dènge d'ara dhu neo tao be'a. de baku soro tèke d'ara neo tao karehe èèna segi miu. te ladhe j'aj'i ka sèmi èèna, na, miu laho mae-mae!

source_text: having your behavior right among the nations, so that whenever they speak against you as evildoers, seeing your good works, they may glorify god in the day of inspection.
target_text: j'aga paie, sèna ka miu mamuri mola ètu madha dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, ladhe ra galaa leli miu, na, dhu rèngu rèdhi, dhoka babe'a miu di. hèia ropa yesus kristus lèpa hari mai, rèngu unu ra ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha ama lamatua, lula tatao miu dhu be'a sèra.

source_text: be subject, then, to every human creation, because of the lord, whether to a king, as the highest,
target_text: dad'èi lamatua èdhi, sèna ka miu nanene dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu rèd'u paredha. nuka sèmi: nanene mi dhèu aae, te nèngu ka ama paredha dedha.

source_text: whether to governors, as to those sent through him, for punishment, indeed, of evildoers, and a praise of those doing good;
target_text: nanene mi gubernur, te dhèu aae ka dhu pua ne, ho huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu, aa na koa-kad'iri dhèu dhu tao j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: because, so is the will of god, doing good, to put to silence the ignorance of the foolish men-
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua d'èi miu tao dhu lèke, sèna ka dhèu goa dhu re'a boe ngaa-ngaa sèra, abhu boe j'ara ho galaa miu.

source_text: as free, and not having freedom as the cloak of evil, but as servants of god;
target_text: masi ka miu dhèu bebas dhu dènge hak sèna ka madhutu dad'èi d'ara mi, te ngaa miu baku tao leli hak ne ho ad'u-ue bhabhelu. pake hak ne sèna ka sab'a hia ama lamatua, te miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu na.

source_text: give honor to all; love the brotherhood; fear god; honor the king.
target_text: miu hud'i pakab'ua ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i. miu hud'i sue ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya kristus. miu hud'i mamuri dhu lèke ètu madha lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu pama'ète lii langu miu. aa miu hud'i pakab'ua ku rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu rèd'u paredha.

source_text: servants, be subject in all fear to the masters, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the crooked;
target_text: ana pua-paleha sèra! nanene paie-iie lamatua miu sèra, aa pakab'ua si. mage nanene dhoka lamatua dhu d'ara be'a aa lii mako di. masi ka lamatua miu bhelu titu kèna, te ngaa miu hud'i nanene paie ne kahèi.

source_text: for this is grace: if anyone endures sorrows because of conscience toward god, suffering unrighteously;
target_text: ladhe nèti miu abhu huku dhu lèke boe j'ara nèti lamatua miu masi ka miu sala boe ngaa-ngaa, aa ladhe miu taha ètu d'ara sasusa èèna, lula miu ngee mèdhi dad'èi lamatua, pe ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu.

source_text: for what renown is it, if sinning and being battered, you endure it? but if, doing good and suffering for it, you endure, this is grace with god,
target_text: ladhe sèmi miu tao sala, hèia abhu gama, na, a'oto na ngaa, ladhe miu taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra èèna? abhu boe, si? te ngaa ladhe miu abhu susa lula tao dhu be'a, hèia miu taha mere d'ara, na, lamatua ladhe-leru miu.

source_text: for to this you were called, because christ also suffered for you, leaving to you an example, that you may follow his steps,
target_text: te kristus neo kahèi sèna ka miu mamuri mola, masi ka miu abhu susa. te nèngu dui j'aj'èra kahèi pala èdhi. dènge sèmi èèna, nèngu j'aj'i mi conto, sèna ka èdhi madhutu ne, èci èèna ka èdhi madhutu kab'a-j'èla na.

source_text: who did not commit sin, nor was guile found in his mouth,
target_text: sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, nèngu tao nèdhi boe sala. abhu boe lii kapod'e-kabèli kalua nèti hèb'a na.

source_text: who being reviled-was not reviling again, suffering-was not threatening, and was committing himself to him who is judging righteously,
target_text: lod'o ra padhai lii pa-aape ne, nèngu bhoka boe hèb'a. ropa dhèu pasusa nèngu, na b'ala boe. te ngaa na soro ngi'u na asa d'ara adhe-aai ama lamatua. te ne'a, na, ama lamatua èèna dhèu pama'ète lii langu dhu mola.

source_text: who himself bore our sins in his body on the tree that having died to sins, we may live to righteousness; by whose stripes you were healed;
target_text: kristus ka dhu pasae nare sasala èdhi ropa madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. na ad'u-ue j'ara ne, ho patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala, sèna ka èdhi mamuri ia ka dènge tao sasala. ka limuri ne èdhi mamuri heka tao sasala, dhoka mamuri dènge tao dhu lèke di. te nèngu gati èdhi, sèna ka pasae nare hahuku èdhi. hahuku ne'e ka dhu panu'a nèngu toke madhe. te nu'a dhu pamadhe yesus èèna ka puri-pa'èle miu.

source_text: for you were as sheep going astray, but now you turned back to the shepherd and overseer of your souls.
target_text: te miu nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu uru èèna sigo eele nèti j'ara. te ngaa limuri ne miu lèpa hari le asa j'ara lamatua dhu mola. te nèngu ka dhu madhenga dènge kab'oi miu, nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu j'aga dènge ladhe-leru kahib'i-kalèbho na sèra.

source_text: wives, be subject to your own husbands in like manner, that even if some are disobedient to the word, they may be won through the behavior of the wives without the word,
target_text: bhèni aa'i-aa'i dhu leo le èmu! deo na ja'a peka, na, èdhi hud'i nanene paie-iie ku dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa. de miu hud'i nanene ku dhèu èmu miu. sanèd'e, te abhu dhèu mone cahag'e dhu leo le èmu, ro'o boe tao madhutu lii holo-nori lamatua. masi ka rèngu ro'o boe nanene lii padhai miu, te ngaa èèna na, rèngu neo parcaya lamatua, lula rèdhi j'ara mamuri miu.

source_text: having beheld your pure behavior in fear,
target_text: te rèngu rèdhi miu sab'a aa'i-aa'i dènge d'ara mola-mèci aa mamuri dhu pakab'ua ama lamatua.

source_text: whose adorning-let it not be that which is outward, of braiding of hair, and of putting around of things of gold, or of putting on of garments,
target_text: bhèni dhu bhèni iia, mai boe nèti ngaa dhu tèdhi nèti li'u. nuka sèmi: sageri kètu madhutu rupa-rupa mod'e, do, pake mèdha hualaa dhu risi eele, do, pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae dhu lèke boe j'ara.

source_text: but-the hidden man of the heart, by the incorruptible thing of the meek and quiet spirit, which is of great value before god,
target_text: te ngaa dhu tao bhèni iia dhu lèke, nuka: d'ara dhu tèdhi boe nèti li'u. conto sèmi: d'ara hua iia, dènge lii mako. te bhèni iia sèmi èèna ka dhu taha taruu, masi ka toke d'ai heka bhora. madhutu a'abhu lamatua, bhèni iia sèmi èèna ka dhu kab'ua risi.

source_text: for thus once also the holy women who hoped on god were adorning themselves, being subject to their own husbands,
target_text: te uru-uru sèra, dhèu bhèni dhu d'ara mola-mèci, dhu parcaya ama lamatua, rèngu sèra ka dhu bhèni iia. rèngu nanene aa madhutu dhèu èmu ra dènge be'a.

source_text: as sarah was obedient to abraham, calling him lord, of whom you became daughters, doing good, and not fearing any terror.
target_text: tare conto nèti sara. nèngu nanene mi dhèu èmu na abraham. nèngu soro iisi na, sèna ka dhèu èmu na ator nèngu. miu bhèni aa'i-aa'i hud'i madhutu ku j'ara nèti sara ne. ladhe miu tao dhu lèke, na, miu madha'u boe.

source_text: husbands, in like manner, dwelling with them, according to knowledge, as to a weaker vessel-to the wife-imparting honor, as also being heirs together of the grace of life, that your prayers are not hindered.
target_text: mone aa'i-aa'i dhu leo le èmu! mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu miu. ngee paie-iie ngaa dhu be'a hia mi nèngu, aa tao madhutu. pakab'ua ne ètu j'ara aa'i-aa'i, lula a'èra bhèni sama boe dènge a'èra dhèu mone. te miu sama-sama abhu pusaka dhu ama lamatua neo hia miu. nuka, mamuri hiu dhu lamatua hia miu nèti d'ara hua iia na. te ngaa miu mone dhu ngara na dhèu èmu-kamali, hud'i mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu miu, sèna ka ladhe miu dua mi sabaj'a d'ara èci manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti lamatua, na, lamatua nanene lii manèngi miu.

source_text: and finally, be all of one mind, having fellow-feeling, loving as brothers, compassionate, courteous,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a pab'ab'e lii holo ja'a aa'i-aa'i sèra sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i mamuri ku d'ara èci. ladhe ca dhèu abhu susa do karej'e, na, miu dhu leo hud'i rasa sèmi èèna kahèi. sue dhèu dhu parcaya kristus. pad'elo d'ara hua iia èci dènge èci. baku padedha iisi, te miu hud'i pahaha iisi ku.

source_text: not giving back evil for evil, or reviling for reviling, but on the contrary, blessing, having known that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing;
target_text: baku b'ala bhabhelu dènge bhabhelu. ladhe dhèu padhai lii padhèto dènge miu, baku b'ala kahèi. te ngaa manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia dhu be'a mi nèngu. te lamatua dhu paroa nare le miu j'aj'i mi dhèu unu na, sèna ka miu bisa sèmi mere dhu hua iia nèti nèngu.

source_text: for he who is willing to love life, and to see good days, let him guard his tongue from evil, and his lips-not to speak guile;
target_text: te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, na, dhèu dhu tenge mamuri be'a, aa dhu tenge mamuri madhera, dhèu èèna hud'i j'aga hèb'a na sèna ka baku ore leli, aa baku pakapod'e d'ara lii.

source_text: let him turn aside from evil, and do good, let him seek peace and pursue it;
target_text: nèngu hud'i ele-ho'a, sèna ka tao heka bhelu, te ngaa tao dhu lèke di. nèngu hud'i patema mamuri padame dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, aa tenge j'ara ho pabe'a taruu dènge ra.

source_text: because the eyes of the lord are on the righteous, and his ears-to their supplication, but the face of the lord is against those doing evil;
target_text: te lamatua èdhi dhu haduli dhèu dhu mamuri mola. aa nèngu kahèi neo nanene lii manèngi-mangaj'i rèngu. te ngaa lamatua èdhi loe boe lab'a dhèu dhu ad'u-ue taruu bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and who is he who will be doing you evil, if you may become imitators of him who is good?
target_text: ladhe miu d'èi tao dhu lèke, cee ka dhu neo paj'èra hari miu? abhu boe, si?

source_text: but if you also should suffer because of righteousness, you are blessed! and do not be afraid of their fear, nor be troubled,
target_text: te ngaa masi ka miu tao dhu lèke, hèia abhu dhu pasusa miu, miu oto. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tadhe boe kristus j'aj'i madha'u lula madha j'ara èci, na, miu baku madhutu ho madha'u sèmi èèna. ngangee miu baku kahèlu, aa d'ara miu baku susa èci èèna ka dènge rèngu.

source_text: but sanctify the lord god in your hearts. and always be ready for defense to everyone who is asking of you an account concerning the hope that is in you, with meekness and fear,
target_text: pamau d'ara miu, lula miu dhu ded'e le kristus ètu d'ara miu ho j'aj'i lamatua miu dhu mola-mèci. ladhe sèmi dhèu manèngi sèna ka miu lole parcaya miu aa sanao-maena miu, dhu peka na, bèli-camèd'a kristus tao aa'i j'aj'i mi be'a, na, miu hud'i pa'èra ku ho dhaa lii karèi rèngu sèra.

source_text: having a good conscience, so that whenever they speak against you as evildoers, they may be ashamed-those who are maligning your good behavior in christ;
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i dhaa ku nèti d'ara dhu hua iia, aa pakab'ua si, sèna ka re'a, na, miu tao dhu lèke mai nèti d'ara dhu mola. masi ka miu tao dhu be'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa tatu abhu dhu padhai lii neo pamanahu miu, lula miu pa'èki dènge kristus. de ladhe miu tao taruu dhu be'a, na, rèngu dhu pa-aape miu èèna na ra'e makae.

source_text: for if the will of god wills it, it is better to suffer doing good, than doing evil;
target_text: ladhe èèna palèke dènge dad'èi lamatua, na, baku bhèlu, te be'a risi miu abhu j'aj'èra nèti tao j'ara dhu lèke; baku nèti miu ad'u-ue j'ara karehe.

source_text: also because christ suffered once for sin-righteous for unrighteous-that he might lead us to god, indeed having been put to death in the flesh, but having been made alive in the spirit,
target_text: te kristus madhe ca tèka di, lula èdhi dhèu rai-haha tao sala. nèngu dhu mamuri mola, madhe le pala èdhi dhu mamuri koe-kapengo. nèngu madhe sèna ka miu bisa pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. kristus èèna, dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi èdhi kahèi, dhèu pamadhe ne, te ngaa roh lamatua pamamuri hari ne.

source_text: by which, having gone, he also preached to the spirits in prison,
target_text: roh èèna kahèi lere nèti nèngu la'e aj'a-nori mi roh-roh dhu lèke bèdho ètu era èci, nuka sèmi d'ara bui.

source_text: who sometime ago disobeyed when once the long-suffering of god waited, in the days of noah-an ark being prepared-in which few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water,
target_text: roh se, nuka samanga nèti dhèu dhu uru-uru sèra ro'o boe nanene lamatua. lod'o èèna, noh tao kapa aae cue. lamatua tatae sèna ka neo nèdhi dhèu sèra tao madhutu dad'èi na, te ngaa rèngu pusi-pahae boe. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhoka dhèu aru di, dhu mamuri nèti èi aae lala.

source_text: also an antitype to immersion which now saves you-not a putting away of the filth of flesh, but the question of a good conscience in regard to god, through the resurrection of jesus christ,
target_text: èi aae lala ne j'aj'i conto, nuka sèmi lod'o sarani miu. sarani ne j'aj'i tadha, peka na, lamatua patabuli eele miu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo miu, lula kristus mamuri hari le. lod'o sarani miu, ra padiu boe miu, ho pamèu ngi'u mi. te dhu lèke ka, nuka, miu padhadha mi lamatua, ho neo tao pamèu d'ara miu. dènge sèmi èèna, na, miu bisa mamuri mola.

source_text: who is at the right hand of god, having gone on to heaven-messengers, and authorities, and powers, having been subjected to him.
target_text: limuri ne, yesus lèpa hari le asa sorga. ètu nèi, na madhèdi ètu era dhu kab'ua risi eele, re baboa g'ana ama lamatua. ka ana-ana pajuu ètu sorga, koasa aa'i-aa'i, dènge dhu rèd'u koasa, hud'i nanene ku kristus.

source_text: christ, then, having suffered for us in the flesh, you also arm yourselves with the same mind, because he who suffered in the flesh has finished with sin,
target_text: kristus èèna, dhèu rai-haha èci èèna ka dènge èdhi. lula nèngu abhu le j'aj'èra ae-ae, miu hud'i pa'èra dui sasusa sama sèmi nèngu kahèi. te ngaa sanèd'e, te dhèu dhu abhu susa lula pa'èki dènge kristus, nèngu pama'ète nare le ho ad'u-ue heka sasala.

source_text: no longer in the desires of men, but in the will of god, to live the rest of the time in the flesh;
target_text: masi ka nèngu mamuri era ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa nèngu mamuri heka ètu d'ara sasala sama sèmi dhèu rai-haha leo sèra. te nèngu mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: for the time has sufficiently passed to have carried out the will of the nations, having walked in licentiousness, lusts, excesses of wines, revelings, drinking-bouts, and unlawful idolatries,
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ae le ka dhu miu bisa pake ho ad'u-ue bhabhelu ngaa èèna ka, sama sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua. nuka sèmi: rèngu tao j'ara dhu lèke boe. tao j'ara makae. tao bhabhelu madhutu dad'èi d'ara ra. rinu mahu. rèngu tao pesta liar. rèngu tao pesta j'ara makae rupa-rupa. ra sogo-tagu nidhu dènge j'ara dhu pamamuru iisi èdhi.

source_text: in which they think it strange-your not running with them to the same excess of wastefulness, slandering you-
target_text: rèngu padhai pa'ele iie kolongara miu, lula rèngu re'a boe, nga tao ka miu tao boe madhutu bhabhelu sèmi rèngu dhu seli-kolane èèna.

source_text: who will give an account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead,
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e, bèli-camèd'a rèngu hud'i lasi ku asa madha ama lamatua, dhu j'aj'i dhèu pama'ète lii langu. rèngu hud'i lole dènge ama lamatua nga tao ka rèngu mamuri ètu d'ara bhelu-katub'a sèmi sèra. baku bhèlu, te dhèu aa'i-aa'i bèli-camèd'a hud'i lasi ku asa madha nèngu. dhèu dhu mamuri era, do dhu madhe le, aa'i-aa'i hud'i lasi ku asa madha lamatua.

source_text: for this also was good news proclaimed to dead men, that they may be judged, indeed, according to men in the flesh, but may live according to god in the spirit.
target_text: lèke tare'a! ama lamatua neo parisa dhèu dhu madhe le, nuka sèmi dhu nèngu parisa dhèu rai-haha leo sèra. te nèngu neo ne'a j'ara mamuri rèngu uru sèra. nèti èèna ka, yesus la'e le peka-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua mi dedha rèngu, sèna ka rèngu kahèi bisa abhu mamuri dhu lèke ho tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: now the end of all things has come near; be sober-minded, then, and be sober in your prayers.
target_text: lod'o èle rai-haha ne oe dètu ae le. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pajiko paie-iie dènge d'ara dhu mau, sèna ka lamatua sèmi nare lii manèngi miu.

source_text: before all things, having earnest love among yourselves, because love covers a multitude of sins;
target_text: dhu lèke ka, miu hud'i mamuri pasue taruu èci dènge èci. te masi ka dhèu leo tao sasala ae-ae, te ngaa miu bisa pa'angalai era dènge ne, lula miu sue ne.

source_text: be hospitable to one another, without murmuring;
target_text: pakabhèle ai sèna ka sèmi mere dhèu tao-mai ho manubha ètu d'ara èmu miu. te ngaa sanèd'e, baku sèmi mere si dènge d'ara ka'uu-kamuki.

source_text: each one, according as he received a gift, ministering it to one another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of god;
target_text: èdhi dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i abhu le karunya nèti lamatua. de èdhi hud'i pake karunya ne ho lalau-lalo'o a'ari dhèu parcaya. haduli aa pake pabe'a-be'a karunya èèna, te èèna ka dhu dènge guna hia mi lamatua.

source_text: if anyone speaks, speak as oracles of god; if anyone ministers, minister as of the strength which god supplies, so that in all things god may be glorified through jesus christ, to whom is the glory and the power through the ages of the ages. amen.
target_text: nuka sèmi: ladhe abhu karunya aj'a-nori dhèu, na, sanèd'e te miu hud'i lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i pake lii holo-nori ama lamatua. ladhe abhu karunya ho ladhe-leru dhèu, na, sab'a pake a'èra dhu lamatua pala-bagi mi miu. dènge j'ara ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i tadhe, na, miu dhèu unu yesus kristus. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu ded'e padedha-dedha ama lamatua. te nèngu èèna, kapai titu kèna! aa koasa nèd'u paredha na dhu dènge boe too-lane! lèke tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: beloved, do not think it strange at the fiery suffering among you that is coming to try you, as if a strange thing were happening to you,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! mage malaa ladhe paraga dènge dadugu-rariu dhu bia. te èèna neo uji parcaya miu. baku pangee, na, dhoka èu di dhu abhu dadugu-rariu sèmi èèna.

source_text: but according as you have fellowship with the sufferings of the christ, rejoice, that you may also rejoice in the revelation of his glory-exulting;
target_text: te ngaa d'ara miu bisa karej'e-karae, lula miu abhu j'aj'èra sama sèmi kristus dhu abhu j'aj'èra kahèi. dènge j'ara ne, èèna na d'ara miu asa karej'e-karae ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi dadedha kristus.

source_text: if you are reproached in the name of christ-you are blessed, because the spirit of glory and of god rests on you; in regard, indeed, to them, is evil spoken of him, and in regard to you, he is glorified;
target_text: ropa dhèu pahahe miu, lula pa'èki dènge kristus, miu oto, lula dadedha roh lamatua pa'èra miu.

source_text: for let none of you suffer as a murderer, or thief, or evildoer, or as a meddler into other men's matters;
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu abhu j'aj'èra, na, baku lula miu pamadhe dhèu, do, dhèu mana'u, dhèu bhelu-katub'a, do, dhèu dhu d'èi soro iisi asa lii langu dhèu.

source_text: and if as a christian, do not let him be ashamed, but let him glorify god in this respect;
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu pasae j'aj'èra lula j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, nèngu baku makae. hua iia risi rèngu koa-kio ama lamatua, lula rèngu j'aj'i dhèu kristen.

source_text: because it is the time of the judgment to have begun from the house of god, and if first from us, what is the end of those disobedient to the good news of god?
target_text: lod'o d'ai le ho dhèu lasi asa madha ama lamatua. na parisa uuru mamuri dhèu-dhèu unu na. de pangee paie-iie! ladhe na mulai nèti èdhi dhèu kristen, na, tasa mera mia dènge rèngu dhu ro'o boe sèmi lii lolo be'a na? tatu hahuku rèngu bia risi hari!

source_text: and if the righteous man is scarcely saved, where will the ungodly and sinner appear?
target_text: te abhu dhu suri ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, na, ladhe dhèu dhu mamuri mola oe abhu boe mamuri sa hèi, tasamia hari dènge rèngu dhu ro'o boe pahae lamatua? aa tasamia hari dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara sasala?

source_text: so that those also suffering according to the will of god, as to a steadfast creator, let them commit their own souls in doing good.
target_text: de ladhe ama lamatua soro tèke dhèu unu na abhu susa madhutu dad'èi lamatua, na, rèngu bisa lèka, peka na, èèna na nèngu j'aga si kahèi. te nèngu ka paj'aj'i si. nèngu kahèi tao madhutu ngaa dhu na peka le. lula nèngu j'aga si sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka rèngu bisa tao taruu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: elders who are among you, i exhort you, as a fellow-elder, and a witness of the sufferings of the christ, and a partaker of the glory about to be revealed,
