target_text: ja'a ne, ca dhèu kètu kahèi. uru èèna, lod'o kristus pasae j'aj'èra na, ja'a kèdhi unu ku dènge musi madha ja'a. aa bèli-camèd'a ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i laladhe rèdhi dadedha ama lamatua, ja'a kahèi neo kèdhi dènge musi madha ku. de ja'a neo holo kètu juma'at dhu leo sèra, na:

source_text: feed the flock of god that is among you, overseeing not by compulsion, but willingly, neither for shameful gain, but eagerly,
target_text: miu nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu ladhe-leru kahib'i-kalèbho ra. de miu hud'i leru paie-iie dhèu dhu lamatua pangèd'u asa miu. uri si paie-iie. mage miu ladhe-leru si, lula dhoka sasab'a miu di, te ngaa lula miu d'èi tao sèmi èèna. uli si madhutu dad'èi lamatua. baku d'èi tenge oto, te ngaa sab'a dènge karej'e ho soru-bara dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: neither as exercising lordship over the heritages, but becoming patterns for the flock,
target_text: baku paredha leli, ho pabia dhèu dhu lamatua hia miu ladhe-leru si. te ngaa miu hud'i j'aj'i conto dhu be'a, dhu bisa paj'uj'u j'ara hia rèngu.

source_text: and the chief shepherd having appeared, you will receive the unfading garland of glory.
target_text: yesus, nuka sèmi kètu nèti dhèu madhenga badha. bèli-camèd'a ladhe na lèpa hari mai, ama lamatua neo b'ae rui-j'aj'èra miu, lula miu uri dhèu miu dènge be'a. upa ne, bisa boe ele iie, te ngaa taha taa-taa d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: in like manner, you young ones, be subject to elders, and all subjecting yourselves to one another; clothe yourselves with humble-mindedness, because god resists the proud, but he gives grace to the humble;
target_text: ana ngèru aa'i-aa'i! miu kahèi hud'i nanene ku kètu juma'at sèra. miu aa'i-aa'i mi baku padedha iisi. te ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri, peka na, lamatua lab'a dhèu dhu padedha iisi, te ngaa nèngu d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu dhu pahaha iisi.

source_text: be humbled, then, under the powerful hand of god, that he may exalt you in good time,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i sanèd'e ku koasa lamatua, sèna ka miu baku pamone-pabhèni. hèia ropa d'ai lod'o na, lamatua koa-kad'iri miu.

source_text: having cast all your care on him, because he cares for you.
target_text: pataleo d'ara miu, sèna ka lamatua uri j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu tao miu madha'u. te nèngu ka dhu haduli miu.

source_text: be sober, vigilant, because your opponent the devil walks around as a roaring lion, seeking whom he may swallow up,
target_text: mage-mage! pake ngangee madhera. aa j'aga paie-iie, te musu èdhi, nuka dhèu aae nidhu, neo palaho miu. neo dhèle aa'i miu, nuka sèmi singa dhu manganga, dhu patangi-tenge badha neo na'a.

source_text: whom you must resist, steadfast in the faith, having known the same sufferings of your brotherhood to be accomplished in the world.
target_text: te ngaa baku madha'u. miu hud'i lab'a dhèu aae nidhu èèna. miu hud'i pa'èra lalèka miu mi lamatua kahèi. te miu me'a le, na, a'ari miu dhèu parcaya buli mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, abhu sasusa sama sèmi miu kahèi.

source_text: and the god of all grace, who called you to his perpetual glory in christ jesus, having suffered a little, himself make you perfect, establish, strengthen, settle you;
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e, te ama lamatua d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi kahèi. nèngu ka dhu paroa le miu, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lula miu sèmi mere le kristus. nèti èèna ka, nèngu neo ded'e miu padedha-dedha, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri taruu dènge nèngu. te ngaa ladhe miu abhu le j'aj'èra dhoka ètu d'ara ciki oo'e di ètu rai-haha ne, lamatua neo pabe'a hari miu. na neo pa'èra miu, aa tao miu bisa taha. nèngu pamadhèdi miu kahèi mi dedha fanderen dhu èra.

source_text: to him is the glory and the power through the ages and the ages! amen.
target_text: ji'i manèngi sèna ka lamatua nèd'u koasa aa'i-aa'i toke d'ai mia-mia. lèke tare'a!

source_text: through silvanus, the faithful brother as i reckon, i wrote through few words to you, exhorting and testifying this to be the true grace of god in which you have stood.
target_text: silas ka dhu soru-bara ja'a ho suri sasuri dhu bab'a ne. nèngu ne, a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya, aa ai g'ana ja'a. ja'a holo-nori miu sèna ka miu taha pa'èra, te lamatua d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na taruu mi èdhi. de miu hud'i èra ku, sèna ka baku hari kabodho.

source_text: she in babylon chosen with you greets you, and my son marcus.
target_text: dhèu parcaya dhu pakaboko ètu kota babel hia miu lii maho'o. ama lamatua hag'e nare le rèngu, sama sèmi na pili miu. ana ja'a markus pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: greet one another in a kiss of love. peace to you all who are in christ jesus! amen.
target_text: ladhe miu paraga, na, pa'uu èci dènge èci ho pad'elo pasue miu. ja'a d'èi ladhe miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu parcaya kristus bisa mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. saloom, petrus

source_text: simeon peter, a servant and an apostle of jesus christ, to those who obtained an equally precious faith with us in the righteousness of our god and savior jesus christ:
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, simon petrus. ja'a j'aj'i ana pua-paleha yesus kristus. ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na kahèi, dhu na pua laku asa mia-mia ho lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti nèngu. ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, dhu parcaya le yesus kristus. lula d'ara mola ama lamatua, ka na bhoke j'ara ho miu bisa parcaya kristus kahèi, sama sèmi ji'i. parcaya ne kab'ua titu kèna hia èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. kristus èèna j'aj'i ama lamatua èdhi, aa nèngu kahèi j'aj'i dhèu dhu patalale èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo.

source_text: grace and peace be multiplied to you in the acknowledgment of god and of jesus our lord!
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu tadhe mèu ama lamatua, aa tadhe kètu èdhi, yesus, dènge be'a. hud'i laa sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, ho miu bisa mamuri dènge dame aa mera-milu èci dènge èci.

source_text: as his divine power has given to us all things pertaining to life and piety, through the acknowledgment of him who called us through glory and virtue,
target_text: yesus dhu dènge koasa èci èèna ka dènge ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, yesus papala èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti ngaa-ngaa dhu èdhi parluu, sèna ka mamuri mola madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèngu tao sèmi èèna, lula èdhi tadhe mèu ne. aa na paroa èdhi ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lula d'ara hua iia dènge dadedha na.

source_text: through which the most great and precious promises have been given to us, that through these you may become partakers of a divine nature, having escaped from the corruption and lust in the world.
target_text: yesus hia le èdhi j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu hua iia. te uru èèna, na padhadha tèke le ho neo hia j'ara se'e. lii padhadha na, aa'i-aa'i be'a titu kèna. yesus hia aa'i mèu-mèu se'e mi èdhi, sèna ka d'ara èdhi bisa sama sèmi d'ara lamatua. aa èdhi bisa lehe tare j'ara-j'ara karehe dhu dhèu ètu rai-haha ne d'èi ad'u-ue, lula rèngu mamuri d'èi dhoka tao madhutu dad'èi unu ra, aa dhu taha rare boe d'ara ra.

source_text: and for this same reason also, having brought in all diligence, supplement your faith with virtue, and with virtue-knowledge,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu pa'èra tao j'ara dhu be'a. mema miu parcaya le yesus, te ngaa èèna dhae d'ai mèka. sab'a taruu j'ara dhu be'a. tadhe lamatua dènge be'a risi hari.

source_text: and with knowledge-self-control, and with self-control-endurance, and with endurance-piety,
target_text: te ngaa mage d'ai dhoka sange èèna di. patema mamuri ho taha mere d'ara. te ngaa sèra dhae d'ai mèka kahèi. lod'o-lod'o miu abhu sasusa, na, miu hud'i pa'èra d'ara ho baku hari kabodho. te ngaa tao parisi hari nèti èèna. tao aa'i mèu-mèu madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: and with piety-brotherly kindness, and with brotherly kindness-love;
target_text: te ngaa mage dhoka d'ai sange èèna di. pad'elo sasue mi a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra. te ngaa èèna dhae d'ai mèka kahèi. te miu hud'i mamuri pasue taruu.

source_text: for these things being in you and abounding, make you neither inert nor unfruitful in regard to the knowledge of our lord jesus christ,
target_text: ladhe mamuri miu sèmi sèra ka, aa j'ara dhu be'a asa tabha taruu, na, sèra sa hia miu asa tadhe mèu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te j'ara dhu be'a ele boe iia d'ara, aa core eele boe lod'o kahèi. te j'ara be'a se'e ka dhu tao d'ara miu ho me'a mèu nèngu.

source_text: for he with whom these things are not present is blind, dim-sighted, having become forgetful of the cleansing of his old sins;
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu d'èi boe tao sèmi sèra, sasoa na, ngangee nèngu bab'a. nèngu nèdhi boe ngaa ètu madha nèngu, nuka sèmi dhèu bèdhu. te lamatua dhu saku eele le sasala na, sèna ka d'ara nèngu bisa mola-mèci. te ngaa dhèu ne bhèlu eele!

source_text: therefore, rather, brothers, be diligent to make steadfast your calling and divine selection, for doing these things you may never stumble;
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! miu limuri ne hud'i bori dhari asa pa'èra. lamatua hag'e nare le miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, ka miu lami asa madha na. de miu hud'i pad'elo ku, na, miu j'aj'i le ana-èpu na. ladhe j'ara dhu ja'a peka se tabha taruu ètu mamuri miu, na, miu manahu boe.

source_text: in this way the entrance into the continuous kingdom of our lord and savior jesus christ will be richly supplemented to you.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, ama lamatua bagi hia miu j'ara èci dhu kapai titu kèna. nuka na bhoke pataleo j'ara, dènge pangèd'u miu hak, ho sèmi mere yesus kristus j'aj'i dhèu aae miu, sèna ka miu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ne. te yesus kristus ne, kètu èdhi. aa nèngu kahèi, dhèu dhu patalale èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: therefore, i will always be ready to remind you about these things, although you have known them and have been established in the present truth,
target_text: miu me'a le j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a peka deo sa, aa miu taha pa'èra, lula miu parcaya ngaa dhu lèke. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a loe boe pasanèd'e miu pahari-pahari, sèna ka miu baku bhèlu eele.

source_text: and i think right, so long as i am in this tent, to stir you up in reminding you,
target_text: ja'a ko'o boe ladhe miu pabhèlu eele j'ara sèra. ja'a d'èi pasanèd'e miu taruu, sèna ka miu pajiko taruu j'ara se'e se, ètu d'ara kahadhu miu. te lod'o ja'a mamuri ètu rai-haha ne era, mema sala boe ladhe ja'a loe boe pasanèd'e j'ara se'e mi miu.

source_text: having known that the laying aside of my tent is soon, even as our lord jesus christ also showed to me.
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a madhe, sama sèmi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus peka le dènge ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a ke'a le.

source_text: and i will also be diligent to ensure that you always have a remembrance to make of these things after my departure.
target_text: masi ka bèli-camèd'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a tenge j'ara ho miu sanèd'e taruu j'ara se'e.

source_text: for having not followed out skillfully devised fables, we made known to you the power and coming of our lord jesus christ, but having become eyewitnesses of his majesty-
target_text: ca hari na, ja'a dènge angalai ja'a lole le dènge miu, lula-nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ji'i peka kahèi, na, bèli-camèd'a ladhe kristus lèpa hari mai, mamai nèngu èèna dènge koasa dhu kapai titu kèna. lèke, si? dhu ji'i lolo se, nanuku boe. lula ji'i lole dhoka dhu ji'i ladhe ngèdhi dènge musi madha ji'i unu mi! nèti èèna ka, ji'i nge'a, na, dadedha yesus kristus ne nuka sèmi dhèu aae kapai sa.

source_text: for having received honor and glory from god the father, such a voice being borne to him by the excellent glory: this is my son, the beloved, in whom i delighted; and we heard this voice borne out of heaven, being with him at the holy mountain.
target_text: ca tèka, ji'i sama-sama dènge yesus ètu ledhe mola-mèci lamatua. hèia ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka lula-nèti dadedha yesus ne. te lod'o èèna, ji'i tadèngi lii dhu be'a titu kèna mai nèti dedha-liru, peka na, ne'e ne, ana pasue ja'a. nèngu ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ja'a.

source_text: and we have a more firm prophetic word, to which we do well giving heed, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until day may dawn, and the morning star may arise in your hearts;
target_text: èèna ka dhu tao ji'i asa lèka èra lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu uru sèra ji'i abhu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. de hua iia risi miu tao madhutu lii moa dhèu se'e! te lii moa rèngu sèra, nuka sèmi labhu èci dhu pasaraa ètu d'ara maroga. de miu hud'i nanene paie-iie ku lii moa se, toke d'ai yesus mai hari. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu asa tabha me'a mèu. te èèna na nuka sèmi miu mèdhi uuru ku hua-hètu aae dhimu, hèia lod'o heka rea kèna ho pasaraa aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: knowing this first, that no prophecy of the writing comes of private exposition,
target_text: sanèd'e, te dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka mema le j'ara ae-ae. te ngaa j'ara-j'ara dhu rèngu peka-padhai se nèti boe dad'èi rèngu.

source_text: for prophecy never came by the will of man, but men spoke from god, being brought by the holy spirit.
target_text: lula ngaa dhu rèngu suri se, mai boe nèti ngaa dhu rèngu neo padhai lii. te ngaa mai nèti ama lamatua, madhutu ngaa dhu roh mola-mèci na pad'elo dènge rèngu.

source_text: but there also came false prophets among the people, as there will also be false teachers among you, who will stealthily bring in destructive sects, even denying the master who bought them, bringing quick destruction to themselves,
target_text: uru èèna, dhèu isra'el cahag'e peka na, rèngu dhu j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua. aa te ngaa rèngu se kapod'e-kabèli di. pe miu paraga dènge dhèu sèmi sèra ètu talora aae miu. te abhu cahag'e dhu peka na, rèngu aj'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua, te ngaa ra leko-monya di. rèngu aj'a pahuni-pahuni ngangee rèngu dhu karehe. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bisa pamaso a'aj'a rèngu dhu koe-kapengo sèra. ladhe miu nanene lii aj'a-nori rèngu, bèli-camèd'a miu abhu calaka. rèngu pasili, peka na, lamatua yesus èèna, lamatua rèngu boe. aa te ngaa, yesus ka dhu sui nare rèngu dènge kab'ua titu kèna. lula tatao rèngu sèmi ne'e ne ka, nèbhu boe rèngu unu ra laho malai.

source_text: and many will follow out their destructive ways, because of whom the way of the truth will be spoken of as evil,
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a abhu kahèi dhèu ae dhu madhutu rèngu, aa tao leli dhu re'a heka makae. bèli-camèd'a dhèu pakarehe a'aj'a dhu lèke, lula tatao rèngu.

source_text: and in covetousness, with forged words, they will make merchandise of you, whose judgment of old is not idle, and their destruction does not slumber.
target_text: mese dhu kapod'e-kabèli sèra manga'a-dèu ngara. rèngu ad'u-ue rupa-rupa lii padhai, sèna ka tipu rare doi-dhari miu. te ngaa baku bhèlu, te ama lamatua dhu pama'ète lii langu dhu pasaruru nèdhi boe musi madha. karèi nèti uru ka, nèngu pa'èra mema le ho huku si. bèli-camèd'a ra laho aa'i.

source_text: for if god did not spare messengers having sinned, but having cast them down to tartarus with chains of deepest gloom, delivered them, having been reserved to judgment,
target_text: conto sèmi, uru èèna, abhu ana pajuu ama lamatua cahag'e ètu sorga dhu tao sala. te ngaa lamatua dhu pama'ète lii langu soro tèke boe si. na pèci si asa d'ara naraka, aa bèdho si ètu d'ara ro'a maroga dhu marèma aae. rèngu pea taha ètu èèna toke d'ai lod'o lasi asa madha ama lamatua.

source_text: and did not spare the old world, but kept the eighth person, noah, a preacher of righteousness, having brought a flood on the world of the impious,
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu mamuri uru-uru sèra. tèu èèna, rèngu ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a dènge pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua. te ngaa lamatua dhu ator le dhèu na èci dhu d'ara mola, ngara na noh, pad'elo j'ara sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri mola. te ngaa ro'o boe nanene ne kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua hia èi aae lala, ka palaho aa'i dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe ne. te ngaa lamatua hia mamuri dhoka noh dènge isi èmu na. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra aru dhèu.

source_text: and having turned the cities of sodom and gomorrah to ashes, condemned with an overthrow, having set them as an example to those about to be impious,
target_text: ca tèka hari, dhèu uru-uru sèra ètu kota sodom dènge kota gomora, mamuri dhoka ad'u-ue bhabhelu-katub'a. hèia ama lamatua huku si. nèngu labhu pakèpu aa'i si j'aj'i ahu, ka dhèu ètu sèra madhe aa'i mèu-mèu. se'e se j'aj'i mi conto hia mi dhèu leo dhu d'èi mamuri ètu d'ara bhabhelu-katub'a dènge dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua. rèngu bisa re'a mema le mamadhe-mamopo ra, ladhe ele boe ho'a.

source_text: and he rescued righteous lot, worn down by the conduct of the lawless in licentiousness,
target_text: te ngaa lod'o èèna, abhu ca dhèu ngara na lot, dhu mamuri mola. nèngu roca le dènge tatao dhu seli-kolane nèti dhèu bhelu se'e, dhu ro'o boe nanene ama lamatua. ka ama lamatua pakaj'èu lot nèti era èèna.

source_text: for the righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul, day by day, in seeing and hearing unlawful works-
target_text: lot ne ca dhèu dhu d'èi tao dhu lèke, te ngaa na pea ètu talora aae dhèu sodom. bèli-bèli èèna, lot nèdhi aa tadèngi kahèi rèngu sisu atora ama lamatua. se'e se ka dhu pasusa d'ara lot.

source_text: the lord has known to rescue the pious out of temptation, and to keep the unrighteous being punished to the day of judgment,
target_text: conto sèra sa pad'elo, peka na, ama lamatua ne'a j'ara hia mamuri mi dhèu dhu d'èi nanene nèngu, ka na pakaj'èu si nèti rupa-rupa dadugu-rariu. nèngu ne'a pamanahu hahuku dhu bia kahèi mi dhèu dhu mamuri koe-kapengo. aa lamatua tao j'ara se'e toke d'ai lod'o na pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and chiefly those following after the flesh in lust and defilement, and despising lordship. bold, self-pleased, they are not afraid to speak evil of glorious ones,
target_text: hahuku dhu bia èèna, lèke risi-risi mi dhèu dhu d'èi dhoka mamuri kaj'alu, madhutu dad'èi d'ara ra. rèngu ro'o boe nanene ca dhèu sa, aa pahahe dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa. tatu ama lamatua huku si. de mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra bani titu kèna, aa padedha iisi seli eele. rèngu ro'o boe pakab'ua aa madha'u boe padhai lii pa'ele iie kolongara ama lamatua dènge ana pajuu na ètu sorga.

source_text: whereas messengers, being greater in strength and power, do not bear a slanderous judgment against them before the lord;
target_text: madhutu mola-mola na, ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga sèra èra risi nèti rèngu mese-mese kapod'e-kabèli se. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ana-ana pajuu se padhai lii pa'ele iie boe kolongara mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra ètu madha lamatua rèngu. aa ra pèci boe sasala asa mese sèra kahèi.

source_text: and these, as irrational natural beasts, made to be caught and destroyed-in what things they are ignorant of, slandering-in their destruction will be destroyed;
target_text: te ngaa mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra re'a dhoka padhai lii pa'ele iie j'ara-j'ara dhu rèngu mesa ra re'a boe. te rèngu èci èèna ka dènge badha dhu dènge boe ngangee na! be'a risi, kèpe ho palaho eele si! te kalua aapa rèngu, sèmi èèna ka. tatu bèli-camèd'a rèngu laho aa'i, lula tatao rèngu dhu karehe sèra.

source_text: doing unjustly, they will receive a reward of unrighteousness, esteeming pleasure in the day, and luxury-they are spots and blemishes, reveling in their deceits, feasting with you,
target_text: rèngu paj'èra ae le dhèu. pe, ama lamatua pasusa rèngu kahèi, lula tatao rèngu dhu lèke boe sèra. rèngu d'èi dhoka tao pesta liar. ladhe re mèu, rèngu d'èi tao leli kahèi, sèna ka dhèu bisa rèdhi bhabhelu rèngu. rèngu re'a boe makae, ka pa'ele iie kolongara miu. ladhe rèngu ra'a pesta sama-sama dènge miu, rèngu d'èi dhoka neo tao madhutu bhabhelu ra.

source_text: having eyes full of adultery, and unable to cease from sin, enticing unstable souls, having a heart exercised in covetousnesses, children of a curse,
target_text: musi madha ra seru lee, ho patangi-tenge dhèu bhèni dhu neo karihu kaj'alu dènge rèngu. mamuri rèngu dhoka bhelu-katub'a di. rèngu tenge dhèu dhu parcaya èra boe mi lamatua, ka pamako si, sèna ka pa'èci dènge rèngu ho tao bhabhelu. rèngu manga'a, aa re'a boe roca. tatu ama lamatua huku si!

source_text: having forsaken a right way, they went astray, having followed in the way of balaam the son of bosor, who loved a reward of unrighteousness, and had a rebuke of his own iniquity-a mute donkey, having spoken in man's voice, forbid the madness of the prophet.
target_text: mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra, uru èèna, rèngu dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mola, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka ra sero eele j'ara. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu sèra nuka sèmi balaam, ana bosor. nèngu ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua. te ngaa nèngu d'èi dhoka tenge doi-dhari di, nèti èèna ka na tao j'ara dhu lèke boe. ca tèka, balaam manya'e badha keled'ei. keled'ei dhu bisa boe padhai lii. te ngaa lod'o èèna, lamatua hia keled'ei ne padhai lii sama sèmi dhèu! ka keled'ei ne kai balaam, lula bhabhelu na. dad'èi keled'ei ne, sèna ka balaam ae eele ka nèti tatao na dhu koe-kapengo, nuka sèmi dhèu huj'u sa.

source_text: these are wells without water, and clouds driven by a storm, to whom the deepest gloom of darkness has been kept throughout the age;
target_text: mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra, èci èèna ka dènge madha èi dhu guna boe, lula mèti eele. rèngu cakaraa kahèi dènge bhuru dhu guna boe, lula lai ngèlu tiu eele. ama lamatua tao tèke le era dhu maroga aatu-aatu èci, sèna ka taha si.

source_text: for speaking swollen words of vanity, they entice in desires of the flesh-licentiousness, those who had truly escaped from those conducting themselves in error,
target_text: te rèngu padhai lii hèb'a-hua dhu dènge boe sasoa. rèngu dadugu dhèu, sèna ka madhutu tao j'ara dhu lèke-lèke boe. rèngu d'èi pamako dhèu dhu heka lèpa hari asa j'ara mola, sèna ka tao hari j'ara karehe.

source_text: promising liberty to them, themselves being servants of corruption, for by whom anyone has been overcome, he has been brought to servitude to this one also;
target_text: dhèu kapod'e-kabèli se padhadha, peka na, ladhe miu nanene ji'i, na, miu neo tao ngaa èèna ka madhutu dad'èi miu, na, tao laa! te ngaa dhèu dhu peka sèmi sèra sa, sama sèmi ènu dhu bisa boe pakaj'èu iisi ra nèti bhelu-katub'a. te dhèu dhu soro tèke j'ara èci ator nèngu, nèngu j'aj'i le ènu ètu j'ara èèna.

source_text: for if having escaped from the defilements of the world, in the acknowledging of the lord and savior jesus christ, and again being entangled by these things, they have been overcome, the last things have become worse to them than the first,
target_text: ladhe neo pakaj'èu nèti bhabhelu ètu rai-haha dhu pakaj'alu èdhi, na, èdhi hud'i tadhe dènge be'a ku kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhu pakaj'èu nèti nèngu, hèia pa'èki hari dènge bhabhelu sama sèmi uru sèra, èèna nuka sèmi bhabhelu sèra ka dhu ator rèngu. d'ai lod'o limuri, rèngu asa tabha j'èra!

source_text: for it were better to them not to have acknowledged the way of righteousness, than having acknowledged it, to turn back from the holy command delivered to them,
target_text: be'a risi, ladhe dhèu re'a rèdhi mèka j'ara mola. te ladhe dhèu re'a le j'ara mamuri dhu lèke, te ngaa ra pakaj'èu iisi ra, ka tao boe madhutu j'ara dhu be'a dènge dhu mola, dhu ama lamatua paredha le mi èdhi, èèna be'a boe.

source_text: and that of the true proverb has happened to them: a dog turned back on his own vomit, and, a sow having bathed herself-to rolling in mire.
target_text: abhu lii tate'a dhu palèke dènge mese kapod'e-kabèli se, dhu peka na, ladhe busa mèdhu, na'e hari mèdhu na. dhu leo hari peka na, masi ka padiu tare le hahi ci'u, te ngaa la'e hari loli èi lobho.

source_text: this is now, beloved, a second letter i write to you, in both which i stir up your pure mind in reminding you
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ne'e ne, sasuri ka dua kèna nèti ja'a dhu ja'a pa'adhu hia miu. ètu d'ara sasuri dua se, ja'a pasanèd'e le miu ho bisa pangee j'ara-j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: to be mindful of the sayings said before by the holy prophets, and of the command of us the apostles of the lord and savior,
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie lii lolo nèti dhèu mola-mèci dhu rèti lii padhai lamatua uru-uru sèra. sanèd'e kahèi dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus. pangee paie ngaa-ngaa dhu lamatua èdhi paredha mi rèngu ho peka mi miu. te nèngu ka dhu patalale miu nèti koasa sasala mi!

source_text: knowing this first, that there will come scoffers in the last days, going on according to their own desires,
target_text: sanèd'e sèmi ne'e: d'ara lod'o èle rai-haha sèra, abhu le dhèu dhu padhèto d'ara lii, dhu tao leli madhutu dad'èi ra. rèngu padhai lii pa'ele iie aa'i j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: and saying, where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things so remain from the beginning of the creation;
target_text: dhèu se, peka na, baku pusi-pahae! yesus padhadha, na, nèngu neo mai hari, do? ladhe sèmi èèna, nèngu buli mia? te karèi nèti bèi-baki èdhi madhe, toke d'ai doe ne'e ne, ngaa-ngaa èci sa dhu ub'a boe. ngaa aa'i-aa'i sama sèmi uru-uru sèra, karèi nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha.

source_text: for this they willingly conceal, that the heavens existed long ago, and the earth having been established by the word of god out of water and through water, through which the world then, having been flooded by water, was destroyed; and by the same word, the present heavens and earth, having been stored up for fire, are being preserved until the day of judgment and destruction of impious men.
target_text: te ngaa abhu ca j'ara dhu dhèu kapod'e-kabèli se ro'o boe sanèd'e. nuka, karèi nèti uru j'ara ka, ama lamatua dhoka padhai lii di, ka liru j'aj'i dènge. ka na paj'aj'i èi. hèia na hag'e èi nèti rai-dedha, ka rai-dedha cèu nèti d'ara èi. ladhe lamatua padhai lii sèmi mia, na, j'aj'i dènge sèmi èèna ka. nèbhu ae ku, lod'o noh mamuri era, ama lamatua pake èi aae lala ho palaho aa'i mèu-mèu dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa limuri ne, lamatua dhu peka tèke le ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a na tao ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne. limuri ne lamatua tatae era, te ngaa ropa d'ai lod'o èèna, tatu na neo tunu pakèpu aa'i si. te lamatua bèli-camèd'a papuru hahuku, sèna ka palaho dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe nèngu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu kapod'e-kabèli se ro'o boe re'a, na, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua tatu tao madhutu ngaa dhu na peka sèra.

source_text: and do not let this one thing be concealed from you, beloved, that one day with the lord is as one thousand years and one thousand years as one day;
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! baku bhèlu j'ara ne'e. lamatua èdhi ige boe lod'o sama sèmi dhu èdhi ige. te madhutu nèngu, na, ca lod'o bisa sama sèmi ca riho tèu. aa ca riho tèu bisa nuka ca lod'o doko di.

source_text: the lord is not slow in regard to the promise, as some count slowness, but is long-suffering to us, not intending any to be lost, but all to come to conversion,
target_text: ladhe lamatua èdhi pajaji neo tao ngaa èci sa, na tao pamèci dènge lod'o na, aa pamata boe. abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu pangee, na, nèngu sab'a nena di. madhutu iia-iia na, sèmi boe èèna! te na taha d'ara, ho tatae d'ai ku lod'o na. dad'èi lamatua èdhi, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i ele-ho'a ku, sèna ka tèke eele sasala-sasigo ra, hèia lèpa madhutu nèngu. te d'ara na la'e boe, ladhe dhèu pacèri nèti nèngu.

source_text: and it will come-the day of the lord-as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a rushing noise, and the elements will be dissolved with burning heat, and the earth and the works in it will not be found.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, lèpa hari mai, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re'a mema. te mamai na dènge sahèka, nuka sèmi dhèu mana'u maso asa d'ara èmu. lod'o èèna, aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu dedha-liru kèpu aa'i mèu-mèu, nuka madha lod'o, liru dènge hua-hètu. aa'i-aa'i ra ele! sèmi èèna kahèi, rai-haha ne dènge isi na aa'i-aa'i. kèpu eele!

source_text: all these, then, being dissolved, what kind of persons ought you to be in holy behaviors and pious acts,
target_text: de ladhe aa'i-aa'i kèpu ladhu ai sèmi èèna, na, mamuri miu hud'i sèmi ngaa sa? miu hud'i pa'èra-èra mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. miu hud'i mamuri mola-mèci!

source_text: waiting for and hurrying the coming of the day of god, by which the heavens, being on fire, will be dissolved, and the elements will melt with burning heat?
target_text: miu hud'i tatae mamai lamatua kahèi. de miu hud'i pa'èra taruu, sèna ka lod'o èèna j'aj'i malai risi hari. lod'o èèna, liru kèpu ladhu ai kahèi. aa ngaa aa'i-aa'i ètu dedha-liru kèpu toke roe eele aa'i si.

source_text: and we wait for new heavens and a new earth according to his promise, in which righteousness dwells;
target_text: te ngaa èèna na, abhu liru rupa hiu dènge rai-haha rupa hiu. ama lamatua dhu moa tèke le sèmi èèna ka. j'ara se'e se ka dhu èdhi mate tae-tae. ètu era nèi abhu dhoka dhèu dhu mamuri mola di.

source_text: for this reason, beloved, waiting for these things, be diligent, spotless and unblameable, to be found by him in peace,
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lod'o miu tatae j'ara se'e se era, miu hud'i bori pa'èra dhari ho j'aj'i dhèu be'a madhutu a'abhu ama lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pèci sasala asa miu. pa'èra sèna ka mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: and count the long-suffering of our lord as salvation, according as also our beloved brother paul-according to the wisdom given to him-wrote to you,
target_text: te lamatua èdhi taha d'ara, ho nèngu patalale miu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo miu. a'ari èdhi paulus suri nèdhi le hia miu madha j'ara ae-ae dhu sama hua, si? lamatua ka dhu hia ne mamèu sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka nèngu suri madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: as also in all the letters, speaking in them concerning these things, among which are some things that are hard to be understood, which the untaught and unstable twist, as also the other writings, to their own destruction.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o dhu paulus suri sasuri, na peka kahèi j'ara se'e se. nèti sasuri na, abhu kahèi dhu èdhi te'a tare mèka sasoa na. abhu kahèi dhèu dhu pakapod'e asa j'ara leo nèti naneo paulus. dhèu se'e kahèi pakapod'e j'ara-j'ara dhu leo nèti isi sasuri mola-mèci lamatua. dhèu sèra, nuka dhèu bai-eed'a dhu ro'o boe pakanucu lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke, aa rèngu dhèu dhu parcaya èra boe. dhèu sèmi se'e se, bèli-camèd'a laho unu ra.

source_text: you, then, beloved, knowing before, take heed, lest, together with the error of the impious being led away, you may fall from your own steadfastness,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! miu me'a le j'ara mamuri nèti mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra. de baku pamud'e! te rèngu d'èi boe nanene atora èci sa. rèngu neo cob'a ho kapod'e miu nèti j'ara dhu mola. te ngaa baku soro tèke si segi miu. miu hud'i pakadhii ku lalèka miu.

source_text: and increase in grace, and in the knowledge of our lord and savior jesus christ; to him is the glory both now, and to the day of the age! amen.
target_text: be'a risi parcaya miu asa tabha èra. te miu me'a le kètu èdhi, yesus kristus ka dhu patalale èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. nèngu neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu. aa nèngu neo miu tadhe ne be'a risi hari kahèi. ja'a d'èi ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i ded'e padedha-dedha yesus kristus nèti doe ne'e toke d'ai mia-mia la'e! saloom, petrus

source_text: that which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we beheld, and our hands handled, concerning the word of life-
target_text: ja'a suri sasuri ne, lula-nèti lii holo-nori dhu hia mamuri. lii holo-nori dhu hia mamuri ne, abhu mema le karèi nèti rai-haha j'aj'i. ne'e ne, ja'a dènge angalai ja'a ladhe ngèdhi le nèngu dènge musi madha ji'i. ji'i tadèngi le lii na dènge ro'a dhilu ji'i. aa ji'i g'ag'e ngèdhi le nèngu dènge kacui-aai ji'i unu mi. ji'i ladhe ngèdhi ne sèmi èèna ka,

source_text: and the life appeared, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the continuous life, which was with the father, and was revealed to us-
target_text: lula na cèu mai ètu talora aae ji'i. uru èèna, nèngu pea dènge ama na, te ngaa limuri ne na pad'elo le ngi'u aae nèngu mi ji'i. nèti èèna ka, ji'i bani lole dènge miu tasa mera mia dhèu rai-haha bisa abhu mamuri mola dhu dènge boe too-lane. te nèngu ne lii holo-nori dhu hia mamuri.

source_text: we declare to you that which we have seen and heard, that you also may have fellowship with us, and our fellowship is with the father, and with his son jesus christ;
target_text: ji'i neo peka dènge miu, aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i ngèdhi le aa aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i tadèngi le, sèna ka miu dènge ji'i sama-sama bisa mamuri d'ara èci. te èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu pa'èki le dènge ama lamatua, aa dènge ana na dhu nèngu pua mai, nuka yesus kristus.

source_text: and these things we write to you, that your joy may be full.
target_text: de ji'i suri sasuri ne, sèna ka pamaho'o d'ara miu. dènge j'ara ne'e, d'ara ji'i asa tabha karej'e kahèi.

source_text: and this is the message that we have heard from him, and announce to you, that god is light, and darkness is not in him at all;
target_text: a'aj'a dhu yesus lole dènge ji'i, èèna ka dhu limuri ne ji'i neo peka dènge miu. sèmi ne'e: ama lamatua be'a seli eele. bhabhelu-katub'a ciki sa abhu boe ètu nèngu. te nèngu ne nuka sèmi saraa dhu heo lo'a-lo'a, dhu pab'ali boe dènge maroga ciki sa.

source_text: if we may say, we have fellowship with him, and may walk in the darkness-we lie, and do not speak the truth;
target_text: ladhe èdhi padhai lii, peka na, èdhi mamuri d'ara èci dènge lamatua, aa te ngaa èdhi mamuri tao bhelu era, na, èèna sama sèmi èdhi mamuri ètu d'ara maroga. te èdhi padhai lii kapod'e-kabèli aa mamuri madhutu boe j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: and if we may walk in the light, as he is in the light-we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of his son jesus christ cleanses us from every sin;
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi mamuri madhutu j'ara mola, èdhi èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti bisa mamuri d'ara èci. aa d'ara èdhi mola-mèci, lula mamadhe yesus kristus, ana ama lamatua, aa raa nèngu rase pamèu-mèu sasala èdhi.

source_text: if we may say, we have no sin, we lead ourselves astray, and the truth is not in us;
target_text: ladhe èdhi padhai lii, peka na, èdhi tao boe sala, èèna j'aj'i tadha, peka na, èdhi tipu ngi'u èdhi unu ti, aa te'a boe mia ka dhu lèke.

source_text: if we may confess our sins, he is steadfast and righteous that he may forgive us the sins, and may cleanse us from every unrighteousness;
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi mangaku sasala èdhi, tatu ama lamatua dhu d'ara mola, saku eele sasala èdhi madhutu lii pajaji na, aa na pamèu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: if we may say, we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
target_text: ladhe èdhi peka, na, èdhi tao tèdhi boe sasala, sasoa na, èdhi tao ama lamatua dhèu leko-monya! te nèngu ka dhu peka tèke, na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu manahu asa d'ara sasala-sasigo. aa ladhe lii padhai èdhi sèmi èèna, tadha na, lii holo-nori nèngu abhu boe ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: my little children, these things i write to you that you may not sin: and if anyone may sin, we have an advocate with the father, jesus christ, the righteous one,
target_text: ana pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a suri se'e aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka miu mamuri dènge tao ia ka sasala. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao sala, èèna na abhu kahèi dhu sarii èdhi ètu madha ama lamatua. dhu sarii èdhi èèna, nuka yesus kristus, dhèu mola-mèci dhu ama lamatua pua mai le asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: and he is the propitiation for our sins, and not only for ours, but also for the whole world,
target_text: nèngu madhe j'aj'i korban pala èdhi, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo èdhi. madha j'ara ne hia boe mi èdhi mesa ti di, te ngaa hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne kahèi.

source_text: and in this we know that we have known him, if we may keep his commands;
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, èdhi tadhe mèu ama lamatua ladhe èdhi madhutu paredha nèngu.

source_text: he who is saying, i have known him, and is not keeping his commands, is a liar, and the truth is not in him;
target_text: dhèu bisa peka, na, ja'a tadhe ama lamatua. te ngaa ladhe nèngu madhutu boe paredha lamatua, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, na, nèngu dhèu kapod'e-kabèli dhu padhai lii leo tao leo.

source_text: and whoever may keep his word, truly the love of god has been perfected in him; in this we know that we are in him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu tao madhutu paredha lamatua, èèna j'aj'i tadha, peka na, sasue nèngu mi lamatua èèna, dhu lèke tare'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi te'a, na, èdhi dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: he who is saying he remains in him, himself ought to also walk according as he walked.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu padhai lii, peka na, ja'a mamuri pa'èki dènge ama lamatua, sasoa na, nèngu hud'i mamuri ku sama sèmi yesus kristus.

source_text: beloved, i do not write a new command to you, but an old command, that you had from the beginning-the old command is the word that you heard from the beginning;
target_text: ana pasue aa'i-aa'i! lii paredha dhu ja'a suri hia miu ne, j'ara hiu boe. te paredha ne dhu suri le ètu d'ara lii holo-nori lamatua dhu miu tadèngi le karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: again, a new command i write to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away, and the true light now shines;
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu j'ara hiu dhu ja'a neo suri lula-nèti paredha lamatua. lii paredha ne, j'aj'i le dènge be'a ètu d'ara mamuri yesus. aa paredha ne mulai sab'a le ètu d'ara miu, lula maroga ètu d'ara miu mulai ele, aa saraa dhu tare'a èèna, pasaraa le ètu d'ara mamuri miu.

source_text: he who is saying he is in the light, and is hating his brother, he is in the darkness until now;
target_text: dhèu bisa padhai lii, peka na, ja'a mamuri ètu d'ara saraa. te ngaa ladhe nèngu tèka d'ara dènge a'ari na, sasoa na, nèngu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga era.

source_text: he who is loving his brother, he remains in the light, and there is not a stumbling-block in him;
target_text: lula dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa, nèngu hud'i pasue ku dènge a'ari na, aa abhu boe bhabhelu-katub'a ètu d'ara na dhu pamanahu nèngu.

source_text: but he who is hating his brother, he is in the darkness, and he walks in the darkness, and he has not known where he goes, because the darkness blinded his eyes.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tèka d'ara dènge a'ari na, èèna j'aj'i tadha, na, nèngu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga. nèngu gogo ai lae-lae, lula maroga pabèdhu le musi madha na.

source_text: i write to you, little children, because sins have been forgiven you through his name;
target_text: ana-ana! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula kristus madhe le gati miu, hèia ama lamatua saku eele le sasala miu.

source_text: i write to you, fathers, because you have known him who is from the beginning; i write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one; i write to you, little youths, because you have known the father;
target_text: dhèu-dhèu heka! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula miu tadhe yesus kristus, dhu abhu mema le karèi nèti uru ka. ana-ana ngèru! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula miu lab'a le bhabhelu-katub'a, toke segi.

source_text: i wrote to you, fathers, because you have known him who is from the beginning; i wrote to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of god remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
target_text: ana-ana! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula miu tadhe ama lamatua. dhèu-dhèu heka! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula miu tadhe yesus kristus, dhu abhu mema le karèi nèti uru ka. ana-ana ngèru! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula miu tèka le lii holo-nori ètu d'ara miu, toke miu j'aj'i èra, aa miu lab'a le bhabhelu-katub'a, toke miu segi.

source_text: do not love the world, nor the things in the world; if anyone loves the world, the love of the father is not in him,
target_text: miu baku sue dad'èi rai-haha, dènge mèdha-panyau na. te dhèu dhu sue rai-haha, bisa boe sue ama lamatua.

source_text: because all that is in the world-the desire of the flesh, and the desire of the eyes, and the ostentation of one's life-is not of the father, but of the world,
target_text: madha j'ara dhu abhu ètu rai-haha ne, pa'èki boe dènge ama lamatua. nuka sèmi, dhèu dhu mamuri pakarej'e dhoka ngi'u na; dhèu manga'a; aa dhèu dhu d'èi padedha iisi lula kakaja-sasu'i na. j'ara sèmi se'e se mai boe nèti ama lamatua, te ngaa mai dhoka nèti rai-haha di.

source_text: and the world is passing away, and the desire of it, but he who is doing the will of god, he remains-throughout the age.
target_text: aa te ngaa rai-haha ne bèli-camèd'a ele, palere-lere dènge ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu neo unu. te ngaa dhèu dhu d'èi madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, dhèu ne ele boe, te nèngu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: little youths, it is the last hour; and even as you heard that the antichrist comes, even now antichrists have become many-whereby we know that it is the last hour;
target_text: ana-ana! lod'o-lod'o èle rai-haha ne oe d'ai kèna. miu tadèngi le, peka na, dhèu dhu lab'a kristus, bèli-camèd'a cèu mai. madhutu iia-iia na, rèngu mai le. te ètu mia-mia, abhu le dhu lab'a kristus. se'e se j'aj'i mi tadha, na, lod'o-lod'o èle rai-haha ne dètu ae le.

source_text: they went forth out of us, but they were not of us, for if they had been of us, they would have remained with us; but they went out so that they might be revealed that they are not all of us.
target_text: dhèu palab'a sèra cèu nèti talora aae èdhi. te ngaa rèngu se dhèu èdhi boe. te, ladhe rèngu tare'a-re'a dhèu èdhi, tatu ra tèke eele boe èdhi, te ngaa ra taha taruu dènge èdhi. aa te ngaa rèngu rai aa'i le nèti èdhi. de lèke tare'a, rèngu se dhèu èdhi boe, si?

source_text: and you have an anointing from the holy one, and have known all things;
target_text: te ngaa miu sama boe sèmi rèngu. te miu dhu sèmi mere le roh nèti dhèu mola-mèci ama lamatua. aa nèngu soru-bara le miu, sèna ka me'a mèu ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: i did not write to you because you have not known the truth, but because you have known it, and because no lie is of the truth.
target_text: miu pangee, na, ja'a suri sasuri ne'e, lula ja'a pangee, na, miu me'a boe ngaa dhu lèke, do? aad'o! te miu me'a mèu le mia ka dhu lèke, aa mia ka dhu leko-monya.

source_text: who is the liar, except he who is denying that jesus is the christ? this one is the antichrist who is denying the father and the son;
target_text: madhutu mola-mola na, abhu le ètu rai-haha ne dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. tasamia sèna ka èdhi tadhe si? rèngu sèra, nuka dhèu dhu padhai lii, peka na, yesus èèna kristus boe. madhutu a'abhu rèngu, yesus èèna, dhèu mola-mèci boe, dhu lamatua pajaji tèke hia mai. dhèu dhu padhai lii sèmi sèra palab'a dènge kristus, te rèngu tule eele ama lamatua dènge ana na.

source_text: everyone who is denying the son, neither has the father; he who is confessing the son has the father also.
target_text: dhèu dhu tule eele ana ama lamatua, rèngu tule eele ama na kahèi. te ngaa ladhe dhèu mangaku ana ama lamatua, sasoa na, dhèu sèra j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua.

source_text: you, then, that which you heard from the beginning, let it remain in you; if that which you heard from the beginning may remain in you, you also will remain in the son and in the father,
target_text: de miu hud'i kèpe ku pa'èra-èra ngaa dhu miu tadèngi mere le karèi nèti uru sèra. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pa'èki taruu dènge ama lamatua, aa dènge ana na kahèi.

source_text: and this is the promise that he promised us-the continuous life.
target_text: aa nèngu unu na ka dhu padhadha le dènge èdhi, peka na, pe èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge ne.

source_text: these things i wrote to you concerning those leading you astray;
target_text: ja'a suri sasuri ne, sèna ka miu tadhe dhèu dhu neo leko-monya miu.

source_text: and you, the anointing that you received from him, it remains in you, and you have no need that anyone may teach you, but as the same anointing teaches you concerning all, and is true, and is not a lie, and even as was taught you, you will remain in him.
target_text: miu sèmi mere le roh mola-mèci lamatua, aa miu mamuri pa'èki le dènge nèngu kahèi. de miu parluu heka dhèu leo aj'a-nori hari miu. te roh lamatua nia le, lula nèngu ka dhu bisa aj'a aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke. roh ne kapod'e-kabèli boe, sèmi dhèu leko-monya sèra. de kèpe pa'èra-èra mi ngaa dhu nèngu nori le, ho miu mamuri d'ara èci taruu dènge kristus.

source_text: and now, little children, remain in him, so that when he may have appeared, we may have boldness, and may not be ashamed before him, at his coming;
target_text: de sèmi ne'e ana-ana! miu hud'i mamuri pa'èki taruu dènge kristus. sèna ka ropa na mai hari, miu madha'u boe, aa dènge boe d'ara makae lami titu ètu madha na.

source_text: if you know that he is righteous, know that everyone doing righteousness, has been begotten of him.
target_text: lula miu dhu me'a le, na, nèngu tao dhoka ngaa dhu lèke, nèti èèna ka bisa me'a kahèi, peka na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ladhe tao ngaa dhu lèke, rèngu j'aj'i ana-ana lamatua.

source_text: see what love the father has given to us, that we may be called children of god; because of this the world does not know us, because it did not know him.
target_text: miu pajiko sèku sasue ama ètu sorga mi dedha èdhi! te sasue na kapai titu kèna, toke na ded'e nare èdhi j'aj'i ana-ana nèngu. lèke si! te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi rai-haha, re'a boe, na, èdhi se cee, lula rèngu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: beloved, now, we are children of god, and it was not yet revealed what we will be. we have known that if he may have appeared, we will be like him, because we will see him as he is;
target_text: ana-ana pasue! èdhi j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua, te ngaa te'a tare mèka, bèli-camèd'a èdhi j'aj'i sèmi ngaa sa. dhu te'a, sèmi ne'e ka: bèli-camèd'a ropa kristus mai hari, èdhi j'aj'i sama sèmi nèngu kahèi, lula èdhi ladhe tèdhi nèngu iia-iia.

source_text: and everyone who is having this hope on him, purifies himself, even as he is pure.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tatae mamai kristus, tatu ra pamèu mamuri rèngu, sèna ka mamuri ra mola-mèci sama sèmi kristus.

source_text: everyone who is doing sin, he also does lawlessness, and sin is lawlessness,
target_text: sasala aa'i-aa'i ra ka dhu sisu paredha lamatua. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao sala, sisu paredha ama lamatua aa palab'a dènge ne.

source_text: and you have known that he appeared that he may take away our sins, and sin is not in him;
target_text: miu me'a le, peka na, kristus j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha sèna ka saku eele sasala-sasigo èdhi. nèngu bisa tao j'ara èèna, lula nèngu mesa na tao nèdhi boe sasala.

source_text: everyone who is remaining in him does not sin; everyone who is sinning, has not seen him, nor known him.
target_text: de dhèu dhu mamuri pa'èki taruu dènge ne, mamuri heka dènge tao sala. te ngaa ladhe dhèu loe boe ad'u-ue sasala, sasoa na, nèngu tadhe boe aa pa'èki boe dènge kristus.

source_text: little children, let no one lead you astray; he who is doing righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous,
target_text: ana-ana pasue! baku lèke tipu. te dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu ngaa dhu lèke, nèngu dhèu d'ara mola èci èèna ka dènge kristus.

source_text: he who is doing sin, he is of the devil, because the devil sins from the beginning; for this reason the son of god appeared, that he may undo the works of the devil;
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri ad'u-ue sasala, j'aj'aj'i ra nèti dhèu aae nidhu. te dhèu aae nidhu ne, baki nèti bhabhelu-katub'a karèi nèti uru j'ara ka. nèti èèna ka, ana ama lamatua mai ho dhedhe palaho bhabhelu nèti dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: everyone who has been begotten of god, he does not sin, because his seed remains in him, and he is not able to sin, because he has been begotten of god.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i le ana lamatua mamuri heka tao sala, lula lamatua dhu pea le ètu d'ara nèngu. nèngu bisa heka ad'u-ue sasala taruu, lula j'aj'aj'i na nèti lamatua.

source_text: in this are revealed the children of god, and the children of the devil; everyone who is not doing righteousness, is not of god, and he who is not loving his brother,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi bisa tadhe mèu, cee ka dhu j'aj'i nèti lamatua, aa cee ka dhu mai nèti dhèu aae nidhu. te dhèu dhu madhutu boe j'ara dhu lèke, aa dhu sue boe a'ari na, sasoa na, j'aj'aj'i na nèti boe ama lamatua.

source_text: because this is the message that you heard from the beginning, that we may love one another,
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, miu tadèngi le lii moa dhu peka na, pasue èci dènge èci!

source_text: not as cain-he was of the evil one, and he slew his brother. and for what reason did he slay him? because his works were evil, and those of his brother were righteous.
target_text: miu sanèd'e era lii lolo kaen dènge habel, si? baku tao madhutu kaen, te nèngu ne dhèu bhelu-katub'a, ka nèngu pamadhe ari na, habel. nga tao ka nèngu tao sèmi èèna? lula kaen tao j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu, te ngaa ari na tao j'ara-j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: do not wonder, my brothers, if the world hates you;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku malaa ladhe dhèu dhu madhutu dad'èi rai-haha d'èi boe miu.

source_text: we have known that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers; he who is not loving his brother remains in death.
target_text: èdhi te'a le dhu peka na, dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara sasala, ladhe madhe, nèngu cèri eele nèti ama lamatua. te ngaa, lula èdhi pasue dènge a'ari èdhi, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ropa èdhi madhe, èdhi mamuri taruu dènge lamatua. te, ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri dènge boe sasue, bèli-camèd'a madhe, na, rèngu pakaj'èu nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: everyone who is hating his brother is a manslayer, and you have known that no manslayer has continuous life remaining in him;
target_text: te dhèu dhu sue boe a'ari na, nèngu cakaraa dènge dhèu dhu pamadhe dhèu. de me'a le, na, dhèu dhu sèmi sèra sa, abhu boe mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: in this we have known love, because he laid down his life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers;
target_text: èdhi bisa te'a conto sasue dhu lèke nèti kristus. te nèngu sue èdhi, ka soro ngi'u na, sèna ka madhe gati èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i soro ngi'u èdhi kahèi bagi a'ari èdhi.

source_text: and whoever may have the goods of the world, and may view his brother having need, and may shut up his yearnings from him-how does the love of god remain in him?
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu unu d'ai, nèdhi a'ari na ca dhèu dhu mamuri susa, te ngaa na tao boe madha-dhilu mi dhèu susa ne, na, tasamia ka nèngu peka na, ja'a sue ama lamatua! lèke boe!

source_text: my little children, may we not love in word nor in tongue, but in work and in truth!
target_text: ana-ana pasue! baku dhoka sue ètu hèb'a di, te ngaa tao j'ara dhu be'a, ho pad'elo sasue dhu lèke.

source_text: and in this we know that we are of the truth, and before him we will assure our hearts,
target_text: te, ladhe èdhi pad'elo sasue dènge ad'u-ue j'ara dhu be'a sèmi èèna, èdhi te'a, na, èdhi abhu mamuri dhu lèke. dènge sèmi èèna, èdhi madha'u heka, aa èdhi bisa doa kètu ropa èdhi ara lati asa madha ama lamatua.

source_text: because if our heart may condemn-because greater is god than our heart, and he knows all things.
target_text: masi ka d'ara iiki èdhi galaa èdhi lula-nèti j'ara dhu lèke boe dhu èdhi ad'u-ue uru èèna, èdhi madha'u ia ka. te rasa kasia ama lamatua kapai risi nèti rasa kasia èdhi. aa nèngu dhu ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu kahèi.

source_text: beloved, if our heart may not condemn us, we have boldness toward god,
target_text: ana-ana pasue! ladhe d'ara iiki èdhi galaa boe èdhi, na, èdhi bisa bani aa makae boe, ropa èdhi ara lati asa madha ama lamatua.

source_text: and whatever we may ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commands, and we do the things pleasing before him,
target_text: lula èdhi tao madhutu paredha lamatua, aa pakarej'e d'ara na, nèti èèna ka èdhi bisa abhu ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi manèngi nèti nèngu.

source_text: and this is his command, that we may believe in the name of his son jesus christ, and may love one another, even as he gave command to us,
target_text: lii paredha na sèmi ne'e ka: parcaya taruu ana na yesus kristus, dhu nèngu pua mai. aa baku loe pasue èci dènge èci, sama sèmi lii paredha yesus.

source_text: and he who is keeping his commands, remains in him, and he in him; and in this we know that he remains in us, from the spirit that he gave us.
target_text: dhèu dhu tao madhutu lii paredha ama lamatua sèra, mamuri na pa'èki dènge ne, aa ama lamatua pa'èki dènge ne kahèi. èdhi te'a, na, ama lamatua ètu d'ara èdhi, lula roh na mamuri ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: beloved, do not believe every spirit, but prove the spirits, if they are of god, because many false prophets have gone forth into the world.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! baku lèka leli lii padhai ladhe dhèu mai, peka na, nèngu nèti lii moa ama lamatua. te ngaa miu hud'i dadoo ne paie-iie, ho me'a mèu lii padhai na tare'a-re'a nèti lamatua, do aad'o. te limuri ne, ae le dhèu kapod'e-kabèli dhu kako pale-lème rai-haha ne. dhèu se tipu dhèu, peka na, rèngu sèra dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: in this you know the spirit of god: every spirit that confesses jesus christ having come in the flesh, it is of god,
target_text: èdhi bisa te'a mèu lii moa dhu tare'a-re'a mai nèti roh lamatua, dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e: ama lamatua padhadha tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, sèna ka neo hia ana na mai asa rai-haha ne. ladhe dhèu dhu nèti lii moa èèna mangaku, peka na, yesus kristus èèna tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, dhu j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi èdhi, na, lii moa èèna mema nèti lamatua.

source_text: and every spirit that does not confess jesus christ having come in the flesh, it is not of god; and this is that of the antichrist, which you heard that it comes, and now it is already in the world.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mangaku boe yesus sèmi èèna, nèngu mai boe nèti ama lamatua. te èèna mai nèti dhu lab'a kristus. miu tadèngi le dhu peka na, dhu lab'a kristus èèna, bèli-camèd'a cèu mai. madhutu mola-mola na, dhu sèmi èèna abhu le ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: you are of god, little children, and you have overcome them; because greater is he who is in you, than he who is in the world.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! miu se, mema mai nèti ama lamatua, aa koasa na ètu d'ara miu. nèti èèna ka, miu segi le dhèu dhu lab'a lamatua. te roh na dhu pea ètu d'ara miu, èra risi nèti koasa dhu ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: they are of the world, because they speak of this from the world, and the world hears them;
target_text: dhèu dhu lab'a lamatua sèra, j'aj'aj'i ra nèti rai-haha. nèti èèna ka, lii padhai lii ra pa'èki mèno madhutu dad'èi rai-haha. hèia dhèu rai-haha ne d'èi nanene si.

source_text: we are of god; he who is knowing god hears us; he who is not of god, does not hear us; from this we know the spirit of truth and the spirit of error.
target_text: te ngaa j'aj'aj'i èdhi nèti ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, dhèu dhu tadhe lamatua d'èi nanene lii padhai èdhi. te ngaa dhèu dhu mai boe nèti lamatua, ro'o boe nanene lii padhai èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe dhèu peka na, nèngu nèti lii moa lamatua, bisa te'a mia ka dhu lèke dhu mai nèti roh lamatua, aa mia ka dhu kapod'e-kabèli.

source_text: beloved, may we love one another, because love is of god, and everyone loving has been begotten of god, and knows god;
target_text: ana-ana pasue! èdhi hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, lula kapua sasue nèti ama lamatua. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri pasue mai nèti ama lamatua kahèi, aa ra tadhe mèu ne.

source_text: he who is not loving did not know god, because god is love.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu dènge boe sasue tadhe boe lamatua. lula lamatua èèna, nuka sasue.

source_text: in this was revealed the love of god in us, because god has sent his only begotten son into the world, that we may live through him;
target_text: lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi èdhi sèmi ne'e: na pua ana na dhu dhodhoka ca dhèu èèna ka, mai asa rai-haha ne sèna ka bhoke j'ara hia èdhi. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, èdhi bisa mamuri taruu dènge lamatua.

source_text: in this is love, not that we loved god, but that he loved us, and sent his son as the propitiation for our sins.
target_text: ladhe neo me'a sasue dhu lèke tare'a, baku pasoro sasue èdhi dènge sasue lamatua. te ngaa ladhe sasue lamatua mi dedha èdhi, lula ama lamatua pua ana na mai, ho j'aj'i korban sèna ka gati èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo èdhi, sèna ka èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge nèngu.

source_text: beloved, if god so loved us, we also ought to love one another;
target_text: ana-ana pasue! lula ama lamatua sue èdhi seli eele, na, èdhi hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci kahèi.

source_text: no one has ever seen god; if we may love one another, god remains in us, and his love is having been perfected in us;
target_text: abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu ladhe nèdhi mèu ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ladhe èdhi pasue èci dènge èci, sasoa na, ama lamatua bera-bera dènge èdhi. aa sasue na asa tabha ètu d'ara mamuri èdhi, toke j'aj'i sasue dhu kateme.

source_text: in this we know that we remain in him, and he in us, because of his spirit he has given us.
target_text: ama lamatua pangèd'u le roh na ètu d'ara èdhi. nèti èèna ka, te'a, na, èdhi mamuri d'ara èci dènge ne, aa nèngu mamuri d'ara èci dènge èdhi kahèi.

source_text: and we have seen and testify that the father has sent the son as savior of the world;
target_text: ja'a dènge angalai ja'a ngèdhi le ana ama lamatua dènge musi madha ji'i. ka ji'i peka palème dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, na, ama lamatua hia le ana na mai, sèna ka patabuli dhèu ètu rai-haha ne nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: whoever may confess that jesus is the son of god, god remains in him, and he in god;
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mangaku, peka na, yesus, ana ama lamatua, nèngu mamuri pabe'a dènge ama lamatua, aa ama lamatua pabe'a dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and we have known and believed the love that god has in us; god is love, and he who is remaining in love, remains in god, and god in him.
target_text: èdhi te'a kahèi, peka na, lamatua sue èdhi titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, èdhi parcaya, nèngu sue èdhi taruu. lamatua sue dhèu rai-haha ne titu kèna. de dhèu dhu mamuri pasue, nèngu mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua, aa lamatua mamuri d'ara èci dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: in this, love has been perfected with us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because even as he is, we also are in this world.
target_text: aa ladhe èdhi d'ara èci dènge lamatua, sasue èdhi j'aj'i kateme. hèia, ropa d'ai lod'o èle ka rai-haha ne, lamatua parisa mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i, na, èdhi madha'u boe ara lati asa madha na, lula èdhi dhu j'aj'i le sèmi kristus, lod'o dhu na mamuri ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: there is no fear in love, but perfect love casts out fear, because fear involves punishment, and he who is fearing has not been made perfect in love;
target_text: ladhe èdhi mamuri pasue, na, èdhi dènge heka d'ara madha'u ciki sa. te ladhe èdhi pasue dènge mola, èèna nuka sèmi èdhi pakaj'èu eele aa'i le madha'u nèti d'ara èdhi. ladhe dhèu madha'u, d'ara na susa, lula nèngu madha'u lèke huku. dhèu ne, nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu ne'a mèka sue dhèu dènge mola.

source_text: we love him, because he first loved us;
target_text: èdhi pasue, lula ama lamatua dhu sue uuru le èdhi.

source_text: if anyone may say, i love god, and may hate his brother, he is a liar; for he who is not loving his brother whom he has seen, how is he able to love god whom he has not seen?
target_text: ladhe dhèu padhai lii, peka na, ja'a sue ama lamatua, te ngaa nèngu tèka d'ara dènge a'ari na, nèngu monya di. te ladhe dhèu sue boe a'ari na dhu ètu katanga madha nèngu, tasamia hari nèngu sue ama lamatua dhu nèdhi mèka? bisa boe, sina ma?

source_text: and this is the command we have from him, that he who is loving god, may also love his brother.
target_text: te ama lamatua unu na ka dhu papuru paredha, peka na, èdhi baku sue dhodhoka nèngu di, te ngaa sue ku a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: everyone who is believing that jesus is the christ has been begotten of god, and everyone who is loving him who begot, also loves him who is begotten of him.
target_text: dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i dhu peka na, yesus, tare'a-re'a kristus dhu ama lamatua pua mai, dhèu sèra j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua. te dhèu dhu sue ca dhèu ama, tatu sue ana na kahèi.

source_text: in this we know that we love the children of god, when we may love god and may keep his commands;
target_text: ladhe èdhi sue lamatua, aa sab'a madhutu paredha na, èèna peka na, èdhi sue ana-ana lamatua kahèi.

source_text: for this is the love of god, that we may keep his commands, and his commands are not burdensome;
target_text: de ladhe èdhi sue nèngu, èdhi hud'i tao madhutu ku paredha na sèra. aa paredha na bia boe.

source_text: because everyone who is begotten of god overcomes the world, and this is the victory that overcame the world-our faith.
target_text: èdhi dhu j'aj'i le ana-ana lamatua, bisa segi dad'èi rai-haha ne, lula èdhi parcaya ne.

source_text: who is he who is overcoming the world, if not he who is believing that jesus is the son of god?
target_text: te dhèu dhu segi dad'èi rai-haha, nuka dhèu dhu parcaya, peka na, yesus, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: this one is he who came through water and blood-jesus the christ, not in water only, but in the water and the blood; and the spirit is the one testifying, because the spirit is the truth,
target_text: sad'i miu me'a, na, yesus, dhèu rai-haha kahèi, aa nèngu ne, kristus kahèi dhu ama lamatua hia mai asa rai-haha ne. lod'o nèngu neo pakako sasab'a-la'a na, yohanis sarani ne pake èi. èle èèna ka, nèngu madhe aa pasuti raa na kahèi. de dhu lèke ka, mesa boe èi di dhu yohanis pake sarani nèngu, te ngaa raa na dhu suti eele èèna dhu kab'ua risi. te roh ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka sèmi èèna, aa dhu ne'a boe leko-monya.

source_text: because there are three who are testifying in heaven: the father, the word, and the holy spirit, and these three are one;
target_text: te abhu tèlu j'ara dhu j'aj'i sakasii:

source_text: and there are three who are testifying in the earth: the spirit, and the water, and the blood, and the three are into the one.
target_text: nuka roh lamatua, èi dhu yohanis pake sarani yesus, aa raa yesus unu na. tèlu j'ara se'e ka, pad'elo ca j'ara dhu sama lula-nèti yesus.

source_text: if we receive the testimony of men, the testimony of god is greater, because this is the testimony of god that he has testified concerning his son.
target_text: ladhe dhèu rai-haha ka j'aj'i sakasii, na, èdhi bisa parcaya ne. risi-risi hari ladhe ama lamatua unu na ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii lula-nèti ana nèngu unu na. aa te ngaa tèlu j'ara se'e dhu ama lamatua pake, ho j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, yesus mesa boe dhèu rai-haha biasa di, te ngaa nèngu ne kristus kahèi.

source_text: he who is believing in the son of god has the testimony in himself; he who is not believing god has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that god has testified concerning his son;
target_text: dhèu dhu parcaya ana ama lamatua, sasoa na, dhèu ne sèmi nare le lii holo-nori lamatua, lula-nèti ana na. te ngaa dhèu dhu lèka boe lamatua, nèngu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii, peka na, ama lamatua leko-monya! dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu sèmi boe lii holo-nori lamatua lula-nèti ana na.

source_text: and this is the testimony, that god gave continuous life to us, and this life is in his son;
target_text: isi nèti lii holo-nori lamatua nuka sèmi ne'e: lamatua hia le èdhi mamuri dhu lèke, toke d'ai mia-mia. aa èdhi abhu mamuri ne, lula èdhi parcaya ana na.

source_text: he who is having the son has life; he who is not having the son of god does not have life.
target_text: de dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge ana ama lamatua abhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu pa'èki boe dènge ana ama lamatua, abhu boe mamuri sèmi èèna.

source_text: i wrote these things to you who are believing in the name of the son of god, that you may know that you have continuous life, and that you may believe in the name of the son of god.
target_text: ja'a suri madha j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i hia miu dhèu parcaya ana ama lamatua, sèna ka me'a mèu, na, miu unu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and this is the boldness that we have toward him, that if we may ask anything according to his will, he hears us,
target_text: ladhe èdhi sabaj'a mi ama lamatua, sad'i èdhi manèngi ngaa èèna ka madhutu dad'èi na, èdhi bisa te'a tare'a-re'a, na, nèngu tadèngi lii manèngi èdhi sèra.

source_text: and if we have known that he hears us, whatever we may ask, we have known that we have the requests that we have requested from him.
target_text: aa ladhe èdhi parcaya tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna, èdhi te'a kahèi, na, èdhi abhu ngaa-ngaa dhu èdhi manèngi nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: if anyone may see his brother sinning a sin that is not to death, he will ask, and he will give life to him-to those not sinning to death; there is sin to death-i do not say that he may ask concerning it;
target_text: ladhe èu mèdhi a'ari mu tao sala dhu nèti boe mamadhe, be'a risi èu sabaj'a sèna ka ama lamatua soru-bara a'ari èu èèna ho na abhu sod'a. a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: abhu sasala dhu nèti boe dhèu asa d'ara mamadhe. abhu kahèi sasala dhu nèti dhèu asa mamadhe. te ngaa ja'a pua boe miu ho sabaj'a ladhe abhu sasala sèmi èèna.

source_text: all unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin that is not to death.
target_text: tatao karehe aa'i-aa'i, sala ètu madha ama lamatua. te ngaa abhu kahèi sasala dhu nèti boe mamadhe.

source_text: we have known that everyone who has been begotten of god does not sin, but he who was begotten of god keeps him, and the evil one does not touch him;
target_text: dhèu dhu pa'èki le dènge ama lamatua, mamuri heka tao sala, te ana ama lamatua dhu ladhe-leru ne. aa dhu bhelu-katub'a bisa boe segi ne kahèi.

source_text: we have known that we are of god, and the whole world lies under the power of the evil one;
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, èdhi kapua ètu d'ara ama lamatua. te ngaa èdhi te'a kahèi, na, dhu bhelu-katub'a dènge koasa ho ator dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: but we have known that the son of god has come, and has given us a mind that we may know him who is true, and we are in him who is true, in his son jesus christ; this one is the true god and the continuous life!
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, ana ama lamatua mai le, sèna ka hia èdhi te'a mèu j'ara se'e, ho èdhi bisa tadhe mèu ama lamatua dhu tare'a. limuri ne, èdhi bisa mamuri pabe'a dènge ne, lula èdhi mamuri d'ara èci dènge ana na, yesus kristus. te yesus kristus èèna, tare'a-re'a lamatua kahèi. aa nèngu ka hia dhèu abhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: little children, guard yourselves from idols! amen.
target_text: ana-ana, ee! j'aga paie-iie mamuri miu. mage abhu dhu seti eele ho gati ama lamatua nèti d'ara miu. d'ai sange ne'e ka. nèti ja'a, yohanis

source_text: the elder to the chosen lady, and to her children, whom i love in truth, and not only i, but also all those having known the truth,
target_text: ina pasue! sasuri ne nèti ja'a, yohanis, dhu j'aj'i ama gareja. ja'a suri sasuri ne hia mi ina, dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le j'aj'i dhèu unu na, aa dènge ana-ana ina sèra. ja'a sue miu aa'i-aa'i mi, dhu d'ara miu pa'èki dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke. dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i, dhu re'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, ra sue miu kahèi.

source_text: because of the truth that is remaining in us, and will be with us throughout the age,
target_text: ji'i sue miu, lula j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke sèle ètu d'ara èdhi, aa èèna na muri taruu ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: there will be with you grace, mercy, and peace from god the father, and from the lord jesus christ, the son of the father, in truth and love.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a, manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua, dènge ana na yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia dènge rasa kasia ra mi èdhi, sèna ka èdhi mamuri dame, mamuri pasue, aa pa'èki taruu dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: i rejoiced exceedingly that i have found of your children walking in truth, even as we received a command from the father;
target_text: ja'a karej'e titu kèna, lod'o ja'a paraga dènge ana ina cahag'e, dhu ra mamuri dènge be'a, madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu lèke, sama sèmi dhu ama lamatua hia le paredha mi èdhi.

source_text: and now i implore you, lady, not as writing to you a new command, but which we had from the beginning, that we may love one another,
target_text: ina pasue! ne'e ne, ja'a manèngi sèna ka èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti mamuri ètu d'ara pasue. dhu ja'a manèngi èèna, paredha hiu boe, te ngaa ja'a dhoka pasanèd'e di nèti paredha dhu èdhi unu le karèi nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: and this is love, that we may walk according to his commands; this is the command, even as you heard from the beginning, that you may walk in it,
target_text: èdhi bisa pad'elo sasue èdhi, ladhe èdhi tao madhutu paredha ama lamatua. karèi nèti uru ka, na paredha le èdhi, sèna ka èdhi mamuri pasue èci dènge èci. ne'e ne j'ara hiu boe, te miu tadèngi le karèi nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: because many deceivers entered into the world, who are not confessing jesus christ coming in flesh; this one is he who is leading astray, and the antichrist.
target_text: dhèu kapod'e-kabèli ae kako palème le rai-haha ne. rèngu aj'a, na, yesus kristus mai asa rai-haha ne, te ngaa nèngu dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a boe. dhèu se'e dhèu kapod'e-kabèli kahèi dhu lab'a kristus, aa ro'o boe sèmi rare, peka na, yesus, nuka kristus dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: see to yourselves that you may not lose the things that we worked for, but may receive a full reward;
target_text: j'aga paie-iie, ho èi kabhèsu èdhi baku core eele iia d'ara. de miu hud'i maj'èni sab'a taruu, sèna ka miu bisa sèmi mere mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua moa neo hia miu ètu sorga.

source_text: everyone who is transgressing, and is not remaining in the teaching of the christ, does not have god; he who is remaining in the teaching of the christ, this one has both the father and the son;
target_text: te dhèu dhu sigo eele nèti aj'a-nori kristus, nèngu pa'èki boe dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu kèpe pa'èra a'aj'a na, nèngu pa'èki dènge ama lamatua, aa dènge ana na, yesus kristus.

source_text: if anyone comes to you, and does not bear this teaching, do not receive him into the house, and do not say to him, greetings!
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu mai aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu leko-leo lula-nèti kristus, na, baku sèmi mere ne asa d'ara èmu miu, aa baku soro-suu hia ne.

source_text: for he who is saying to him, greetings, has fellowship with his evil works.
target_text: te ladhe pusi-pahae ne, na, miu sèmi mere le sasab'a na dhu bhelu-katub'a èèna.

source_text: having many things to write to you, i did not intend it with paper and ink, but i hope to come to you, and speak mouth to mouth, that our joy may be full.
target_text: madha j'ara ae era, dhu ja'a neo peka dènge miu, te ngaa be'a risi ja'a baku suri ètu d'ara sasuri. te nèbhu heka, ja'a neo dhiu padhai lii dènge miu, sèna ka èdhi sama-sama bisa karej'e-karae tare'a-re'a.

source_text: the children of your chosen sister greet you. amen.
target_text: ama lamatua hag'e nare kahèi a'a ina. ana-ana na hia lii maho'o mi ina si aa'i-aa'i ètu èèna. sange ne'e ka. salam nèti ja'a, yohanis

source_text: the elder to gaius the beloved, whom i love in truth!
target_text: angalai gayus dhu ja'a sue tare'a-re'a. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, yohanis, ama gareja!

source_text: beloved, i desire you to prosper concerning all things, and to be in health, even as your soul prospers,
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua j'aga èu, ho èu baku isi-noso kètu-kabo'o, aa d'ara èu be'a-be'a.

source_text: for i rejoiced exceedingly, brothers coming and testifying of the truth in you, even as you walk in truth;
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri a'ari dhu mai lolo dènge ja'a, peka na, èu madhutu taruu j'ara mamuri dhu lèke nèti ama lamatua. ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, d'ara ja'a karej'e titu kèna.

source_text: i have no joy greater than these things, that i may hear of my children walking in truth.
target_text: te ja'a karej'e risi eele, ladhe tadèngi ana-ana ja'a mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: beloved, you act faithfully in whatever you may do toward the brothers and the one among strangers,
target_text: angalai pasue! èu pakako le sasab'a ama lamatua dènge be'a, ropa èu sèmi more dènge hua iia a'ari dhu kako palème ho pakako sasab'a kristus. masi ka èu tadhe mèka si, te ngaa sèmi more si dènge be'a.

source_text: who testified of your love before an assembly, whom you will do well, having sent forward worthily of god,
target_text: dhèu dhu lèpa hari mai, palolo hia juma'at ètu ne'e, peka na, èu sèmi more dènge be'a, aa sue si. limuri ne, ja'a manèngi ho èu soru-bara taruu dhèu sèmi sèra, te èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: because they went forth for his name, receiving nothing from the nations;
target_text: rèngu loe boe kako palème sèna ka aj'a-nori dhèu nèti j'ara mamuri yesus kristus. te ngaa rèngu sèmi boe bantuan ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu dhu parcaya boe kristus.

source_text: we, then, ought to receive such, that we may become fellow-workers to the truth.
target_text: de mema dhu lèke kèna, ladhe èdhi ka dhu soru-bara si. te dènge j'ara ne, èdhi pakako sasab'a lamatua sama-sama dènge rèngu.

source_text: i wrote to the assembly, but he who is loving to be first among them-diotrephes-does not receive us;
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a pa'adhu le sasuri hia juma'at ètu èèna, te ngaa diotrefes padedha iisi na nuka sèmi dhèu aae-dhèu kapai. aa na d'èi boe nanene ja'a.

source_text: because of this, if i may come, i will cause him to remember his works that he does, talking nonsense against us with evil words; and not content with these, neither does he himself receive the brothers, and he forbids those intending to receive them, and he casts them out of the assembly.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a dhiu, èèna na ja'a bhoke paled'a-led'a ngaa dhu nèngu ad'u-ue. te na padhai lii pod'e-ed'o sèna ka neo pamanahu èdhi. risi-risi hari, na tule eele dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua dhu dhiu asa èèna. hèia na kakèj'i a'ari ètu èèna kahèi, ho baku sèmi rare dhèu sèra.

source_text: beloved, do not be following that which is evil, but that which is good; he who is doing good, he is of god, but he who is doing evil has not seen god;
target_text: angalai pasue! èu hud'i madhutu ku tatao dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a. baku madhutu dhèu dhu ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a. te dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a, rèngu sèra dhèu unu ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu ad'u-ue j'ara bhelu-katub'a, tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: testimony has been given to demetrius by all, and by the truth itself, and we also-we testify, and you have known that our testimony is true.
target_text: ladhe sèku demetrius. dhèu aa'i-aa'i koa-kad'iri ne lula na madhutu mola-mola j'ara mamuri lamatua dhu lèke. ja'a koa ne kahèi, aa èu me'a, na, ja'a monya boe.

source_text: many things i had to write, but i do not wish to write to you through ink and pen,
target_text: abhu j'ara ae-ae era dhu ja'a neo peka dènge èu, te ngaa ja'a suri boe ètu d'ara sasuri.

source_text: and i hope to see you soon, and we will speak mouth to mouth. peace to you! the friends greet you. be greeting the friends by name.
target_text: te ja'a sanao, nèbhu heka èdhi paraga, sèna ka èdhi dua ti bisa padhai lii patoo madha dènge madha.
d'ai uuru ku sange ne'e. a'ari ètu ne'e pa'adhu lii maho'o. mèti ku lii maho'o ja'a hia mi a'ari aa'i-aa'i ètu èèna, ca dhèu-dhèu ka dènge ngara na. saloom, nèti ja'a, yohanis

source_text: judas, a servant of jesus christ, and brother of james, to those called, having been loved in god the father, and having been kept in jesus christ,
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, yudas, ari yakobis. ja'a ne, ana pua-paleha nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a suri sasuri ne hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare, dhu na sue, aa dhu yesus kristus loe boe j'aga si toke d'ai nèngu mai hari.

source_text: mercy and peace and love be multiplied to you!
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho ama lamatua pad'elo rasa kasia aa pad'elo d'ara hua iia na ae-ae mi miu, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: beloved, using all diligence to write to you concerning our common salvation, i had necessity to write to you, exhorting you to fight for the faith once delivered to the holy ones,
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! uru èèna ja'a neo suri sasuri hia miu, lula-nèti j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua tao, sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi. te ngaa limuri ne, abhu lii langu, de ja'a hud'i suri hari j'ara dhu leo. ama lamatua pangèd'u le mi èdhi j'ara mamuri dhu mola. nèngu hia j'ara mamuri ne ca tèka di, aa na ub'a boe. nèngu hia j'ara mamuri ne mi dhèu-dhèu parcaya. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu pa'èra-èra d'ara, ho dhèu baku pakapod'e j'ara mamuri nèti lamatua.

source_text: for there came in certain men stealthily, having been written beforehand to this judgment long ago, impious, perverting the grace of our god to licentiousness, and denying our only master and lord-jesus christ.
target_text: te ngaa abhu le pèri-pèri dhèu dhu mai pahuni-pahuni ètu talora aae miu. dhèu sèra madhutu boe j'ara mamuri ama lamatua dhu mola, te ngaa ra madhutu dad'èi d'ara unu ra. rèngu peka na, d'ara hua iia lamatua ka dhu bhoke j'ara ho rèngu bisa tao leli. èèna na omo koso! rèngu se dhèu dhu peka leo, tao leo! dad'èi rèngu ka, ho èdhi nanene ia ka dhèu aae èdhi dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te ngaa sanèd'e, te dhu suri tèke ètu sasuri mola-mèci, na, lamatua unu na ka dhu tao tèke le hahuku dhu j'èra karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: now i intend to remind you, you once having known all this, that jesus, having saved a people out of the land of egypt, he secondly destroyed those not having believed;
target_text: abhu j'ara ae dhu miu me'a le, te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e hari, ho miu baku pamud'e. sanèd'e ku lii lolo uru-uru sèra, lod'o dhèu isra'el kalua nèti masir. masi ka ama lamatua hia mamuri le dhèu ca nau kateme, te ngaa d'ai loo-limuri, na palaho eele aa'i dhu ro'o boe parcaya ne.

source_text: messengers also, those who did not keep their own principality, but left their proper dwelling, he has kept in eternal bonds under darkness until the judgment of the great day,
target_text: conto leo, nuka ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga. ama lamatua pangèd'u si koasa, te ngaa dènge lane kahèi. te ngaa rèngu cahag'e roca boe, hèia ra tao risi nèti hak rèngu. hèia lamatua èki si, pake rate dhu bisa boe ma'ète, aa taha si ètu era maroga sèna ka mate d'ai lod'o dhu ama lamatua neo pama'ète sasala dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: as sodom and gomorrah, and the cities around them, in like manner to these messengers, having given themselves to whoredom, and having gone after other flesh, have been set before as an example, undergoing the justice of continuous fire.
target_text: aa mage bhèlu kota sodom dènge kota gomora, dènge rae-rae leo dhu padètu ètu sèra. dhèu-dhèu ra d'èi dhoka ad'u-ue rupa-rupa bhabhelu-katub'a dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu rèngu boe. rèngu d'èi titu kèna pa'èci dhu lèke-lèke boe kahèi. te ngaa lamatua pakèpu aa'i si pake ai. lii lolo ne pasanèd'e èdhi, peka na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua pake ai naraka dhu madhe boe èèna, sèna ka huku aa'i-aa'i dhu bhelu-katub'a.
