target_text: sakaria, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua, dhu suri mema le nèti uru ka, lula-nèti dhèu dua se. na pakasame sèmi aj'u saitun dua kapua, aa era tatèke labhu dua, dhu patitu tangare asa ama lamatua, dhu j'aj'i kètu mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and if anyone may will to injure them, fire proceeds out of their mouth, and devours their enemies, and if anyone may will to injure them, thus it is required of him to be killed.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo paj'èra dhèu dua dhu rèti lii padhai lamatua, èèna na ai bhodho nèti d'ara hèb'a ra, ho pakèpu aa'i musu ra. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, dhèu dhu neo paj'èra si, tatu madhe.

source_text: these have authority to shut the sky, that rain may not rain in the days of their prophecy, and they have authority over the waters to turn them to blood, and to strike the land with every plague, as often as they may will.
target_text: lod'o dua ra j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua ètu rai-haha ne, lamatua pangèd'u ra koasa ho ra bisa taha èj'i, koasa sèna ka tao madha èi j'aj'i raa, aa koasa ho ad'u-ue rupa-rupa mamadhe-mamopo ètu rai-haha, madhutu dad'èi ra.

source_text: and when they may finish their testimony, the beast that is coming up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them,
target_text: lod'o d'ai èle sasab'a-la'a ra, èèna na badha bhelu ci'u bhodho mai nèti ro'a j'aj'èra dhu dènge boe too-lane. badha ne'e lab'a rèngu dua ra, toke na segi si, aa na pamadhe dua ra.

source_text: and their body is on the street of the great city that is called spiritually sodom and egypt, where also their lord was crucified, and they gaze-those of the peoples, and tribes, and tongues, and nations-on their dead bodies three and a half days, and they will not allow their dead bodies to be put into tombs,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, dua ra madhe ètu kota kapai, dhu uru èèna era dhèu paku pamadhe lamatua rèngu ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te kota ne'e j'aj'i le kota bhelu, sèmi kota sodom dènge rai masir uru èèna. èèna na, dhèu core eele ngi'u aae dua ra, toke d'ai tèlu lod'o dènge ca èta. ka dhèu-dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, nèti udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge nèti kabarai aa'i-aa'i ra, mai lingu. dhèu se ro'o boe hia ijin ho padhane si,

source_text: and those dwelling on the earth will rejoice over them, and will make merry, and they will send gifts to one another, because these-the two prophets-tormented those dwelling on the earth.
target_text: lula ra karej'e laladhe ngi'u aae dhèu dua se, dhu mai lalai ngangee dhèu ae ètu rai-haha ne. ka dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra tao pesta, aa ra pa'adhu hadia èci dènge èci.

source_text: and after the three and a half days, the spirit of life from god entered into them, and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell on those beholding them,
target_text: te ngaa ropa èle tèlu lod'o dènge ca èta, hèia ama lamatua hia si a'ae, ka dua ra mamuri hari. hèia dhèu-dhèu dhu ladhe rèdhi si, madha'u toke isi ra rèbha-rèbha.

source_text: and they heard a great voice out of heaven saying to them, come up here; and they went up to heaven in the cloud, and their enemies beheld them;
target_text: ka dhèu dua se tadèngi lii dhu mèdhu èci nèti dedha-liru pua ra, peka na, dua mi ca'e ka asa ne'e mai! hèia dua ra ca'e asa dedha-liru lasi dènge ra'i-liru dhu sarimu nare si. ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka musu ra malaa ko'a-ko'a sène.

source_text: and in that hour a great earthquake came, and the tenth of the city fell, and seven thousand names of men were killed in the earthquake, and the rest became frightened, and they gave glory to the god of heaven.
target_text: kaca'a laa, rai opo dhu kapai titu kèna. ladhe ige èmu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara kota, nèti canguru èmu, dhu guri, cue. aa dhèu dhu madhe, pidhu riho dhèu. dhu madhe boe, ra madha'u bia. te ngaa rèngu èèna na pakab'ua kahèi kolongara ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha ètu sorga.

source_text: the second woe went forth, behold, the third woe comes quickly.
target_text: dènge sèmi ne'e, j'aj'èra ka dua seli le. te ngaa baku pamud'e! te calaka ka tèlu oe mai kèna.

source_text: and the seventh messenger sounded the trumpet, and there came great voices in heaven, saying, the kingdoms of the world became those of our lord and of his christ, and he will reign through the ages of the ages!
target_text: hèia ana pajuu lamatua ka pidhu tiu tèbhe na. kaca'a laa, ja'a tadèngi lii ae-ae nèti sorga, dhu peka na, limuri ne, dhu rèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha, dhodhoka ama lamatua dènge kristus, nuka dhèu dhu lamatua hag'e nare karèi nèti uru ka mai. èèna na lamatua nèd'u paredha taa-taa, sama sèmi dhèu aae.

source_text: and the twenty-four elders, who are sitting on their thrones before god, fell on their faces and worshiped god,
target_text: ka dua nguru èpa katua dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha ètu madha ama lamatua, tadèngi lii èèna kahèi. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu, toke rèhu ra d'ai rai, ka ra koa-kio ama lamatua,

source_text: saying, we give thanks to you, o lord god, the almighty, who is, and who was, and who is coming, because you have taken your great power and reigned;
target_text: aa sod'a, peka na, oo ama lamatua! kètu ji'i! ama lamatua ji'i! lamatua ka dhu paredha aa'i-aa'i. lamatua ka dhu koasa nare aa'i. lamatua ka dhu karèi nèti uru ka mai. lamatua ka dhu deo ne'e ne. ji'i manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula ama pake le koasa mu dhu kapai risi, sèna ka mèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and the nations were angry, and your anger came, and the time of the dead to be judged, and to give the reward to your servants, to the prophets, and to the holy ones, and to those fearing your name, to the small and to the great, and to destroy those who are destroying the earth.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu nèti suku-suku nasa titu kèna, lula rèngu ro'o boe madhutu lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, lamatua nasa kahèi, lula rèngu ro'o boe tadhe ne. limuri ne, d'ai le lod'o na, sèna ka lamatua huku dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe ne. limuri ne, d'ai le lod'o na, ho lamatua palaho dhèu dhu palaho dhèu leo. limuri ne, d'ai le lod'o na, ho lamatua parisa lii langu dhèu madhe. limuri ne, d'ai le lod'o na, ho lamatua b'ae-baj'a èi kabhèsu dhèu sab'a na. nuka: dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, dènge dhèu unu lamatua, ana iiki-dhèu kapai, dhèu ngèru-dhèu heka. lamatua b'ae rui-j'aj'èra mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, dhu pakab'ua kolongara na.

source_text: and the temple of god was opened in heaven, and the ark of his covenant was seen in his temple, and there came lightnings, and voices, and thunders, and an earthquake, and great hail.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a ladhe kèdhi babèdho èmu manèngi-mangaj'i lamatua ètu sorga, dhu conge tèke. ka ja'a kèdhi boaraka dhu uru èèna era tèke lii paredha ama lamatua dhu suri ètu lei hadhu. hèia bela kacèb'a lolo aae nèti haa, nèti dhimu, d'oro lii pagod'o-god'o, rai-haha ne karedha, dènge èj'i es hadhu dhu bia, kabhui mai nèti dedha-liru.

source_text: and a great sign was seen in the sky: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a garland of twelve stars,
target_text: ka cag'ag'a laa, ja'a kèdhi tadha èci dhu kapai titu kèna cèu ètu dedha-liru, dhu dhèu dhae rèdhi mèka ca tèka sa. tadha ne, nuka sèmi: bhèni ca dhèu dhu ngi'u na pahutu dènge madha lod'o. hèru j'aj'i mi era pacapa haga na. nèngu pake solo dhèu aae, dhu dènge hua-hètu canguru dua bua.

source_text: and having a child in her womb she cries out, travailing and being in pain to bring forth.
target_text: bhèni ne dènge babia, ka dhu tangi, te abhu le tadha ho nara iisi.

source_text: and there was seen another sign in the sky, and behold, a great fire-colored dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns on his heads,
target_text: kaca'a laa, ja'a kèdhi hari tadha èci dhu kapai aae, dhu cèu ètu dedha-liru kahèi. tadha ne, nuka mege naga mea ci'u dhu kapai. kètu na pidhu, aa tadhu na canguru bua. ètu kètu na sèra, dhu pake solo dhèu aae.

source_text: and his tail draws the third of the stars of the sky, and he cast them to the earth; and the dragon stood before the woman who is about to bring forth, that when she may bring forth, he may devour her child;
target_text: na pake rèu lai na, ho saku eele hua-hètu ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko ètu dedha-liru. hèia na core hua-hètu se asa rai-haha. ka la'e titu ètu madha bhèni ne, na tatae toke bhèni ne nara iisi. te na neo dhèle dènge ka ana nèti bhèni ne.

source_text: and she brought forth a male son, who is about to rule all the nations with a rod of iron, and her child was snatched up to god and to his throne,
target_text: hèia bhèni ne nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. te ngaa ana pajuu ama lamatua ca dhèu nèti sorga, mai parame nare ana ne, ka rai nèti asa lamatua, sèna ka nèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga. te bèli-camèd'a ana ne paredha suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha dènge koasa dhu kapai risi eele.

source_text: and the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place made ready from god, that there they may nourish her-one thousand, two hundred, sixty days.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni ne rai la'e asa d'ara mamoo èci dhu lamatua tao tèke hia ne. pe ra ladhe-leru ne, toke tèlu tèu dènge ca èta, nuka, 1. 260 ca riho dua ngasu èna nguru lod'o.

source_text: and there came war in heaven: michael and his messengers warred against the dragon, and the dragon and his messengers warred,
target_text: èle èèna ka, j'aj'i pamusu aae ètu sorga. ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, dènge kapala musu ra mikael, lab'a mege naga dènge ana pajuu na.

source_text: and they did not prevail, nor was their place found anymore in heaven;
target_text: ka mikael si segi mege naga ne dènge ana pajuu na sèra. èle ka, ra kai mege naga ne dènge ana pajuu na sèra, ho pea ia ka ètu sorga.

source_text: and the great dragon was cast forth-the old serpent, who is called devil, and satan, who is leading the whole world astray-he was cast forth to the earth, and his messengers were cast forth with him.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra bhabhoo eele si nèti sorga, hèia core si asa rai-haha. mege naga ne, nuka dhèu aae nidhu, dhu ngara na ‘lamatua nidhu'. karèi nèti uru ka, nèngu ne'e ka dhu leko-monya dhèu ho ad'u-ue sasala.

source_text: and i heard a great voice saying in heaven, now came the salvation, and the power, and the kingdom, of our god, and the authority of his christ, because the accuser of our brothers was cast down, who is accusing them before our god day and night;
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi hari lii dhu mèdhu èci nèti dedha-liru, peka na, uru èèna, mege naga ne'e ka dhu titu dhii-dhii ètu madha ama lamatua. sasab'a nèngu, nuka pèci sasala asa a'ari èdhi, dhèu parcaya sèra. na loe boe galaa si mèu-mèda. te ngaa limuri ne, ra bhabhoo eele ne nèti sorga. de limuri ne aa'i-aa'i tesa le. te d'ai lod'o na kèna, sèna ka lamatua hia mamuri mi dhèu rai-haha. limuri ne lamatua nèd'u le paredha dènge koasa na dhu kapai. aa na ded'e le kristus, dhèu dhu hag'e nare ho j'aj'i dhèu aae dhu paredha suku aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and they overcame him because of the blood of the lamb, and because of the word of their testimony, and they did not love their life-to death;
target_text: a'ari èdhi sèra ka dhu segi mege naga èèna, dhu uru èèna pèci sasala mi rèngu, lula raa ana kalèbho dhu suti sèna ka saku eele sasala-sasigo ra. a'ari èdhi segi ne kahèi, lula rèngu bani lole lii holo-nori lamatua. masi ka dhèu nasa ho neo pamadhe si, te ngaa ra bege boe.

source_text: because of this be glad, you heavens, and those who dwell in them; woe to those inhabiting the earth and the sea, because the devil went down to you, having great wrath, having known that he has a short time.
target_text: de aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu sorga hud'i karej'e-karae ku! te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha hud'i bori pa'èra ku, lula mamadhe-mamopo oe bèbhe mai lèke miu. dhèu aae nidhu puru mai le ètu talora aae miu. nèngu nasa titu kèna, lula ne'a, na, lod'o ho nèngu tao bhabhelu, oe èle kèna!

source_text: and when the dragon saw that he was cast forth to the earth, he pursued the woman who brought forth the male,
target_text: ropa mege naga ne'a, na, nèngu dhu ra core le asa rai-haha, ka la'e dènge tenge bhèni dhu nara iisi ana èèna, ho neo paj'èra ne.

source_text: and there were given to the woman two wings of the great eagle, that she may fly into the wilderness, to her place, where she is nourished a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent;
target_text: te ngaa ra hia bhèni ne èla dua, nuka sèmi èla manea luji, sèna ka na lela la'e lu'u asa d'ara mamoo dhu pakaj'èu nèti mege naga. ètu era nèi, ra ladhe-leru ne, toke tèlu tèu dènge ca èta.

source_text: and the serpent cast forth out of his mouth water as a river after the woman, that he may cause her to be carried away by the river,
target_text: ropa nèdhi nare sèmi èèna, hèia mege naga ne sabhuu èi, nuka sèmi èi aae lala, ho neo hae nèti bhèni ne.

source_text: and the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river that the dragon cast forth out of his mouth;
target_text: te ngaa rai-haha bara bhèni ne, dènge j'ara pacangange rai, ho dhèla aa'i mèu-mèu èi ne, dhu kalua nèti d'ara hèb'a mege naga, sèna ka baku d'ai bhèni ne.

source_text: and the dragon was angry against the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her seed, those keeping the commands of god, and having the testimony of jesus.
target_text: ka mege naga ne nasa titu kèna dènge bhèni ne. hèia la'e pamusu dènge ana-ana leo nèti bhèni ne, nuka dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu lii paredha ama lamatua, aa dhu loe boe nèti peka-padhai lii lolo be'a lula-nèti yesus.
èle èèna ka, mege naga ne la'e titu ka ètu sebhe dhasi, dènge kadhi ngutu kèru-kèru.

source_text: and i stood on the sand of the sea, and i saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and ten crowns on its horns, and on its heads names of slander,
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi badha bhelu ci'u dhu kalua nèti d'ara dhasi. badha ne, kètu na pidhu, aa tadhu na canguru. ètu kolo tadhu na sèra, dhu pake solo dhèu aae. ètu kètu na sèra, dhu suri lii-lii pakarehe ama lamatua.

source_text: and the beast that i saw was like to a leopard, and its feet as of a bear, and its mouth as the mouth of a lion, and the dragon gave to it his power, and his throne, and great authority.
target_text: ngi'u na, sama sèmi meo aasu. haga na, èci èèna ka dènge haga kiu aau. hèb'a na sèmi hèb'a singa. mege naga èèna pangèd'u koasa na mi badha bhelu ne, ho madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha, aa pake koasa na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and i saw one of its heads as slain to death, and its deadly wound was healed, and all the earth wondered after the beast,
target_text: ètu kètu èci nèti badha bhelu ne, abhu era hisu aae èci, nuka sèmi dhu ra pare ne ka oe madhe, te ngaa madhe boe. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne malaa, ropa ladhe rèdhi a'èra na, ka dhèu se madhutu ne.

source_text: and they worshiped the dragon who gave authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, who is like to the beast? who is able to war with it?
target_text: dhèu se pahaha iisi ra mi mege naga ne, dènge ded'e padedha-dedha ne nuka sèmi lamatua, lula mege ne ka dhu pangèd'u koasa na mi badha bhelu èèna. dhèu sèra koa-kio kahèi badha bhelu ne, peka na, nèngu ne kapai titu kèna! abhu boe èci sa dhu bisa segi ne!

source_text: and there was given to it a mouth speaking great things, and slanders, and there was given to it authority to make war forty-two months,
target_text: ama lamatua soro tèke badha bhelu ne, sèna ka na padedha iisi na, aa padhai lii pakarehe lamatua. hia ne ijin kahèi, ho nèd'u paredha toke d'ai tèlu tèu dènge ca èta nuka 42 èpa nguru dua hèru.

source_text: and it opened its mouth for slander toward god, to slander his name, and of his dwelling place, and of those who dwell in heaven,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na padhai lii pamanahu kolongara ama lamatua, dènge pakarehe kolongara dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua dhu pea ètu sorga.

source_text: and there was given to it to make war with the holy ones, and to overcome them, and there was given to it authority over every tribe, and tongue, and nation.
target_text: ama lamatua soro tèke ne kahèi, ho pamusu lab'a dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua, toke na segi. na abhu koasa kahèi, sèna ka paredha suku aa'i-aa'i, udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, lii aa'i-aa'i, aa kabarai aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and all who are dwelling on the earth will worship him, whose names have not been written in the scroll of life of the lamb slain from the foundation of the world;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, sogo-tagu badha bhelu èèna, nuka rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu ngara ra suri boe ètu d'ara sasuri ana kalèbho. uru èèna dhèu pamadhe ana kalèbho èèna, te ngaa lamatua pamamuri hari ne. lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, nèngu dhu suri nare le ngara-ngara nèti dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ra ètu d'ara sasuri na. dhu peka na, pe rèngu sèra ka dhu unu mamuri taa-taa, toke d'ai mia-mia dènge nèngu.

source_text: if anyone has an ear-let him hear:
target_text: nanene paie-iie!

source_text: if anyone goes into captivity, into captivity he goes; if anyone is to be killed with sword, it is necessary of him by sword to be killed; here is the endurance and the faith of the holy ones.
target_text: ladhe lamatua pama'ète nare le, dhèu cee ka dhu hud'i lèke kèpe, pe ra kèpe rare ne. aa ladhe lamatua pama'ète nare le, dhèu cee ka dhu hud'i madhe ku dènge samala, pe ra pamadhe nèngu pake samala kahèi. nèti èèna ka, dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua baku hari kabodho, te èèna hia ra tebho ho madhutu taruu dènge parcaya na taa-taa!

source_text: and i saw another beast coming up out of the earth, and it had two horns like a lamb, and it was speaking as a dragon,
target_text: èle, hèia ja'a kèdhi badha bhelu dhu leo ci'u, bhodho nèti rai-haha. tadhu na dua, nuka sèmi tadhu kahib'i-kalèbho. lii na nuka sèmi lii mege naga.

source_text: and all the authority of the first beast does it do before it, and it makes the earth and those dwelling in it that they will worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed,
target_text: nèngu nèti lii padhai lamatua na, nuka badha bhelu dhu uru èèna, dhu lèke pare ka oe madhe. na abhu koasa nèti lamatua na, sèna ka na laka-seti dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i ho sogo-tagu lamatua na.

source_text: and it does great signs, that fire also it may make to come down from the sky to the earth before men,
target_text: nèngu tao tadha-tadha malaa dhu kapai kahèi, toke na bisa papuru ai nèti dedha-liru, ètu madha dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: and it leads astray those dwelling on the earth, because of the signs that were given it to do before the beast, saying to those dwelling on the earth to make an image to the beast that has the wound of the sword and lived,
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, ka badha bhelu ka dua ne, pake koasa nèti lamatua na, ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu rai-haha. na paredha dhèu ho tao mèdha sogo-tagu cue, rupa na nuka sèmi lamatua na, sèna ka ra pakab'ua lamatua na, dhu uru èèna dhèu pare ne, ka oe madhe.

source_text: and there was given to it to give a spirit to the image of the beast, that also the image of the beast may speak, and it may cause as many as will not worship the image of the beast, that they may be killed.
target_text: ama lamatua soro tèke kahèi, badha dhu kapod'e-kabèli ne, ho na hia a'ae, sèna ka pamamuri mèdha sogo-tagu ne. nèti èèna ka, mèdha sogo-tagu ne bisa padhai lii, ho pua pamadhe dhèu dhu ro'o boe pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: and it makes all, the small, and the great, and the rich, and the poor, and the freemen, and the servants, that it may give to them a mark on their right hand or on their foreheads,
target_text: badha dhu kapod'e-kabèli ne laka-seti dhèu kahèi, sèna ka tao tadha mi ai g'ana ra, do mi katangarèi ra. dhèu aa'i-aa'i, nuka ana iiki-dhèu kapai, dhèu kaja-dhèu unu aad'o, dhèu ènu, do dhèu mardeka, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i abhu ku cap èèna.

source_text: and that no one may be able to buy, or to sell, except he who is having the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.
target_text: te ladhe aad'o, dhèu sèra bisa boe pahia do pahèli ngaa-ngaa. ètu d'ara cap ne, dhu suri ngara badha bhelu ka èci, dènge nomer na.

source_text: here is the wisdom! he who is having the understanding, let him count the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and its number: six hundred sixty-six.
target_text: de hud'i pangee paie-iie! dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu bisa re'a sasoa nèti nomer èèna. nuka 666 èna ngasu èna nguru èna, dhu paj'uj'u mi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: and i saw, and behold, a lamb was standing on mount zion, and with him one hundred forty-four thousand, having the name of his father written on their foreheads;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a boti kètu, kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana kalèbho dhu titu ètu kolo ledhe iiki èci. ngara na ledhe sion. na titu dènge dhèu na 144. cangasu èpa nguru èpa riho dhèu. ètu katangarèi dhèu se'e, dhu suri ngara ana kalèbho, dènge ngara ama na.

source_text: and i heard a voice out of heaven, as a voice of many waters, and as a voice of great thunder, and i heard a voice of harpists harping with their harps,
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi lii èci nèti dedha-liru. lii ne kadèru sèmi lii bèbhe naha dhasi kapai, aa dou sèmi lii d'oro. te ngaa lii ne culi be'a titu kèna, nuka sèmi dhèu ae dhu karihu sasadhu.

source_text: and they sing, as it were, a new song before the throne, and before the four living creatures, and the elders, and no one was able to learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand who have been bought from the earth;
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi 144. cangasu èpa nguru èpa riho dhèu se, dhu titu tangare asa madha ama lamatua, dènge badha aae èpa ngi'u dhu reo rare kadera paredha lamatua, aa dènge katua-katua sèra. dhèu ae-ae se sod'a lii sod'a hiu èci. lii sod'a ne, dhodhoka rèngu di dhu re'a, dhèu leo aad'o. te rèngu dhu pabe'a le dènge lamatua, lula lamatua pake raa ana na, ho sui si nèti sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: these are they who were not defiled with women, for they are virgin; these are they who are following the lamb wherever he may go; these were bought from among men-a first-fruit to god and to the lamb-
target_text: mamuri rèngu mola-mèci le, nuka sèmi mone kalora iisi dhu pa'èci nèdhi mèka dènge dhèu bhèni. rèngu parai eele boe dènge ana kalèbho èèna, sad'i asa era mia èèna ka, lula ama lamatua sui le rèngu pake raa ana na, sèna ka rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. rèngu èci èèna ka dènge hua hela dhu uru tèka nèti d'ara oka hia mi lamatua dènge ana kalèbho.

source_text: and in their mouth there was not found guile, for they are unblemished before the throne of god.
target_text: rèngu dhu re'a boe padhai lii leko-monya, lula d'ara ra mola.

source_text: and i saw another messenger flying in midair, having continuous good news to proclaim to those dwelling on the earth, and to every nation, and tribe, and tongue, and people,
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu lamatua ca dhèu hari mai nèti sorga. ana pajuu ne dhu lela dedha titu kèna, ho rodhe palème lii lolo be'a lamatua, dhu ma'ète boe ciki sa. na lela palème era, ho peka dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, nèti udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, nèti lii aa'i-aa'i, dènge negara aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: saying in a great voice, fear god, and give to him glory, because the hour of his judgment came, and worship him who made the sky, and the land, and sea, and fountains of waters.
target_text: na pa'oo-parodha, peka na, miu hud'i pakab'ua ku ama lamatua! miu hud'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na dhu dedha risi eele! lula lod'o na d'ai le, ho lamatua parisa lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i madhutu tatao ra. koa-kio ne! ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara na! lula nèngu ka paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha. aa nèti paredha na, ka dhasi dènge madha èi j'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: and another messenger followed, saying, fallen, fallen is babylon the great, because of the wine of the wrath of her whoredom she has given to all nations to drink.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, hèia ja'a kèdhi hari ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu nèti sorga, dhu mai madhutu ana pajuu dhu mai uru èèna. na lii, aku nèngu na, laho eele le! laho mae-mae le! kota babel dhu kapai na, laho le! kota dhu bhelu èèna, guri eele le pamera dènge rai. uru èèna, kota ne, nuka sèmi bhèni kajeo dhu laka-seti suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne ho rinu mahu, aa madhutu dad'èi na, ka ad'u-ue j'ara makae. te ngaa limuri ne kota ne, pasae nare le pala na nèti nanasa lamatua.

source_text: and a third messenger followed them, saying in a great voice, if anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi hari ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu nèti sorga, mai madhutu ana pajuu ka dua deo na. na pa'oo-parodha, peka na, mata unu mi! dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sogo-tagu badha bhelu dènge mèdha sogo-tagu na, do abhu cap ètu katangarèi, do ètu kacui-aai, pe rèngu pasae rare nanasa lamatua!

source_text: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of god that has been mingled unmixed in the cup of his anger, and he will be tormented in fire and brimstone before the holy messengers, and before the lamb,
target_text: bèli-camèd'a lamatua mesa na sabhori mai nanasa na mi dedha rèngu, nuka sèmi na panginu si èi uuru nèti èi anggor pèd'u. èèna na core si asa d'ara èi nasu dhu heo robhe-robhe dhu loe boe ciki sa. ana pajuu na nèti sorga sèra, aa ana kalèbho èèna kahèi ladhe rèdhi j'ara ne'e.

source_text: and the smoke of their torment goes up through ages of ages; and they have no rest day and night, who are worshiping the beast and his image, also if any receive the mark of his name.
target_text: peka ka laa, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sogo-tagu badha bhelu dènge mèdha sogo-tagu na, do rèngu dhu lèke le cap na, pe dui rare j'aj'èra taa-taa. sèb'u nèti j'aj'èra rèngu bhodho mai loe boe mèu-mèda.

source_text: here is endurance of the holy ones; here are those keeping the commands of god, and the faith of jesus. and i heard a voice out of heaven saying to me, write: blessed are the dead who are dying in the lord from this time! yes, says the spirit, that they may rest from their labors-and their works follow them!
target_text: de se'e se, sasoa na, dhèu unu ama lamatua, hud'i nanene ku paie-iie lii paredha na, aa parcaya taruu mi yesus, aa baku hari kabodho. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii èci nèti dedha-liru, peka na, yohanis! èu hud'i suri ku sèmi ne'e: karèi nèti deo ne'e, dhèu dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, ladhe ra madhe, rèngu abhu oto. hèia roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci dhaa, peka na, tare'a! bèli-camèd'a rèngu sèra oto tare'a-re'a! lula rèngu j'èra le ètu rai-haha, te ngaa ra taha ho madhutu taruu lamatua. de èèna na, lamatua b'ala j'aj'èra rèngu, ka rèngu mamuri j'èra heka ètu sorga.

source_text: and i saw, and behold, a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden garland, and in his hand a sharp sickle;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a padoa kètu. kaca'a laa, kèdhi ra'i-liru dhu pudhi lao-lao, aa ca dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha na. dhèu ne, oe sèmi dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. na pake dènge solo juara dhu tao nèti hualaa, aa nèd'u dènge hela pare j'u'u madèka èci.

source_text: and another messenger came forth out of the temple crying in a great voice to him who is sitting on the cloud, send forth your sickle and reap, because the hour of reaping has come to you, because the harvest of the earth has been ripe;
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu dhèu èci hari nèti sorga, kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. na rodhe dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha ra'i-liru èèna, peka na, pake hela èu èèna ho lamu puu-g'ètu ka! te d'ai le hèru pakaboko isi rai.

source_text: and he who is sitting on the cloud put forth his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.
target_text: ka dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha ra'i-liru ne, kèpe nare hela na, ka na la'e puu-g'ètu. hèia na oru kaboko isi rai nèti rai-haha.

source_text: and another messenger came forth out of the temple that is in heaven, having-he also-a sharp sickle,
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu leo hari ca dhèu kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu sorga. nèngu nèd'u dènge hela pare j'u'u madèka èci, ho neo g'ètu hua aj'u.

source_text: and another messenger came forth out from the altar, having authority over the fire, and he called with a great cry to him having the sharp sickle, saying, send forth your sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, because her grapes have come to perfection;
target_text: hèia ana pajuu dhu leo hari èci kalua nèti era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu sorga. sasab'a ana pajuu ne, nuka j'aga ai ètu era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi. na pa'oo pua ana pajuu dhu nèd'u hela pare j'u'u deo na, aku nèngu na, pake ka hela èu èèna, ho lamu ka g'ètu hua aj'u ètu rai-haha! te ètu nèi, hua anggor dhu madhasa aa'i le.

source_text: and the messenger put forth his sickle to the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of god;
target_text: ka ana pajuu ne kèpe nare ka hela pare j'u'u na la'e asa rai-haha, ho na g'ètu hua anggor, j'ue dènge ii kateme. hèia na pamaso hua anggor se asa d'ara bak pacèli anggor. ka ra j'èli marèu anggor se, sèna ka rare èi. j'èli marèu hua anggor ètu d'ara bak pacèli ne, sasoa na, nanasa lamatua.

source_text: and the winepress was trodden outside of the city, and blood came forth out of the winepress-to the bridles of the horses, one thousand six hundred stadia.
target_text: bak pacèli ne ètu li'u kota. ropa ra j'èli marèu anggor se, hèia raa kalua ae-ae. raa ne hae sama sèmi loko cue, dhu madhera na tèlu ngasu kilo, aa marèma na d'ai ca meter ca èta.

source_text: and i saw another sign in the sky, great and wonderful: seven messengers having the seven last plagues, because in these the wrath of god was completed,
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi tadha èci ètu dedha-liru, dhu kapai titu kèna, toke ja'a malaa bia. abhu ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga, èci-èci ka dènge koasa ra, ho hia calaka kapai asa rai-haha. pidhu calaka se, nuka j'aj'èra dhu limuri tèka. ladhe j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i ka, d'ara ama lamatua pacuhi, ka nasa heka dènge dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: and i saw as a sea of glass mingled with fire, and those who gain the victory over the beast, and his image, and his mark, and the number of his name, standing by the sea of the glass, having harps of god,
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi dhasi dhu ha'a-ha'a, nuka sèmi tèru dhu pab'ali dènge ai. ja'a kèdhi kahèi dhèu ae dhu titu ètu sebhe dhasi èèna. dhèu se'e ka dhu madhutu boe badha bhelu èèna, aa ra sogo-tagu boe mèdha sogo-tagu na, aa dhu sèmi boe cap na hèi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu kèpe dènge mèdha lii sod'a èci nuka sèmi sasadhu, dhu ra abhu nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and they sing the song of moses, servant of god, and the song of the lamb, saying, great and wonderful are your works, o lord god, the almighty, righteous and true are your ways, o king of holy ones!
target_text: ka ra sod'a lii sod'a èci dhu musa suri. musa ne, ana pua-paleha ama lamatua uru-uru sèra. dhèu se'e se sod'a kahèi lii sod'a èci dhu koa-kio yesus. te uru èèna, dhèu pamadhe ne, sama sèmi dhèu roro pamadhe ana kalèbho ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, sèna ka pamaringi d'ara na. dhèu se sod'a, peka na, ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua! ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na! lula koasa lamatua kapai risi eele. dènge a'èra na kapai titu kèna. lamatua ka dhu nèd'u le paredha mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha. lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu aae mi udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha. tatao lamatua mola sèmi isi pupu. sasab'a lamatua be'a seli eele! j'ara lamatua mèu rèd'e-rèd'e. mamuri lamatua lèke mola-mola!

source_text: who may not fear you, o lord, and glorify your name? because you alone are holy, because all the nations will come and worship before you, because your righteous acts were revealed.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra koa-kio babe'a lamatua. lula lamatua mesa na dhu mola-mèci. aa lamatua mesa na di, dènge boe sasala. pe suku aa'i-aa'i mai pahaha iisi mi lamatua. pe udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i mai manèngi makasi mi lamatua. lula dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a rèdhi le tatao lamatua dhu be'a. aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a le mamola d'ara lamatua.

source_text: and after these things i saw, and behold, the temple of the dwelling place of the testimony was opened in heaven;
target_text: ropa dhèu se èle sod'a, ja'a kèdhi kama luri mola-mèci ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i lamatua ètu sorga, dènge bhèla bhabhiri dhu bhoke pataleo tèke.

source_text: and the seven messengers having the seven plagues came forth out of the temple, clothed in linen, pure and radiant, and girded around the breasts with golden girdles:
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga dhu rèti dènge pidhu calaka sèra. rèngu kalua mai nèti èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. rèngu pake mèdha-papake dhu kale'e pudhi mèu, aa pake salalu dhu tao nèti poe dènge pai.

source_text: and one of the four living creatures gave to the seven messengers seven golden bowls, full of the wrath of god, who is living through the ages of the ages;
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi badha aae èci nèti èpa ngi'u sèra ètu sebhe kadera paredha lamatua, dhu papala pidhu bokor hualaa mi ana pajuu dhèu pidhu sèra. pidhu bokor se, èci-èci ka dhu isi ra hahuku nèti ama lamatua dhu taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia. te na pa'èra le, ho sabhori nanasa na asa rai-haha.

source_text: and the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of god, and from his power, and no one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven messengers may be completed.
target_text: nèbhu boe, hèia èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ne pènu dènge sèb'u dhu bodho mai nèti dadedha dènge koasa ama lamatua. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa maso asa era èèna. ana pajuu dhèu pidhu se hud'i sabhori pa'èle ku pidhu calaka asa rai-haha ne, heka dhèu bisa maso asa era èèna kèna.

source_text: and i heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven messengers, go away, and pour out the bowls of the wrath of god into the earth;
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi lii parodha èci kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, ho peka dènge ana pajuu dhèu pidhu se, na, lami ka! nedhe mèti ka bokor se'e, ho bhori ka nanasa lamatua asa rai-haha.

source_text: and the first went away, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and there came a sore-bad and grievous-to men, those having the mark of the beast, and those worshiping his image.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia ana pajuu ka èci la'e bhori isi bokor na asa rai-haha. kaca'a laa, papèd'a-tarègu lèke dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uru sèra abhu cap nèti badha bhelu, dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu sogo-tagu mèdha sogo-tagu na. rèngu se lèke èi papèd'a hisu huu dhu rarii titu kèna.

source_text: and the second messenger poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of one dead, and every living soul in the sea died.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu ka dua la'e bhori isi bokor na asa d'ara dhasi. kaca'a laa, èi ètu d'ara dhasi j'aj'i raa dhu hèu mau, cakaraa hèu raa dhèu madhe. ka aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu d'ara dhasi madhe aa'i si.

source_text: and the third messenger poured out his bowl into the rivers, and into the fountains of the waters, and there came blood,
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka tèlu la'e bhori isi bokor na asa d'ara loko dènge madha èi. ka èi aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i raa.

source_text: and i heard the messenger of the waters, saying, righteous, o lord, are you, who is, and who was, and who will be, the holy one, because you judged these things,
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi ana pajuu ca dhèu nèti sorga, dhu uri èi aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. na koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, oo lamatua! lamatua dhu mola-mèci! lamatua dhu sala nèdhi boe! lamatua mema-mema karèi nèti uru ka. aa lamatua taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia. lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhu mola isi pupu. lamatua hia le huku dhu kasii-kasore boe.

source_text: because they poured out the blood of holy ones and prophets, and you gave to them blood to drink, for they are worthy;
target_text: dhèu-dhèu pasuti le, raa nèti dhèu unu lamatua. dhèu-dhèu pamadhe le, dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. nèti èèna ka, lamatua laka-seti si, ho rinu raa kahèi. nèti èèna ka, lamatua b'ala si, dènge huku dhu lèke.

source_text: and i heard another out of the altar, saying, yes, lord god, the almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.
target_text: èle ka, ja'a tadèngi lii èci kalua nèti mei sogo-tagu, peka na, tare'a! ama lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi eele. tare'a! ama lamatua dhu èra risi aa'i. lamatua dhu pama'ète lii langu dhu koe boe kapengo boe. lamatua dhu pamanahu huku dhu lèke mola-mola.

source_text: and the fourth messenger poured out his bowl on the sun, and there was given to him to scorch men with fire,
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka èpa la'e bhori isi bokor na asa madha lod'o. kaca'a laa, lod'o pana titu kèna, ka dhèu ètu rai-haha ne kèpu-ladhu ai.

source_text: and men were scorched with great heat, and they slandered the name of god, who has authority over these plagues, and they did not convert-to give to him glory.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke tunu se, dhoo kolongara ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu papuru calaka ne hia mai asa rèngu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu ele-ho'a, ka lèpa asa lamatua ho koa-kio kolongara na.

source_text: and the fifth messenger poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom became darkened, and they were gnawing their tongues from the pain,
target_text: ka ana pajuu ka lèmi la'e bhori isi bokor na asa kadera paredha badha bhelu se. kaca'a laa, maroga kiu-kiu saguru nare dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sogo-tagu ne, toke j'èra titu kèna hèia ra gègu-ria.

source_text: and they slandered the god of heaven, from their pains, and from their sores, and they did not convert from their works.
target_text: dhèu se'e kahèi dhoo ama lamatua ètu sorga, lula hisu ra rarii titu kèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu ae eele nèti bhabhelu ra, ka lèpa asa ama lamatua.

source_text: and the sixth messenger poured out his bowl on the great river, the euphrates, and its water was dried up, that the way of the kings who are from the rising of the sun may be made ready;
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka èna bhori isi bokor na asa loko aae, dhu ngara na efrat. ka loko ne mango-meto dènge ka. hèia ra tao j'ara ètu d'ara loko ne, hia dhèu aae-dhèu aae dènge sordad'u-sordad'u dhu bèli-camèd'a mai nèti cabèka dhimu.

source_text: and i saw come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits like frogs-
target_text: ka ja'a ladhe kèdhi nidhu bhelu tèlu. rupa ra sama sèmi ana gaged'e. ci'u bhodho nèti d'ara hèb'a mege naga. ci'u kalua nèti d'ara hèb'a badha bhelu. aa ci'u hari bhodho nèti hèb'a dhèu kapod'e-kabèli, dhu nèti lii padhai mege naga èèna.

source_text: for they are spirits of demons, doing signs-which go forth to the kings of the earth, and of the whole world, to bring them together to the battle of that great day of god the almighty.
target_text: nidhu tèlu se dènge koasa ho tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa. ra kalua, lasi paraga dènge dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, ka ra pajaji ho ètu d'ara ca lod'o sa lasi pamusu, lab'a ama lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi eele èèna. te ngaa lod'o dhu ra pajaji èèna, lèke dènge lod'o dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le, ho na segi musu na aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: behold, i come as a thief; blessed is he who is watching, and keeping his garments, that he may not walk naked, and they may see his unseemliness. and they brought them together to the place that is called in hebrew armageddon.
target_text: era dhu ra pakaboko ho pamusu èèna, lii ibrani peka na, armagedon. yesus kristus peka kahèi, na, sanèd'e paie-iie! te kaca'a laa, ja'a mai nuka sèmi dhèu mana'u, dhu dhèu èci sa re'a boe. dhèu dhu oto, nuka rèngu dhu beke dènge dhu bori mema dhari. te ladhe ja'a mai, nèngu na'e boe makae, lula dhèu rèdhi boe era makae na.

source_text: and the seventh messenger poured out his bowl on the air, and there came forth a great voice from the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, it is done!
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka pidhu la'e bhori isi bokor na asa madha ngèlu. ka ama lamatua padhai lii mèdhu nèti kadera paredha na ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, èle le! nanasa ja'a bhori aa'i mèu-mèu le!

source_text: and there came voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and a great earthquake came, such as has not come since men came on the earth, so mighty an earthquake-so great!
target_text: hèia bela heo ha'a-ha'a, dènge d'oro lii gasi-gasi. aa rai opo dhu kapai titu kèna, dhu j'aj'i nèdhi mèka karèi nèti rai-haha ne j'aj'i.

source_text: and it came-the great city-into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell, and babylon the great was remembered before god, to give to her the cup of the wine of the wrath of his anger,
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua bhèlu boe bhabhelu dhèu ètu kota babel. ka na pake rai opo dhu kapai aae, sèna ka tao kota kapai ne masèke mi tèlu. ama lamatua ad'u-ue sèmi èèna, sèna ka dhèu babel re'a nanasa na. kota-kota leo ètu rai-haha ne, laho eele aa'i si kahèi.

source_text: and every island fled away, and mountains were not found,
target_text: lod'o èèna pulu-pulu cène aa'i si, aa ledhe-ledhe ela aa'i kahèi.

source_text: and great hail as of talent weight comes down out of the sky on men, and men slandered god because of the plague of the hail, because its plague is very great.
target_text: abhu kahèi èj'i es hadhu dhu kapai, bèbhe nèti dedha-liru, kabhie nare dhèu-dhèu ètu rai-haha. es hadhu se, babia ra abhu kahèi d'ai èpa nguru kilo. lula èj'i es ne dhu paj'èra dhèu, ka ra dhoo ama lamatua.

source_text: and there came one of the seven messengers, who were having the seven bowls, and he spoke with me, saying to me, come, i will show to you the judgment of the great whore, who is sitting on the many waters,
target_text: èle ka, ana pajuu èci nèti rèngu dhèu pidhu dhu rèd'u bokor dhu dènge heka isi, mai peka dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, mai ku sa ne'e! ja'a neo pad'elo dènge èu, j'ara tasamia ama lamatua huku bhèni kajeo dhu bhelu aae èèna. nèngu ne, nuka kota kapai èèna, dhu ra patitu padètu dènge èi ae-ae.

source_text: with whom the kings of the earth committed whoredom; and those inhabiting the earth were made drunk from the wine of her whoredom;
target_text: uru èèna, dhèu aae-dhèu aae nèti mia-mia, mai ad'u-ue j'ara makae dènge ana kabarai d'ara kota ne. dhèu leo kahèi mai rinu mahu, aa madhutu tatao j'ara makae ra.

source_text: and he carried me away to a wilderness in the spirit, and i saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast, full of names of slander, having seven heads and ten horns,
target_text: èle èèna ka, roh ama lamatua maso asa ja'a, hèia ana pajuu nèti sorga ded'e nèti ja'a asa d'ara mamoo èci. d'ai nèi, ja'a ladhe kèdhi dhèu bhèni ca dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kabodho badha bhelu mea ci'u. kètu badha ne pidhu, dènge tadhu na canguru. palème ètu ngi'u na dhu suri lii-lii dhu pakarehe ama lamatua.

source_text: and the woman was clothed with purple and scarlet-color, and gilded with gold, and precious stone, and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and uncleanness of her whoredom,
target_text: bhèni ne pake bèla manii mea dènge mea sanama mangèru. na pagaa ngi'u na dènge nèu mèdha hualaa, hadhu kale'e dhu kab'ua, dènge mutiara. ètu ai g'ana na, nèd'u dènge cangkir hualaa èci dhu pènu dènge èi anggor. anggor ne, sasoa na, j'ara makae, aa bhabhelu dènge tatao kaj'alu aa'i-aa'i dhu leo, dhu na ad'u-ue.

source_text: and on her forehead was a name written: secret, babylon the great, the mother of the whores, and the abominations of the earth.
target_text: ètu katangarèi na, dhu suri ngara èci, dhu dhèu re'a boe. lii dhu ra suri èèna, sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a ne, babel! ja'a ne, kota dhu kapai risi! rupa-rupa bhabhelu ètu rai-haha, j'aj'aj'i ra nèti ja'a ka. j'ara makae aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne, kapua ra nèti ja'a.

source_text: and i saw the woman drunken from the blood of the holy ones, and from the blood of the witnesses of jesus, and i wondered-having seen her-with great wonder;
target_text: ja'a laladhe, na, bhèni ne dhu mahu bia, lula nèngu dhu ninu le raa dhèu unu ama lamatua sèra. sasoa na, na pamadhe le dhèu unu ama lamatua, lula rèngu loe boe peka j'ara mamuri yesus. ropa ja'a kèdhi tatao bhèni ne sèmi èèna, hèia hèb'a ja'a nganga-nganga sène, lula malaa bia.

source_text: and the messenger said to me, for this reason did you wonder? i will tell you the secret of the woman and of the beast that is carrying her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ne karèi ja'a, peka na, nga tao ka èu naa-naa, aa malaa sèmi èèna? mai ho ja'a peka dènge èu sasoa na nèti bhèni kajeo ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge sasoa nèti badha bhelu dhu nèngu manya'e èèna. badha ne'e ka dhu kètu pidhu dènge tadhu canguru.

source_text: the beast that you saw: it was, and it is not, and it is about to come up out of the abyss, and to go away to destruction, and those dwelling on the earth will wonder, whose names have not been written on the scroll of life from the foundation of the world, beholding the beast that was, and is not, although it is.
target_text: uru èèna, badha bhelu ne dhu mamuri le ètu rai-haha, te ngaa limuri ne aad'o heka. te ngaa nèbhu heka, na kalua hari mai nèti ro'a j'aj'èra dhu dènge boe too-lane èèna. lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha, dhu ngara ra dhae suri mèka ètu d'ara sasuri ana kalèbho, dhu ama lamatua suri tèke le karèi uru ka, nèti na paj'aj'i rai-haha ne. bèli-camèd'a, dhèu se'e se malaa-maloha, lula rèdhi badha bhelu ne lèpa hari mai. te ngaa ladhe na mai hari, pe ama lamatua pèci ne asa d'ara dhasi ai èi nasu dhu heo na taa-taa.

source_text: here is the mind that is having wisdom: the seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits,
target_text: dhèu cee dhu d'èlu-mèu, na, nèngu bisa ne'a sasoa j'ara se'e. badha bhelu dhu kètu pidhu, sasoa na, nuka ledhe pidhu bua. bhèni kajeo èèna, dhu madhèdi ètu dedha ledhe sèra. aa sasoa nèti kètu pidhu sèra, nuka dhèu aae dhèu pidhu.

source_text: and there are seven kings, the five fell, and the one is, the other did not yet come, and when he may come, it is necessary for him to remain a short time;
target_text: lèmi nèti dhèu aae pidhu se, madhe le. ca dhèu dhu nèd'u paredha limuri ne. aa ca dhèu hari dhae mai mèka. te ngaa ladhe mai, nèngu nèd'u paredha nèbhu boe.

source_text: and the beast that was, and is not, he also is eighth, and he is out of the seven, and he goes away to destruction.
target_text: ne'e ne ja'a lole dènge èu, nèti badha bhelu dhu uru èèna mamuri, te ngaa limuri ne madhe le. lod'o èèna, nèngu ne ca dhèu nèti pidhu dhèu aae sèra, te ngaa èèna na mai hari nèd'u paredha, ho j'aj'i dhèu aae ka aru. pe na laho mae-mae kahèi.

source_text: and the ten horns that you saw are ten kings who did not yet receive a kingdom, but receive authority as kings one hour with the beast;
target_text: canguru tadhu se, sasoa na, nuka canguru dhèu aae. rèngu se dhae rèd'u mèka paredha. bèli-camèd'a rèngu abhu koasa, ho rèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge badha bhelu ne, te ngaa dhoka ciki-diki di.

source_text: these have one mind, and they will give over their own power and authority to the beast;
target_text: te rare lii èci, ho pangèd'u koasa ra mi badha bhelu èèna.

source_text: these will make war with the lamb, and the lamb will overcome them, because he is lord of lords, and king of kings, and those with him are called, and chosen, and steadfast.
target_text: dhèu aae sèra, bèli-camèd'a lasi pamusu, lab'a ana kalèbho. te ngaa ana kalèbho dènge dhèu unu na segi aa'i si. dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu ana kalèbho ne, nuka rèngu dhu na hag'e nare le, aa na paroa si ho madhutu ne taa-taa. pe rèngu segi, lula ana kalèbho ne èra titu kèna. dhodhoka nèngu di dhu j'aj'i dhèu aae nèti dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ra, aa lamatua nèti lamatua aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and he says to me, the waters that you saw, where the whore sits, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues;
target_text: aa èi ae-ae dhu padètu dènge bhèni kajeo ne, nuka dhèu-dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, nèti udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge dhèu ae-ae nèti lii aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and the ten horns that you saw, and the beast, these will hate the whore, and will make her desolate and naked, and will eat her flesh, and will burn her in fire,
target_text: canguru dhèu aae dènge badha bhelu se, èèna na ra tèka d'ara dènge bhèni kajeo dhu ne'a boe makae ne. èèna na parame rare mèdha-papake dènge mèdha-panyau na aa'i-aa'i, ka tèke eele ne dènge boe mèdha-papake ètu ua na. èle èèna ka, ra'e sisi bhèni ne kahèi. aa ngi'u na dhu ate, core asa d'ara ai.

source_text: for god gave into their hearts to do his purpose, and to make one purpose, and to give their kingdom to the beast until the sayings of god may be fulfilled,
target_text: ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu tao, toke canguru dhèu aae se rare lii èci, ho pangèd'u koasa ra mi badha bhelu ne, toke na palaho bhèni ne. dènge j'ara ne'e, ngaa dhu ama lamatua neo ad'u-ue, bèli-camèd'a aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i.

source_text: and the woman that you saw is the great city that is having reign over the kings of the earth.
target_text: bhèni kajeo dhu èu mèdhi èèna, nuka dhèu aae-dhèu kapai nèti kota kapai dhu paredha dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and after these things i saw another messenger coming down out of heaven, having great authority, and the earth was lightened from his glory,
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu, mai nèti sorga. nèngu ne dhu dènge koasa aa saraa dhu kapai, ho pasaraa palème rai-haha.

source_text: and he cried in might with a great voice, saying, fallen, fallen is babylon the great! and she became a habitation of demons, and a hold of every unclean spirit, and a hold of every unclean and hateful bird,
target_text: dènge lii aae, na peka, laho le! laho le! kota babel laho mae-mae le! guri le! guri le! kota kapai ne, guri dolu-dolu le! nèngu j'aj'i le era pea nidhu. nèngu j'aj'i le rai èta-èsu roh bhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i. nèngu j'aj'i le era pakaboko nèti manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i dhu ra'a sisi hèu. nèngu j'aj'i le oka nèti badha aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu madenge.

source_text: because all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her whoredom, and the kings of the earth committed whoredom with her, and merchants of the earth were made rich from the power of her indulgence.
target_text: nèngu guri le, lula suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, loe boe mai rinu mahu èi anggor na. nèngu laho le, lula udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, loe boe mai ad'u-ue j'ara makae dènge ana kabarai kota ne. dhèu aae-dhèu aae nèti negara aa'i-aa'i, mai j'unu pa'èci ètu èèna. dhèu d'aga nèti kota aa'i-aa'i, mai pahia toke rèngu j'aj'i kaja. lula kota ne nuka sèmi dhèu bhèni dhu d'èi hèli mèdha dhu kab'ua aae. lula kota ne sama sèmi bhèni kajeo dhu d'èi dhoka tenge ngaa-ngaa dhu hua iia di.

source_text: and i heard another voice out of heaven, saying, come forth out of her, my people, that you may not partake with her sins, and that you may not receive of her plagues,
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi hari lii leo èci, paroa nèti dedha-liru, peka na, wee! dhèu ja'a aa'i-aa'i! rai eele ka era èèna! tèke eele ka kota èèna! baku tao madhutu bhabhelu ana kabarai kota ne, sèna ka baku lèke hahuku ra kahèi.

source_text: because her sins have reached up to heaven, and god remembered her unrighteousness.
target_text: lula bhabhelu ra, ae seli eele. aa sasala ra, tanga-tanga d'ai dedha-liru. limuri ne ama lamatua bhèlu heka, j'ara mamuri ra dhu bhelu-katub'a èèna. limuri ne ama lamatua dhu pa'èra le, ho neo huku si.

source_text: render to her as she also rendered to you, and double to her twofold according to her works; in the cup that she mingled mingle to her double.
target_text: de miu hud'i b'ala ku bhabhelu ra, sama sèmi rèngu tao le bhabhelu mi dhèu leo. te ngaa miu hud'i b'ala si, toke d'ai babia na dua-dua hari. uru èèna, rèngu tipu le dhèu, ho rinu nèti d'ara cangkir hualaa ra, dhu pènu dènge èi anggor j'aj'èra. te ngaa limuri ne rèngu mesa ra hud'i rinu ku anggor j'aj'èra èèna, toke dua-dua hari.

source_text: as much as she glorified herself and indulged, so much torment and sorrow give to her, because in her heart she says, i sit as queen, and i am not a widow, and i will not see sorrow;
target_text: rèngu se tao ngi'u ra kapai. aa ra padedha-dedha ngi'u unu ra. rèngu d'èi dhoka mamuri karej'e-karae di. rèngu d'èi dhoka dhu be'a-be'a di. nèti èèna ka, rèngu hud'i abhu ku sasusa dhu bia. de rèngu hud'i mamuri j'èra bia ku. te uru èèna, ra padhai lii padedha iisi sama sèmi bhèni kajeo, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, ina bhèni aae! ja'a ne, èèna na j'aj'i boe bhèni balu! ja'a èèna na roma iisi boe. ja'a èèna na silu boe mèdha balu dhèu madhe. '

source_text: because of this, in one day, will come her plagues: death, and sorrow, and famine; and she will be utterly burned in fire, because strong is the lord god who is judging her;
target_text: ra padhai lii sèmi èèna, toke ama lamatua nasa le dènge ra. ka ama lamatua neo huku si. èèna na, d'ara ca lod'o di, rèngu manganga titu kèna, rèngu tangi roma iisi, aa ra madhe aapa. toke dhèu core eele si asa d'ara ai. toke ai na'e pakèpu ngi'u aae si. te lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi, ka dhu papuru huku ne. aa lamatua dhu èra risi eele, dhu pama'ète lii langu ne.

source_text: and the kings of the earth will weep over her and strike themselves for her, who committed whoredom and indulged with her, when they may see the smoke of her burning,
target_text: dhèu aae-dhèu aae uru sa, mai j'unu pa'èci dènge ana kabarai kota ne, aa mamuri karej'e-karae ètu èèna. pe ladhe rèdhi sèb'u dhu ca'e nèti d'ara ai, pe re'a, na, kota ne dhu ai na'e aa'i le. ka ra tangi ne dènge d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: having stood from afar because of the fear of her torment, saying, woe, woe, the great city! babylon, the strong city! because in one hour your judgment came.
target_text: ka ra mangingi, ladhe j'aj'èra dhèu sèra. te ngaa ra bani dhoka titu ètu kaj'èu di. aa rèngu bani dhoka laladhe nèti nèi di. hèia ra padhai lii, peka na, ‘ira ii! kasian èu babel! ira ii! kasian kota kapai! te dhoka d'ara ca jam di, èu abhu huku le. te dhoka d'ara ciki oo'e di, èu laho le. '

source_text: and the merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her, because no one buys their cargo anymore;
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, dhèu-dhèu dhu uru sèra, mai nèti mia-mia ho d'aga ètu èèna, rèngu tangi roma iisi kahèi. te abhu boe ca dhèu sa, dhu neo lasi hèli mèdha d'aga ra.

source_text: cargo of gold, and silver, and precious stone, and pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all fragrant wood, and every vessel of ivory, and every vessel of most precious wood, and brass, and iron, and marble,
target_text: abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli mèdha ra dhu tao nèti hualaa, doi pudhi, hadhu kale'e, do mutiara. abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli bèla lenan, do bèla sutra rèngu, do bèla alus dhu leo, dhu mea oe sèmi mangèru sa. abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli mèdha ra dhu tao nèti aj'u hèu mèngi, aa mèdha dhu d'ule nèti èli gajah, do aj'u dhu d'ule dhu leo sèra. abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli mèdha ra dhu tao nèti tabaga, bèsi, do hadhu marmar.

source_text: and cinnamon, and amomum, and incense, and ointment, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and cattle, and sheep, and of horses, and of chariots, and of bodies and souls of men.
target_text: abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli kayu manis, do bubhu lara dhu leo sèra. abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli raa aj'u hèu mèngi ra, do èi hèu mèngi dhu leo sèra. abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli èi anggor ra, èi mènyi saitun ra, tarigu, do are-gandum ra. abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli sapi ra, kahib'i-kalèbho ra, do jara ra. abhu heka dhu neo lasi hèli kareta mèdha ra, do ènu ra sèra.

source_text: and the fruits of the desire of your soul went away from you, and all things-the sumptuous and the radiant-went away from you, and no more at all may you find them.
target_text: èèna na dhèu d'aga sèra manyasa, ka ra peka na, ‘ira ii, babel, ee! ira ii, kota kapai, ee! mèdha-panyau èu dhu hua iia sèra, dhu kabarai èu d'èi risi, aad'o heka èci sa. aa'i-aa'i ra ela aa'i mèu-mèu, toke kabarai èu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, toke rod'o kakara d'ai rai. '

source_text: the merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far off because of the fear of her torment, weeping, and mourning,
target_text: uru èèna, dhèu d'aga se j'aj'i kaja, lula kota ne dhu nuka sèmi bhèni kajeo. te ngaa limuri ne, ra loe boe manyasa. rèngu j'aj'i madha'u titu kèna, laladhe j'aj'èra ana kabarai kota ne. rèngu j'aj'i mangingi titu kèna, laladhe hahuku ra. te ngaa rèngu dhoka bani laladhe nèti kaj'èu di. rèngu bani dhoka titu nèti era nèi di.

source_text: and saying, woe, woe, the great city, that was clothed with fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and gilded in gold, and precious stone, and pearls-
target_text: hèia ra padhai lii, peka na, ‘ira ii! kasian èu babel, ee! ira ii! kasian kota kapai, ee! uru èèna, ana kabarai èu pake mèdha bèla alus, dhu mea oe sèmi mangèru sa, nèti bèla dhu kab'ua titu kèna. uru èèna, ana kabarai èu d'èi panèu mèdha hualaa, mutiara, dènge hadhu kale'e dhu kab'ua titu kèna.

source_text: because in one hour so much riches were made desolate! and every shipmaster, and all the company on the ships, and sailors, and as many as work the sea, stood far off,
target_text: te ngaa d'ara ca jam di, mèdha-panyau èu sèra èla aa'i mèu-mèu si. dhodhoka d'ara ciki oo'e èèna di, kakaja èu saku hani-hani! ' uru èèna juraga kapa, dènge mataroo sèra, kako lasi-mai nèti kota èèna. te ngaa limuri ne, rèngu bani dhodhoka panahu nèti kaj'èu di. te ngaa limuri ne rèngu bani dhoka laladhe nèti nèi di.

source_text: and were crying, seeing the smoke of her burning, saying, what city is like to the great city?
target_text: rèngu ladhe sèb'u kalua nèti d'ara ai èèna. ka re'a, na, ai na'e aa'i le. hèia ra manyasa, ka peka na, ‘ira ii, kasian! abhu heka kota leo dhu kapai sèmi kota babel ne. aduu, kasian! abhu heka kota dhu leo, dhu babe'a na sama sèmi nèngu ne. '

source_text: and they cast dust on their heads, and were crying out, weeping and mourning, saying, woe, woe, the great city! in which were made rich all having ships in the sea, out of her costliness-for in one hour was she made desolate.
target_text: rèngu soke ahu ho ceb'e mi kètu ra, lula d'ara ra susa. rèngu tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula d'ara ra laho mae-mae. ka ra peka na, ‘ira ii! kasian èu babel, ee! ira ii! kasian kota kapai! ji'i dènge kapa la'a-mai ngèti mèdha hia kabarai èu, toke ji'i d'ai kaja-su'i kahèi. ji'i hua ngèti le mèdha kabarai èu, toke ji'i mamuri hua iia kahèi. te ngaa dhoka d'ara ca jam di, aa'i-aa'i se saku hani-hani. te ngaa dhoka ètu d'ara ciki oo'e di, laho aa'i si mèu-mèu. '

source_text: be glad over her, o heaven, and you holy apostles and prophets, because god judged your judgment of her!
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi lii aae èci peka tabha hari, sèmi ne'e ka: ‘he, miu dhu mamuri ètu sorga! miu parluu heka d'ara pèd'a. he, miu dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua! d'ara miu parluu heka susa. miu dhu j'aj'i le dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, hud'i laa d'ara miu karae. miu dhu j'aj'i le dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, hud'i laa d'ara miu maho'o. uru èèna, babel pasusa le miu. uru èèna, kabarai kota ne paj'èra miu. te ngaa limuri ne lamatua pama'ète le lii langu miu dènge mola. te limuri ne na b'ala le bhabhelu-katub'a kabarai kota èèna. '

source_text: and one strong messenger took up a stone as a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, thus with violence will babylon be cast, the great city, and may not be found anymore at all;
target_text: ka ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu èci nèti sorga dhu èra titu kèna. na mai ded'e nare hadhu aae cue, dhu kapai na sange dhèu èci. hèia na pèci hadhu ne asa d'ara dhasi. ka na peka, pe ra palaho eele babel sèmi èèna kahèi. pe ra pa'ele kota kapai èèna, sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and voice of harpists, and musicians, and pipers, and trumpeters, may not be heard at all in you anymore; and any craftsman of any craft may not be found at all in you anymore; and noise of a millstone may not be heard at all in you anymore;
target_text: abhu heka ca dhèu sa, dhu karihu musiik ètu d'ara kota èèna. abhu heka dhèu, dhu tadèngi lii gai sasadhu, tiu sakino, aa lii tiu tèbhe ètu d'ara kota èèna. abhu heka tuka èci sa, dhu sab'a ètu d'ara sab'a-la'a ra. abhu heka dhèu, dhu gili are ètu kota èèna.

source_text: and light of a lamp may not shine at all in you anymore; and voice of bridegroom and of bride may not be heard at all in you anymore; because your merchants were the great ones of the earth, because all the nations were led astray in your sorcery,
target_text: abhu heka dhèu, dhu paheo labhu ètu d'ara kota èèna. abhu heka dhèu, dhu tao pesta kab'i ètu èèna. uru èèna, ètu kota ne, dhèu pahia-pahèli mèdha ra, toke j'aj'i kaja-su'i. uru èèna, dhèu d'aga ètu babel, mamuri hua iia. te ngaa rèngu pake na'i nidhu, ho leko-monya dhèu ètu rai-haha. rèngu pake seher, ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and in her blood of prophets and of holy ones was found, and of all those who have been slain on the earth.
target_text: babel abhu le huku dhu bia, lula kabarai na loe boe pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. kota kapai ne laho le, lula kabarai na paj'èra toke madhe dhèu unu lamatua. abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu lamatua dhu ra pamadhe ètu era-era leo. te ngaa babel ka dhu hud'i dui nare sasala sèra. kota kapai èèna ka dhu hud'i tago nare aa'i.

source_text: and after these things i heard a great voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, hallelujah! the salvation, and the glory, and the power belong to the lord our god;
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ne padhai lii nare, ka ja'a tadèngi lii dhèu ae-ae sod'a ètu sorga. ra sod'a, peka na, haleluya! haleluya! èdhi koa-kio ama lamatua èdhi, lula nèngu ka dhu dedha risi eele. haleluya! haleluya! èdhi koa-kio ama lamatua èdhi, lula nèngu ka dhu koasa kapai risi. lamatua ka dhu patabuli èdhi, nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. lamatua ka dhu pamèci èdhi, nèti sasala-sasala èdhi.

source_text: because true and righteous are his judgments, because he judged the great whore who corrupted the earth in her whoredom, and he avenged the blood of his servants at her hand;
target_text: èdhi koa-kio ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu pama'ète lii langu dènge mola. èdhi koa-kio ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu hia hahuku dhu lèke. lamatua dhu huku le bhèni kajeo èèna, lula nèngu ka dhu dadugu dhèu ètu rai-haha, sèna ka madhutu tao j'ara makae sama-sama dènge ne, aa madhutu bhabhelu na. lamatua b'ala le bhèni aapa èèna, lula nèngu loe boe pamadhe ana pua-paleha lamatua.

source_text: and a second time they said, hallelujah; and her smoke comes up through the ages of the ages!
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra sod'a lii sod'a leo hari ètu sorga, peka na, haleluya! koa-kio lamatua! haleluya! j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na! lula sèb'u ai dhu tunu pakèpu ngi'u aae bhèni èèna, ca'e taruu dhu loe boe ciki sa. aa sèb'u nèti ai dhu tunu eele kota kapai èèna, ca'e taruu dhu loe boe ciki sa.

source_text: and the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and they worshiped god who is sitting on the throne, saying, amen! hallelujah!
target_text: hèia dua nguru èpa katua, dènge badha aae èpa ngi'u sèra, patitu kètu urutuu, ho pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha na. ra pakab'ua ne, peka na, tare'a sèmi èèna! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! haleluya! mai ti j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na!

source_text: and a voice out of the throne came forth, saying, praise our god, all you his servants, and those fearing him, both the small and the great;
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi hari lii èci dhu mai nèti kadera paredha èèna, peka na, he, miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu j'aj'i le ana pua-paleha ama lamatua! he, miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua! mai sèna ka ti j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua. mai aa'i-aa'i, ana iiki-dhèu kapai, koa-kio ne.

source_text: and i heard as the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, hallelujah! because our lord, the god, the almighty, has reigned!
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi oe sèmi dhèu ae-ae dhu padhai lii. lii ra mèdhu nuka sèmi lii èi dhu hae nèti kolo ledhe, aa dou sèmi lii d'oro, ra peka na, haleluya! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua. haleluya! ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na. lula nèngu ka dhu koasa kapai risi. aa nèngu ka dhu paredha aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: may we rejoice and exult, and give the glory to him, because the marriage of the lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready;
target_text: limuri ne, d'ara èdhi karej'e le. limuri ne, d'ara èdhi kea rae-rae. èdhi koa-kio ne. lula d'ai le lod'o kab'i ana kalèbho kèna. èdhi j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na, lula bhèni dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu èmu ana kalèbho, dhu pa'èra le.

source_text: and there was given to her that she may be clothed with fine linen, pure and radiant, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the holy ones.
target_text: ama lamatua hia ne kodho kab'i na nèti bèla alus. ama lamatua pangèd'u na mèdha-papake dhu pudhi kale'e. mèdha-papake dhu pudhi kale'e èèna, sasoa na, tatao dhu be'a nèti dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: and he says to me, write: blessed are they who have been called to the banquet of the marriage of the lamb; and he says to me, these are the true words of god;
target_text: ka ana pajuu nèti sorga èèna, peka dènge ja'a, na, yohanis! èu hud'i suri more ku, sèmi ne'e: ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu abhu nèru ho mai asa pesta kab'i ana kalèbho ne, rèngu oto tare'a-re'a! ' hèia na peka hari dènge ja'a, lii holo-nori ama lamatua ne, lèke tare'a-re'a!

source_text: and i fell before his feet to worship him, and he says to me, behold-no! i am your fellow servant, and of your brothers, those having the testimony of jesus; worship god, for the testimony of jesus is the spirit of the prophecy.
target_text: ka ja'a patitu kètu urutuu ho neo pahaha iisi mi ana pajuu ne. te ngaa na kai, peka na, èu baku tao sèmi ne'e! te ja'a ne ènu ama lamatua, èci èèna dènge èu ne, aa sama sèmi a'ari èu dhu lasi peka-padhai lii aj'a-nori yesus. te dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua peka-padhai lula-nèti yesus kahèi, sèna ka dhèu pahaha iisi mi nèngu. te naneo roh ama lamatua sèmi èèna. de baku pahaha iisi mi ja'a ne. te ngaa pahaha iisi dhoka mi ama lamatua di.

source_text: and i saw heaven having been opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who is sitting on it is called faithful and true, and in righteousness he judges and makes war,
target_text: hèia ja'a doa kètu, ka ladhe kèdhi babèdho sorga dhu bhoke tèke. cag'ag'a laa, ja'a kèdhi jara pudhi ci'u kalua mai. dhèu dhu manya'e na, ngara na dhèu dhu kèpe pa'èra lii pajaji aa dhèu dhu mola. lod'o na parisa lii langu, na pama'ète dènge mola. ladhe nèngu la'e pamusu, la'e dènge d'ara mola.

source_text: and his eyes are as a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns-having a name written that no one has known, except himself,
target_text: musi madha na heo sama sèmi ai. na pake solo dhèu aae dhu ae, ètu kètu na. ngara na dhu suri ètu ngi'u na, te ngaa nèngu mesa na di, dhu ne'a sasoa ngara èèna.

source_text: and he is clothed with a garment covered with blood, and his name is called, the word of god.
target_text: mèdha-papake na, dhu cèb'u le asa d'ara raa. dhèu paroa ne, lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: and the armies in heaven were following him on white horses, clothed in fine linen-white and pure;
target_text: ja'a kèdhi kahèi sordad'u-sordad'u nèti sorga dhu manya'e jara pudhi, dhu madhutu ne. sordad'u se pake mèdha alus dhu pudhi mèu kahèi.

source_text: and out of his mouth proceeds a sharp sword, that with it he may strike the nations, and he will rule them with a rod of iron, and he treads the press of the wine of the wrath and the anger of god the almighty,
target_text: abhu samala èci dhu madèka, kalua nèti d'ara hèb'a na. na pake samala ne, ho la'e pamusu, lab'a suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha. hèia na segi si. ka na j'aj'i dhèu aae rèngu. na paredha si dènge ai bèsi, toke rèngu re'a nanasa lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi. j'ara ne'e ne, sama sèmi dhèu j'èli marèu hua anggor, ho pacèli rare èi na.

source_text: and he has on the garment and on his thigh the name written: king of kings, and lord of lords.
target_text: aa ètu kodho dènge ètu haree na, dhu suri sèmi ne'e: dhèu aae nèti dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ra, lamatua nèti lamatua aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and i saw one messenger standing in the sun, and he cried with a great voice, saying to all the birds that are flying in midair, come and be gathered together to the banquet of the great god or the great banquet of god,
target_text: ka ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu ca dhèu nèti sorga dhu titu ètu dedha madha lod'o. hèia na rodhe manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i dhu lela re talora liru, peka na, mai aa'i-aa'i mi pakaboko mi era ne'e, ho mi'a pesta kapai dhu ama lamatua tao!

source_text: that you may eat flesh of kings, and flesh of chiefs of thousands, and flesh of strong men, and flesh of horses, and of those sitting on them, and the flesh of all-freemen and servants-both small and great.
target_text: sisi dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i ra, miu bisa mi'a. nuka sisi nèti: dhèu aae-dhèu aae, komedhaa, dènge sordad'u sèra. miu mi'a kahèi sisi jara dènge sisi sordad'u dhu manya'e si. miu mi'a kahèi sisi ènu-ènu, do dhèu mardeka, do ana iiki-dhèu kapai. peka ka laa, ngara na ngaa dhu dènge sisi, mi'e si.

source_text: and i saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, having been gathered together to make war with him who is sitting on the horse, and with his army;
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi badha bhelu dhu uru èèna bodho nèti d'ara dhasi. la'e pane'a lii dènge dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, dènge sordad'u ra. ka lasi pamusu, lab'a dhèu dhu manya'e jara pudhi èèna, dènge sordad'u dhu palere-lere dènge ne nèti sorga.

source_text: and the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who did the signs before him, in which he led astray those who received the mark of the beast, and those who worshiped his image; the two were cast living into the lake of the fire that is burning with brimstone;
target_text: te ngaa dhèu manya'e jara pudhi ne, kèpe nare badha bhelu dènge dhèu nèti lii padhai na dhu kapod'e-kabèli sèra. dhèu dhu nèti padhai lii na, nuka dhèu dhu tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa ho leko-monya dhèu, dhu ra sèmi rare cap nèti badha bhelu ne, aa sogo-tagu mèdha sogo-tagu na. te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu dhu manya'e jara pudhi ne, pèci eele le badha bhelu dènge dhèu dhu nèti lii padhai na, asa d'ara dhasi ai èi nasu dhu heo na madhe boe.

source_text: and the rest were killed with the sword of him who is sitting on the horse, which is proceeding out of his mouth, and all the birds were filled with their flesh.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu dhu manya'e jara pudhi ne, la'e pamadhe aa'i sordad'u dhu leo sèra, pake dènge samala dhu kalua nèti d'ara hèb'a na. hèia manu-bhui dhu ra'a sisi hèu, mai ra'e aa'i ngi'u aae dhèu madhe sèra.

source_text: and i saw a messenger coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss, and a great chain over his hand,
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu èci nèti sorga puru mai nèti dedha-liru. na kèpe dènge rate aae èci, aa nèd'u dènge gagoe nèti ro'a j'aj'èra dhu dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: and he laid hold on the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil and satan, and bound him one thousand years,
target_text: ka na la'e kèpe mege naga, nuka dhèu aae nidhu, dhu ra peka na, lamatua nidhu. nèngu ne'e ka dhu leko-monya dhèu rai-haha karèi nèti uru ka mai. hèia ana pajuu ne èki mege naga ne dènge rate, ho taha ne ètu d'ara ro'a j'aj'èra dhu dènge boe lane èèna, toke ca riho tèu.

source_text: and he cast him into the abyss, and shut him up, and put a seal on him, that he may no longer lead the nations astray, until the one thousand years may be completed; and after these it is necessary for him to be loosed a short time.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ne tule eele mege naga na asa d'ara ro'a j'aj'èra èèna. ka na segel pamadhe hèb'a ro'a èèna, sèna ka taha mege naga ne ètu d'ara ro'a, toke èle ca riho tèu. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, mege naga ne bisa heka leko-monya suku-suku ètu rai-haha ne, ètu d'ara ca riho tèu. èle èèna ka, heka patabuli ne kèna, te ngaa nare boe nèbhu.

source_text: and i saw thrones, and they that sat on them, and judgment was given to them, and the souls of those who have been beheaded because of the testimony of jesus, and because of the word of god, and who did not worship the beast, nor his image, and did not receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand, and they lived and reigned with the christ one thousand years;
target_text: èle ka, ja'a kèdhi kadera paredha ae-ae, dènge dhèu madhèdi ètu dedha. ama lamatua dhu ded'e si j'aj'i hakim. rèngu se dhu uru èèna lasi lole lii lolo be'a nèti yesus, dènge lii holo-nori ama lamatua, toke dhèu pamadhe si. rèngu se ka dhu sogo-tagu boe badha bhelu dènge mèdha sogo-tagu na. rèngu se dhu ro'o boe sèmi cap nèti badha bhelu ne ètu katangarèi ra, do ètu kacui-aai ra. dhèu pamadhe si, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari si, sèna ka ra rèd'u paredha bera-bera dènge kristus toke ca riho tèu.

source_text: and the rest of the dead did not live again until the one thousand years may be completed; this is the first resurrection. blessed and holy-he who is having part in the first resurrection; the second death has no authority over these, but they will be priests of god and of the christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.
target_text: dènge sèmi ne'e, rèngu se'e ka dhu uru j'ara ama lamatua pamamuri hari si nèti mamadhe. de rèngu oto titu kèna, te rèngu j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua. ra core boe si asa era j'aj'èra èèna, ka ra abhu boe mamadhe ka dua. te rèngu se nuka sèmi ama agama dhu bèli-camèd'a lalau-lalo'o ama lamatua dènge kristus. aa rèngu rèd'u paredha kahèi bera-bera dènge kristus toke d'ai ca riho tèu. te ngaa dhèu madhe dhu leo sèra, hud'i mate ku d'ai ca riho tèu, heka ama lamatua pamamuri hari si kèna.

source_text: and when the one thousand years may be completed, satan will be loosed out of his prison,
target_text: ropa èle ca riho tèu ku, pe lamatua pua patalale mege naga nèti d'ara ro'a j'aj'èra.

source_text: and he will go forth to lead the nations astray, that are in the four corners of the earth-gog and magog-to gather them together to war, of whom the number-as the sand of the sea;
target_text: hèia la'e leko-monya dhèu nèti suku-suku dhu ra peka na, gog dènge magog, dhu mai nèti mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne. pe na pakaboko dhèu ra ho lasi pamusu. dhèu se ae titu kèna, sama sèmi salae ètu nebhe dhasi.

source_text: and they went up over the breadth of the land, and surrounded the camp of the holy ones, and the beloved city, and there came down fire from god out of heaven, and devoured them;
target_text: hèia sordad'u gog dènge magog kako lasi kaj'èu d'ai rae-rae ètu d'ara rai-haha. ka ra reo rare kota lamatua dènge dhèu dhu na sue sèra. te ngaa ama lamatua papuru ai nèti dedha-liru ka na'a pakèpu aa'i sordad'u se'e.

source_text: and the devil, who is leading them astray, was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone where the beast and the false prophet are, and they will be tormented day and night through the ages of the ages.
target_text: ka dhèu unu lamatua sèra kèpe rare dhèu aae nidhu dhu kapod'e nare le dhèu ae. hèia ra core ne asa d'ara dhasi ai èi nasu, dhu heo na loe boe. èèna na, ra bèdho tèke ne sama-sama dènge badha bhelu, aa dènge dhèu nèti lii padhai kapod'e-kabèli èèna. ètu era ne'e, rèngu abhu j'aj'èra loe boe mèu-mèda toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and i saw a great white throne, and him who is sitting on it, from whose face the earth and the sky fled away, and no place was found for them;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a ladhe kèdhi kadera paredha pudhi aae cue. aa ama lamatua ka dhu madhèdi ètu kadera èèna. cag'ag'a laa, rai-haha dènge liru, rai pakaj'èu ka ele aa'i si toke tèdhi heka senu-salao sa hèi.

source_text: and i saw the dead, small and great, standing before god, and scrolls were opened, and another scroll was opened, which is that of the life, and the dead were judged out of the things written in the scrolls-according to their works;
target_text: ka ladhe kèdhi dhèu dhu madhe sèra. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ana iiki-dhèu kapai, titu tangara asa kadera paredha. hèia ana pajuu nèti sorga mai, ka bhoke sasuri-sasuri dhu suri tatao aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu rai-haha ad'u-ue. ka ra bhoke hari sasuri leo èci, dhu suri ngara-ngara dhèu dhu bèli-camèd'a mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua. hèia na pama'ète lii langu nèti dhèu madhe, madhutu ngaa dhu rèngu èci-èci ad'u-ue, nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri sèra.

source_text: and the sea gave up those dead in it, and death and hades gave up the dead in them, and they were judged, each one according to their works;
target_text: ka dhèu madhe sèra mai titu patangara dènge kadera paredha èèna. rèngu se aa'i-aa'i dhu madhe le ètu rai-dedha dènge ètu d'ara dhasi. hèia ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu rèngu èci-èci, madhutu tatao ra.

source_text: and death and hades were cast into the lake of the fire-this is the second death;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua pèci eele mamadhe asa d'ara dhasi ai. aa na core eele kahèi era pea samanga dhèu madhe asa d'ara dhasi ai. te dhasi ai ne, era mamadhe ka dua.

source_text: and if anyone was not found written in the scroll of life, he was cast into the lake of the fire.
target_text: dhèu dhu ngara ra suri boe ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e, lèke core kahèi asa d'ara dhasi ai. te sasuri èèna, nuka dhu suri ngara-ngara dhèu dhu mamuri dènge ama lamatua taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: and i saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth passed away, and the sea is no more;
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi liru dènge rai-haha rupa hiu, te liru dènge rai-haha dhu dhui ele aa'i le. dhasi aad'o heka kahèi.

source_text: and i saw the holy city, new jerusalem, coming down from god out of heaven, made ready as a bride adorned for her husband;
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi kota mola-mèci unu ama lamatua, nuka yerusalem hiu, puru mai nèti sorga. kota ne, dhu pa'èra mema, sama sèmi bhèni dhu neo leo-èmu hiu, dhu lalau nare le iisi, ho la'e soru mone dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu èmu na.

source_text: and i heard a great voice out of heaven, saying, behold, the dwelling place of god is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they will be his peoples, and god himself will be with them as their god,
target_text: ka ja'a tadèngi lii dhu kapai èci mai nèti kadera paredha ne, peka na, ladhe paie-iie! karèi nèti deo ne'e ne, èmu ama lamatua ètu talora aae dhèu rai-haha. karèi nèti deo ne'e ne, lamatua mamuri pa'èci dènge dhèu unu na. te nèngu j'aj'i le ama lamatua ra. aa rèngu j'aj'i le ana-ana na. bèli-camèd'a nèngu bera-bera dènge ra. aa na palere-lere dènge rèngu taa-taa.

source_text: and god will wipe away every tear from their eyes, and there will be no more death, nor sorrow, nor crying, nor will there be anymore pain, because the first things passed away.
