target_text: bèli-camèd'a na seka pamango èi madha aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka rèngu roma iisi heka. lula ètu era èèna, abhu heka papèd'a-tarègu. aa ètu era èèna, abhu heka mamadhe. ngaa-ngaa dhu uru èèna rèti sasusa, aad'o heka èci sa. ngaa-ngaa dhu uru èèna rèti j'aj'èra, ele aa'i si le.

source_text: and he who is sitting on the throne said, behold, i make all things new; and he says to me, write, because these words are true and steadfast;
target_text: hèia nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha èèna, peka na, ladhe paie-iie, te ja'a tao pahiu aa'i le. ka na padhai lii hari dènge ja'a, peka na, suri ka! dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parcaya lii holo-nori ja'a ne, te aa'i-aa'i se mema lèke tare'a-re'a!

source_text: and he said to me, it is done! i am the alpha and the omega, the beginning and the end. to him who is thirsting, i will give of the fountain of the water of life freely.
target_text: ka na peka hari dènge ja'a, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a pajaji sèra, j'aj'i aa'i le. te ja'a ne, alpa toke omega, aa ja'a ne, a toke z, aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru ka, toke d'ai èle. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu koko-kamango, pe ja'a hia ra rinu iia-iia d'ara, nèti madha èi dhu nèti mamuri hia dhèu, sèna ka dhèu sèra bisa mamuri dènge tare'a.

source_text: the one who is overcoming will inherit all things, and i will be his god, and he will be my son.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu taha madhutu j'ara lamatua dhu mola, bèli-camèd'a rèngu unu mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i ra. pe ja'a j'aj'i ama lamatua ra, aa rèngu j'aj'i ana-ana ja'a.

source_text: but to fearful, and unsteadfast, and abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all the liars, their part is in the lake that is burning with fire and brimstone, which is the second death.
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi dhèu dhu èèna na lèke core si, asa d'ara dhasi ai èi nasu dhu heo na ma'ète boe ciki sa. nuka sèmi: dhèu dhu madha'u leli, dhèu dhu soro kabodho mi lamatua yesus, dhèu d'ara kaj'alu, dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, dhèu pamadhe dhèu, dhèu sogo-tagu nidhu, dhèu suagi, aa dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. bèli-camèd'a rèngu aa'i-aa'i lèke pèci asa d'ara dhasi ai, dhu ra peka na, ‘era mamadhe ka dua. '

source_text: and one of the seven messengers, having the seven bowls that are full of the seven last plagues, came and spoke with me, saying, come, i will show you the bride, the wife of the lamb,
target_text: ka ja'a ladhe kèdhi ca dhèu nèti ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga, dhu uru èèna rèd'u bokor dhu isi dènge nanasa lamatua. na mai paraga dènge ja'a, ka na lii, peka na, mai ku sa ne'e! te ja'a neo pad'elo dènge èu bhèni dhu neo kab'i dènge ana kalèbho.

source_text: and he carried me away in the spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the great city, the holy jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from god,
target_text: hèia ja'a abhu roh lamatua, ka ana pajuu ca dhèu nèti sorga mai nedhe nèti ja'a asa kolo ledhe dhu dedha aae èci. nèti era ne'e, na pad'elo ja'a kota yerusalem, nuka kota ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, dhu puru mai nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: having the glory of god, and her light-like a most precious stone, as a jasper stone clear as crystal,
target_text: kota ne saraga titu kèna! abhu saraa dhu kalua nèti dadedha ama lamatua sèmi hadhu intan dhu kale'e, toke kota aa'i-aa'i heo lo'a-lo'a.

source_text: also having a great and high wall, having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve messengers, and names written thereon, which are those of the twelve tribes of the sons of israel-
target_text: abhu tedhe dhu dedha aae oke nare kota ne, dènge canguru dua babèdho. abhu kahèi canguru dua ana pajuu nèti sorga dhu madhenge babèdho kapai se. ètu canguru dua babèdho se, dhu suri ngara-ngara nèti canguru dua udhu-rasa isra'el.

source_text: at the east three gates, at the north three gates, at the south three gates, at the west three gates;
target_text: tèlu babèdho tangara asa dhimu. tèlu tangara asa haa. tèlu tangara asa badae. aa tèlu hari tangara asa balèu.

source_text: and the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them names of the twelve apostles of the lamb.
target_text: tedhe ne dhu patitu ètu canguru dua hadhu fanderen dhu kapai. ètu hadhu se èci-èci dhu suri ngara nèti canguru dua dhèu pajuu-paleha ana kalèbho dhu lalau-lalo'o ne ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and he who is speaking with me had a golden reed, that he may measure the city, and its gates, and its wall;
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu padhai lii dènge ja'a, kèpe nare tatea a'uku nèti hualaa èci, ho neo uku kota ne dènge hèb'a babèdho kapai, aa dènge tedhe na.

source_text: and the city lies square, and the length of it is as great as the breadth; and he measured the city with the reed-twelve thousand stadia; the length, and the breadth, and the height of it are equal.
target_text: na uku uru tedhe kota. madhera, bhabhèla dènge katitu na, èci èèna ka. nuka, aa'i-aa'i ra, 2. dua riho dua ngasu dua nguru kilometer.

source_text: and he measured its wall-one hundred forty-four cubits, the measure of a man, that is, of the messenger;
target_text: hèia na uku ma'aa tedhe, madhutu a'uku dhèu rai-haha. ma'aa na, èna nguru lèmi meter.

source_text: and the building of its wall was jasper, and the city is pure gold-like to pure glass.
target_text: tedhe ne, tao nèti hadhu kale'e, ngara na yaspis. aa aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara kota ne, tao nèti poe dènge pai, dhu mèu aadha-aadha nuka sèmi tèru.

source_text: and the foundations of the wall of the city have been adorned with every precious stone: the first foundation jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
target_text: canguru dua hadhu fanderen sèra, tao nèti rupa-rupa hadhu kale'e dhu kab'ua. fanderen ka èci, tao nèti hadhu yaspis, dhu mangèru kale'e. ka dua, nèti hadhu nilam dhu kale'e mangèru bhidhu-bhidhu. ka tèlu, tao nèti hadhu mirah dhu mea kale'e. ka èpa, tao nèti hadhu samrud, dhu mangèru kale'e.

source_text: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, the twelfth amethyst.
target_text: ka lèmi, tao nèti hadhu unam dhu pakatanga dènge karara mea sanama pudhi. ka èna, dhu tao nèti hadhu sardius, dhu mea kale'e. ka pidhu, tao nèti ratna cempaka dhu karara hualaa. ka aru, dhu tao nèti hadhu beril, dhu kale'e mangèru aae. ka ceo, tao nèti hadhu krisolit, dhu karara moce-moce. ka canguru, tao nèti hadhu krisopras dhu mangèru mud'a. ka canguru èci, tao nèti hadhu lasuardi, dhu mangèru dhasi. aa ka canguru dua, tao nèti hadhu kecubung, dhu kale'e mea sanama mangèru.

source_text: and the twelve gates are twelve pearls, each one of the gates respectively was of one pearl; and the street of the city is pure gold-as transparent glass.
target_text: aa babèdho kapai canguru dua bua sèra, tao nèti canguru bua mutiara. babèdho èci tao nèti mutiara cue. j'ara oka-hoo ètu d'ara kota ne, tao nèti poe-pai dhu kale'e sèmi tèru.

source_text: and i did not see a temple in it, for the lord god, the almighty, and the lamb, are its temple.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a kèdhi boe èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara kota ne. lula ama lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi dènge ana kalèbho pea taa-taa ètu d'ara kota ne. nèti èèna ka, dhèu pahaha iisi mema mi rèngu.

source_text: and the city has no need of the sun, nor of the moon, that they may shine in it; for the glory of god lightens it, and the lamp of it-the lamb;
target_text: kota èèna, parluu boe madha lod'o dènge hèru ho pasaraa ne, lula saraa ama lamatua ka dhu pasaraa ne. aa ana kalèbho ne j'aj'i nuka sèmi labhu dhu heo.

source_text: and the nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth bring their glory and honor into it,
target_text: dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, èèna na kako lasi mai ètu d'ara saraa èèna. dhèu aae-dhèu aae nèti rai-haha, rèti kakaja-sasu'i ra asa nèi kahèi.

source_text: and its gates will never be shut by day, for night will not be there;
target_text: ètu era nèi, abhu boe mèda. nèti èèna ka, parluu boe bèdho hèb'a tedhe.

source_text: and they will bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it;
target_text: pe asa d'ara kota ne, dhèu rèti aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a kahèi, dènge hormat aa'i-aa'i nèti rai-rai ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and there may never enter into it anything defiling and doing abomination, and a lie, if not those written in the lamb's scroll of life.
target_text: te ngaa dhu bisa boe maso asa nèi, nuka aa'i-aa'i dhu karehe, nuka sèmi: dhèu sogo-tagu nidhu, dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae, dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. dhu bisa maso, nuka rèngu dhu ngara ra abhu ètu d'ara sasuri ana kalèbho. rèngu se'e ka dhu mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: and he showed me the river of the water of life, radiant as crystal, going forth out of the throne of god and of the lamb
target_text: èle ka ana pajuu nèti sorga pad'elo dènge ja'a loko èci, dhu èi ne nèti mamuri. èi ne mèu aadha-aadha nuka sèmi tèru. na hae mai nèti kadera paredha ama lamatua dènge ana kalèbho.

source_text: in the midst of its street, and of the river on this side and on that-the tree of life, producing twelve fruits, yielding its fruit according to each month, and the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations;
target_text: hèia hae la'e asa talora aae j'ara oka-hoo ètu d'ara kota ne. nèti sebhe-sebhe loko ne, abhu aj'u dhu hua na nèti mamuri. aj'u ne d'ara ca tèu, hua canguru dua hari; ca hèru, ca tèka. rèu na bisa j'aj'i èi na'i ho puri-pa'èle suku-suku ètu rai-haha nèti papèd'a ra.

source_text: and there will no longer be any curse, and the throne of god and of the lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him,
target_text: te ngaa rèngu dhu ama lamatua tule eele aa dhoo si, abhu boe ètu d'ara kota ne. dhu ètu ne'e, nuka ama lamatua dènge ana kalèbho dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha, aa dènge ana pua-paleha ra dhu pahaha iisi mi rèngu.

source_text: and they will see his face, and his name is on their foreheads,
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i bisa ladhe rèdhi rèhu ama lamatua. ètu katangarèi dhèu se'e, dhu suri ngara lamatua.

source_text: and there will be no night there, and they have no need of the light of a lamp and of the light of the sun, because the lord god gives them light, and they will reign through the ages of the ages.
target_text: mèda abhu boe ètu kota ne'e. de dhèu unu lamatua parluu boe madha lod'o, do labhu, lula ama lamatua ka dhu pasaraa kota ne. bèli-camèd'a rèngu sama-sama rèd'u paredha toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: and he said to me, these words are steadfast and true, and the lord god of the holy prophets sent his messenger to show to his servants the things that must come quickly.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ne peka dènge ja'a, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a peka kore dènge èu se'e, lèke tare'a-re'a. dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parcaya lii ja'a se. uru èèna, ama lamatua pake roh na ho peka-padhai lii holo-nori na mi dhèu rèti lii padhai na. te ngaa limuri ne, na pake ana pajuu na nèti sorga ho lole mi dhèu unu na, lula-nèti j'ara aa'i-aa'i se dhu nèbhu heka hud'i j'aj'i ku.

source_text: behold, i come quickly; blessed is he who is keeping the words of the prophecy of this scroll.
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii, peka na, sanèd'e paie-iie! nèbhu heka, te ja'a neo mai. ètu d'ara sasuri ne, dhu suri aa'i mèu-mèu le, ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu isi sasuri ne, pe rèngu abhu a'oto.

source_text: and i, john, am he who is seeing these things and hearing, and when i heard and beheld, i fell down to worship before the feet of the messenger who is showing me these things;
target_text: dhu suri sasuri ne, nuka ja'a, yohanis. aa'i-aa'i se ja'a nanene dènge ro'a dhilu ja'a, aa kèdhi dènge musi madha ja'a. ropa tadèngi kore, hèia ja'a patitu kètu urutuu ho pahaha iisi ètu madha ana pajuu nèti sorga ne, dhu pad'elo le aa'i-aa'i se mi ja'a.

source_text: and he says to me, behold-no! for i am your fellow servant, and of your brothers the prophets, and of those keeping the words of this scroll; worship god.
target_text: te ngaa na kai ja'a, peka na, ee! èu baku tao sèmi èèna! èu dhodhoka pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua di! baku mi ja'a ne. te ja'a ne ènu lamatua kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge èu dènge a'ari èu dhu j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai na, aa dènge dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i ra dhu tao madhutu ngaa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e.

source_text: and he says to me, you may not seal the words of the prophecy of this scroll, because the time is near.
target_text: èu baku pahuni isi sasuri ne dènge dhèu leo. te nèbhu heka, aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne, hud'i j'aj'i ku.

source_text: the one being unrighteous-let him be unrighteous still; and the filthy-let him be filthy still; and the righteous-let him do righteousness still; and the holy-let him be holy still.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu, na, hud'i rèngu sène ra tao kaj'alu taruu. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri mola-mèci, hud'i laa ra mamuri mola taruu. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao karehe, hud'i rèngu sène ra tao bhelu taruu. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu tao be'a, hud'i laa ra tao taruu dhu be'a.

source_text: behold, i come quickly, and my reward is with me, to render to each as his work will be;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lii hari, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e paie! te nèbhu heka, ja'a dhiu. pe ja'a b'ala hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i, madhutu ngaa dhu ra ad'u-ue.

source_text: i am the alpha and the omega-the beginning and end-the first and the last.
target_text: ja'a ne, alpa toke omega. ja'a ne, a toke z. aa'i-aa'i j'aj'aj'i ra nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru, toke d'ai èle.

source_text: blessed are those washing their robes that the authority will be theirs to the tree of life, and they may enter into the city by the gates;
target_text: dhèu dhu rase pamèu le mèdha-papake ra, rèngu ka dhu oto. te rèngu ka abhu hak ho maso re babèdho kapai dhu la'e asa d'ara kota ne. dhèu dhu mamuri mola, rèngu ka dhu oto. te bèli-camèd'a rèngu abhu ijin ho ra'a hua dhu hia dhèu mamuri taa-taa.

source_text: and outside are the dogs, and the sorcerers, and the whoremongers, and the murderers, and the idolaters, and everyone cherishing and doing falsehood.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo bisa boe maso asa era èèna. dhèu dhu unu boe lamatua, bisa boe pea ètu era èèna. nuka rèngu dhu parcaya boe lamatua, dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, tuka sogo-tagu, tuka pamadhe dhèu, tuka suagi, dènge rèngu dhu leko-monya. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa boe ara asa d'ara. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pea dhoka mi li'u di.

source_text: i, jesus, sent my messenger to testify to you these things concerning the assemblies; i am the root and the offspring of david, the radiant morning star!
target_text: ja'a ne, yesus. ja'a ka dhu paleha ana pajuu ja'a nèti sorga, ho bhoke j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka pe miu lami lole peka lii pajaji ja'a se'e mi pidhu juma'at sèra. ja'a ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. ja'a ne, dhèu aae dhu kèd'u paredha. saraa nèti ja'a heo lo'a-lo'a, nuka sèmi hua-hètu oe mèu. saraa nèti ja'a madèka titu kèna, nuka sèmi hua-hètu èèna.

source_text: and the spirit and the bride say, come! and he who is hearing-let him say, come! and he who is thirsting-let him come; and he who is willing-let him take the water of life freely.
target_text: roh ama lamatua mai paroa, peka na, mai asa ne'e! bhèni dhu neo kab'i paroa kahèi, peka na, mai ka! aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi peka kahèi, mai ka! dhèu cee dhu koko-kamango, mai ho minu! dhèu cee dhu neo ninu èi dhu nèti mamuri, mai mere ka! dhèu bisa rare èi ne dhu iia-iia d'ara. dhèu bisa rinu èi ne dhu b'ae boe.

source_text: for i testify to everyone hearing the words of the prophecy of this scroll, if anyone may add to these, god will add to him the plagues that have been written in this scroll,
target_text: ja'a, yohanis, pasanèd'e dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na tadèngi ngaa dhu ama lamatua bhoke mema hia ja'a ètu d'ara sasuri ne: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu patabha hari ngaa-ngaa ètu d'ara sasuri ne, èèna na ama lamatua pabie hari hahuku na mi nèngu dènge pidhu calaka sèra dhu na dutu mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: and if anyone may take away from the words of the scroll of this prophecy, god will take away his part from the scroll of life, and out of the holy city, and the things that have been written in this scroll.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhu pakura hari isi sasuri ne, pe ama lamatua tao eele hak nèngu, sèna ka bisa boe maso asa d'ara kota dhu mola-mèci, aa bisa boe na'a hua aj'u dhu hia dhèu mamuri taa-taa.

source_text: the one testifying to these things says, yes, i come quickly! amen. come, lord jesus!
target_text: yesus mesa na ka dhu bhoke j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra. na moa le, peka na, tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna! nèbhu heka, ja'a neo dhiu. de mai ka, lamatua yesus!

source_text: the grace of our lord jesus christ is with all the holy ones. amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka lamatua yesus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu unu na aa'i-aa'i. lèke tare'a sèmi èèna! amin! nèti ja'a, yohanis
